paras.en: Patients with diabetic chronic kidney disease who took semaglutide were less likely to wind up in kidney failure, or die from a heart attack or stroke, than those taking a placebo, researchers reported in 2024 in the New England Journal of Medicine. That trial was stopped early, as the drug was so effective at preventing death that doctors no longer considered it ethical to keep giving participants the placebo.
paras.zh: 研究人员于 2024 年在《新英格兰医学杂志》上报道，与服用安慰剂的患者相比，服用索马鲁肽的糖尿病慢性肾病患者最终出现肾衰竭、死于心脏病或中风的可能性较小。该试验提前停止，因为该药物在预防死亡方面非常有效，以至于医生不再认为继续给参与者服用安慰剂是合乎道德的。

paras.en: For the new study, some of those same researchers then looked at a subset of 106 participants to find out how the drug worked. The team collected kidney tissue samples before and after the participants took semaglutide, and compared them with samples from participants given the placebo. Semaglutide use led to striking visible changes in the tissues, including increased blood flow, reduced scarring and reduced blood vessel stiffness, a measure of vessel health.
paras.zh: 在这项新研究中，其中一些研究人员对 106 名参与者进行了观察，以了解该药物的作用原理。研究小组收集了参与者服用索马鲁肽前后的肾组织样本，并将其与服用安慰剂的参与者的样本进行了比较。索马鲁肽的使用导致组织发生显着的明显变化，包括血流量增加、疤痕减少和血管硬度降低（衡量血管健康的指标）。

paras.en: Increased blood flow is important because it increases filtration, which is the kidneys’ main job, says Peter Nguyen, a nephrologist at Houston Methodist Hospital who was not involved in the study.
paras.zh: 休斯顿卫理公会医院的肾病专家彼得·阮（Peter Nguyen）没有参与这项研究，他说，增加血流量很重要，因为它可以增加过滤，而过滤是肾脏的主要工作。

paras.en: Researchers also looked at levels of a protein, called albumin, in patients’ urine. High levels can be an early sign that the kidneys’ filters aren’t working well. While those levels didn’t change much in those on the placebo, they dropped in patients taking semaglutide ― a sign the filters weren’t quite as leaky any more.
paras.zh: 研究人员还研究了患者尿液中一种称为白蛋白的蛋白质的水平。高水平可能是肾脏过滤器无法正常工作的早期迹象。虽然服用安慰剂的患者的这些水平没有太大变化，但服用索马鲁肽的患者的这些水平有所下降——这表明过滤器不再那么渗漏了。

paras.en: The team then looked under the hood for genetic clues to how semaglutide appeared to heal the kidneys. Within the glomerulus, the tiny blood vessels responsible for the kidney’s filtering action, genes relating to metabolic stress were turned off, Katherine Tuttle, a nephrologist at the University of Washington’s Providence Medical Research Center in Spokane, and colleagues found. Within these same cells, inflammatory genes were also turned off, while repair genes were switched on.
paras.zh: 然后，研究小组深入寻找索马鲁肽如何治愈肾脏的遗传线索。华盛顿大学斯波坎普罗维登斯医学研究中心的肾病学家凯瑟琳·塔特尔及其同事发现，在肾小球内，负责肾脏过滤作用的微小血管、与代谢压力相关的基因被关闭。在这些相同的细胞内，炎症基因也被关闭，而修复基因被打开。

paras.en: The researchers also looked at a subset of genes responsible for cells “talking” to each other within the glomerulus. Before semaglutide, the blood vessels and immune cells were “chattering” with each other, sending lots of inflammatory signals, Tuttle says. After semaglutide, the immune cells went quiet, silencing the messages that ramp up harmful inflammation. These changes in gene activity point to a healthier kidney that’s less stressed and inflamed, and that has had repair processes flipped on.
paras.zh: 研究人员还研究了负责肾小球内细胞相互“交谈”的基因子集。塔特尔说，在索马鲁肽之前，血管和免疫细胞彼此“喋喋不休”，发送大量炎症信号。服用索马鲁肽后，免疫细胞变得安静，消除了加剧有害炎症的信息。这些基因活性的变化表明肾脏更健康，压力和炎症更少，并且修复过程已启动。

paras.en: With semaglutide treatment, Tuttle says, patients’ damaged kidneys showed clear signs of repair.
paras.zh: 塔特尔说，通过索马鲁肽治疗，患者受损的肾脏显示出明显的修复迹象。

articles.title: Toxic secrets are hiding in Arctic ice
articles.author: Katherine Kornei

paras.en: Ice cores record Earth’s secrets, even the dirty ones.
paras.zh: 冰芯记录着地球的秘密，甚至是肮脏的秘密。

paras.en: Some of the cylindrical sections of ice extracted from the Arctic contain elevated levels of arsenic, lead and other heavy metals that circulated in our planet’s atmosphere in the late 19th and early 20th centuries. Those pollutants, which have been tied to declines in IQ and higher rates of certain cancers, were probably emitted by a mining and smelting company in Montana whose grounds are now designated as multiple Superfund sites, the researchers report November 3 in Nature Sustainability.
paras.zh: 从北极提取的一些圆柱形冰块含有较高含量的砷、铅和其他重金属，这些重金属在 19 世纪末和 20 世纪初在地球大气层中循环。研究人员于 11 月 3 日在《自然可持续发展》杂志上报告称，这些污染物可能是蒙大拿州一家采矿和冶炼公司排放的，这些污染物与智商下降和某些癌症发病率较高有关，该公司的场地现已被指定为多个超级基金地点。

paras.en: The ice cores contain tiny particles that were once airborne — including pollutants, volcanic ash and salt from ocean spray — and fell to our planet’s surface within a few days or weeks. In polar regions, that fallout combines with snow and is preserved as ice.
paras.zh: 冰芯含有曾经在空气中传播的微小颗粒，包括污染物、火山灰和海洋喷雾中的盐分，并在几天或几周内落到地球表面。在极地地区，沉降物与雪结合并以冰的形式保存下来。

paras.en: Joseph McConnell, an environmental scientist at the Desert Research Institute, and his collaborators recently analyzed 10 ice cores collected across Canada, Greenland and Russia. The cores contained material that had fallen to Earth as early as 210 BCE, but the interval spanning the Industrial Revolution in the United States — from roughly 1870 to 1914 — was what caught the team’s collective eye.
paras.zh: 沙漠研究所的环境科学家约瑟夫·麦康奈尔 (Joseph McConnell) 和他的合作者最近分析了在加拿大、格陵兰岛和俄罗斯收集的 10 个冰芯。这些核心包含早在公元前 210 年就掉落到地球的物质，但美国工业革命期间（大约从 1870 年到 1914 年）引起了团队的集体关注。

paras.en: In the ice layers from that period, arsenic concentrations in some of the ice cores were up to 15 times higher than pre-Industrial Revolution levels. Because the heavy metal exposure has been tied to upticks in the rates of certain cancers, McConnell and his team set out to determine the most likely source of all that pollution.
paras.zh: 在那个时期的冰层中，一些冰芯中的砷浓度比工业革命前的水平高出 15 倍。由于重金属暴露与某些癌症发病率上升有关，麦康奈尔和他的团队着手确定所有这些污染最可能的来源。

paras.en: The largest increases in arsenic existed in the ice cores from Greenland. That finding was a big hint, McConnell says, because atmospheric circulation patterns tend to move material from west to east. “The only way you can explain that pattern of deposition is if the emissions are coming from North America,” McConnell says. “Had it been from Europe, we would have seen much larger increases in the Russian Arctic.”
paras.zh: 砷含量增加最多的是格陵兰岛的冰芯。麦康奈尔说，这一发现是一个重要的暗示，因为大气环流模式往往会将物质从西向东移动。 “可以解释这种沉积模式的唯一方法是排放是否来自北美，”麦康奈尔说。 “如果它来自欧洲，我们会看到俄罗斯北极地区的增幅要大得多。”

paras.en: The most likely source, the team concluded, was a massive copper mining and smelting operation in southwestern Montana operated by the Anaconda Copper Mining Company. It was one of the largest in North America during the Industrial Revolution and, unlike other copper mining operations in the area, it worked with copper ore that contained heavy metals like arsenic and lead. It was no secret that those toxic metals were entering the atmosphere, says Fred Quivik, a historian and the author of Smoke and Tailings, a book about the environmental history of copper smelting in Montana. “Ranchers and farmers started seeing their livestock die from arsenic poisoning.”
paras.zh: 研究小组得出结论，最有可能的来源是蒙大拿州西南部由阿纳康达铜矿公司运营的大型铜矿开采和冶炼厂。它是工业革命期间北美最大的铜矿开采企业之一，与该地区其他铜矿开采作业不同，它开采的铜矿石含有砷和铅等重金属。历史学家、《烟雾与尾矿》一书的作者 Fred Quivik 说，这些有毒金属正在进入大气层，这已经不是什么秘密了，该书是一本关于蒙大拿州铜冶炼环境历史的书。 “牧场主和农民开始看到他们的牲畜死于砷中毒。”

paras.en: Based on the concentrations of arsenic in the ice cores and models of how material disperses in the atmosphere, McConnell and his colleagues estimated that the Anaconda Copper Mining Company was emitting roughly 30 tons of arsenic per day into the atmosphere in the late 19th and early 20th centuries. By comparison, Chile, currently the world’s largest producer of copper and home to more than 20 mining operations, collectively emits roughly one quarter as much arsenic today.
paras.zh: 根据冰芯中砷的浓度以及物质在大气中扩散的模型，麦康奈尔和他的同事估计，Anaconda 铜矿公司在 19 世纪末和 20 世纪初每天向大气中排放大约 30 吨砷。相比之下，目前世界上最大的铜生产国、拥有 20 多个采矿作业的智利，其砷排放量仅为目前的四分之一左右。

paras.en: Beginning in 1919, the Anaconda Copper Mining Company installed devices near its smokestacks and other facilities to capture arsenic and prevent its release into the atmosphere. Arsenic emissions dropped by about 60 percent as a result, the ice core data showed, but by then hundreds of thousands of nearby residents had already been exposed for decades. That exposure could have been lessened, McConnell says, if the Anaconda Copper Mining Company hadn’t waited so long to install the pollution-abatement technology. “They delayed installation for about a decade.”
paras.zh: 从 1919 年开始，Anaconda 铜矿公司在其烟囱和其他设施附近安装了装置，以捕获砷并防止其释放到大气中。冰芯数据显示，砷排放量因此下降了约 60%，但到那时附近数十万居民已经暴露在砷中数十年了。麦康奈尔说，如果阿纳康达铜矿公司没有等这么久才安装污染减排技术，这种暴露可能会减少。 “他们将安装推迟了大约十年。”

paras.en: These new findings should be combined with census records to trace the effects of this pollution on human health in the 19th and 20th centuries, McConnell and his team suggest. “We hope that epidemiologists will take this information and really investigate potential impacts on human populations.”
paras.zh: 麦康奈尔和他的团队建议，这些新发现应与人口普查记录相结合，以追踪这种污染对 19 世纪和 20 世纪人类健康的影响。 “我们希望流行病学家能够利用这些信息并真正调查对人类的潜在影响。”

articles.title: A Mysterious Object in Space Pulsed Every 62 Minutes. Then It Vanished.
articles.author: Michelle Starr

paras.en: In September of 2002, a mystery emerged from the heart of the Milky Way.
paras.zh: 2002年9月，银河系中心出现了一个谜团。

paras.en: Something spat out five flares of powerful radio waves, precisely timed 77 minutes apart. Then, it fell silent.
paras.zh: 有什么东西喷出了五道强大的无线电波，时间间隔精确为 77 分钟。然后，就陷入了沉默。

paras.en: Astronomer Scott Hyman of Sweet Briar College wasn't quite sure what to make of it. He spent years looking for another, without much success, ultimately turning his attention to other work.
paras.zh: 斯威特布莱尔学院的天文学家斯科特·海曼不太确定如何理解这一点。他花了数年时间寻找另一份工作，但没有取得太大成功，最终将注意力转向其他工作。

paras.en: Twenty years later, while looking for something else, it happened again. There, in the data, every 62.2 minutes – another powerful flare of radio waves from a mysterious source.
paras.zh: 二十年后，在寻找别的东西时，同样的事情又发生了。在数据中，每 62.2 分钟就会有一次来自神秘来源的强大无线电波耀斑。

paras.en: But the new discovery offers tantalizing clues about what might be producing these strange signals, known as long-period transients (LPTs) – and whether they all come from the same kind of object.
paras.zh: 但这项新发现提供了一些诱人的线索，说明什么可能产生这些奇怪的信号，即长周期瞬变信号（LPT），以及它们是否都来自同一类型的物体。

paras.en: "Are all LPTs one type of object?" Hyman told ScienceAlert. "Do they represent a new subcategory of white dwarfs or neutron stars? An entirely hitherto unknown type of object?"
paras.zh: “所有 LPT 都是一种对象吗？”海曼告诉 ScienceAlert。 “它们是否代表白矮星或中子星的新子类别？一种迄今为止完全未知的天体类型？”

paras.en: The long-period transient is a newly recognized class of radio source that has only become apparent in the last few years – unidentified objects that emit long, bright pulses of radio waves with regular, lengthy pauses between each emission.
paras.zh: 长周期瞬变是一类新近被认可的无线电源，在过去几年中才变得明显——不明物体发出长而明亮的无线电波脉冲，每次发射之间有规律的、长时间的停顿。

paras.en: The discovery that established the category was GLEAM-X J1627-5235 – observed in 2018, and first reported in 2022.
paras.zh: 确立该类别的发现是 GLEAM-X J1627-5235——于 2018 年观察到，并于 2022 年首次报道。

paras.en: Since then, around a dozen of the mystery pulsators have emerged in surveys of the radio sky, across the Milky Way, including – retroactively – Hyman's first, weird observation, GCRT J1745-3009.
paras.zh: 从那时起，在对银河系射电天空的勘测中，大约出现了十几个神秘脉动器，其中包括海曼的第一个奇怪的观测结果，GCRT J1745-3009。

paras.en: "It is very gratifying to read about every new LPT detection after so many years coming up empty monitoring for similar objects to the GCRT," Hyman said.
paras.zh: 海曼说：“在这么多年对与 GCRT 类似的物体进行空监测之后，读到每一次新的 LPT 检测都是非常令人欣慰的。”

paras.en: But it's proven more difficult than you might think to pin an identity on these strange emitters.
paras.zh: 但事实证明，给这些奇怪的发射器确定身份比你想象的要困难得多。

paras.en: There are several known types of dead stars that pulse in periodic fashion, but none can comfortably explain the full range of behavior exhibited by LPTs.
paras.zh: 有几种已知类型的死恒星以周期性方式脉冲，但没有一种可以轻松地解释 LPT 所表现出的全部行为。

paras.en: There are three leading contenders: pulsars and magnetars, which are neutron stars whose radio emissions are powered by different mechanisms; and white dwarfs, which can periodically lash out through interactions with a binary companion.
paras.zh: 存在三个主要竞争者：脉冲星和磁星，它们是中子星，其无线电发射由不同的机制提供动力；和白矮星，它们可以通过与双星伴星的相互作用定期进行攻击。

paras.en: Pulsars are rapidly spinning neutron stars that sweep beams of radio emission across space like cosmic lighthouses, on short timescales that match their rotation.
paras.zh: 脉冲星是快速旋转的中子星，它们像宇宙灯塔一样在太空中扫射无线电发射束，其时间尺度与其旋转相匹配。

paras.en: Magnetars are their more intensely magnetic cousins, capable of generating powerful bursts of radiation as their magnetic fields twist and rearrange.
paras.zh: 磁星是它们的近亲，磁性更强，能够在磁场扭曲和重新排列时产生强大的辐射爆发。

paras.en: But LPTs pulse extraordinarily slowly by neutron star standards – sometimes taking hours between flashes.
paras.zh: 但按照中子星的标准，LPT的脉冲速度非常慢——有时两次闪光之间需要几个小时。

paras.en: At such leisurely rotation rates, conventional pulsars should struggle to generate the conditions needed to produce radio emission at all.
paras.zh: 在如此缓慢的旋转速度下，传统脉冲星应该很难产生产生无线电发射所需的条件。

paras.en: These stellar remnants are larger and can rotate much more slowly, and interactions with a companion star can generate powerful radio signals. Indeed, some LPTs have been linked to white dwarf binary systems.
paras.zh: 这些恒星残骸更大，旋转速度更慢，与伴星的相互作用可以产生强大的无线电信号。事实上，一些 LPT 已与白矮星双星系统联系在一起。

paras.en: But that doesn't mean all LPTs are white dwarfs.
paras.zh: 但这并不意味着所有LPT都是白矮星。

paras.en: Their diverse pulse patterns, polarization, and periods raise the possibility that more than one physical mechanism – and perhaps more than one kind of object – could be responsible.
paras.zh: 它们不同的脉冲模式、极化和周期提出了一种可能性：不止一种物理机制——也许不止一种物体——可能是造成这种现象的原因。

paras.en: It was into this mess that a strange new signal arrived in 2022, photobombing Hyman's new research focus.
paras.zh: 正是在这种混乱之中，2022 年一个奇怪的新信号到来，对海曼的新研究焦点进行了照片轰炸。

paras.en: By then, he had turned his attention to a search for millisecond pulsars – rapidly spinning neutron stars that might help explain an excess of gamma rays from the center of the Milky Way.
paras.zh: 那时，他已将注意力转向寻找毫秒脉冲星——快速旋转的中子星，这可能有助于解释银河系中心过量的伽马射线。

paras.en: But one candidate in the data was behaving rather strangely.
paras.zh: 但数据中的一位候选人表现得相当奇怪。

paras.en: "One object that we detected in archival observations of the MeerKAT telescope had pulsar-like properties, but the 'pulses' occurred many minutes apart, and at seemingly regular intervals," Hyman said.
paras.zh: 海曼说：“我们在 MeerKAT 望远镜的档案观测中发现的一个物体具有类似脉冲星的特性，但‘脉冲’相隔许多分钟，而且似乎每隔一定的时间间隔发生。”

paras.en: "We searched other archives, and found that the ASKAP telescope had been observing the same region of the sky on exactly the same day. This observation was 10 hours long and confirmed a 62-minute period. Together with its other properties, that's when we realized we had stumbled on an LPT."
paras.zh: “我们搜索了其他档案，发现 ASKAP 望远镜在同一天一直在观测天空的同一区域。这次观测持续了 10 个小时，并确认了 62 分钟的周期。结合它的其他特性，我们意识到我们偶然发现了 LPT。”

paras.en: True to its main character energy, however, it had a few surprises up its polarized sleeve.
paras.zh: 然而，正如其主角的能量一样，它的两极分化的袖子里也有一些惊喜。

paras.en: Rather than emitting just one burst every 62 minutes, LPT J1555-5631 produced two distinct pulses during each cycle – one longer, one shorter.
paras.zh: LPT J1555-5631 不是每 62 分钟仅发射一次脉冲，而是在每个周期内产生两个不同的脉冲 - 一个较长，一个较短。

paras.en: Even stranger, the two pulses showed opposite circular polarization: the radio waves from one pulse twisted in one direction, while those from the other twisted in the opposite direction.
paras.zh: 更奇怪的是，这两个脉冲表现出相反的圆偏振：一个脉冲的无线电波向一个方向扭曲，而另一个脉冲的无线电波向相反的方向扭曲。

paras.en: That gave the researchers a tantalizing clue about the object's magnetic field.
paras.zh: 这为研究人员提供了有关该物体磁场的诱人线索。

paras.en: "These properties indicate that the emission arises from regions near both magnetic poles, and that the rotation and magnetic axes of the object are nearly perpendicular to each other," Hyman explained.
paras.zh: 海曼解释说：“这些特性表明发射来自两个磁极附近的区域，并且物体的旋转轴和磁轴几乎彼此垂直。”

paras.en: This means there's something rather hinky going on with LPT J1555-5631 – because the pulses aren't quite evenly spaced. Instead of appearing 180 degrees apart, as might be expected from a simple dipolar magnetic field, they're separated by just 165.4 degrees.
paras.zh: 这意味着 LPT J1555-5631 发生了一些相当奇怪的事情——因为脉冲间隔不太均匀。它们不像简单的偶极磁场那样看起来相距 180 度，而是仅相距 165.4 度。

paras.en: "A 180-degree separation would more easily be explained by emission from a standard dipolar magnetosphere environment," Hyman said. "The observed deviation is an important clue pointing to a more complicated magnetic field structure."
paras.zh: 海曼说：“180 度的分离更容易用标准偶极磁层环境的发射来解释。” “观察到的偏差是指向更复杂的磁场结构的重要线索。”

paras.en: And there's one other big, glaring mystery in the room: why LPTs erupt with such clockwork regularity, only to fall silent – and whether any of them can get restless again later.
paras.zh: 房间里还有另一个巨大而引人注目的谜团：为什么LPT会以如此有规律的规律爆发，然后又陷入沉默——以及它们中的任何一个是否会在以后再次变得焦躁不安。

paras.en: LPT J1555-5631, like most of the LPT catalog, has not yet been detected again. GCRT J1745-3009, on the other hand, has shown repeat activity – as have two others.
paras.zh: LPT J1555-5631 与大多数 LPT 目录一样，尚未再次被检测到。另一方面，GCRT J1745-3009 已显示出重复活动——其他两个也是如此。

paras.en: Hyman said that such dramatic changes in activity likely have something to do with the object's magnetosphere – the region around it dominated by its magnetic field – but a larger catalog of LPTs might be needed for patterns to emerge in the data, giving astronomers something to start pulling apart.
paras.zh: 海曼表示，这种剧烈的活动变化可能与该物体的磁层（其周围由其磁场主导的区域）有关，但可能需要更大的 LPT 目录才能在数据中出现模式，从而为天文学家提供一些可以开始分解的东西。

paras.en: "After many more LPTs are discovered, we hopefully will uncover more trends between them that allow us to make targeted searches of suspected LPTs," Hyman said.
paras.zh: 海曼说：“在发现更多的 LPT 后，我们希望能够发现它们之间的更多趋势，使我们能够对可疑的 LPT 进行有针对性的搜索。”

paras.en: "That would be exciting, although so are continued discoveries from blind searches of the archives and serendipity."
paras.zh: “这将是令人兴奋的，尽管盲目搜索档案和偶然发现的不断发现也是令人兴奋的。”

paras.en: The research has been published in The Astrophysical Journal.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《天体物理学杂志》上。

articles.title: Secrets of Earth's Oldest Animals Preserved by Ancient Underwater Canyons, Study Finds
articles.author: Russell McLendon

paras.en: Life on Earth remained mostly tiny for the first few billion years, until bizarre giants began to appear in the Ediacaran Period, about 600 million years ago.
paras.zh: 在最初的几十亿年里，地球上的生命大多仍然很小，直到大约六亿年前的埃迪卡拉时期开始出现奇异的巨人。

paras.en: Long dominated by microbial life, Earth was finally getting its first animals.
paras.zh: 长期由微生物生命主宰的地球终于迎来了第一批动物。

paras.en: In a new study, researchers look back at this pivotal time, investigating not just the animals themselves, but also how some environments preserved evidence of their soft, hard-to-fossilize bodies for us to find half a billion years later.
paras.zh: 在一项新的研究中，研究人员回顾了这个关键时期，不仅调查了动物本身，还调查了一些环境如何保存了它们柔软、难以石化的身体的证据，以便我们在 5 亿年后找到它们。

paras.en: These were pioneering creatures, yet many looked unlike anything alive today.
paras.zh: 这些都是开创性的生物，但其中许多看起来与今天的生物不同。

paras.en: Collectively known as the Ediacaran biota, they included a wide range of mainly soft, often Seussian organisms with unprecedented size and complexity – and, in some cases, question-mark butts.
paras.zh: 它们统称为埃迪卡拉生物群，包括一系列主要是软的、通常是苏斯状的生物，其尺寸和复杂性前所未有，在某些情况下，甚至是问号生物。

paras.en: They would soon disappear, however, in a mass extinction roughly 550 million years ago that set the stage for the Cambrian explosion.
paras.zh: 然而，在大约 5.5 亿年前的一次大规模灭绝中，它们很快就消失了，这场灭绝为寒武纪大爆发奠定了基础。

paras.en: As new animals proliferated, the Ediacaran biota had seemingly vanished without a trace.
paras.zh: 随着新动物的激增，埃迪卡拉生物群似乎消失得无影无踪。

paras.en: In fact, it's amazing we know anything about these ancient animals, given how long ago they lived and how little hard material they left behind to fossilize.
paras.zh: 事实上，令人惊讶的是，我们对这些古代动物的了解如此之多，因为它们生活在很久以前，而且它们留下来形成化石的坚硬物质又是如此之少。

paras.en: As the new study explains, quirks of Ediacaran landscapes, coasts, and climates combined to preserve hints of their existence.
paras.zh: 正如这项新研究所解释的那样，埃迪卡拉纪地貌、海岸和气候的怪异结合在一起，保留了它们存在的迹象。

paras.en: "More than half a billion years ago, the landscape of what is now South Australia looked very different," says lead author Karol Faehnrich, a geologist at Adelaide University.
paras.zh: “五亿多年前，现在南澳大利亚的地貌看起来非常不同，”主要作者、阿德莱德大学地质学家卡罗尔·费恩里奇 (Karol Faehnrich) 说。

paras.en: The research focuses on rock formations from the Flinders Ranges in South Australia, a mountainous region famed for its rare trove of diverse, well-preserved fossils dating back to the Ediacaran Period, which lasted from about 635 million to 538.8 million years ago.
paras.zh: 这项研究的重点是南澳大利亚弗林德斯山脉的岩层，该山区以其罕见的多样化且保存完好的化石而闻名，其历史可以追溯到埃迪卡拉时期，该时期持续了大约 6.35 亿年至 5.388 亿年前。

paras.en: Ediacaran biota remain shrouded in mystery. It's unclear how they fit into Earth's broader family tree – i.e., to what degree they're ancestral animals or evolutionary dead ends – but also why their rapid radiation occurred in the first place, followed by their enigmatic decline.
paras.zh: 埃迪卡拉生物群仍然笼罩在神秘之中。目前还不清楚它们如何融入地球更广泛的家谱——即它们在多大程度上是祖先动物或进化的死胡同——也不清楚为什么它们首先会发生快速辐射，然后是神秘的衰落。

paras.en: Previous research has linked Ediacaran biota with global sea-level changes occurring at the time, Faehnrich and his colleagues note, and those changes have been cited as potential drivers of evolutionary innovation as well as factors in Ediacaran fossil preservation.
paras.zh: 费恩里奇和他的同事指出，先前的研究已将埃迪卡拉生物群与当时发生的全球海平面变化联系起来，这些变化被认为是进化创新的潜在驱动力以及埃迪卡拉化石保存的因素。

paras.en: Yet this is speculative; we still don't know why these creatures evolved, why they died out, or what role sea-level change played in their fortunes.
paras.zh: 但这只是推测。我们仍然不知道这些生物为何进化、为何灭绝，也不知道海平面变化对它们的命运有何影响。

paras.en: In the new study, researchers mapped geological features across the Flinders Ranges to learn what the landscape was like about 550 million years ago – including how it changed late in the Ediacaran Period and how fossil-bearing sediments accumulated.
paras.zh: 在这项新研究中，研究人员绘制了弗林德斯山脉的地质特征图，以了解大约 5.5 亿年前的地貌，包括埃迪卡拉纪晚期的变化以及含化石沉积物的积累。

paras.en: This revealed traces of colossal southeast-oriented canyons, plunging to depths of 280 meters (919 feet) and stretching more than 6 kilometers (3.7 miles) across in some places.
paras.zh: 这揭示了巨大的东南方向峡谷的痕迹，峡谷深度达 280 米（919 英尺），有些地方绵延超过 6 公里（3.7 英里）。

paras.en: The canyons seem to have formed largely through underwater erosion, starting with a major decline in sea levels, the researchers report. When sea levels later rose, the canyons filled with sediment as the landscape flooded.
paras.zh: 研究人员报告说，这些峡谷似乎主要是通过水下侵蚀形成的，首先是海平面大幅下降。后来海平面上升，峡谷里充满了沉积物，地貌被洪水淹没。

paras.en: Under these conditions, a layer of Rawnsley Quartzite called the Ediacara Member preserved rare clues about the region's historic inhabitants.
paras.zh: 在这些条件下，一层被称为埃迪卡拉岩层的罗恩斯利石英岩保留了有关该地区历史居民的罕见线索。

paras.en: "We found evidence that huge underwater canyons cut across the continental shelf before being rapidly flooded as sea levels rose again," Faehnrich says. "This flooding created the conditions that allowed one of the world's richest Ediacaran fossils to be preserved."
paras.zh: 费恩里奇说：“我们发现的证据表明，巨大的水下峡谷横穿大陆架，然后随着海平面再次上升而迅速被淹没。” “这次洪水创造了条件，使世界上最丰富的埃迪卡拉化石之一得以保存。”

paras.en: Based on characteristics of sediment depositions in the canyons, the region was apparently subjected to powerful water flows that could have moved large volumes of material.
paras.zh: 根据峡谷沉积物的特征，该地区显然受到强大水流的影响，可能会移动大量物质。

paras.en: With insights gleaned from modern submarine canyons, underwater erosion seems more likely to have driven this process than river dynamics alone, the researchers conclude.
paras.zh: 研究人员得出结论，根据从现代海底峡谷收集到的见解，水下侵蚀似乎比河流动力学本身更有可能推动这一过程。

paras.en: "The evidence points to a combination of changing sea levels and local geological processes shaping the ancient basin," says co-author Diego Garcia-Bellido, a biologist at Adelaide University.
paras.zh: “证据表明海平面变化和当地地质过程共同塑造了古代盆地，”合著者、阿德莱德大学生物学家迭戈·加西亚-贝利多说。

paras.en: "This extraordinary evolution paved the way for the preservation of fossil-rich horizons. Many Ediacaran fossils are preserved as delicate impressions of soft-bodied organisms," he says.
paras.zh: “这种非凡的进化为保存富含化石的地平线铺平了道路。许多埃迪卡拉化石被保存为软体生物的精致印记，”他说。

paras.en: "Those kinds of fossils only survive when environmental conditions are just right. Our work shows that the rise in sea levels played an important role in creating a window of exceptional preservation."
paras.zh: “这些化石只有在环境条件合适的情况下才能生存。我们的研究表明，海平面上升在创造特殊保存窗口方面发挥了重要作用。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Earth and Planetary Science Letters.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《地球与行星科学快报》上。

articles.title: Coffee Doesn't Just Help You Poop. It May Change The Physiology in Your Gut.
articles.author: Jess Cockerill

paras.en: We can usually feel the effects of coffee in the body pretty quickly.
paras.zh: 我们通常可以很快感受到咖啡对身体的影响。

paras.en: If you're a regular coffee drinker, that first sip can promptly clear the morning fog and get your day going.
paras.zh: 如果您经常喝咖啡，那么第一口就可以立即驱散晨雾，让您的一天充满活力。

paras.en: Not long after, coffee drinkers also tend to experience a different side effect: their bowels get going, too.
paras.zh: 不久之后，喝咖啡的人也往往会经历不同的副作用：他们的肠道也开始蠕动。

paras.en: But new research published in the journal Gut Microbiology suggests regular coffee consumption may have a few other interesting effects on your gut.
paras.zh: 但发表在《肠道微生物学》杂志上的新研究表明，经常饮用咖啡可能会对肠道产生一些其他有趣的影响。

paras.en: We're all keen to know what might be going on inside our bodies as a result of our coffee habits, but it's surprisingly difficult to pin down the details.
paras.zh: 我们都渴望知道我们的咖啡习惯会导致我们的身体内部发生什么变化，但要确定细节却出人意料地困难。

paras.en: Scientists from institutions in Denmark, Singapore, and Belgium repurposed data from 61 participants involved in an observational study, PRIMA (which stands for 'toward Personalized dietary Recommendations based on the Interaction between diet, Microbiome and Abiotic conditions in the gut').
paras.zh: 来自丹麦、新加坡和比利时机构的科学家重新利用了参与观察性研究 PRIMA（其代表“基于饮食、微生物组和肠道非生物条件之间的相互作用的个性化饮食建议”）的 61 名参与者的数据。

paras.en: The researchers investigated whether habitual coffee intake (based on an eight-day food diary and biomarkers in urine) was associated with gut microbiota composition (assessed using samples of participants' poop) and gastrointestinal physiology measures like colon contractions (recorded via a smart pill swallowed by 50 of the participants).
paras.zh: 研究人员调查了习惯性咖啡摄入量（基于八天饮食日记和尿液中的生物标志物）是否与肠道微生物群组成（使用参与者粪便样本评估）和结肠收缩等胃肠道生理指标（通过 50 名参与者吞下的智能药丸记录）相关。

paras.en: "Small intestinal pH was also significantly lower in frequent coffee drinkers, compared to rare coffee drinkers," the authors report.
paras.zh: 作者报告说：“与很少喝咖啡的人相比，经常喝咖啡的人的小肠 pH 值也显着降低。”

paras.en: And in general, the more caffeine metabolites there were in a person's urine sample, the more bacteria there were in their poop, too.
paras.zh: 一般来说，一个人的尿液样本中咖啡因代谢物越多，粪便中的细菌也就越多。

paras.en: That correlation held up for all four caffeine metabolites tested, which means it's unlikely to have occurred due to random chance.
paras.zh: 这种相关性对于所有四种测试的咖啡因代谢物都是成立的，这意味着它不太可能是由于随机机会而发生的。

paras.en: But that wasn't the case for some of the other results.
paras.zh: 但其他一些结果并非如此。

paras.en: The 48 people who drank coffee frequently – defined in this study by the low bar of consuming coffee on four or more of the eight days – had more microbial species richness in samples of their poop than the 13 who drank it rarely (i.e., less than three of eight days).
paras.zh: 48 名经常喝咖啡的人（在本研究中定义为八天中四天或以上喝咖啡的门槛较低）的粪便样本中微生物物种丰富度高于 13 名很少喝咖啡的人（即八天中少于三天）。

paras.en: Even that result wasn't particularly strong, statistically speaking, especially because of the low sample size.
paras.zh: 从统计学上来说，即使这个结果也不是特别有力，特别是因为样本量较小。

paras.en: The gut microbiome results were also fairly inconclusive.
paras.zh: 肠道微生物组的结果也相当不确定。

paras.en: At first, it seemed the gut microbiomes of frequent coffee drinkers had a distinct profile. Species of the bacterium Lawsonibacter were particularly abundant, along with Slackia and an unclassified taxon in the family Eggerthellaceae.
paras.zh: 起初，经常喝咖啡的人的肠道微生物组似乎具有独特的特征。 Lawsonibacter 细菌的种类特别丰富，还有 Slackia 和 Eggerthellaceae 科的未分类分类单元。

paras.en: Scientists already knew Lawsonibacter's growth can be stimulated by coffee in lab conditions, and that it tends to grow more prolifically in the guts of coffee drinkers.
paras.zh: 科学家们已经知道，在实验室条件下，咖啡可以刺激劳森杆菌的生长，并且它往往会在喝咖啡的人的肠道中生长得更快。

paras.en: But in this study, when the microbiome results were adjusted using a statistical tool designed to decrease the rate of false discovery, these differences between frequent and rare drinkers did not hold up, though Lawsonibacter and the Eggerthellaceae taxon were still linked to how much coffee people drank in other analyses.
paras.zh: 但在这项研究中，当使用旨在降低错误发现率的统计工具调整微生物组结果时，频繁饮酒者和很少饮酒者之间的这些差异并没有成立，尽管在其他分析中劳森杆菌和艾格菌科分类群仍然与人们喝咖啡的量有关。

paras.en: Scientists would have to conduct this research with a much, much larger sample size to know for sure if there are any meaningful patterns here.
paras.zh: 科学家必须以大得多的样本量进行这项研究，才能确定这里是否存在任何有意义的模式。

paras.en: And as to whether any of those effects would be good for you? The study doesn't really go there.
paras.zh: 至于这些影响是否对您有好处？这项研究并没有真正去那里。

paras.en: "It is important to note that this study was originally not intended to investigate the effects of coffee consumption," the authors write.
paras.zh: “值得注意的是，这项研究最初并不是为了调查咖啡消费的影响，”作者写道。

paras.en: However, they add, "the relationships observed provide valuable indications for future research on the interplay between the gut microbiota, gut physiology, and coffee – one of the most consumed beverages in the world."
paras.zh: 然而，他们补充说，“观察到的关系为未来研究肠道微生物群、肠道生理学和咖啡（世界上消费最多的饮料之一）之间的相互作用提供了有价值的指示。”

paras.en: The findings are reported in Gut Microbiology.
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在《肠道微生物学》杂志上。

articles.title: Dinosaurs may have been eating seaweed 100 million years ago

paras.en: Dinosaurs may have been eating seaweed 100 million years ago
paras.zh: 恐龙可能在一亿年前就以海藻为食

paras.en: - Dinosaurs may have been snacking on seaweed and other ocean foods more than 100 million years ago, according to surprising new evidence hidden in their fossilized teeth. Researchers discovered chemical signatures suggesting that coastal dinosaurs and other prehistoric animals relied partly on nutrients originating in the sea. The findings reveal that marine resources traveled through ancient food chains, supplementing the diets of everything from plant-eating dinosaurs to predators.
paras.zh: - 根据隐藏在恐龙牙齿化石中的令人惊讶的新证据，恐龙可能在一亿多年前就以海藻和其他海洋食物为食。研究人员发现的化学特征表明沿海恐龙和其他史前动物部分依赖于海洋中的营养物质。研究结果表明，海洋资源通过古代食物链流动，补充了从植食性恐龙到掠食者等各种生物的饮食。

paras.en: Dinosaurs living along ancient coastlines may have enjoyed an unexpected addition to their diets: seaweed and other food from the ocean. New research suggests that marine resources washed onto prehistoric beaches helped feed dinosaurs and their prey millions of years ago.
paras.zh: 生活在古代海岸线的恐龙可能在饮食中享受到了意想不到的补充：海藻和其他来自海洋的食物。新的研究表明，数百万年前，冲刷到史前海滩的海洋资源帮助喂养了恐龙及其猎物。

paras.en: Today, powerful storms frequently deposit seaweed and other ocean material along shorelines, creating opportunities for animals that live on land to find additional food. Scientists call this process marine subsidization (MS). It is especially common in coastal environments and can become more important when food on land is limited, such as during droughts.
paras.zh: 如今，强大的风暴经常在海岸线上沉积海藻和其他海洋物质，为生活在陆地上的动物创造寻找额外食物的机会。科学家将这个过程称为海洋补贴（MS）。它在沿海环境中尤其常见，当陆地上的食物有限时（例如干旱期间），它会变得更加重要。

paras.en: A new study published in Frontiers in Ecology and Evolution suggests that this relationship between land and sea existed during the age of dinosaurs. By examining chemical signatures preserved in fossils, researchers found evidence that ocean resources contributed to prehistoric food chains.
paras.zh: 发表在《生态学与进化前沿》上的一项新研究表明，陆地和海洋之间的这种关系在恐龙时代就存在。通过检查化石中保存的化学特征，研究人员发现了海洋资源对史前食物链做出贡献的证据。

paras.en: "We show that coastal terrestrial organisms in the greenhouse climates of the Cretaceous relied on marine resources to supplement their diets in a similar way that modern organisms do," said first author Dr. Clayton Forster, a geologist at the University of Arkansas. "We can identify that marine resources are passed along the food chain and incorporated in the minerals of bones and teeth of dinosaurs, crocodiles, turtles, and fish."
paras.zh: “我们表明，白垩纪温室气候下的沿海陆地生物依靠海洋资源来补充食物，就像现代生物一样，”第一作者、阿肯色大学地质学家克莱顿·福斯特博士说。 “我们可以确定，海洋资源沿着食物链传递，并融入恐龙、鳄鱼、海龟和鱼类的骨骼和牙齿的矿物质中。”

paras.en: Mysterious Chemical Clues in Dinosaur Teeth
paras.zh: 恐龙牙齿中神秘的化学线索

paras.en: The discovery helps explain a longstanding mystery involving the chemical composition of dinosaur teeth.
paras.zh: 这一发现有助于解释有关恐龙牙齿化学成分的长期谜团。

paras.en: Plants contain two forms of carbon known as isotopes: 'light' (C-12) and 'heavy' (C-13). Scientists can measure the relative amounts of these isotopes, expressed as δ13C, to identify a chemical fingerprint that passes from food into the animals that consume it.
paras.zh: 植物含有两种形式的碳，称为同位素：“轻”(C-12) 和“重”(C-13)。科学家可以测量这些同位素的相对含量（以 δ13C 表示），以识别从食物传递到食用该食物的动物的化学指纹。

paras.en: As animals eat, this carbon signature becomes incorporated into their tooth enamel. The δ13C value in enamel is typically higher than that of the food consumed, with living animals generally showing an increase of between 11 and 13 parts per thousand.
paras.zh: 当动物进食时，这种碳特征就会融入到它们的牙釉质中。牙釉质中的 δ13C 值通常高于所消耗食物的 δ13C 值，活体动物的 δ13C 值通常会增加 11 至 13 ppm。

paras.en: However, previous measurements of dinosaur teeth have consistently revealed unusually high values. These readings also exceed what scientists would expect from animals that ate only plants growing on land, which generally have lower δ13C values than most marine plants.
paras.zh: 然而，之前对恐龙牙齿的测量一直显示出异常高的数值。这些读数也超出了科学家对只吃陆地植物的动物的预期，这些植物的 δ13C 值通常低于大多数海洋植物。

paras.en: One possible explanation is that dinosaurs, or the animals they consumed, were obtaining some of their nutrients from the ocean.
paras.zh: 一种可能的解释是，恐龙或它们吃的动物从海洋中获取一些营养。

paras.en: "By determining the carbon isotope composition of dinosaur, fish, and crocodile tooth enamel, we can determine what their primary dietary source was and if they were different between regions," explained Forster.
paras.zh: 福斯特解释说：“通过确定恐龙、鱼类和鳄鱼牙釉质的碳同位素组成，我们可以确定它们的主要饮食来源是什么，以及它们在不同地区是否有所不同。”

paras.en: Fossils Reveal a Prehistoric Ocean Food Source
paras.zh: 化石揭示了史前海洋食物来源

paras.en: To investigate, researchers examined fossils from (once) coastal locations bordering the Western Interior Seaway and the ancient coastline of the Gulf of Mexico. Around 100 million years ago, the Western Interior Seaway was an enormous inland sea that divided North America into two separate landmasses.
paras.zh: 为了进行调查，研究人员检查了来自（曾经）与西部内海航道和墨西哥湾古代海岸线接壤的沿海地区的化石。大约一亿年前，西部内陆航道是一片巨大的内陆海，将北美分为两个独立的大陆。

paras.en: The team also analyzed fossils from locations farther inland, allowing them to compare animals that lived near the ocean with those that occupied landlocked environments.
paras.zh: 研究小组还分析了来自更内陆地区的化石，使他们能够将生活在海洋附近的动物与生活在内陆环境的动物进行比较。

paras.en: The fossil deposits formed during two intervals of the Cretaceous Period: the early Albian (around 113-107 million years ago) and the early Cenomanian (approximately 100-96 million years ago).
paras.zh: 这些化石沉积物形成于白垩纪时期的两个时期：阿尔布阶早期（约113-1.07亿年前）和塞诺曼阶早期（约100-96百万年前）。

paras.en: Researchers used powdered fossil material to measure carbon isotope signatures from both periods. They also determined the latitudes where the animals had lived to investigate whether geography influenced the results.
paras.zh: 研究人员使用粉末状化石材料来测量这两个时期的碳同位素特征。他们还确定了动物居住的纬度，以调查地理是否影响结果。

paras.en: A clear pattern emerged. Fossils from coastal environments consistently contained higher δ13C values than those from the inland formation. Remarkably, the coastal signatures remained similar across different locations, regardless of latitude or geological age.
paras.zh: 一个清晰的模式出现了。来自沿海环境的化石始终比来自内陆地层的化石含有更高的 δ13C 值。值得注意的是，无论纬度或地质年龄如何，不同地点的沿海特征仍然相似。

paras.en: These findings provide the first evidence of marine subsidization in prehistoric ecosystems, indicating that nutrients originating in the ocean were entering food chains on land millions of years ago.
paras.zh: 这些发现提供了史前生态系统中海洋补贴的第一个证据，表明源自海洋的营养物质在数百万年前就进入了陆地上的食物链。

paras.en: Seaweed May Have Been on the Dinosaur Menu
paras.zh: 海藻可能出现在恐龙的菜单上

paras.en: The researchers next considered what ocean food source could explain the widespread chemical signatures.
paras.zh: 研究人员接下来考虑了哪些海洋食物来源可以解释广泛的化学特征。

paras.en: "Coastal-dwelling organisms must have eaten some kind of organic matter from the ocean, or prey that had done so. This pattern is shared from fish to megaherbivores and indicates that the extra carbon source must have been low in the food-chain to affect both aquatic and terrestrial animals," Forster explained.
paras.zh: 福斯特解释说：“沿海生物一定是从海洋中吃掉了某种有机物，或者是吃了这种有机物的猎物。从鱼类到大型食草动物都有这种模式，这表明额外的碳源在食物链中一定处于较低水平，才会影响水生和陆生动物。”

paras.en: For the same chemical pattern to appear in such a wide variety of animals, the marine food source would likely have entered the food chain near its base. It also needed to be something that existed along coastlines but was absent farther inland, while remaining available for millions of years.
paras.zh: 对于如此广泛的动物中出现相同的化学模式，海洋食物来源很可能已经进入食物链的底部附近。它还需要是沿着海岸线存在但在内陆更远的地方不存在的东西，同时保持可用数百万年。

paras.en: Seaweed emerged as the most likely explanation.
paras.zh: 海藻是最有可能的解释。

paras.en: "Few organisms meet these criteria besides marine macroalgae or macrophytes - seaweeds," said Forster. "Given the almost ubiquitous behavior of large coastal herbivores today to supplement their diet with seaweeds, it's likely that most of the sampled herbivorous dinosaurs were no different."
paras.zh: 福斯特说：“除了海洋大型藻类或大型植物（海藻）之外，很少有生物体符合这些标准。” “鉴于当今大型沿海食草动物以海藻补充饮食的行为几乎无处不在，大多数采样的食草恐龙很可能没有什么不同。”

paras.en: Modern plant-eating animals living near coastlines often consume seaweed to supplement their diets. The fossil evidence suggests that many herbivorous dinosaurs may have behaved similarly, with marine nutrients also passing to other animals through the food chain.
paras.zh: 生活在海岸线附近的现代植食动物经常食用海藻来补充饮食。 The fossil evidence suggests that many herbivorous dinosaurs may have behaved similarly, with marine nutrients also passing to other animals through the food chain.

paras.en: Not Every Dinosaur Had a Taste for the Sea
paras.zh: 并非所有恐龙都喜欢大海

paras.en: Despite the widespread evidence of marine nutrients in coastal food webs, the researchers found that not every dinosaur took advantage of these resources.
paras.zh: 尽管有广泛的证据表明沿海食物网中存在海洋营养物质，但研究人员发现，并非所有恐龙都利用了这些资源。

paras.en: One notable exception was Tenontosaurus tilletti, a large plant-eating dinosaur whose fossils have been discovered at numerous locations dating to the Cretaceous Period.
paras.zh: 一个值得注意的例外是特农托龙，这是一种大型食草恐龙，其化石已在许多地点被发现，其历史可以追溯到白垩纪时期。

paras.en: Its tooth enamel contained δ13C values comparable to those of modern animals that feed on plants growing on land. This suggests that Tenontosaurus tilletti did not rely on marine food sources, even though other dinosaurs apparently did.
paras.zh: 它的牙釉质含有 δ13C 值，与以陆地植物为食的现代动物相当。这表明蒂勒蒂腱龙并不依赖海洋食物来源，尽管其他恐龙显然也依赖海洋食物来源。

paras.en: The difference also strengthens the researchers' interpretation of the fossil evidence. If geological processes occurring after death had altered the carbon signatures in dinosaur teeth, the same unusual values would be expected more broadly. Instead, the variation between species suggests that the elevated readings reflect genuine differences in diet.
paras.zh: 这种差异也加强了研究人员对化石证据的解释。如果死亡后发生的地质过程改变了恐龙牙齿中的碳特征，那么我们将更广泛地预期同样的不寻常值。相反，物种之间的差异表明，读数升高反映了饮食的真正差异。

paras.en: An Ancient Connection Between Land and Ocean
paras.zh: 陆地与海洋之间的古老联系

paras.en: Although the findings provide strong evidence that marine resources supported the coastal ecosystems examined, important questions remain.
paras.zh: 尽管研究结果提供了强有力的证据表明海洋资源支持了所研究的沿海生态系统，但重要的问题仍然存在。

paras.en: The available fossils do not include specimens from polar or equatorial regions during the early Albian and early Cenomanian. As a result, scientists cannot yet determine how widespread this feeding behavior was across different latitudes.
paras.zh: 现有的化石不包括早期阿尔布阶和早期塞诺曼阶期间极地或赤道地区的标本。因此，科学家们还无法确定这种进食行为在不同纬度的分布范围有多大。

paras.en: Additional studies will also be needed to establish whether similar relationships existed during other geological periods, including the earlier Jurassic Period and the later early Cenozoic Era.
paras.zh: 还需要进行更多的研究来确定其他地质时期是否存在类似的关系，包括早期的侏罗纪时期和晚期的新生代早期。

paras.en: Beyond revealing a surprising possibility about what dinosaurs ate, the discovery highlights how closely life on land has been connected to the ocean throughout Earth's history.
paras.zh: 除了揭示恐龙吃什么的令人惊讶的可能性之外，这一发现还强调了在整个地球历史上陆地生命与海洋的联系是多么紧密。

paras.en: "Our study emphasizes the connections between terrestrial and marine ecosystems," concluded Forster. "They are deeply intertwined and have been for hundreds of millions of years. It highlights the importance of environmental linkages across time and space and protecting them where they exist today."
paras.zh: “我们的研究强调陆地和海洋生态系统之间的联系，”福斯特总结道。 “它们深深地交织在一起，并且已经存在了数亿年。它凸显了跨越时间和空间的环境联系以及保护它们今天存在的地方的重要性。”

paras.en: - Clayton W. Forster, Celina A. Suarez, Thomas M. Cullen, Lindsay E. Zanno, Ethan G. Hyland. Marine subsidization of dinosaurian ecosystems. Frontiers in Ecology and Evolution, 2026; 14 DOI: 10.3389/fevo.2026.1895247
paras.zh: - Clayton W. Forster、Celina A. Suarez、Thomas M. Cullen、Lindsay E. Zanno、Ethan G. Hyland。恐龙生态系统的海洋补贴。生态学与进化前沿，2026； 14 DOI：10.3389/fevo.2026.1895247

articles.title: Scientists discover a bizarre paradox among endangered penguins

paras.en: Scientists discover a bizarre paradox among endangered penguins
paras.zh: 科学家在濒临灭绝的企鹅中发现了一个奇怪的悖论

paras.en: - A groundbreaking drone survey has revealed a startling split in the fate of New Zealand's endangered Erect-crested penguins. While one population has remained stable for decades, another has declined by more than 40%, apparently due to a combination of predators, worsening storms, and changing ocean conditions. Even more surprisingly, the tiny Bounty Islands support nearly as many breeding pairs as the Antipodes Islands, despite being 40 times smaller.
paras.zh: - 一项开创性的无人机调查显示，新西兰濒临灭绝的直立冠企鹅的命运出现了惊人的分化。虽然一种种群几十年来一直保持稳定，但另一种种群却下降了 40% 以上，这显然是由于捕食者、恶化的风暴和海洋条件变化的综合作用。更令人惊讶的是，小小的邦蒂群岛支持的繁殖对数量几乎与安提波德群岛一样多，尽管其面积只有安提波德群岛的 40 倍。

paras.en: A new study from the University of Otago, Ōtākou Whakaihu Waka, has revealed a surprising divide in the fortunes of one of New Zealand's least understood penguin species. Although Erect-crested penguins breed in just two remote island groups, their populations are experiencing dramatically different outcomes.
paras.zh: 奥塔哥大学 Ōtākou Whakaihu Waka 的一项新研究揭示了新西兰最不为人所知的企鹅物种之一的命运之间惊人的鸿沟。尽管直立冠企鹅只在两个偏远的岛屿群中繁殖，但它们的种群却经历了截然不同的结果。

paras.en: Published in PLOS ONE, the research found that one population has remained stable for at least 25 years, while the other has declined by more than 40 percent over the past three decades.
paras.zh: 这项发表在《PLOS ONE》上的研究发现，一个种群至少在过去25年里保持稳定，而另一个种群在过去30年里则减少了40%以上。

paras.en: The study was led by Dr. Thomas Mattern of the Tawaki Project, which brings together scientists from the university's Departments of Zoology and Marine Science. Researchers also collaborated with the Antarctic Research Trust and the Global Penguin Society.
paras.zh: 这项研究由塔瓦基项目的托马斯·马特恩博士领导，该项目汇集了该大学动物学和海洋科学系的科学家。研究人员还与南极研究信托基金和全球企鹅协会合作。

paras.en: Drone Surveys Reveal a Surprising Penguin Population Divide
paras.zh: 无人机调查揭示了令人惊讶的企鹅种群差距

paras.en: Erect-crested penguins breed exclusively on the Bounty and Antipodes islands, two isolated island groups located approximately 800 kilometers southeast of New Zealand's South Island.
paras.zh: 直立冠企鹅只在邦蒂岛和安提波德斯岛繁殖，这两个孤立的岛屿群位于新西兰南岛东南约 800 公里处。

paras.en: To determine how many penguins remain, researchers conducted extensive drone surveys between 2022 and 2024. They photographed and counted every breeding colony across both island groups, producing the first comprehensive population survey of the entire species.
paras.zh: 为了确定剩余的企鹅数量，研究人员在 2022 年至 2024 年间进行了广泛的无人机调查。他们拍摄并统计了两个岛屿群中的每个繁殖群，首次对整个物种进行了全面的种群调查。

paras.en: "The results overturn a long-standing assumption," Dr. Mattern says.
paras.zh: “结果推翻了长期以来的假设，”马特恩博士说。

paras.en: "The tiny Bounty Islands, at just 50 hectares, were found to hold almost as many breeding pairs (about 27,800) as the Antipodes Islands (about 29,800), even though the latter is 40 times larger and historically considered the species' stronghold."
paras.zh: “Bounty 群岛面积仅 50 公顷，被发现拥有几乎与 Antipodes 群岛（约 29,800 只）一样多的繁殖对（约 27,800 只），尽管后者的面积是 Antipodes 群岛的 40 倍，并且历史上被认为是该物种的据点。”

paras.en: The difference in population trends was even more unexpected. Despite their small size, the Bounty Islands have maintained a relatively consistent number of breeding penguins for decades. Meanwhile, the much larger Antipodes Islands have experienced a substantial decline.
paras.zh: 人口趋势的差异更出乎意料。尽管面积很小，但几十年来，邦蒂群岛的繁殖企鹅数量一直保持相对稳定。与此同时，面积大得多的安提波德斯群岛的面积也出现了大幅下降。

paras.en: "Comparing the new counts with historical records going back to the mid-1990s, the Bounty Islands population has remained essentially unchanged for at least 25 years.
paras.zh: “将新的统计数据与 20 世纪 90 年代中期的历史记录进行比较，邦蒂群岛的人口至少在 25 年来基本保持不变。

paras.en: "The Antipodes Islands population, by contrast, has declined by more than 40 percent since 1995."
paras.zh: “相比之下，Antipodes 群岛的人口自 1995 年以来下降了 40% 以上。”

paras.en: Why Are Penguins Disappearing From the Antipodes Islands?
paras.zh: 为什么企鹅从安提波德斯群岛消失？

paras.en: Researchers believe several overlapping pressures may explain why the two populations are heading in opposite directions. Natural predators, increasingly destructive storms, and differences in where the birds travel and feed could all be contributing.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，几种重叠的压力可能可以解释为什么这两个种群正朝着相反的方向发展。天敌、破坏性日益增强的风暴，以及鸟类迁徙和觅食地点的差异都可能是造成这种情况的原因。

paras.en: One particularly troubling factor involves skuas, native subantarctic birds that prey on penguin eggs and chicks. As penguin colonies become smaller, the birds lose some of the protection that comes from nesting together in large numbers.
paras.zh: 一个特别令人不安的因素涉及贼鸥，这是一种捕食企鹅蛋和雏鸟的亚南极本土鸟类。随着企鹅群变得越来越小，这些鸟类就会失去一些来自大量筑巢的保护。

paras.en: "As Antipodes colonies have shrunk over recent decades, the collective defense they once provided against native subantarctic bird, the skua, a natural predator of eggs and chicks, has weakened, allowing predation losses to increase and colonies to fragment further."
paras.zh: “近几十年来，随着Antipodes群体的萎缩，它们曾经对本地亚南极鸟类贼鸥（鸡蛋和雏鸟的天敌）提供的集体防御已经减弱，导致捕食损失增加，群体进一步分裂。”

paras.en: Co-author Dr. Klemens Pütz of the Antarctic Research Trust suggests that changes involving another penguin species may have intensified this pressure.
paras.zh: 南极研究基金会的合著者克莱门斯·普茨博士表示，涉及另一种企鹅物种的变化可能加剧了这种压力。

paras.en: Eastern Rockhopper penguins suffered a "catastrophically" severe population collapse during the second half of the 20th century. Similar declines occurred across their Southern Ocean breeding range, likely driven by warming ocean waters. Today, fewer than 1,000 breeding pairs remain on the Antipodes Islands.
paras.zh: 20 世纪下半叶，东部跳岩企鹅遭受了“灾难性”的严重人口锐减。类似的下降发生在南大洋的繁殖范围，这可能是由于海水变暖造成的。如今，Antipodes 群岛上仅剩不到 1,000 只繁殖对。

paras.en: "As Rockhoppers disappeared, skuas may have turned to Erect-crested penguin eggs and chicks instead," Dr. Pütz says.
paras.zh: “随着摇滚企鹅的消失，贼鸥可能转而以直冠企鹅的蛋和雏鸟为食。”Pütz博士说。

paras.en: Stronger Storms and Different Migration Routes Add to the Threat
paras.zh: 更强的风暴和不同的迁徙路线增加了威胁

paras.en: Predators are not the only challenge facing the Antipodes penguins. Increasingly powerful storms, consistent with wider climate trends across the Southern Ocean, have caused landslides that break up breeding colonies and leave the birds more vulnerable.
paras.zh: 捕食者并不是安足企鹅面临的唯一挑战。与南大洋更广泛的气候趋势一致，日益强大的风暴引发了山体滑坡，破坏了繁殖群，使鸟类更加脆弱。

paras.en: Differences in ocean habitats and seasonal movements may also help explain why the two populations have experienced such contrasting outcomes.
paras.zh: 海洋栖息地和季节性运动的差异也可能有助于解释为什么这两个种群经历了如此截然不同的结果。

paras.en: According to Dr. Mattern, penguins breeding on the Antipodes Islands migrate considerable distances into the Antarctic Polar Frontal Zone when the breeding season ends. In contrast, birds from the Bounty Islands remain closer to their nesting grounds, where the surrounding waters are more sheltered and may offer more abundant food.
paras.zh: 马特恩博士表示，当繁殖季节结束时，在安提波德群岛繁殖的企鹅会迁徙相当长的距离进入南极极锋区。相比之下，来自邦蒂群岛的鸟类离它们的筑巢地更近，周围的水域受到更多庇护，可能会提供更丰富的食物。

paras.en: These differences could leave the two populations exposed to very different environmental pressures, despite belonging to the same species.
paras.zh: 尽管属于同一物种，这些差异可能使两个种群面临截然不同的环境压力。

paras.en: The Strange Paradox of Schrödinger's Penguin
paras.zh: 薛定谔的企鹅的奇怪悖论

paras.en: The researchers have named this unusual situation "Schrödinger's Penguin," drawing inspiration from the famous physics thought experiment involving a cat inside a sealed box.
paras.zh: 研究人员将这种不寻常的情况命名为“薛定谔的企鹅”，其灵感来自著名的物理思想实验，涉及一只密封盒子里的猫。

paras.en: In that experiment, the cat is imagined to be both alive and dead until the box is opened and its condition is observed. But Dr. Mattern explains that the penguin discovery turns the familiar concept around.
paras.zh: 在那个实验中，猫被想象成既活着又死了，直到打开盒子并观察它的状况。但马特恩博士解释说，企鹅的发现颠覆了人们熟悉的概念。

paras.en: "With Schrödinger's cat, opening the box settles the question one way or the other.
paras.zh: “对于薛定谔的猫，打开盒子可以以某种方式解决问题。

paras.en: "With Erect-crested penguins, it's the opposite. From a distance, without proper surveys, everyone assumed there was a single answer for the whole species.
paras.zh: “对于直立冠企鹅来说，情况恰恰相反。从远处看，没有经过适当的调查，每个人都认为整个物种有一个单一的答案。

paras.en: "Once we actually opened the metaphorical box and looked, we found there wasn't one state at all, but two: stable on the Bounty Islands, declining on the Antipodes Islands."
paras.zh: “一旦我们真正打开隐喻的盒子并观察，我们发现根本不存在一种状态，而是两种状态：邦蒂群岛稳定，安提波德斯群岛衰落。”

paras.en: In other words, looking at the species as a whole can conceal what is happening within individual populations. Only by examining both island groups separately did researchers uncover how dramatically their circumstances differ.
paras.zh: 换句话说，从整体上看待物种可以掩盖个体种群内发生的事情。只有通过分别研究这两个岛屿群，研究人员才发现它们的情况有何显着差异。

paras.en: A Hidden Conservation Crisis for Endangered Penguins
paras.zh: 濒危企鹅隐藏的保护危机

paras.en: The Erect-crested penguin is currently one of only four penguin species worldwide classified as "Endangered" on the International Union for Conservation of Nature Red List. Another New Zealand penguin, the hoiho/yellow-eyed penguin, shares that designation.
paras.zh: 直立冠企鹅是目前世界上仅有的四种被国际自然保护联盟红色名录列为“濒危”的企鹅物种之一。另一种新西兰企鹅，即黄眼企鹅，也有这个称号。

paras.en: However, the two species have received very different levels of attention. While the plight of the hoiho has attracted ongoing public interest and conservation efforts, the Erect-crested penguin has remained relatively overlooked.
paras.zh: 然而，这两个物种受到的关注程度却截然不同。虽然海凤企鹅的困境引起了公众的持续关注和保护工作，但直立冠企鹅仍然相对被忽视。

paras.en: Dr. Mattern explains that the species' current conservation classification relies on population estimates from the 1970s that were considerably inflated. When the new survey results are considered, the "Endangered" designation remains broadly appropriate for the declining Antipodes population, but not for the stable Bounty Islands population.
paras.zh: 马特恩博士解释说，该物种目前的保护分类依赖于 20 世纪 70 年代的种群估计，而这一估计被大大夸大了。当考虑到新的调查结果时，“濒临灭绝”的称号仍然广泛适用于不断减少的对足群岛种群，但不适用于稳定的邦蒂群岛种群。

paras.en: This creates a difficult conservation dilemma. If the two populations are combined into a single assessment, the species' overall threat classification could actually improve, even though one population continues to decline sharply.
paras.zh: 这造成了一个艰难的保护困境。如果将两个种群合并为一项评估，尽管其中一个种群继续急剧下降，但该物种的总体威胁分类实际上可能会得到改善。

paras.en: "Averaged across both populations, the global ranking would actually improve to "Vulnerable," masking the severity of the Antipodes decline, and downplaying how exposed the Bounty Islands, likely the species' last secure stronghold, are to industrial fishing."
paras.zh: “对这两个种群进行平均，全球排名实际上会提高到“脆弱”，掩盖了对足类数量下降的严重程度，并淡化了赏金群岛（可能是该物种最后的安全据点）对工业捕捞的暴露程度。”

paras.en: The researchers warn that a more favorable overall classification could create a misleading impression of security. Although the Bounty Islands population remains stable, it may still face significant threats, particularly from industrial fishing activity.
paras.zh: 研究人员警告说，更有利的总体分类可能会造成安全方面的误导性印象。尽管邦蒂群岛的人口保持稳定，但仍可能面临重大威胁，特别是来自工业捕捞活动的威胁。

paras.en: "A single, ostensibly improved threat ranking is like putting the lid back on Schrödinger's box, trading a convenient illusion for the stronger protection the Bounty Islands population actually needs," Dr. Mattern says.
paras.zh: 马特恩博士说：“表面上改进的单一威胁排名就像给薛定谔的盒子盖上盖子，用方便的幻觉换取了赏金群岛居民实际需要的更强有力的保护。”

paras.en: The findings highlight why conservation efforts must account for the circumstances of individual populations rather than relying exclusively on a species' global status. For Erect-crested penguins, recognizing the differences between the two island groups could be essential to protecting their future.
paras.zh: 研究结果强调了为什么保护工作必须考虑到单个种群的情况，而不是仅仅依赖于某个物种的全球地位。对于直立冠企鹅来说，认识到两个岛屿群之间的差异对于保护它们的未来至关重要。

paras.en: The study received funding from the Vontobel Foundation (Switzerland) through the Antarctic Research Trust and from the Global Penguin Society. The research was carried out under permits issued by the New Zealand Department of Conservation.
paras.zh: 该研究通过南极研究信托基金获得了冯托贝尔基金会（瑞士）和全球企鹅协会的资助。该研究是在新西兰环境保护部颁发的许可下进行的。

articles.title: Alzheimer’s may start shrinking two brain regions years before memory loss

paras.en: Alzheimerâs may start shrinking two brain regions years before memory loss
paras.zh: 阿尔茨海默病可能在记忆丧失前数年开始萎缩两个大脑区域

paras.en: - Johns Hopkins scientists have uncovered hidden warning signs of Alzheimerâs disease that may appear up to a decade before memory loss begins. Brain scans revealed that two regions involved in memory and emotion start shrinking before the hippocampus, the area doctors typically examine for signs of Alzheimerâs. These early changes are linked to abnormal tau protein buildup and could provide a powerful new way to identify people at risk.
paras.zh: - 约翰·霍普金斯大学的科学家发现了阿尔茨海默病的隐藏警告信号，这些信号可能在记忆丧失开始前十年出现。 Brain scans revealed that two regions involved in memory and emotion start shrinking before the hippocampus, the area doctors typically examine for signs of Alzheimerâs.这些早期变化与异常的 tau 蛋白积累有关，可以提供一种强大的新方法来识别高危人群。

paras.en: Alzheimer's disease may begin leaving detectable clues in the brain as much as a decade before memory problems appear. Researchers at Johns Hopkins University have identified two brain regions that show signs of deterioration earlier than the hippocampus, the area commonly examined for evidence of the disease.
paras.zh: 早在记忆问题出现之前十年，阿尔茨海默病就可能开始在大脑中留下可检测的线索。约翰·霍普金斯大学的研究人员发现，两个大脑区域比海马体更早出现恶化迹象，海马体是通常检查疾病证据的区域。

paras.en: The discovery could eventually help doctors recognize Alzheimer's years before symptoms develop, potentially allowing treatment to begin when it has the greatest chance of protecting the brain.
paras.zh: 这一发现最终可以帮助医生在症状出现前数年识别出阿尔茨海默病，从而有可能在最有可能保护大脑的时候开始治疗。

paras.en: By examining hundreds of brain scans, the scientists found that the entorhinal cortex and amygdala, two regions involved in memory and emotion, begin losing tissue earlier than the hippocampus. These changes may offer important new clues about how Alzheimer's develops and how it could be detected before significant cognitive decline occurs.
paras.zh: 通过检查数百次脑部扫描，科学家们发现内嗅皮层和杏仁核这两个涉及记忆和情感的区域比海马体更早开始失去组织。这些变化可能为了解阿尔茨海默病如何发展以及如何在认知能力显着下降之前检测到它提供重要的新线索。

paras.en: "We have found that there are early changes in the brain manifesting the clinical biomarkers of atrophy as much as a decade before there are clinical symptoms," said biomedical engineer and senior author Michael Miller. "It's at least a 5-to-10-year play where your brain is changing. Imagine if we could start to treat the neurodegenerative changes at the 2, 3 or 4-year point rather than after 15 years when the changes are manifesting in memory symptoms. That's the great promise here for your loved ones who are at risk."
paras.zh: 生物医学工程师兼资深作者迈克尔·米勒（Michael Miller）说：“我们发现，早在出现临床症状之前十年，大脑就出现了早期变化，表现出了萎缩的临床生物标志物。” “这至少需要 5 到 10 年的时间，你的大脑就会发生变化。想象一下，如果我们能够在 2 年、3 年或 4 年时开始治疗神经退行性变化，而不是 15 年后，当这些变化在记忆症状中显现出来时，这对你面临风险的亲人来说是一个巨大的希望。”

paras.en: The findings were recently published in NeuroImage Reports and are being presented at Neuroscience 2026, the annual meeting of the Society for Neuroscience.
paras.zh: 研究结果最近发表在 NeuroImage Reports 上，并在神经科学学会年会 Neuroscience 2026 上发表。

paras.en: Detecting Alzheimer's Before Memory Loss Begins
paras.zh: 在记忆丧失开始之前检测阿尔茨海默病

paras.en: Alzheimer's is the most common cause of dementia worldwide, but the disease does not begin when someone first experiences forgetfulness or confusion. Changes associated with Alzheimer's can accumulate in the brain for decades before noticeable symptoms emerge.
paras.zh: 阿尔茨海默氏症是全世界痴呆症最常见的原因，但这种疾病并不是在某人第一次经历健忘或混乱时开始的。与阿尔茨海默病相关的变化可能会在大脑中积累数十年，然后才会出现明显的症状。

paras.en: Scientists believe this long period of silent progression may provide a crucial opportunity for treatment. Interventions that begin before extensive damage occurs could potentially do more to preserve memory and other cognitive abilities. However, taking advantage of that opportunity requires reliable ways to identify the disease in its earliest stages.
paras.zh: 科学家认为，这种长期的无声进展可能会提供重要的治疗机会。在发生广泛损害之前开始的干预措施可能会在保护记忆和其他认知能力方面发挥更大的作用。然而，利用这一机会需要可靠的方法来在疾病的早期阶段进行识别。

paras.en: One promising approach involves biomarkers, measurable biological changes that can indicate the presence or progression of a disease. In Alzheimer's research, these markers could help reveal who is developing the condition before symptoms become apparent.
paras.zh: 一种有前途的方法涉及生物标志物，即可以指示疾病存在或进展的可测量的生物变化。在阿尔茨海默氏症的研究中，这些标记可以帮助在症状变得明显之前揭示谁正在患上这种疾病。

paras.en: "Our goal is to be able to treat individuals before the symptoms of Alzheimer's disease develop so that they may delayed or even stopped," said Marilyn Albert, co-author and director of the Johns Hopkins Alzheimer's Disease Research Center.
paras.zh: 约翰·霍普金斯大学阿尔茨海默病研究中心的合著者兼主任玛丽莲·阿尔伯特说：“我们的目标是能够在阿尔茨海默病症状出现之前对个体进行治疗，从而延迟甚至停止症状。”

paras.en: Two Brain Regions Reveal Earlier Warning Signs
paras.zh: 两个大脑区域揭示早期警告信号

paras.en: To investigate where the earliest detectable changes occur, the researchers examined hundreds of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and positron emission tomography (PET) scans collected through two independent research projects: the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative and the Biomarkers of Cognitive Decline Among Normal Individuals study.
paras.zh: 为了调查最早可检测到的变化发生的位置，研究人员检查了通过两个独立研究项目收集的数百张磁共振成像（MRI）和正电子发射断层扫描（PET）扫描：阿尔茨海默病神经影像计划和正常个体认知衰退的生物标志物研究。

paras.en: The scans followed people at different stages of Alzheimer's disease over time, including individuals without symptoms, those experiencing cognitive impairment, and patients who ultimately died from the disease.
paras.zh: 这些扫描随着时间的推移对处于阿尔茨海默病不同阶段的人进行了跟踪，包括没有症状的人、患有认知障碍的人以及最终死于该病的患者。

paras.en: In both groups, the researchers observed a consistent pattern. The entorhinal cortex and amygdala, which are located near the hippocampus, showed greater relative tissue loss during the early stages of Alzheimer's than the hippocampus itself.
paras.zh: 在两组中，研究人员观察到了一致的模式。位于海马体附近的内嗅皮层和杏仁核在阿尔茨海默病的早期阶段表现出比海马体本身更大的相对组织损失。

paras.en: This distinction matters because the hippocampus plays a central role in memory and has traditionally been a major focus when doctors look for Alzheimer's-related brain damage.
paras.zh: 这种区别很重要，因为海马体在记忆中发挥着核心作用，并且传统上一直是医生寻找与阿尔茨海默病相关的脑损伤时的主要关注点。

paras.en: The two newly highlighted regions perform important functions of their own. The entorhinal cortex helps retrieve previously stored memories, while the amygdala contributes to emotional memory, including how emotional experiences are processed and remembered.
paras.zh: 这两个新突出的区域发挥着各自的重要功能。内嗅皮层有助于检索以前存储的记忆，而杏仁核有助于情感记忆，包括如何处理和记住情感经历。

paras.en: Their earlier shrinkage suggests that examining these structures together could reveal signs of Alzheimer's that might be less apparent when attention is focused primarily on the hippocampus.
paras.zh: 它们早期的收缩表明，一起检查这些结构可以揭示阿尔茨海默氏症的迹象，当注意力主要集中在海马体时，这些迹象可能不太明显。

paras.en: Brain Shrinkage Linked to Alzheimer's Tau Protein
paras.zh: 大脑萎缩与阿尔茨海默病 Tau 蛋白有关

paras.en: The researchers also found an important connection between the loss of brain tissue and tau, a protein closely associated with Alzheimer's disease.
paras.zh: 研究人员还发现脑组织损失与tau蛋白（一种与阿尔茨海默病密切相关的蛋白质）之间存在重要联系。

paras.en: Under normal conditions, tau helps maintain the internal structure of nerve cells. In Alzheimer's, however, tau can accumulate abnormally and form tangles that interfere with healthy brain function.
paras.zh: 正常情况下，tau蛋白有助于维持神经细胞的内部结构。然而，在阿尔茨海默氏症中，tau 蛋白会异常积累并形成缠结，从而干扰健康的大脑功能。

paras.en: Using PET imaging and digital pathology, the scientists found that areas of gray matter shrinkage overlapped with regions showing tau-related changes. Gray matter contains large numbers of nerve cell bodies and is essential for processing information throughout the brain.
paras.zh: 利用 PET 成像和数字病理学，科学家们发现灰质收缩的区域与显示 tau 相关变化的区域重叠。灰质含有大量神经细胞体，对于处理整个大脑的信息至关重要。

paras.en: This relationship strengthens the possibility that changes in the entorhinal cortex and amygdala could serve as useful indicators of early Alzheimer's disease.
paras.zh: 这种关系增强了内嗅皮层和杏仁核的变化可以作为早期阿尔茨海默病的有用指标的可能性。

paras.en: The team believes that measuring tissue loss in both regions, rather than relying primarily on changes in the hippocampus, could eventually improve predictions of who is likely to develop cognitive decline.
paras.zh: 研究小组认为，测量这两个区域的组织损失，而不是主要依赖海马体的变化，最终可以改善对谁可能出现认知能力下降的预测。

paras.en: As brain imaging becomes more accessible and less expensive, this approach could also become increasingly practical. For people with a family history of Alzheimer's or other risk factors, researchers envision a future in which doctors might examine these regions as early as a person's 30s or 40s.
paras.zh: 随着脑成像变得更加容易和便宜，这种方法也可能变得越来越实用。对于有阿尔茨海默氏症家族史或其他危险因素的人，研究人员预计，未来医生可能会在患者 30 多岁或 40 多岁时就对这些区域进行检查。

paras.en: "As biomarkers and treatments become increasingly available, knowing who is going to have cognitive decline is going to be really important," said co-author Meaghan Morris, a neuropathologist who studies Alzheimer's and other dementias. "This could really play into better risk stratification for identifying who is going to have cognitive decline in the near future -- and treating people earlier and earlier to hopefully slow the course of the disease."
paras.zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病和其他痴呆症的神经病理学家、论文合著者梅根·莫里斯 (Meaghan Morris) 表示：“随着生物标志物和治疗方法的日益普及，了解谁会出现认知能力下降将变得非常重要。” “这确实可以更好地进行风险分层，以确定谁在不久的将来会出现认知能力下降，并尽早治疗人们，以期减缓疾病的进程。”

paras.en: A Potential New Path Toward Earlier Alzheimer's Treatment
paras.zh: 早期阿尔茨海默病治疗的潜在新途径

paras.en: Although the findings are promising, more research is necessary before doctors can use these brain changes as a reliable diagnostic tool. The study identifies potential early biomarkers, but it does not yet establish a clinical test capable of predicting Alzheimer's years in advance.
paras.zh: 尽管这些发现很有希望，但在医生可以将这些大脑变化用作可靠的诊断工具之前，还需要进行更多的研究。该研究确定了潜在的早期生物标志物，但尚未建立能够提前数年预测阿尔茨海默病的临床测试。

paras.en: The next step is to investigate what happens within these regions at a much smaller scale. The researchers want to understand the molecular changes surrounding abnormal tau accumulation and how those changes contribute to the progressive loss of brain tissue.
paras.zh: 下一步是以更小的规模调查这些区域内发生的情况。研究人员希望了解异常 tau 蛋白积累周围的分子变化，以及这些变化如何导致脑组织逐渐丧失。

paras.en: Identifying the biological processes involved could eventually reveal new targets for therapies designed to interrupt Alzheimer's before extensive damage occurs.
paras.zh: 确定所涉及的生物学过程最终可能会揭示出新的治疗靶点，这些治疗旨在在广泛的损害发生之前阻止阿尔茨海默病的发展。

paras.en: "Our future work is to better show the molecular neighborhoods associated with these Tau protein changes as localized by these clinical biomarkers of atrophy," Miller said. "Once we know more about the molecular neighborhoods, we can develop therapies."
paras.zh: “我们未来的工作是更好地展示与这些萎缩的临床生物标志物定位的 Tau 蛋白变化相关的分子邻域，”米勒说。 “一旦我们更多地了解分子邻域，我们就可以开发治疗方法。”

articles.title: See Jupiter and Mars make a spectacular close approach overnight Nov. 15-16
articles.author: Anthony Wood

paras.en: Heads up stargazers! Mars meets Jupiter for a spectacular rendezvous in the heart of the constellation Leo on the night of Nov. 15-16, and they won't be this close again until July 2029.
paras.zh: 观星者请注意！ 11 月 15 日至 16 日晚上，火星与木星在狮子座中心进行壮观的会合，直到 2029 年 7 月它们才会再次如此接近。

paras.en: Jupiter and Mars will appear a little over 1 degree from each other as they rise over the eastern horizon around midnight for viewers in the U.S., as the blue-white light of the main-sequence star Regulus glows below, according to In-The-Sky.
paras.zh: 据《天空》报道，对于美国观众来说，木星和火星在午夜左右从东方地平线升起时，彼此之间的角度将略高于 1 度，主序星轩辕十四的蓝白色光芒在下方闪烁。

paras.en: It's all a trick of perspective, but spectacular nonetheless. In reality Mars and Jupiter are separated by a gulf of over 368 million miles (592 million kilometers), while the light from Regulus has travelled for some 79 light-years before reaching Earth.
paras.zh: 这都是一个透视技巧，但仍然很壮观。事实上，火星和木星相隔超过 3.68 亿英里（5.92 亿公里）的鸿沟，而轩辕十四发出的光在到达地球之前已经传播了约 79 光年。

paras.en: The spectacular display occurs just once every 2-2.5 years, when Mars catches up to Jupiter as it plies its more distant orbit, making the pair appear side by side from our Earthly vantage point — an event known to astronomers as an appulse.
paras.zh: 这种壮观的景象每 2-2.5 年就会发生一次，当时火星在其更遥远的轨道上追赶木星，使这两颗行星从我们地球的有利位置并排出现——这一事件被天文学家称为脉冲。

paras.en: Both Mars and Jupiter are "superior planets" whose orbits exist beyond that of Earth. As a result their disks always appear full to us through the eyepiece of a telescope, unlike the inner planets Mercury and Venus, which exhibit moon-like phases as they circle the sun.
paras.zh: 火星和木星都是“高级行星”，其轨道超出了地球的轨道。因此，通过望远镜的目镜，它们的圆盘总是充满的，这与内行星水星和金星不同，它们在绕太阳运行时表现出类似月亮的相位。

paras.en: A 6-inch telescope can reveal the wildly differing natures of the solar system worlds. Slew your scope to Jupiter to spot the gargantuan cloud bands (and zones) that ring the gas giant, formed from masses of ammonia and water that travel in different directions through Jupiter's hydrogen and helium atmosphere, driven by powerful jet streams.
paras.zh: 6 英寸望远镜可以揭示太阳系世界截然不同的性质。将望远镜转向木星，观察环绕这颗气态巨行星的巨大云带（和区域），这些云带是由大量氨和水形成的，在强大的喷射流的驱动下，这些氨和水在木星的氢和氦大气层中以不同的方向传播。

paras.en: Mars, meanwhile, appears as a reddish, ochre disk complete with dark surface features, where basaltic rock has been scoured clean of the iron-rich dust that covers much of its surface, according to NASA.
paras.zh: 与此同时，据美国宇航局称，火星看起来是一个微红色的赭色圆盘，表面呈现黑色特征，玄武岩已被清除掉覆盖其大部分表面的富铁尘埃。

paras.en: Interested in seeing and capturing the planets for yourself? Then be sure to read our guide on everything you need to observe and photograph the planets of the solar system, along with our picks of the top telescopes, cameras and lenses for exploring the night sky in 2026.
paras.zh: 有兴趣亲自观察和捕捉行星吗？那么请务必阅读我们的指南，了解观察和拍摄太阳系行星所需的一切，以及我们精选的 2026 年探索夜空的顶级望远镜、相机和镜头。

paras.en: Editor's Note: If you would like to share your photos of Mars and Jupiter with Space.com's readers, then please send your photo(s), comments, and your name and location to spacephotos@space.com.
paras.zh: 编者注：如果您想与 Space.com 的读者分享您的火星和木星照片，请将您的照片、评论以及您的姓名和位置发送至 spacephotos@space.com。

paras.en: Anthony Wood joined Space.com in April 2025 after contributing articles to outlets including IGN, New Atlas and Gizmodo. He has a passion for the night sky, science, Hideo Kojima, and human space exploration, and can’t wait for the day when astronauts once again set foot on the moon.
paras.zh: 安东尼·伍德 (Anthony Wood) 向 IGN、New Atlas 和 Gizmodo 等媒体投稿后于 2025 年 4 月加入 Space.com。他热爱夜空、科学、小岛秀夫和人类太空探索，迫不及待地等待宇航员再次踏上月球的那一天。

articles.title: 'Now everything changes': SpaceX catches Starship upper stage for 1st time ever (video)
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: SpaceX caught the upper stage of its Starship megarocket for the first time ever today (Nov. 14), a landmark achievement that could unlock the giant vehicle's immense potential.
paras.zh: 今天（11 月 14 日），SpaceX 首次登上了 Starship 巨型火箭的上层，这是一项具有里程碑意义的成就，可以释放这艘巨型火箭的巨大潜力。

paras.en: Starship launched on its 15th test flight on Friday evening (Nov. 13), rising into the sky from SpaceX's Starbase site in South Texas. The mission plan called for bringing both of the vehicle's stages back to Starbase and catching them with the launch tower's "chopstick" arms — an unprecedented total recovery of an orbital rocket.
paras.zh: 周五晚上（11 月 13 日），Starship 进行了第 15 次试飞，从 SpaceX 位于德克萨斯州南部的 Starbase 基地升空。该任务计划要求将飞行器的两个阶段带回 Starbase，并用发射塔的“筷子”臂接住它们——这是前所未有的轨道火箭完全回收。

paras.en: That didn't happen; Starship's Super Heavy booster diverted to a Gulf of Mexico splashdown on Friday after experiencing a low-fuel alarm. But Ship succeeded in its attempt, notching a huge milestone for SpaceX and its dream of full rocket reuse.
paras.zh: 但那并没有发生；周五，星舰的超重型助推器在出现低燃料警报后转向墨西哥湾溅落。但 Ship 的尝试取得了成功，为 SpaceX 及其全面重复使用火箭的梦想创造了一个巨大的里程碑。

paras.en: "That was the missing link," SpaceX's Dan Huot said during the company's landing webcast today, his voice thick with emotion. "That was the holy grail of spaceflight, plummeting through fire to be snatched out of the air by steel. We caught a Starship, and now everything changes."
paras.zh: “这就是缺失的环节，”SpaceX 的 Dan Huot 在今天公司的着陆网络广播中说道，他的声音充满了情感。 “那是太空飞行的圣杯，从火中坠落，然后被钢铁从空中夺走。我们抓住了一艘星舰，现在一切都改变了。”

paras.en: The Ship catch occurred today at 4:20 p.m. EST (2120 GMT; 3:20 p.m. local Texas time), roughly 22.5 hours after Flight 15 lifted off.
paras.zh: 船只被捕获发生在今天下午 4 点 20 分。美国东部时间（格林尼治标准时间 2120；德克萨斯州当地时间下午 3:20），15 号航班起飞后大约 22.5 小时。

paras.en: Many SpaceX employees went outside to watch the vehicle, known as Ship 42, descend through the clouds toward its Starbase launch tower, which the company calls "Mechazilla."
paras.zh: 许多 SpaceX 员工走到外面观看这艘被称为“Ship 42”的飞行器穿过云层降落到其 Starbase 发射塔，该公司将其称为“Mechazilla”。

paras.en: And they got quite a show: Ship 42 nestled gently into Mechazilla's waiting arms, while "Baby Come Back" played over SpaceX's landing webcast.
paras.zh: 他们的表演相当精彩：42 号船轻轻地依偎在 Mechazilla 等待的怀抱中，而 SpaceX 的着陆网络广播中则播放着“宝贝回来了”。

paras.en: "This is so incredible to see," SpaceX's Jessie Anderson said during the livestream. "One of the most incredible and historic engineering feats of all time has just happened right in front of our eyes."
paras.zh: “这真是令人难以置信，”SpaceX 的 Jessie Anderson 在直播中说道。 “有史以来最令人难以置信、最具历史意义的工程壮举之一就发生在我们眼前。”

paras.en: Why was this such a big deal? SpaceX had already caught Super Heavy — on three previous Starship test flights, in fact. But it had never tried before with Ship. The upper stage is a tougher target, for it flies higher, farther and faster than the booster. Indeed, on Flight 15, Ship 42 came all the way back down from orbit.
paras.zh: 为什么这件事如此重要？事实上，SpaceX 在之前的三次星际飞船试飞中就已经赶上了 Super Heavy。但它以前从未尝试过使用 Ship。上级是一个更难的目标，因为它比助推器飞得更高、更远、更快。事实上，在 15 号航班上，42 号飞船一路从轨道返回。

paras.en: While the double-catch attempt, and the chopsticks success with Ship, were Flight 15's main headlines, the mission had other objectives as well. One was getting Ship to orbit, which had happened on just one previous Starship launch — Flight 14, which lifted off on Sept. 28.
paras.zh: 虽然双接尝试和筷子与飞船的成功是 15 号航班的主要头条新闻，但这次任务还有其他目标。其中之一是将飞船送入轨道，这发生在之前的一次星舰发射——9 月 28 日升空的 14 号航班上。

paras.en: Ship deployed 26 of SpaceX's next-gen Starlink V3 broadband satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO) on Flight 14, and it did so again on Flight 15. These 52 spacecraft are the first members of a constellation that will eventually consist of 100,000 satellites, if all goes according to SpaceX's plan.
paras.zh: 在 14 号航班上，这艘船在低地球轨道 (LEO) 部署了 26 颗 SpaceX 下一代 Starlink V3 宽带卫星，并在 15 号航班上再次这样做。如果一切按照 SpaceX 的计划进行，这艘船将最终由 100,000 颗卫星组成的星座的首批成员。这 52 颗航天器是该星座的首批成员。

paras.en: Some of those Starlink satellites took video and images of Ship 42's heat shield to check its health for today's landing attempt. Those images, combined with ground-based cameras, found Ship 42 to be in good shape and ready for its big moment.
paras.zh: 其中一些星链卫星拍摄了 42 号船隔热罩的视频和图像，以检查其健康状况，以适应今天的着陆尝试。这些图像与地面摄像机相结合，发现 42 号船状态良好，准备好迎接它的重要时刻。

paras.en: SpaceX plans to use Starship to build an even bigger network in LEO than the Starlink V3 system — Starmind, an AI data-center constellation that will harbor a million spacecraft, according to Elon Musk. (For context: SpaceX's current-gen Starlink network employs about 11,000 satellites at the moment.)
paras.zh: 埃隆·马斯克表示，SpaceX 计划利用 Starship 在近地轨道建立一个比 Starlink V3 系统更大的网络——Starmind，这是一个人工智能数据中心星座，将容纳 100 万艘航天器。 （背景信息：SpaceX 的当前一代 Starlink 网络目前使用了约 11,000 颗卫星。）

paras.en: Assembling these megaconstellations will require an incredible launch cadence. The double chopstick catch is key to that vision, SpaceX says, for it will enable quicker inspection, refurbishment and reflight of Starship.
paras.zh: 组装这些巨型星座将需要令人难以置信的发射节奏。 SpaceX 表示，双筷子挂钩是实现这一愿景的关键，因为它将能够更快地检查、翻新和重新飞行 Starship。

paras.en: So the company will doubtless try the maneuver again soon — probably on the next Starship flight, which won't be too far down the road.
paras.zh: 因此，该公司无疑很快就会再次尝试这种操作——可能是在下一次星舰飞行中，距离不会太远。

paras.en: Editor's note: This story was updated at 8 a.m. EST to include new details on SpaceX's Starship Flight 15 mission from SpaceX. Space.com Editor-in-Chief Tariq Malik contributed to this report. It was updated again at 4:45 p.m. ET on Nov. 14 with news of successful Ship catch.
paras.zh: 编者注：本文于美国东部时间上午 8 点更新，包含有关 SpaceX 的 Starship Flight 15 任务的新细节。 Space.com 主编塔里克·马利克为本报告做出了贡献。下午4点45分再次更新。美国东部时间 11 月 14 日，有成功捕获船只的消息。

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 14, 1969: NASA's Apollo 12 astronauts launch to the moon on a 'pinpoint landing' lunar mission
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On Nov. 14, 1969, the Apollo 12 mission launched to the moon. This was the second moon landing of the Apollo program.
paras.zh: 1969 年 11 月 14 日，阿波罗 12 号任务发射到月球。这是阿波罗计划的第二次登月。

paras.en: The two astronauts on board were Pete Conrad, commander, and Alan Bean, the lunar module pilot. Astronaut Richard Gordon, the command module pilot, stayed in the command module and orbited the moon while his crewmates went to the surface. The astronauts made a pinpoint landing in a lunar mare called the Ocean of Storms.
paras.zh: 船上的两名宇航员是指挥官皮特·康拉德和登月舱飞行员艾伦·比恩。指令舱飞行员宇航员理查德戈登留在指令舱中绕月飞行，而他的船员则前往月球表面。宇航员在名为“风暴之洋”的月球母马中精确着陆。

paras.en: The previous moon mission, Apollo 11, drifted far from the planned landing zone. But Apollo 12 landed close to a scientific target. That target was a robotic lander called Surveyor 3. Scientists wanted to look at Surveyor 3 to see how well the spacecraft lasted on the moon since it landed there more than two years earlier.
paras.zh: 上一次登月任务阿波罗 11 号偏离了计划的着陆区很远。但阿波罗 12 号着陆接近科学目标。该目标是一个名为“测量者 3”号的机器人着陆器。科学家们想要观察“测量者 3”号，看看这艘航天器自两年多前登陆月球以来在月球上的持续情况如何。

paras.en: The Apollo 12 moonwalkers also performed a lot of moon science. The astronauts picked up 75 pounds of moon rocks. Most of the rocks were basalts that formed from molten lava. These basalts showed the Apollo 12 landing site is more than 3 billion years old.
paras.zh: 阿波罗12号月球漫步者还进行了大量的月球科学研究。宇航员捡起了 75 磅的月球岩石。大多数岩石是由熔岩形成的玄武岩。这些玄武岩表明阿波罗 12 号着陆点已有超过 30 亿年的历史。

paras.en: Apollo 12 proved that the Apollo 11 moon landing was not just a one-off stunt while setting the stage for even more ambitious missions.
paras.zh: 阿波罗 12 号证明阿波罗 11 号登月不仅仅是一次性的噱头，同时也为更雄心勃勃的任务奠定了基础。

paras.en: To truly explore the moon and advance our understanding of how our solar system formed, the follow-on Apollo flights needed to be able to land where the geologists had identified as areas of interest. Apollo 12, with its touchdown in proximity to the Surveyor probe, proved this was possible.
paras.zh: 为了真正探索月球并加深我们对太阳系形成方式的了解，后续的阿波罗飞行需要能够降落在地质学家确定的感兴趣区域。阿波罗 12 号在勘测者号探测器附近着陆，证明了这是可能的。

paras.en: The launch of Apollo 12 also underscored the importance of having a well-prepared Mission Control team, an asset that would be critical to outcome of the next mission, Apollo 13.
paras.zh: 阿波罗 12 号的发射还强调了拥有一支准备充分的任务控制团队的重要性，这一资产对于下一次阿波罗 13 号任务的结果至关重要。

paras.en: The ability to recover from a complete electrical short out with the simple call of a through of a switch "SCE to AUX" proved that knowing every detail about how the spacecraft worked was key to a successful program.
paras.zh: 通过简单地调用“SCE 至 AUX”开关即可从完全电气短路中恢复的能力证明，了解航天器工作原理的每个细节是项目成功的关键。

paras.en: Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.
paras.zh: 想要更多太空历史吗？查看我们完整的“太空中的这一天”故事存档，并在 YouTube 上观看“太空中的这一天”视频。

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering 是西北太平洋地区的一名多媒体记者，在 FutureFlight.aero 和 Aviation International News 报道航空业的未来，此前曾担任 Space.com 的航天和天文学新闻编辑。作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。
