articles.title: CCIA Report Highlights Satellite Connectivity’s Potential to Expand Internet Access and Drive Economic Growth
articles.author: CCIA

paras.en: Washington — The Computer & Communications Industry Association today released Connecting the World: Unlocking the Potential of Satellite Connectivity, a new report examining how satellite technology can expand internet access, strengthen emergency communications, and drive economic growth.
paras.zh: 华盛顿——计算机和通信行业协会今天发布了一份新报告《连接世界：释放卫星连接的潜力》，该报告探讨了卫星技术如何扩大互联网接入、加强应急通信和推动经济增长。

paras.en: The report examines how the post-pandemic shift to digital services and economic opportunities exposed connectivity gaps across the world, and how next-generation satellite networks can complement terrestrial infrastructure to connect underserved communities and support applications across agriculture, transportation, and other industries.
paras.zh: 该报告探讨了后疫情时代向数字服务和经济机会的转变如何暴露了全球各地的连接鸿沟，以及下一代卫星网络如何能够对地面基础设施形成补充，从而连接服务欠缺的社区，并为农业、交通运输和其他行业的应用提供支持。

paras.en: CCIA recommends modernizing outdated spectrum and licensing rules, strengthening satellite supply chains and launch capacity, and adopting technology-neutral policies that improve connectivity affordability and digital literacy.
paras.zh: CCIA建议更新过时的频谱和许可规则，加强卫星供应链和发射能力，并采取技术中立的政策，以提高连接的经济性和数字素养。

paras.en: The following can be attributed to Karina Perez, Director of CCIA’s Space & Spectrum Policy Center:
paras.zh: 以下内容来自 CCIA 空间与频谱政策中心主任 Karina Perez：

paras.en: “Satellite connectivity can help bring more people online while creating new opportunities for businesses, communities, and consumers. Policymakers should modernize outdated rules and reduce unnecessary barriers to ensure satellite technologies can complement existing networks, expand consumer choice, and help connect underserved populations.”
paras.zh: “卫星连接可以帮助更多的人上网，同时为企业、社区和消费者创造新的机会。政策制定者应该对过时的规则进行现代化改造，减少不必要的障碍，以确保卫星技术能够补充现有网络，扩大消费者的选择，并帮助连接服务不足的人群。”

paras.en: CCIA is an international, not-for-profit trade association representing a broad cross section of communications and technology firms. For more than 50 years, CCIA has promoted open markets, open systems, and open networks. CCIA members employ more than 1.6 million workers, invest more than $100 billion in research and development, and contribute trillions of dollars in productivity to the global economy. For more, visit www.ccianet.org.
paras.zh: CCIA 是一个国际性非营利贸易协会，代表广泛的通信和技术公司。 50多年来，CCIA一直致力于推动开放市场、开放系统和开放网络。 CCIA 成员雇用了超过 160 万名工人，在研发方面投资超过 1000 亿美元，为全球经济贡献了数万亿美元的生产力。欲了解更多信息，请访问 www.ccianet.org。

articles.title: What role does industry play in Europe’s space sovereignty push?
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, SpaceNews’ Jason Rainbow interviews Atle Woello, the CEO and senior vice president of the space systems and surveillance business unit at Kongsberg NanoAvionics. They discuss the role space plays for defense systems that are increasingly interconnected across domains, as well as the role that the European industrial base can play in the continent’s recent political and fundraising push to bolster sovereignty, independence and resilience in space.
paras.zh: 在本集中，SpaceNews 的 Jason Rainbow 采访了 Kongsberg NanoAvionics 空间系统和监视业务部门的首席执行官兼高级副总裁 Atle Woello。他们讨论了太空对于跨领域互联日益紧密的防御系统的作用，以及欧洲工业基础在欧洲大陆最近为加强太空主权、独立和复原力而进行的政治和筹款活动中可以发挥的作用。

paras.en: This episode is sponsored by Xiphos Systems.
paras.zh: 本集由 Xiphos Systems 赞助。

paras.en: Xiphos Systems develops compact, high-performance embedded computing solutions for spacecraft and aerospace applications. Founded in 1996 and based in Montreal, the company specializes in commercial off-the-shelf processing platforms designed for space, combining processors, programmable logic, storage, networking, and RF capabilities in low size, weight, power, and cost designs. Its portfolio includes processor boards, onboard computers, RF payload systems, and AI-capable computing platforms for satellites, launch vehicles, lunar missions, and robotics. With more than two decades of experience and over 1,000 processor cards delivered, Xiphos supports customers from system integration through deployment, helping bring reliable computing closer to the mission.
paras.zh: Xiphos Systems 为航天器和航空航天应用开发紧凑、高性能的嵌入式计算解决方案。 Founded in 1996 and based in Montreal, the company specializes in commercial off-the-shelf processing platforms designed for space, combining processors, programmable logic, storage, networking, and RF capabilities in low size, weight, power, and cost designs.其产品组合包括处理器板、机载计算机、射频有效载荷系统以及用于卫星、运载火箭、月球任务和机器人的人工智能计算平台。 Xiphos 拥有二十多年的经验和交付的 1,000 多个处理器卡，为客户提供从系统集成到部署的支持，帮助实现可靠的计算更接近使命。

articles.title: AST SpaceMobile presses case for developing own launch vehicle
articles.author: Jeff Foust

paras.en: WASHINGTON — AST SpaceMobile executives expressed confidence in the company’s ability to field a new reusable launch vehicle in just two years despite widespread industry skepticism and conflicting accounts of where the vehicle will launch from.
paras.zh: 华盛顿——尽管业界普遍持怀疑态度，且对于该运载火箭的发射地点众说纷纭，但AST SpaceMobile的高管们仍对公司在短短两年内就能部署新型可重复使用运载火箭的能力表示信心。

paras.en: The company, which is developing a constellation of direct-to-device satellites, held an “unveiling” event in New York Nov. 12 to discuss its Blacklift launch vehicle that the company announced Nov. 6. The company said then it was developing Blacklift to provide its own way to launch its BlueBird satellites given a constrained launch market.
paras.zh: 该公司正在开发一系列直接设备卫星，于 11 月 12 日在纽约举行了一次“揭幕”活动，讨论该公司于 11 月 6 日宣布的 Blacklift 运载火箭。该公司当时表示，鉴于发射市场有限，它正在开发 Blacklift，以提供自己的蓝鸟卫星发射方式。

paras.en: “We’re not doing this thing because we want to be in the launch business. We want this because we have so much demand of our satellites and, as you have seen it, we cannot get enough launches on time,” Abel Avellan, chief executive of AST SpaceMobile, said at the event.
paras.zh: AST SpaceMobile 首席执行官阿贝尔·阿维兰 (Abel Avellan) 在活动中表示：“我们做这件事不是因为我们想从事发射业务。我们之所以这样做是因为我们对卫星的需求很大，而且正如你所看到的，我们无法按时进行足够的发射。”

paras.en: Blacklift, with a payload capacity of 20 tons to low Earth orbit, will be able to carry up to five BlueBird satellites per launch. The vehicle will be used exclusively for AST’s satellites, with a goal of launching twice a month.
paras.zh: Blacklift 的近地轨道有效载荷为 20 吨，每次发射最多可携带五颗蓝鸟卫星。该飞行器将专门用于 AST 的卫星，目标是每月发射两次。

paras.en: Although the company billed the event as an unveiling, the company showed no hardware beyond videos of engines from Firefly Aerospace that AST is acquiring for Blacklift and animations of the vehicle itself. Much of the event focused on the BlueBird satellites, such as a tour of the Midland, Texas, factory where the company builds those spacecraft.
paras.zh: 尽管该公司将此次活动宣传为揭幕仪式，但除了 AST 为 Blacklift 收购的 Firefly Aerospace 发动机的视频和车辆本身的动画之外，该公司没有展示任何硬件。活动的大部分内容都集中在蓝鸟卫星上，例如参观该公司建造这些航天器的德克萨斯州米德兰工厂。

paras.en: The company did provide a few technical details about the rocket. Blacklift will be a three-stage rocket, using seven of Firefly’s Miranda engines in its first stage, two Firefly Vira engines in the second stage and one Vira engine in the third stage. That is a nontraditional approach in a launch market where most vehicles optimized for low Earth orbit payloads use only two stages.
paras.zh: 该公司确实提供了有关火箭的一些技术细节。 Blacklift 将是一款三级火箭，第一级使用七台 Firefly Miranda 发动机，第二级使用两台 Firefly Vira 发动机，第三级使用一台 Vira 发动机。在发射市场中，这是一种非传统方法，大多数针对低地球轨道有效载荷进行优化的运载工具仅使用两级。

paras.en: Avellan said the three-stage approach is tied to plans to recover and reuse the first stage. “When you have three stages, the first stage will go up not that much and will come back down very easily, compared of going back very high and then trying to maneuver that back to Earth,” he said. However, existing reusable rockets such as Falcon 9 and New Glenn, and those in development by Relativity Space, Rocket Lab and Stoke Space, use two-stage designs.
paras.zh: 阿维兰表示，三阶段方法与回收和再利用第一阶段的计划有关。他说：“当你有三个阶段时，第一阶段上升的幅度不会很大，并且很容易下降，与回到很高的高度然后试图将其返回地球相比。”然而，现有的可重复使用火箭，如猎鹰 9 号和新格伦号，以及相对论空间公司、火箭实验室和斯托克空间公司正在开发的火箭，都采用两级设计。

paras.en: Blacklift will also entirely use carbon composite materials, which he said comes from the company’s experience using those materials on its spacecraft as well as Firefly’s experience from its vehicles. Composites, he said, reduce the vehicle’s dry mass by 40% compared to metallic structures.
paras.zh: Blacklift还将完全使用碳复合材料，他说这来自该公司在其航天器上使用这些材料的经验以及Firefly在其车辆上的经验。他说，与金属结构相比，复合材料可将车辆的干质量减少 40%。

paras.en: Perhaps the most notable aspect of Blacklift is the vehicle’s schedule, which calls for a first flight in late 2028. AST argues that its decision to use Firefly engines, rather than develop its own, makes that schedule feasible.
paras.zh: 也许 Blacklift 最引人注目的方面是该车辆的时间表，该时间表要求在 2028 年末进行首次飞行。 AST 认为，其决定使用 Firefly 发动机而不是自行开发发动机，使得该时间表变得可行。

paras.en: “A typical design cycle of a rocket could be over a decade. Eighty percent of that is on the engine,” he said.
paras.zh: “火箭的典型设计周期可能超过十年。其中百分之八十是在发动机上，”他说。

paras.en: “We’re starting this program on third base,” he added. “We bypass 10 years of engineering and R&D.”
paras.zh: “我们正在三垒开始这个计划，”他补充道。 “我们绕过了 10 年的工程和研发。”

paras.en: In addition to buying the engines from Firefly, AST said in its presentation it was buying other components, from avionics to separation systems, from “heritage suppliers,” although Avellan said in his talk that the company would be “95% vertically integrated” on the rocket. He said the company is starting to make composite tanks at its Midland factory using existing tools, with 10 tanks completed by January for testing.
paras.zh: 除了从 Firefly 购买发动机外，AST 在其演示中表示，它还从“传统供应商”购买其他组件，从航空电子设备到分离系统，尽管阿维兰在演讲中表示该公司将“95% 垂直整合”在火箭上。他表示，该公司正开始在其米德兰工厂使用现有工具制造复合材料储罐，到 1 月份已完成 10 个储罐进行测试。

paras.en: “What remains is integration, stage testing, and licensing: exactly what the plan is built around,” the company stated in a slide.
paras.zh: 该公司在幻灯片中表示：“剩下的就是集成、阶段测试和许可：该计划正是围绕这些内容构建的。”

paras.en: However, it is not clear how well the company’s experience with composite structures will translate to tanks. Rocket Lab, another company using carbon composites for launch vehicle structures, had a composite propellant tank built for the first stage of its Neutron rocket damaged in qualification testing in January. In October, Rocket Lab reported another issue with the tanks, causing it to delay the vehicle’s first launch to sometime in 2027.
paras.zh: 然而，目前尚不清楚该公司在复合材料结构方面的经验将如何转化为坦克。另一家使用碳复合材料用于运载火箭结构的公司 Rocket Lab 为其中子火箭第一级建造的复合推进剂箱在 1 月份的资格测试中受损。 10 月，火箭实验室报告了坦克的另一个问题，导致其将车辆的首次发射推迟到 2027 年的某个时间。

paras.en: Another issue is where Blacklift will launch from. In a Nov. 9 earnings call, Avellan indicated that the vehicle would initially launch from the same pad at Wallops Island, Virginia, built for Northrop Grumman’s Antares and being updated to support Firefly’s Alpha and the joint Firefly/Northrop Eclipse vehicles.
paras.zh: 另一个问题是 Blacklift 将从哪里启动。在 11 月 9 日的财报电话会议上，阿维兰表示，该飞行器最初将从弗吉尼亚州沃勒普斯岛的同一个发射台发射，该发射台是为诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司的 Antares 建造的，并进行了更新以支持萤火虫的 Alpha 和萤火虫/诺斯罗普 Eclipse 联合飞行器。

paras.en: “Our first launches are going to be upgrades on existing launch, which Firefly already have prearranged for their Eclipse configuration,” he said. “Wallops will require an upgrade that we can fit in the timeframe that we have.”
paras.zh: “我们的首次发布将是现有发布的升级，Firefly 已经为其 Eclipse 配置预先安排了，”他说。 “Wallops 需要进行升级，以便我们能够在现有的时间内完成。”

paras.en: He provided similar comments at the unveiling event. “We have a launch site, a site which is Wallops. It’s the same place where Antares used to fly, and where the Eclipse from Firefly will fly, and that were upgrading that facility.”
paras.zh: 他在揭幕仪式上也发表了类似的评论。 “We have a launch site, a site which is Wallops. It’s the same place where Antares used to fly, and where the Eclipse from Firefly will fly, and that were upgrading that facility.”

paras.en: “Antares heritage pad at Wallops, already being upgraded for Miranda engines,” stated a slide in AST’s presentation.
paras.zh: “瓦洛普斯的安塔瑞斯遗产基地已经针对米兰达发动机进行了升级，”AST 演示文稿中的一张幻灯片说道。

paras.en: However, a spokesperson for the Virginia Spaceport Authority, which operates the commercial launch pads at Wallops, told SpaceNews Nov. 12 that while it has engaged in “early, preliminary conversations” with AST about hosting Blacklift launches, those talks do not include Pad 0-A, the pad built for Antares.
paras.zh: 然而，负责运营沃洛普斯商业发射台的弗吉尼亚航天港管理局的一位发言人在 11 月 12 日告诉《太空新闻》，虽然该机构已与 AST 就举办 Blacklift 发射进行了“早期、初步对话”，但这些谈判并不包括为 Antares 建造的 Pad 0-A 发射台。

paras.en: The options available to AST at Wallops include renovating Pad 0-B, which is used for smaller solid-fuel rockets, or building a new pad. Either would be significantly more expensive and time-consuming than using Pad 0-A, as AST claims it can do.
paras.zh: Wallops 的 AST 可用的选项包括翻新用于小型固体燃料火箭的 0-B 发射台，或建造一个新的发射台。正如 AST 声称的那样，这两种方法都比使用 Pad 0-A 更昂贵、更耗时。

paras.en: The company did not disclose how much it plans to spend developing Blacklift beyond the $1.3 billion contract with Firefly that includes engines for the first three rockets, a license to allow AST to produce its own engines and engineering services.
paras.zh: 该公司没有透露除了与 Firefly 签订的价值 13 亿美元的合同之外，它还计划花费多少资金来开发 Blacklift，其中包括前三枚火箭的发动机、允许 AST 生产自己的发动机和工程服务的许可证。

articles.title: I Am Artemis Katie Spicer
articles.author: Lee Mohon

paras.en: For Katie Spicer, embracing opportunity and challenge has led to giant leaps during her time at NASA. Now as the NASA lander integration lead for Blue Origin’s Blue Moon Mark 2 lander, one of the commercially provided human landing systems for NASA’s Artemis program, Spicer will have her handprint on history.
paras.zh: For Katie Spicer, embracing opportunity and challenge has led to giant leaps during her time at NASA.现在，作为蓝色起源 Blue Moon Mark 2 着陆器（NASA 阿尔忒弥斯计划商业提供的载人着陆系统之一）的 NASA 着陆器集成负责人，斯派塞将在历史上留下她的手印。

paras.en: Spicer works in the Flight Operations Directorate at NASA’s Johnson Space Center in Houston, where she evaluates and monitors design and development of Blue Origin’s lander. The design of the Blue Moon lander is rapidly evolving as Blue Origin continues to develop a streamlined lander test article for the agency’s Artemis III rendezvous and docking mission in low Earth orbit as well as a fully functional lander for a crewed lunar landing in 2028.
paras.zh: 斯派塞在休斯敦美国宇航局约翰逊航天中心的飞行运营理事会工作，负责评估和监控蓝色起源着陆器的设计和开发。 The design of the Blue Moon lander is rapidly evolving as Blue Origin continues to develop a streamlined lander test article for the agency’s Artemis III rendezvous and docking mission in low Earth orbit as well as a fully functional lander for a crewed lunar landing in 2028.

paras.en: Spicer works closely with her NASA and Blue Origin counterparts to ensure the design of the Blue Moon lander can support the overall Artemis mission objectives.
paras.zh: 斯派塞与美国宇航局和蓝色起源同行密切合作，确保蓝月着陆器的设计能够支持阿耳忒弥斯的整体任务目标。

paras.en: “I look at the design of everything Artemis crews will touch, work with, or interface with to ensure systems will function the way crews will need them to,” Spicer said. “In some cases, the design might meet requirements, but I delve deeper into details. How easy will it be for crew to grab handles or handrails? Can they operate push-button displays in microgravity? Are the hygiene systems as user-friendly as possible in the limited space that’s available in the spacecraft? And, are there proper procedures and training to ensure the crew can safely and effectively use the systems? Evaluating all these operational details with crew perspective is part of my job.”
paras.zh: 斯派塞说：“我会研究阿耳忒弥斯船员将接触、使用或接口的所有东西的设计，以确保系统能够按照船员需要的方式运行。” “在某些情况下，设计可能会满足要求，但我会更深入地研究细节。机组人员抓住把手或扶手有多容易？他们可以在微重力下操作按钮显示器吗？在航天器的有限空间内，卫​​生系统是否尽可能方便用户？并且，是否有适当的程序和培训来确保机组人员能够安全有效地使用这些系统？从机组人员的角度评估所有这些操作细节是我工作的一部分。”

paras.en: Spicer has spent her career looking at the small details in the big picture.
paras.zh: 斯派塞的职业生涯一直着眼于大局中的小细节。

paras.en: After earning a bachelor’s degree in microbiology from the Pennsylvania State University in State College, Spicer spent several years working as a full-time homemaker and raising three children. She got her start at NASA working part-time in the historic Life Sciences Laboratory, performing duties such as washing dishes, cleaning lab equipment, and running tests for scientists.
paras.zh: 在宾夕法尼亚州立大学州立学院分校获得微生物学学士学位后，斯派塞做了几年全职家庭主妇并抚养了三个孩子。她在 NASA 历史悠久的生命科学实验室开始兼职工作，履行洗碗、清洁实验室设备和为科学家进行测试等职责。

paras.en: “I went from tidying up and keeping my home running to maintaining the historic lab where the Apollo crews were quarantined when they came back from the Moon and the Moon rock samples were stored,” Spicer said.
paras.zh: 斯派塞说：“我从打扫卫生、维持家的运转，到维护历史悠久的实验室，阿波罗宇航员从月球回来后都在那里被隔离，并储存了月球岩石样本。”

paras.en: From there, Spicer began working with science payloads on the space station. She helped operate the Human Research Facility racks in the International Space Station National Laboratory and worked with scientists and crew to ensure in-flight processes and protocols were completed. It was there that Spicer found a love for the fast-paced dynamic of real-time space operations.
paras.zh: 从那时起，斯派塞开始研究空间站上的科学有效载荷。 She helped operate the Human Research Facility racks in the International Space Station National Laboratory and worked with scientists and crew to ensure in-flight processes and protocols were completed.正是在那里，斯派塞发现了对实时太空作战的快节奏动态的热爱。

paras.en: Spicer became a flight controller at NASA Johnson’s Mission Control Center in 2018. The learning curve to become a flight controller was steep, but it did not deter her. Spicer studied and trained for five years to earn the ultimate instructor and flight controller certifications.
paras.zh: Spicer became a flight controller at NASA Johnson’s Mission Control Center in 2018. The learning curve to become a flight controller was steep, but it did not deter her.斯派塞经过五年的学习和培训，获得了终极教练和飞行管制员认证。

paras.en: “Unlike most people I work with, I don’t have an engineering degree,” Spicer said. “On my own, I studied engineering principles. I passed boards and certification tests. I learned to speak ‘engineer!’”
paras.zh: “与我共事的大多数人不同，我没有工程学位，”斯派塞说。 “我独自学习了工程原理。我通过了委员会和认证测试。我学会了说‘工程师！’”

paras.en: Spicer spent five years as an Operations and Support Officer in the space station’s flight control room in Mission Control, also known as the “front room” to spaceflight.
paras.zh: 斯派塞曾在空间站飞行控制室的飞行任务控制中心担任运营与支持官长达五年，该控制中心也被称为太空飞行的“前厅”。

paras.en: Now, when she looks at the Moon in the night sky, Spicer says she’s humbled and honored to be part of the team that’s sending astronauts back to the lunar surface.
paras.zh: 现在，当她看着夜空中的月亮时，斯派塞说，她很荣幸能够成为将宇航员送回月球表面的团队的一员。

paras.en: “I’m reminded of the great responsibility that NASA has in this endeavor, of the legacy of the courageous Apollo crews who went before, and inspiring the next generation of space explorers to keep going and reaching for the stars!” she said.
paras.zh: “我想起了美国宇航局在这项努力中所承担的重大责任，以及勇敢的阿波罗宇航员的遗产，并激励下一代太空探索者继续前进并到达星星！”她说。

paras.en: As part of a Golden Age of innovation and exploration, NASA will send Artemis astronauts on increasingly difficult missions near the lunar South Pole to explore more of the Moon than ever before. In addition to providing economic benefits and advancing scientific discovery through its Moon missions, NASA will establish an enduring human presence on the lunar surface and build on the agency’s foundation for the first crewed mission to Mars.
paras.zh: 作为创新和探索黄金时代的一部分，美国宇航局将派遣阿耳忒弥斯宇航员前往月球南极附近执行日益艰巨的任务，以探索比以往更多的月球区域。除了通过月球任务提供经济效益和推进科学发现外，美国宇航局还将在月球表面建立持久的人类存在，并为该机构首次载人火星任务奠定基础。

paras.en: To learn more about the Artemis program, visit:
paras.zh: 要了解有关 Artemis 计划的更多信息，请访问：

articles.title: A Global Rebound for Mangroves

paras.en: Scientists began using satellites to map mangrove forests in the 1970s after the launch of the first Landsat satellite. For decades, the story they told about mangroves was dominated by loss and decline. Research published in Science suggests that the tide has turned.
paras.zh: 20 世纪 70 年代，第一颗 Landsat 卫星发射后，科学家们开始使用卫星绘制红树林地图。几十年来，他们讲述的关于红树林的故事主要是关于红树林的损失和衰退。 《科学》杂志上发表的研究表明，潮流已经转变。

paras.en: A global rebound began around 2010, the scientists found, led by the expansion of mangrove forests in Asia, Australia, and South America. The researchers analyzed Landsat imagery collected between 1984 and 2023, looking for signs of changes in the extent and density of mangrove canopy.
paras.zh: 科学家发现，在亚洲、澳大利亚和南美洲红树林扩张的带动下，全球范围开始出现反弹，于 2010 年左右开始。研究人员分析了 1984 年至 2023 年间收集的陆地卫星图像，寻找红树林树冠范围和密度变化的迹象。

paras.en: They tallied losses of nearly 3,000 square kilometers (1,200 square miles) between 1984 and 2010, followed by an unexpected increase of nearly 2,000 square kilometers (770 square miles) of mangroves after 2010. They also found that many of today's mangrove forests have denser, more closed canopies than they did in 2010, a sign of healthier, less degraded forests, particularly in South America.
paras.zh: 他们统计，1984 年至 2010 年间，红树林损失了近 3,000 平方公里（1,200 平方英里），而 2010 年之后，红树林意外增加了近 2,000 平方公里（770 平方英里）。他们还发现，如今许多红树林的树冠比 2010 年更密集、更封闭，这是森林更健康、退化更少的标志，特别是在南美洲。

paras.en: "Other research groups have mapped and analyzed long-term changes in select regions, but these are the first global mangrove maps that cover such a long period," said Zhen Zhang, an environmental scientist at Tulane University. "About two-thirds of the expansion was due to mangroves colonizing new areas and the other third due to restoration and regrowth in degraded areas," he added.
paras.zh: 杜兰大学环境科学家张震说：“其他研究小组已经绘制并分析了选定区域的长期变化，但这是第一张涵盖如此长时期的全球红树林地图。” “大约三分之二的扩张是由于红树林在新地区的殖民，另外三分之一是由于退化地区的恢复和再生，”他补充道。

paras.en: One of the most notable reversals occurred in Southeast Asia—especially Burma (Myanmar). The country lost mangroves rapidly in the 1980s and 1990s due to the expansion of agriculture, aquaculture, and firewood harvesting in coastal areas, but the trend reversed around 2010, when mangrove area began expanding in many places. The authors attribute the turnaround to increased awareness and restoration efforts after the devastating Indian Ocean tsunami in 2004, strengthened legal protections for forests, and high rates of sedimentation that opened up new mudflats for colonization.
paras.zh: 最显着的逆转之一发生在东南亚，尤其是缅甸。 20世纪80年代和90年代，由于沿海地区农业、水产养殖和薪柴采伐的扩张，红树林迅速消失，但2010年左右，红树林面积开始逆转，许多地方开始扩大。作者将这一转变归因于 2004 年毁灭性的印度洋海啸后人们的意识增强和恢复努力、加强了对森林的法律保护以及高沉积率，为殖民开辟了新的泥滩。

paras.en: The pair of Landsat images above shows expansion of mangrove forests in Palaw Township in Burma's Myeik District—an area that has seen both significant regeneration of degraded mangrove forests and the spread of trees into new areas since 2010. In this region, much of the regeneration appears to be occurring in abandoned rice fields (brown) south of the village of Kyauktaung. People on nearby Pyin Bukyi Island, meanwhile, have experimented with conservation projects and tree planting efforts to support mangroves. Despite the gains, deforestation remains a common challenge in Burma, which lost 28.6 percent of its mangrove area between the 1980s and 2010. Since then, the country's mangrove area has grown about 10 percent.
paras.zh: 上面的两张 Landsat 图像显示了缅甸丹老县 Palaw 镇的红树林扩张情况，自 2010 年以来，该地区退化的红树林得到了显着的再生，树木也扩展到了新的地区。在该地区，大部分再生似乎发生在 Kyauktaung 村以南的废弃稻田（棕色）中。与此同时，附近彬布基岛上的人们已经尝试了保护项目和植树活动来支持红树林。尽管取得了进展，森林砍伐仍然是缅甸面临的一个普遍挑战，在 20 世纪 80 年代至 2010 年间，缅甸红树林面积减少了 28.6%。此后，该国红树林面积增长了约 10%。

paras.en: Mangrove trees are relatively small—averaging about 13 meters (43 feet)—but mighty from an ecological perspective, with mangrove ecosystems storing up to four times as much carbon as taller inland tropical forests. The trees play an important role in protecting coastal communities from erosion and storm surges, and their distinctive stilt-like roots provide habitat and vital nursery grounds for fish, shrimp, crabs, and other marine life.
paras.zh: 红树林相对较小，平均高度约为 13 米（43 英尺），但从生态角度来看却非常强大，红树林生态系统储存的碳量是较高的内陆热带森林的四倍。这些树木在保护沿海社区免受侵蚀和风暴潮影响方面发挥着重要作用，其独特的高跷状根为鱼、虾、螃蟹和其他海洋生物提供了栖息地和重要的苗圃。

paras.en: In several areas, such as around the mouth of the Amazon River and in northern Australia, extensive deposition of sediment has created new mudflats that mangroves have successfully colonized, contributing to steady increases in each of these regions since the 1990s. At the northern and southern edges of their range, including the southeastern U.S., warming temperatures and fewer freezes have also allowed mangroves to push into areas that were previously too cold, Zhang explained.
paras.zh: 在一些地区，例如亚马逊河口周围和澳大利亚北部，沉积物的广泛沉积形成了新的泥滩，红树林成功地在这些泥滩上生长，从而自 20 世纪 90 年代以来这些地区的面积稳步增长。张解释说，在其分布范围的北部和南部边缘，包括美国东南部，气温升高和冰冻减少也使红树林得以进入以前太冷的地区。

paras.en: There are some areas, however, where losses have outweighed gains. Substantial mangrove losses in the Niger Delta, for instance, have reduced the total mangrove area in West and Central Africa since 2010. North America and southern Africa, meanwhile, have seen widespread degradation after tropical cyclones devastated broad swaths of mangroves. "The global successes we've seen with mangroves during the past decade should not be seen as grounds for complacency," cautioned Zhang. "This underscores that conservation and slowing deforestation can lead to huge positive impacts when coupled with natural expansion and regeneration."
paras.zh: 然而，在某些领域，损失大于收益。例如，自 2010 年以来，尼日尔三角洲的红树林大幅减少，导致西非和中非的红树林总面积减少。与此同时，热带气旋摧毁了大片红树林，北美和南部非洲的红树林面积也出现了大范围的退化。 “过去十年我们在红树林方面取得的全球成功不应被视为自满的理由，”张警告说。 “这强调了保护和减缓森林砍伐与自然扩张和再生相结合可以产生巨大的积极影响。”

paras.en: NASA Earth Observatory images by Michala Garrison, using Landsat data from the U.S. Geological Survey. Story by Adam Voiland.
paras.zh: NASA 地球观测站图像，由 Michala Garrison 使用美国地质调查局的陆地卫星数据拍摄。亚当·沃伊兰的故事。

articles.title: APOD: 2026 November 13 – NGC 206 and the Star Clouds of Andromeda

paras.en: Discover the cosmos! Each day a different image or photograph of our fascinating universe is featured, along with a brief explanation written by a professional astronomer.
paras.zh: 探索宇宙！每天都会展示我们迷人的宇宙的不同图像或照片，以及由专业天文学家撰写的简短说明。

paras.en: NGC 206 and the Star Clouds of Andromeda
paras.zh: NGC 206 和仙女座星云

paras.en: Explanation: The large stellar association cataloged as NGC 206 is nestled within the dusty arms of the neighboring Andromeda galaxy along with the galaxy's pinkish star-forming regions. Also known as M31, the spiral galaxy is a mere 2.5 million light-years away. NGC 206 is found at the center of this sharp and detailed close-up of the southwestern extent of Andromeda's disk. The bright, blue stars of NGC 206 indicate its youth. In fact, its youngest massive stars are less than 10 million years old. Much larger than the open or galactic clusters of young stars in the disk of our Milky Way galaxy, NGC 206 spans about 4,000 light-years. That's comparable in size to the giant stellar nurseries NGC 604 in nearby spiral M33 and the Tarantula Nebula in the Large Magellanic Cloud.
paras.zh: 说明：编目为 NGC 206 的大型恒星协会坐落在邻近仙女座星系的尘埃臂内，以及该星系的粉红色恒星形成区域。这个螺旋星系也被称为 M31，距我们仅 250 万光年。 NGC 206 位于仙女座星系盘西南范围清晰而详细的特写镜头的中心。 NGC 206 明亮的蓝色恒星表明它还很年轻。事实上，它最年轻的大质量恒星的年龄还不到一千万年。 NGC 206 比我们银河系盘中的疏散星团或年轻恒星星团大得多，其跨度约为 4,000 光年。它的大小与附近 M33 旋涡中的巨型恒星托儿所 NGC 604 和大麦哲伦星云中的狼蛛星云相当。

articles.title: Kenya begins countdown towards end of Ebola after last patient discharged

paras.en: Kenya begins countdown towards end of Ebola after last patient discharged
paras.zh: 最后一名患者出院后，肯尼亚开始倒计时埃博拉结束

paras.en: Authorities will now monitor the situation for 42 days before the country can be officially declared free of Ebola disease caused by the Bundibugyo species.
paras.zh: 当局现在将监测局势 42 天，然后才能正式宣布该国已消除由本迪布焦物种引起的埃博拉疾病。

paras.en: The development comes more than a month after Kenya confirmed its first case, which was linked to the ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).
paras.zh: 这一进展发生在肯尼亚确认首例病例一个多月后，该病例与刚果民主共和国（DRC）持续爆发的疫情有关。

paras.en: “Forty-two days is twice the longest incubation period of the virus. If no new case is recorded in that period, Kenya will be declared free of Ebola on 23 December 2026,” said Aden Duale, Cabinet Secretary for Health, speaking in the capital, Nairobi, on Wednesday.
paras.zh: “四十二天是该病毒最长潜伏期的两倍。如果在此期间没有记录到新病例，肯尼亚将于 2026 年 12 月 23 日宣布摆脱埃博拉病毒，”内阁卫生部长亚丁·杜阿勒 (Aden Duale) 周三在首都内罗毕发表讲话时表示。

paras.en: The UN World Health Organization (WHO) congratulated Kenya on the milestone but stressed the need to remain vigilant.
paras.zh: 联合国世界卫生组织（WHO）祝贺肯尼亚取得这一里程碑，但强调需要保持警惕。

paras.en: Authorities should keep up disease surveillance, screen patients in health facilities and strengthen laboratory capacity and health worker preparedness so that any new cases are identified and controlled quickly, said Dr. Abdourahmane Diallo, Director for Programme Management at the WHO Regional Office for Africa.
paras.zh: 世卫组织非洲区域办事处项目管理主任阿卜杜拉赫马内·迪亚洛博士表示，当局应继续进行疾病监测，对卫生机构中的患者进行筛查，并加强实验室能力和卫生工作者的准备，以便迅速发现和控制任何新病例。

paras.en: Kenya confirmed its first case on 6 October – a Kenyan man who had travelled home from the DRC via Uganda and died at a Nairobi hospital.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚于 10 月 6 日确认了第一例病例，一名肯尼亚男子从刚果民主共和国经乌干达回国，在内罗毕一家医院死亡。

paras.en: Contact tracing quickly found all 135 people who had been in close contact with him, both in Kenya and abroad. Those at risk stayed in quarantine, where health workers monitored them every day.
paras.zh: 接触者追踪很快找到了在肯尼亚和国外与他有过密切接触的所有 135 人。那些处于危险中的人留在隔离区，卫生工作者每天对他们进行监测。

paras.en: Eight more people tested positive – four family members of the first patient and four health workers who had cared for him before Ebola was suspected.
paras.zh: 另有八人检测呈阳性，其中包括第一位患者的四名家庭成员和在疑似埃博拉病毒之前照顾过他的四名卫生工作者。

paras.en: As they were all in quarantine, the virus never spread to the community.
paras.zh: 由于他们都处于隔离状态，病毒从未传播到社区。

paras.en: The last case was confirmed on 19 October and no new case has been recorded since. Seven patients have recovered and two people have died, WHO said.
paras.zh: 最后一例于 10 月 19 日确诊，此后没有记录新病例。世界卫生组织表示，七名患者已康复，两人死亡。

paras.en: Health authorities stressed that the fight against Ebola is not over.
paras.zh: 卫生当局强调，抗击埃博拉病毒的斗争尚未结束。

paras.en: “Let me be clear. The countdown is not the end of our response,” Mr. Duale said, noting that rapid response teams will stay on guard, every alert will be investigated and survivors will receive follow-up care and support.
paras.zh: “让我明确一点。倒计时并不是我们应对行动的结束，”杜阿勒先生说，他指出快速反应小组将保持警惕，对每一个警报都将进行调查，幸存者将得到后续护理和支持。

articles.title: COP31: Cities rise up the climate agenda as leaders face demands for action

paras.en: COP31: Cities rise up the climate agenda as leaders face demands for action
paras.zh: COP31：随着领导人面临采取行动的要求，城市提出了气候议程

paras.en: From flooded homes to melting Himalayan glaciers, the human cost of climate change took centre stage at COP31 on Thursday, as world leaders turned their attention to protecting cities and vulnerable communities, while activists challenged governments to do more.
paras.zh: 从被洪水淹没的房屋到融化的喜马拉雅冰川，气候变化造成的人员伤亡成为周四 COP31 会议的中心议题，世界领导人将注意力转向保护城市和脆弱社区，而活动人士则要求政府采取更多行动。

paras.en: - Resilient cities: Leaders hold a historic dialogue on housing, urban resilience and climate action.
paras.zh: - 韧性城市：领导人就住房、城市韧性和气候行动举行历史性对话。

paras.en: - Leaders’ Summit: Vulnerable countries demand greater protection and access to climate finance.
paras.zh: - 领导人峰会：脆弱国家需要更多保护和获得气候融资的机会。

paras.en: - Negotiations: Divisions persist over funding adaptation and accelerating climate action.
paras.zh: - 谈判：在资助适应和加速气候行动方面仍然存在分歧。

paras.en: - Climate justice: Greta Thunberg joins activists from Nepal and Australia in demanding change.
paras.zh: - 气候正义：格蕾塔·桑伯格与尼泊尔和澳大利亚的活动人士一起要求变革。

paras.en: - Disaster risk financing: New UN platform aims to unlock more than $3 billion to protect 75 million people from climate shocks by 2030.
paras.zh: - 灾害风险融资：新的联合国平台旨在到 2030 年释放超过 30 亿美元，以保护 7500 万人免受气候冲击。

paras.en: Climate change is often paired with images of melting glaciers, disappearing forests and devastating fires. But for millions living in cities, the crisis is increasingly knocking on their doors.
paras.zh: 气候变化常常与冰川融化、森林消失和毁灭性火灾的画面联系在一起。但对于生活在城市的数百万人来说，危机正日益向他们逼近。

paras.en: The signs are everywhere: in floodwaters pouring into family homes, unbearable heat inside poorly built housing, and neighbourhoods where inadequate drainage turns heavy rains into disaster.
paras.zh: 这些迹象随处可见：洪水涌入家庭住宅，建筑简陋的房屋内酷热难耐，排水不畅的社区因暴雨而酿成灾难。

paras.en: “Perhaps we have to change … the imaginary when we talk and think about climate change,” UN-Habitat Executive Director Anacláudia Rossbach told UN News on the sidelines of COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye.
paras.zh: “也许我们必须改变......当我们谈论和思考气候变化时的想象，”联合国人居署执行主任阿纳克劳迪亚·罗斯巴赫在土耳其安塔利亚举行的第三十一届联合国气候变化框架公约（COP31）间隙告诉《联合国新闻》。

paras.en: Her message was simple: cities are on the front lines of climate change, and protecting them means protecting the people who live there.
paras.zh: 她的信息很简单：城市处于气候变化的最前线，保护它们就意味着保护居住在那里的人们。

paras.en: For the first time at a UN climate conference, the COP31 Leaders' Summit dedicated a high-level dialogue to urban resilience, adaptation and climate action.
paras.zh: COP31 领导人峰会首次在联合国气候会议上专门就城市复原力、适应和气候行动进行了高层对话。

paras.en: The meeting brought together national and local leaders, financial institutions and other partners to address a growing challenge: up to three billion people lack adequate housing, while more than one billion live in informal settlements, often exposed to floods, landslides and extreme heat.
paras.zh: 这次会议汇集了国家和地方领导人、金融机构和其他合作伙伴，共同应对日益严峻的挑战：多达 30 亿人缺乏足够的住房，而超过 10 亿人居住在非正规住区，经常遭受洪水、山体滑坡和酷热的影响。

paras.en: In remarks delivered on behalf of Secretary-General António Guterres, UN-Habitat chief Anacláudia Rossbach stressed that housing must be at the heart of climate action.
paras.zh: 联合国人居署负责人阿纳克劳迪亚·罗斯巴赫在代表秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯发表讲话时强调，住房必须成为气候行动的核心。

paras.en: “Housing is climate action. Urban planning is climate action. Access to basic services is climate action,” she said.
paras.zh: “住房是气候行动。城市规划是气候行动。获得基本服务是气候行动，”她说。

paras.en: Speaking separately to UN News, she called for greater attention to the poorest communities, particularly those living in informal settlements, who have fewer resources to prepare for disasters or recover from them.
paras.zh: 她在接受《联合国新闻》采访时，呼吁更多地关注最贫困的社区，特别是那些生活在非正规住区的社区，他们用于备灾或灾后恢复的资源较少。

paras.en: Protecting them requires more than stronger buildings. It also means access to drainage, sanitation, electricity and water, backed by better urban planning and financing.
paras.zh: 保护它们需要的不仅仅是更坚固的建筑。它还意味着在更好的城市规划和融资的支持下获得排水、卫生设施、电力和水。

paras.en: “We need systemic change,” Ms. Rossbach said, underscoring the importance of partnerships among governments, banks, businesses and communities.
paras.zh: “我们需要系统性变革，”罗斯巴赫女士说，她强调了政府、银行、企业和社区之间合作的重要性。

paras.en: There are signs of progress. A new UN-Habitat analysis found that 80 per cent of national climate plans now contain well-developed urban measures, up from 50 per cent in the previous round.
paras.zh: 有进步的迹象。联合国人居署的一项新分析发现，目前 80% 的国家气候计划包含完善的城市措施，高于上一轮的 50%。

paras.en: Yet cities need around $4.5 trillion in climate investment annually through 2030, while current financing covers only about one-fifth of that amount.
paras.zh: 然而，到 2030 年，城市每年需要约 4.5 万亿美元的气候投资，而目前的融资仅占该金额的五分之一左右。

paras.en: For Ms. Rossbach, the meeting marked a turning point.
paras.zh: 对于罗斯巴赫女士来说，这次会议标志着一个转折点。

paras.en: “We brought everybody that we need to bring together at this meeting,” she said, expressing hope that cities would gain a stronger voice in future negotiations and better access to financing.
paras.zh: 她说：“我们在这次会议上召集了所有需要召集的人。”她表示希望各城市能够在未来的谈判中获得更强有力的发言权并获得更好的融资机会。

paras.en: In other positive news, 69 mayors representing more than 250 million people committed to another year of climate action through the Yearly Offer of Action initiative, a 60 per cent increase from last year.
paras.zh: 其他积极消息包括，代表超过 2.5 亿人口的 69 名市长通过“年度行动倡议”承诺将在新一年采取气候行动，这一数字比去年增加了 60%。

paras.en: Their plans include flood-warning systems in Addis Ababa, London's first dedicated heat plan and incentives to improve the environmental performance of 400 commercial buildings in Melbourne.
paras.zh: 他们的计划包括亚的斯亚贝巴的洪水预警系统、伦敦第一个专门的供热计划以及旨在改善墨尔本 400 座商业建筑环境绩效的激励措施。

paras.en: World leaders confront the cost of climate disasters
paras.zh: 世界领导人面临气候灾难的代价

paras.en: At the second day of the Leaders’ Summit, developing nations renewed appeals for support as they grapple with mounting climate-related losses.
paras.zh: 在领导人峰会的第二天，发展中国家再次呼吁获得支持，以应对日益严重的气候相关损失。

paras.en: Seychelles warned that recovering from increasingly destructive storms and floods can leave small countries trapped in debt, while Nepal highlighted growing dangers facing mountain communities as glaciers melt and extreme weather intensifies.
paras.zh: 塞舌尔警告称，从破坏性日益增强的风暴和洪水中恢复可能会使小国陷入债务困境，而尼泊尔则强调，随着冰川融化和极端天气加剧，山区社区面临的危险日益增加。

paras.en: After failing to secure a dedicated agenda item earlier this week, Nepal, Bhutan and Kyrgyzstan joined Tajikistan and Pakistan in calling for greater protection of glaciers and mountain communities. Nepal also proposed a “Sagarmatha to the Sea” partnership linking mountain and coastal communities, alongside stronger early warning systems and climate finance.
paras.zh: 在本周早些时候未能确定专门的议程项目后，尼泊尔、不丹和吉尔吉斯斯坦与塔吉克斯坦和巴基斯坦一起呼吁加强对冰川和山区社区的保护。尼泊尔还提出了“萨加玛塔到海洋”伙伴关系，将山区和沿海社区联系起来，同时加强预警系统和气候融资。

paras.en: In other highlights, UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham announced the country’s first special representative for climate security, citing growing links between climate change, food insecurity, migration and conflict.
paras.zh: 在其他亮点中，英国首相安迪·伯纳姆宣布任命该国首位气候安全特别代表，理由是气候变化、粮食不安全、移民和冲突之间的联系日益密切。

paras.en: In the negotiation rooms, delegates continued to wrestle with disagreements over adaptation finance and the future of fossil fuels.
paras.zh: 在谈判室里，代表们继续就适应资金和化石燃料的未来问题上的分歧进行斗争。

paras.en: Small island nations demanded faster emissions reductions, while fossil fuel-producing countries defended their development priorities, underscoring the difficulties of reaching agreement.
paras.zh: 小岛屿国家要求加快减排，而化石燃料生产国则捍卫其发展优先事项，强调达成协议的难度。

paras.en: Financial commitments did emerge elsewhere. Philanthropic organizations announced more than $480 million to tackle methane and other powerful greenhouse gases, alongside an additional $25 million to support emissions reductions in seven countries.
paras.zh: 财政承诺确实出现在其他地方。慈善组织宣布提供超过 4.8 亿美元用于解决甲烷和其他强效温室气体问题，同时还额外提供 2500 万美元用于支持七个国家的减排工作。

paras.en: “The climate crisis is already here and now and it is already a matter of life and death,” she told journalists gathered in the media zone, accusing political leaders of failing to confront the emergency.
paras.zh: “气候危机已经发生，现在已经是生死攸关的问题，”她对聚集在媒体区的记者说，并指责政治领导人未能应对这一紧急情况。

paras.en: “The actions from those in power here are completely detached from reality,” she said.
paras.zh: “这里当权者的行为完全脱离现实，”她说。

paras.en: “The planet is not dying, it is being killed, and we know by who, and it's being killed by the very same people often thought to come to our rescue. No one is coming to our rescue.”
paras.zh: “这个星球并没有消亡，而是正在被杀死，我们知道是谁杀死了它，而杀死它的正是那些经常被认为会来拯救我们的人。没有人来拯救我们。”

paras.en: Beside her, Nepalese parliamentarian Sagar Dhakal recalled helping dig people from the rubble after a deadly landslide near the Nepal-Tibet border earlier this year.
paras.zh: 在她旁边，尼泊尔议员萨加尔·达卡尔（Sagar Dhakal）回忆起今年早些时候尼泊尔与西藏边境附近发生致命山体滑坡后帮助从废墟中挖掘人员的情景。

paras.en: “I don't think there are words in the dictionary to describe it,” he said.
paras.zh: “我认为字典里没有单词可以描述它，”他说。

paras.en: He then raised his phone to show journalists a report about Switzerland, where authorities had monitored an unstable glacier and evacuated residents before a devastating collapse.
paras.zh: 然后，他举起手机向记者展示了一份有关瑞士的报告，瑞士当局对一座不稳定的冰川进行了监测，并在毁灭性崩塌之前疏散了居民。

paras.en: “Switzerland could do it because they had enough research and resources,” he said. "But Nepal couldn't do it.”
paras.zh: “瑞士可以做到这一点，因为他们有足够的研究和资源，”他说。 “但尼泊尔做不到。”

paras.en: For communities living beneath the Himalayas, the contrast was clear: access to science, technology and early warnings can mean the difference between life and death.
paras.zh: 对于生活在喜马拉雅山下的社区来说，对比是显而易见的：获得科学、技术和早期预警可能意味着生与死的区别。

paras.en: - Negotiations: Australia, which is leading the talks, has asked countries for input on a proposed COP31 cover decision, with written submissions due Saturday. Disagreements remain over adaptation finance and the transition away from fossil fuels.
paras.zh: - 谈判：主导谈判的澳大利亚已要求各国就拟议的 COP31 封面决定提供意见，并于周六提交书面意见。在适应资金和摆脱化石燃料的过渡方面仍存在分歧。

paras.en: - Methane funding: Philanthropic organizations announced more than $480 million to cut methane and other powerful greenhouse gases, plus $25 million to help seven developing countries reduce emissions.
paras.zh: - 甲烷资金：慈善组织宣布提供超过 4.8 亿美元用于减少甲烷和其他强效温室气体排放，另外还提供 2500 万美元用于帮助七个发展中国家减少排放。

paras.en: - Historic island pledge: Solomon Islands pledged $400,000 to the Green Climate Fund, becoming the first small island developing state to contribute to a replenishment cycle and urging wealthier nations to follow.
paras.zh: - 历史性的岛屿承诺：所罗门群岛承诺向绿色气候基金提供 40 万美元，成为第一个为补充周期做出贡献的小岛屿发展中国家，并敦促富裕国家效仿。

paras.en: - Climate investment: Türkiye secured a $1.6 billion financing agreement with the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank to support climate reforms, clean energy and resilience.
paras.zh: - 气候投资：土耳其与亚洲基础设施投资银行签署了 16 亿美元的融资协议，以支持气候改革、清洁能源和复原力。

paras.en: Follow the latest developments from COP31 through our new podcast, Talk & Action, and our special daily coverage of the conference.
paras.zh: 通过我们的新播客、Talk & Action 以及我们对会议的每日特别报道，关注 COP31 的最新进展。

articles.title: When the rains fail: Preparing for drought in Central America

paras.en: When the rains fail: Preparing for drought in Central America
paras.zh: 当降雨停止时：为中美洲的干旱做好准备

paras.en: Across Central America’s so-called Dry Corridor, farming families live at the mercy of the rains. In southwestern Honduras, Anastacio Martínez Gómez has spent most of his 73 years learning to work the land. But experience can only take him so far.
paras.zh: 在中美洲所谓的“干旱走廊”上，农民家庭的生活只能靠雨水的支配。在洪都拉斯西南部，阿纳斯塔西奥·马丁内斯·戈麦斯 (Anastacio Martínez Gómez) 73 年来的大部分时间都在学习如何耕种土地。但经验只能带他走这么远。

paras.en: "When there’s no water, that’s where you run out of ideas,” he says.
paras.zh: “当没有水时，你就会失去想法，”他说。

paras.en: In his village of Palagua, dry seasons can last five or six months. For years, a failed maize or bean harvest meant searching for work elsewhere.
paras.zh: 在他的巴拉瓜村，旱季可持续五六个月。多年来，玉米或豆类歉收意味着要到别处寻找工作。

paras.en: Then, Mr. Martínez volunteered part of his land for a reservoir – opening up new possibilities for his whole community.
paras.zh: 然后，马丁内斯先生自愿将他的部分土地用于修建水库，为他的整个社区开辟了新的可能性。

paras.en: The Dry Corridor is a drought-prone region stretching across parts of Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador and Nicaragua, where more than seven million people do not have guaranteed access to food.
paras.zh: 干旱走廊是一个干旱多发地区，横跨危地马拉、洪都拉斯、萨尔瓦多和尼加拉瓜的部分地区，那里有超过七百万人无法保证获得食物。

paras.en: When crops fail, families face a stark choice: go hungry or migrate. This year, El Niño has made that choice harder.
paras.zh: 当农作物歉收时，家庭面临严峻的选择：要么挨饿，要么迁移。今年，厄尔尼诺现象让这一选择变得更加困难。

paras.en: El Niño is a natural climate pattern caused by unusually warm surface waters in the central and eastern Pacific Ocean.
paras.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象是由太平洋中部和东部异常温暖的表层海水引起的一种自然气候模式。

paras.en: It disrupts weather patterns around the world, affecting rainfall and temperatures. The World Meteorological Organization (WMO) says the current event could be unprecedented in strength. In Central America, it is increasing the risk of below-average rainfall and drought.
paras.zh: 它扰乱了世界各地的天气模式，影响降雨量和气温。世界气象组织（WMO）表示，当前事件的强度可能是前所未有的。在中美洲，降雨量低于平均水平和干旱的风险正在增加。

paras.en: Mr. Martínez grew mainly maize and beans, planting two crops a year. If the rains stopped before the plants matured, he could lose everything.
paras.zh: 马丁内斯先生主要种植玉米和豆类，每年种植两季作物。如果雨在植物成熟之前停止，他可能会失去一切。

paras.en: “We would plant the first and second crops, and just like that, we were left with no options.”
paras.zh: “我们会种植第一批和第二批作物，就这样，我们别无选择。”

paras.en: That began to change when a project was launched to build a large water reservoir in the community. There was one condition: the farmers had to contribute the land.
paras.zh: 当一个在社区建造大型水库的项目启动时，这种情况开始发生变化。有一个条件：农民必须贡献土地。

paras.en: Mr. Martínez volunteered five manzanas (about 3.5 hectares). “I raised my hand without thinking for even 30 seconds. I said, ‘I’ll give five manzanas for the project’”
paras.zh: 马丁内斯先生自愿提供了五块曼萨纳（约 3.5 公顷）。 “我想都没想就举起了手，连 30 秒都没有。我说，‘我将为这个项目捐出 5 个曼萨纳’”

paras.en: With support from the World Food Programme (WFP), the reservoir and irrigation systems gave farmers a way to store and use water during the dry months.
paras.zh: 在世界粮食计划署 ​​(WFP) 的支持下，水库和灌溉系统为农民提供了在干旱月份储存和使用水的方法。

paras.en: The project also included training to help them grow more types of crops and use water more efficiently. Anastacio and other farmers spent three weeks at Zamorano, the Pan-American Agricultural School in Honduras, learning techniques including how to raise tilapia and grow plantains.
paras.zh: 该项目还包括帮助他们种植更多种类的农作物并更有效地利用水的培训。阿纳斯塔西奥和其他农民在洪都拉斯的萨莫拉诺泛美农业学校度过了三个星期，学习包括如何饲养罗非鱼和种植车前草在内的技术。

paras.en: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) also provided agricultural tools.
paras.zh: 联合国粮食及农业组织（FAO）也提供了农具。

paras.en: “I was self-taught. All I knew was how to grow maize and beans. Now I can tell you I’m more of a technician,” he says. “I owe all of that to WFP.”
paras.zh: “我是自学成才的。我只知道如何种植玉米和豆类。现在我可以告诉你，我更像是一名技术人员，”他说。 “我把这一切都归功于粮食计划署。”

paras.en: His farm is now far more diverse. He grows plantains, cassava, sweet potatoes and malanga, among other crops, and has about 80 mango trees and three fish ponds. He can harvest during both the rainy and dry seasons, and neighbors buy produce directly from the farm.
paras.zh: 他的农场现在更加多样化。他种植大蕉、木薯、红薯和马兰加等农作物，并拥有约 80 棵芒果树和三个鱼塘。他可以在雨季和旱季收获，邻居们直接从农场购买农产品。

paras.en: When his children visit from the United States and Spain, they leave with suitcases full of food.
paras.zh: 当他的孩子们从美国和西班牙来访时，他们会带着装满食物的手提箱离开。

paras.en: At 73, Mr. Martínez still farms. On Sundays, he rests in a hammock, wearing shorts and a T-shirt, with his dogs beside him.
paras.zh: 马丁内斯先生 73 岁了，仍然务农。周日，他穿着短裤和 T 恤，躺在吊床上休息，他的狗就在他身边。

paras.en: “I sleep peacefully. I have nothing to fear here.”
paras.zh: “我睡得很安稳。在这里我没有什么可害怕的。”

paras.en: In Camotán, Guatemala’s Chiquimula Department, Marta Ávalos is helping her community confront another consequence of drought: the risk of running out of food when crops fail and household incomes disappear.
paras.zh: 在危地马拉奇基穆拉省卡莫坦，玛尔塔·阿瓦洛斯正在帮助她的社区应对干旱的另一个后果：农作物歉收和家庭收入消失时面临粮食短缺的风险。

paras.en: Ms. Ávalos, who grew up in Camotán, knows what it means to struggle for an education. She wanted to be a teacher, but her family could not always afford to keep her in school.
paras.zh: 在卡莫坦长大的阿瓦洛斯女士知道为教育而奋斗意味着什么。她想成为一名教师，但她的家庭始终无法负担她上学的费用。

paras.en: She alternated years of study with years of work picking coffee on farms, saving for her school supplies, shoes and backpack.
paras.zh: 她一边学习，一边在农场采摘咖啡，攒钱购买学习用品、鞋子和背包。

paras.en: “Families are making the most of what they receive. Before, that mindset didn’t exist,” Ms. Ávalos says.
paras.zh: “家庭正在充分利用他们收到的东西。以前，这种心态并不存在，”阿瓦洛斯女士说。

paras.en: Her mother feared she would come home pregnant rather than with a diploma. It was her grandfather who persuaded her to let her continue. “All right, even if it means eating tortillas with salt, I’ll support you,” her mother told her.
paras.zh: 她的母亲担心她回家时会怀着身孕，而不是带着文凭。是她的祖父说服了她，让她继续下去。 “好吧，即使这意味着吃加盐的玉米饼，我也会支持你，”她的母亲告诉她。

paras.en: “Believe me, I jumped for joy,” Ms. Ávalos recalls.
paras.zh: “相信我，我高兴得跳了起来，”阿瓦洛斯女士回忆道。

paras.en: She became a teacher, earned a degree in education and now works for the municipality, organizing community projects. Neighbors turn to her for help with paperwork and other problems.
paras.zh: 她成为一名教师，获得了教育学位，现在在市政府工作，组织社区项目。邻居们向她寻求文书工作和其他问题的帮助。

paras.en: When WFP began working in the area to help families cope with drought and the risk of child malnutrition, Ms. Ávalos became a key partner in organizing the community’s response.
paras.zh: 当粮食计划署开始在该地区开展工作，帮助家庭应对干旱和儿童营养不良的风险时，阿瓦洛斯女士成为组织社区应对措施的重要合作伙伴。

paras.en: The goal was not only to help families through the hardest months, but also to prepare them for the next drought. Such measures are part of what the United Nations calls anticipatory action: taking steps ahead of an expected crisis to reduce its likely impact.
paras.zh: 其目标不仅是帮助家庭度过最艰难的几个月，还要让他们为下一次干旱做好准备。这些措施是联合国所谓的预期行动的一部分：在预期的危机发生之前采取措施以减少其可能的影响。

paras.en: One of the initiatives was a community grain bank funded by the UN Central Emergency Fund (CERF). WFP provided the initial stock of maize and beans, and residents took charge of buying, selling and restocking, storing the grain in blue plastic silos taller than Ms. Ávalos herself.
paras.zh: 其中一项举措是由联合国中央紧急基金（CERF）资助的社区粮食银行。粮食计划署提供了玉米和豆类的初始库存，居民负责购买、销售和补充库存，将谷物储存在比阿瓦洛斯女士本人还高的蓝色塑料筒仓中。

paras.en: Before, families had to travel to the municipal market to buy maize and beans, a round trip of about an hour that cost around 70 quetzales (about $9), Ms. Ávalos says. Now the grain is minutes from their homes.
paras.zh: 阿瓦洛斯女士说，以前，家庭必须前往市政市场购买玉米和豆类，往返约一小时，花费约 70 格查尔（约 9 美元）。现在，谷物距离他们的家只有几分钟的路程。

paras.en: Not everyone wanted to keep the bank running. Some residents suggested selling off the stock, assuming WFP would not come back to check.
paras.zh: 并不是每个人都想让银行继续运转。一些居民建议出售库存，假设粮食计划署不会回来检查。

paras.en: Ms. Ávalos, who sits on the community development council, told them that was not the purpose of the project. One of the community’s two grain banks is now in her own home.
paras.zh: 社区发展委员会成员阿瓦洛斯女士告诉他们，这不是该项目的目的。该社区的两个粮食银行之一现在就在她自己的家里。

paras.en: Most of the hamlet’s 200 families buy grain from the banks. The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) provided hens and agricultural tools, the Ministry of Agriculture supplied vegetable seeds, and the municipality contributed fertilizer. Some families sell eggs to buy rice, sugar or beans.
paras.zh: 该村 200 个家庭中的大多数都从银行购买粮食。联合国粮食及农业组织（FAO）提供了鸡只和农具，农业部提供了蔬菜种子，市政府提供了化肥。有些家庭卖鸡蛋来购买大米、糖或豆类。

paras.en: “Families are making the most of what they receive. Before, that mindset didn’t exist,” Ms. Ávalos says.
paras.zh: “家庭正在充分利用他们收到的东西。以前，这种心态并不存在，”阿瓦洛斯女士说。

paras.en: The work in these communities is part of a broader WFP effort to help families prepare for drought before it becomes a crisis. The agency started giving El Niño early warnings in April, before the main planting season and distributing cash assistance to families most at risk.
paras.zh: 这些社区的工作是粮食计划署更广泛努力的一部分，旨在帮助家庭在干旱演变成危机之前做好应对准备。该机构从四月份主要种植季节之前开始发出厄尔尼诺现象早期预警，并向处境最危险的家庭分发现金援助。

paras.en: These measures have reached more than 409,000 people across countries in the Dry Corridor, according to WFP.
paras.zh: 据世界粮食计划署称，这些措施已惠及干旱走廊各国的 409,000 多人。

paras.en: As drought conditions worsened, the agency stepped up its emergency response. More than 470,000 people across Central America are now receiving food and cash assistance from WFP, according to the agency.
paras.zh: 随着干旱情况恶化，该机构加强了应急响应。据该机构称，中美洲地区目前有超过 470,000 人正在接受粮食署提供的粮食和现金援助。

paras.en: “If El Niño teaches us one lesson, it is this: preparing for disaster costs far less than rebuilding after,” Lena Savelli, WFP’s Regional Director for Latin America and the Caribbean, wrote.
paras.zh: 世界粮食计划署拉丁美洲和加勒比地区主任莉娜·萨维利（Lena Savelli）写道：“如果说厄尔尼诺现象给我们上了一课，那就是：为灾难做准备的成本远低于灾后重建的成本。”

paras.en: Hear Anastacio Martínez and Marta Ávalos tell their stories in “Cuando deja de llover” the latest episode of the Spanish-language podcast Sin la ONU.
paras.zh: 在西班牙语播客 Sin la ONU 的最新一集“Cuando deja de llover”中聆听阿纳斯塔西奥·马丁内斯 (Anastacio Martínez) 和玛尔塔·阿瓦洛斯 (Marta Ávalos) 讲述他们的故事。

articles.title: Littler opens bid for third Grand Slam crown with stunning Greaves win

paras.en: Grand Slam of Darts: Luke Littler turns on magical display to defeat Beau Greaves as Ross Smith suffers shock defeat
paras.zh: 飞镖大满贯：卢克·利特勒 (Luke Littler) 神奇表演击败博·格里夫斯 (Beau Greaves)，罗斯·史密斯 (Ross Smith) 惨败

paras.en: Luke Littler makes a statement with emphatic victory over Beau Greaves as European champion Ross Smith suffers a shock opening defeat; you can watch the Grand Slam of Darts in Wolverhampton live on Sky Sports up until the final on November 22
paras.zh: 卢克·利特勒 (Luke Littler) 发表声明，大力战胜博·格里夫斯 (Beau Greaves)，而欧洲冠军罗斯·史密斯 (Ross Smith) 却在开场惨败；您可以在天空体育频道观看伍尔弗汉普顿飞镖大满贯比赛的直播，直至 11 月 22 日决赛

paras.en: Luke Littler started his pursuit of a Grand Slam of Darts hat-trick with a commanding 5-2 victory against Beau Greaves in Wolverhampton on Saturday night.
paras.zh: 周六晚上，卢克·利特勒 (Luke Littler) 在狼队以 5-2 的比分战胜博·格里夫斯 (Beau Greaves)，开始了他对飞镖大满贯帽子戏法的追求。

paras.en: In a Group A blockbuster, 'The Nuke' struck seven maximums and a 109.97 average to defeat the Women's Matchplay champion.
paras.zh: 在 A 组的一鸣惊人中，“The Nuke”以 7 个最高分和 109.97 的平均分击败了女子比洞赛冠军。

paras.en: Littler has yet to taste defeat in 15 Grand Slam matches, as he bids to join Phil Taylor and Michael van Gerwen by becoming the third player to win three successive titles in the West Midlands.
paras.zh: 利特勒尚未在 15 场大满贯比赛中尝到失败的滋味，他力争成为继菲尔·泰勒和迈克尔·范格文之后第三位在西米德兰兹连续三届夺冠的球员。

paras.en: - As it happened on Day One at the Grand Slam of Darts
paras.zh: - 正如飞镖大满贯第一天所发生的那样

paras.en: - Darts in 2026: Key dates, calendar, results 📅
paras.zh: - 2026 年飞镖：关键日期、日历、结果 📅

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Get instant access with NOW 📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？现在就立即访问📺

paras.en: Greaves had memorably beaten Littler in the semi-finals of last year's World Youth Championship, but the back-to-back world champion had revenge on his mind.
paras.zh: 格里夫斯在去年的世青赛半决赛中令人难忘地击败了利特勒，但这位背靠背的世界冠军却一心复仇。

paras.en: After looking invincible in the first half of 2026 as he won the first five majors, Littler had come up short at the World Series of Darts Finals, then slipped to a first-round exit at the Grand Prix before another last-eight defeat in the European Championship.
paras.zh: 利特勒在 2026 年上半年赢得了前 5 个大满贯赛冠军，看起来所向无敌，但他在世界飞镖系列赛决赛中表现不佳，然后在大奖赛上滑入首轮出局，然后在欧洲锦标赛上再次遭遇八强失利。

paras.en: Littler, though, produced a vintage clinical display at WV Active Aldersley as he broke Greaves in the second leg before soon opening up a 3-0 lead in rapid time.
paras.zh: 不过，利特勒在西弗吉尼亚州阿尔德斯利的比赛中表现出色，他在第二回合中破掉了格里夫斯，很快就以 3-0 领先。

paras.en: Greaves held to cut the deficit back to 4-2 before Littler swiftly wrapped things up by taking out tops with his first match dart.
paras.zh: 格里夫斯保发后将比分差距缩小至 4-2，随后利特勒凭借他的第一场比赛飞镖迅速结束了比赛。

paras.en: Speaking to Sky Sports, Littler said: "I'm happy with the win. I needed to get off to a strong start because Beau started to find it at the end.
paras.zh: 利特勒在接受天空体育采访时表示：“我对这场胜利感到很高兴。我需要有一个强劲的开局，因为博在最后开始找到了它。

paras.en: "I just had to finish how I started. I was very good at the scoring, but 29 per cent on the doubles needs to improve.
paras.zh: “我只需要完成我的开始。我的得分非常好，但双打29%的命中率需要提高。

paras.en: "Beau was fantastic, but I'm happy with myself and I'm still 100 per cent here in Wolverhampton."
paras.zh: “博太棒了，但我对自己很满意，我仍然百分百地在伍尔弗汉普顿。”

paras.en: The 19-year-old from Warrington is now aiming to find his Alexandra Palace form, adding: "I love it here. I remember my first year; last year was the same, and this year is the same.
paras.zh: 这位来自沃灵顿的 19 岁球员现在的目标是找到自己在亚历山德拉宫的状态，他补充道：“我喜欢这里。我记得我的第一年；去年是一样的，今年也是一样。

paras.en: "If I am performing like this, then I'm going to be happy.
paras.zh: “如果我有这样的表现，我会很高兴。

paras.en: "It's what I need. The last three or four majors haven't gone well, but I've been practising, and I'm glad I've shown it.
paras.zh: “这就是我所需要的。过去的三四个大满贯赛进​​展得并不顺利，但我一直在练习，我很高兴我已经展示了这一点。

paras.en: "It's perfect timing. I'm not going to Minehead for the Players Championship, this is the last major before the World Championship.
paras.zh: “这是完美的时机。我不会去迈恩黑德参加球员锦标赛，这是世界锦标赛之前的最后一场大满贯赛。

paras.en: "After this, there are a few exhibitions, and hopefully it works out."
paras.zh: “之后还会举办一些展览，希望能够成功。”

paras.en: John Part, speaking on Sky Sports, said: "His 180s and scoring were absolutely phenomenal. Beau didn't come out of the gates at her best, but you wouldn't say it was one of her better performances. We know she can play better than that.
paras.zh: 约翰·帕特在接受天空体育采访时表示：“他的 180 岁高龄和得分绝对是现象级的。博并没有达到最佳状态，但你不会说这是她更好的表现之一。我们知道她可以打得更好。”

paras.en: "We're not sure Luke has been fully tested yet, but let's see."
paras.zh: “我们不确定卢克是否已经接受过全面测试，但让我们看看吧。”

paras.en: Rusty-Jake Rodriguez caused a seismic shock to defeat two-time major winner Ross Smith 5-3 and pick up just a third ranking win of the entire season.
paras.zh: 拉斯蒂·杰克·罗德里格斯（Rusty-Jake Rodriguez）以 5-3 击败两届大满贯冠军罗斯·史密斯（Ross Smith），掀起了一场震动，取得了整个赛季的第三场排名赛胜利。

paras.en: Smith will take on Gabriel Clemens in a must-win clash on Sunday, while Austrian Rodriguez will face the German on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 史密斯将在周日的一场必胜比赛中对阵加布里埃尔·克莱门斯，而奥地利选手罗德里格斯将于周二对阵德国人。

paras.en: In a match featuring nine maximums and finishes of 121 and 156, 20-year-old debutant Henry Coates made himself at home on the big stage, but in the end it was three-time champion Van Gerwen who came out on top in a final-leg thriller after dodging two match darts.
paras.zh: 在一场九次满分、121和156的比赛中，20岁的首次亮相的亨利·科茨(Henry Coates)在大舞台上表现得如鱼得水，但最终三届冠军范格文(Van Gerwen)在最后一场惊险地躲过了两个比赛飞镖后取得了胜利。

paras.en: Gerwyn Price defied a furious fightback from Joe Hunt to open his bid for a fourth Grand Slam of Darts crown.
paras.zh: 格文·普莱斯 (Gerwyn Price) 顶住了乔·亨特 (Joe Hunt) 的猛烈反击，开始争夺第四个飞镖大满贯桂冠。

paras.en: Hunt produced a moment of magic by reeling in 'The Big Fish' as he won three legs on the spin from 4-0 down before 'The Iceman' stumbled over the finishing line.
paras.zh: 亨特创造了一个神奇的时刻，他在0-4落后的情况下，在旋转中赢得了三回合，最终“大鱼”卷入，然后“冰人”跌跌撞撞地冲过终点线。

paras.en: James Wade, who is making his record-equalling 19th Grand Slam appearance alongside Dutch superstar Van Gerwen, averaged 104 to open Group K with a 5-1 victory over Cam Crabtree.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·韦德 (James Wade) 与荷兰巨星范格文 (Van Gerwen) 一起追平个人第 19 次大满贯赛事纪录，他在 K 组首场比赛中以 5-1 战胜卡姆·克拉布特里 (Cam Crabtree)，以场均 104 杆的成绩出战。

paras.en: The left-hander - a three-time runner-up at this event and aiming to lift the coveted Eric Bristow Trophy for the first time - started his campaign with an 11-darter and a 104 finish along the way.
paras.zh: 这位左投手在本次赛事中三度获得亚军，目标是首次举起令人垂涎的埃里克·布里斯托杯。他以 11 镖和 104 分的成绩开始了他的竞选。

paras.en: Crabtree landed a spectacular 151 finish, but to no avail as Wade pinned a 110 checkout to seal victory.
paras.zh: 克拉布特里 (Crabtree) 打出令人惊叹的 151 分，但没有成功，韦德 (Wade) 打出了 110 分以锁定胜利。

paras.en: Luke Humphries - the 2023 champion - fired in an 11-darter to defeat PDC Asian Champion Paolo Nebrida with a 105.7 average.
paras.zh: 2023 年冠军卢克·汉弗莱斯 (Luke Humphries) 投出 11 镖，以 105.7 分的平均成绩击败了 PDC 亚洲冠军保罗·内布里达 (Paolo Nebrida)。

paras.en: Gian van Veen averaged a ridiculous 110.51 to seal a 5-2 win over Carl Sneyd, while 'Hollywood' Chris Dobey eased past Jan Schmidt by the same scoreline.
paras.zh: 吉安·范·维恩 (Gian van Veen) 场均得分高达 110.51，以 5-2 击败卡尔·斯尼德 (Carl Sneyd)，而“好莱坞”克里斯·多比 (Chris Dobey) 以同样的比分轻松击败扬·施密特 (Jan Schmidt)。

paras.en: Aspinall sends out warning as Clayton is shocked
paras.zh: 阿斯皮纳尔发出警告，克莱顿感到震惊

paras.en: Nathan Aspinall averaged an incredible 111.68 to dispatch Maik Kuivenhoven 5-1 in a remarkable Grand Slam of Darts clash in which 'The Asp' missed a nine-dart attempt - going seven darts into the perfect leg.
paras.zh: 内森·阿斯皮诺尔（Nathan Aspinall）以令人难以置信的平均分 111.68 分，在一场引人注目的飞镖大满贯比赛中以 5-1 击败了迈克·奎文霍文（Maik Ku​​ivenhoven），其中“阿斯普”错过了九镖尝试 - 将七镖打进了完美的腿。

paras.en: Aspinall landed 149 and 120 checkouts on the way to a thumping win as he destroyed his Dutch opponent and sent out a warning to the rest of the field.
paras.zh: 阿斯皮诺尔以 149 和 120 的结账率取得了巨大的胜利，他摧毁了荷兰对手并向场上其他人发出了警告。

paras.en: Sky Sports Darts' Mark Webster said: "Just an incredible performance wasn't it and he was just setting his stall out.
paras.zh: 天空体育飞镖队的马克·韦伯斯特说：“这只是一场令人难以置信的表现，他只是在摆摊。

paras.en: "Getting through the group is paramount but if you can do it performing well, you're going to take confidence from it.
paras.zh: “通过小组是最重要的，但如果你能表现出色，你就会从中获得信心。

paras.en: "He's still got work to do; he needs to beat Karel Sedlacek to confirm his spot in the next round but that was a brilliant display.
paras.zh: “他还有工作要做；他需要击败卡雷尔·塞德拉切克才能确认自己进入下一轮的位置，但那是一场精彩的表现。

paras.en: "He looked focused, he looked composed, he even had a dart to win the opening leg as well he went seven into a perfect leg.
paras.zh: “他看起来很专注，他看起来很镇静，他甚至在第一回合中用飞镖赢得了胜利，而且他在完美的回合中打进了七分。

paras.en: "Nathan Aspinall is on fire, and he was saying the right things before the game as well, he was confident that he was going to win this game and he did it in such style."
paras.zh: “内森·阿斯皮诺尔（Nathan Aspinall）火力旺盛，他在赛前也说了正确的话，他有信心赢得这场比赛，而且他以这种方式做到了。”

paras.en: Swedish star Anton Ostlund marked his Wolverhampton debut with a last-leg victory over fifth seed Jonny Clayton.
paras.zh: 瑞典球星安东·奥斯特伦德在最后回合战胜五号种子乔尼·克莱顿，标志着他在狼队的首秀。

paras.en: He will take on Rob Cross on Monday night, while Clayton will face 'Voltage' in a must-win match on Sunday.
paras.zh: 他将在周一晚上迎战罗布·克罗斯，而克莱顿将在周日的一场必胜比赛中对阵“Voltage”。

paras.en: Showman Tommy Morris stayed calm and composed as he put on a destructive display to smash Josh Rock 5-2.
paras.zh: 表演者汤米·莫里斯 (Tommy Morris) 保持冷静，展现出毁灭性的表演，以 5-2 击败乔什·洛克 (Josh Rock)。

paras.en: The part-time gardener made the most of his TV debut with a brilliant walk-on and then pinned a 121 en route to victory in Wolverhampton.
paras.zh: 这位兼职园丁充分利用了他的电视处子秀，以精彩的跑龙套表演，然后在伍尔弗汉普顿的比赛中打出了 121 杆，取得了胜利。

paras.en: He will take on Kevin Doets on Monday evening, while Rock will face the Dutchman on Sunday in a must-win game.
paras.zh: 他将在周一晚上迎战凯文·多茨，而洛克将在周日对阵荷兰人，这是一场必胜的比赛。

paras.en: Morris, who became just the sixth non-Tour Card holder to win a ranking title at Players Championship 34 earlier this month, said: "I was very nervous, but I take everything in my stride. I'm enjoying my progress. Even if I lose, I'm losing graciously."
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，莫里斯成为第六位在球员锦标赛第34届锦标赛上赢得排名赛冠军的非巡回赛卡持有者，他说：“我非常紧张，但我对一切都泰然处之。我很享受自己的进步。即使我输了，我也很优雅地输了。”

paras.en: Webster said: "From the minute he [Tommy] walked on to the first three darts of the match he just enjoyed himself; it was a composed display.
paras.zh: 韦伯斯特说：“从他（汤米）走上比赛前三镖的那一刻起，他就很享受；这是一场沉着的表现。

paras.en: "It was great to watch as well, the pace he played at, maybe Josh got caught up in that, but Tommy was the better player and deserved to win."
paras.zh: “观看比赛也很棒，他的比赛节奏，也许乔什陷入了困境，但汤米是更好的球员，理应获胜。”

paras.en: Stephen Bunting overcame some late double trouble to deny Raymond Smith 5-4 in a high-quality affair, while world championship semi-finalist Ryan Searle came from behind to scrape past debutant Charlie Manby 5-4.
paras.zh: 斯蒂芬·邦廷 (Stephen Bunting) 克服了最后时刻的双重麻烦，以 5-4 击败了雷蒙德·史密斯 (Raymond Smith)，这是一场高质量的比赛，而世界冠军半决赛选手瑞安·塞尔 (Ryan Searle) 则后来居上，以 5-4 险胜首次亮相的查理·曼比 (Charlie Manby)。

paras.en: Dutch ace Wessel Nijman and Castleford star Tom Sykes opened with wins, while Jermaine Wattimena started his campaign with a dominant 5-2 victory against Lisa Ashton.
paras.zh: 荷兰王牌韦塞尔·尼曼（Wessel Nijman）和卡斯尔福德明星汤姆·赛克斯（Tom Sykes）以胜利开局，而杰梅因·瓦蒂梅纳（Jermaine Wattimena）以 5-2 的优势战胜了丽莎·阿什顿（Lisa Ashton）。

articles.title: Ireland overcome Fiji ahead of South Africa showdown

paras.en: Nations Championship: Ireland overcome Fiji 43-15 ahead of showdown with world champions South Africa next Saturday
paras.zh: 国锦赛：爱尔兰43-15战胜斐济，下周六将与世锦赛冠军南非对决

paras.en: Fiji went ahead briefly at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin before Ireland overhauled them to take a 43-15 victory in the Nations Championship; Ireland are now gearing up for a showdown with world champions South Africa next Saturday
paras.zh: 斐济队在都柏林英杰华体育场短暂取得领先，随后爱尔兰队在国锦赛上以 43-15 击败斐济队。爱尔兰现在正在准备下周六与世界冠军南非队的对决

paras.en: Ireland beat Fiji 43-15 in Dublin in the Nations Championship.
paras.zh: 爱尔兰在都柏林举行的国锦赛上以 43-15 击败斐济。

paras.en: The hosts had won all six previous Test matches between the sides but struggled for fluency and briefly trailed during an uncomfortable opening period at a subdued Aviva Stadium.
paras.zh: 东道主赢得了双方之前的全部六场测试赛，但在流畅性方面表现不佳，并在气氛压抑的英杰华体育场的开局阶段短暂落后。

paras.en: Robert Baloucoune scored twice in the first half for Andy Farrell's men after quick-fire tries from Fiji pair Josua Tuisova and Peceli Yato overhauled Tommy O'Brien's early opener.
paras.zh: 斐济组合约苏亚·图伊索瓦和佩切利·亚托的快速射门打破了汤米·奥布莱恩的开局，罗伯特·巴卢库恩在上半场为安迪·法雷尔的球队梅开二度。

paras.en: Ronan Kelleher, Andrew Porter, O'Brien and Nick Timoney went over in the second half as Ireland eventually pulled clear to keep alive their hopes of reaching the Nations Championship final.
paras.zh: 罗南·凯莱赫、安德鲁·波特、奥布莱恩和尼克·蒂莫尼在下半场先后上场，爱尔兰队最终扳平比分，保住了进入国家锦标赛决赛的希望。

paras.en: Ireland are now gearing up for a showdown with world champions South Africa next weekend.
paras.zh: 爱尔兰现在正在准备下周末与世界冠军南非队的对决。

paras.en: The result over Fiji leaves Ireland level on 20 points with second-placed England in the northern hemisphere standings - a point below leaders France - ahead of next week's mouthwatering clash with the Springboks.
paras.zh: 战胜斐济的比赛结果使得爱尔兰在北半球积分榜上与排名第二的英格兰队同积 20 分，比领头羊法国队低一分，迎接下周与跳羚队的令人垂涎的比赛。

paras.en: Ireland must now beat South Africa and hope France, who host Argentina, and England, who take on New Zealand, falter in Saturday's matches to secure a place in the final at Twickenham on November 29.
paras.zh: 爱尔兰现在必须击败南非，并希望东道主阿根廷的法国队和迎战新西兰的英格兰队在周六的比赛中表现不佳，以确保进入 11 月 29 日在特威克纳姆举行的决赛。

articles.title: U.S. charges 3 men with plotting multiple terror attacks, including on British air base
articles.author: Michael Kosnar

paras.en: Three men, including one already jailed in the U.S., were accused by U.S. authorities Tuesday of being Iran-supported operatives who plotted nearly 20 attacks on Jewish communities in Europe and the U.S., as well as a planned assault on a British air base used by the U.S. Air Force.
paras.zh: 三名男子，其中一名已在美国入狱，周二被美国当局指控为伊朗支持的特工，他们策划了近 20 起针对欧洲和美国犹太社区的袭击，并计划袭击美国空军使用的英国空军基地。

paras.en: Charges against Mohammad Al-Saadi, a dual Iranian-Iraqi national; Mohsen Mohajeri, an Iranian national; and Mohammad Ali Al-Hassani, an Iraqi national, were outlined in a superseding indictment unsealed in federal court in New York City.
paras.zh: 对拥有伊朗和伊拉克双重国籍的穆罕默德·萨阿迪 (Mohammad Al-Saadi) 的指控； Mohsen Mohajeri，伊朗国民；纽约市联邦法院公布的一份替代起诉书中概述了伊拉克国民穆罕默德·阿里·哈桑尼的情况。

paras.en: Only Al-Saadi — an alleged pro-Iranian terrorist who is believed to have plotted attacks across Europe, Canada and the U.S., as first reported by NBC News — is in custody.
paras.zh: 只有萨阿迪 (Al-Saadi) 被拘留，他是一名被指控亲伊朗的恐怖分子，据美国全国广播公司新闻 (NBC News) 首次报道，据信他策划了对欧洲、加拿大和美国的袭击。

paras.en: U.S. Attorney Jamie McDonald in New York said in a news release that Al-Saadi, who was arrested in the spring, continued to coordinate with his co-defendants in the days leading up to the attempted September terrorist plot at a British Royal Air Force Base in Fairford, where U.S. bombers and troops had been stationed.
paras.zh: 纽约美国检察官杰米·麦克唐纳 (Jamie McDonald) 在一份新闻稿中表示，今年春天被捕的萨阿迪在 9 月份在费尔福德英国皇家空军基地（美国轰炸机和部队曾驻扎在那里）未遂恐怖袭击阴谋之前的几天里，继续与他的同案被告进行协调。

paras.en: “As alleged, these defendants helped orchestrate a campaign of terror on behalf of terrorist organizations affiliated with Iran that targeted Jewish communities in Europe and the United States, and the British military base, RAF Fairford, housing American service members,” said McDonald, whose office is handling the case.
paras.zh: 负责处理此案的办公室的麦克唐纳表示：“正如指控的那样，这些被告代表与伊朗有关联的恐怖组织帮助策划了一场恐怖活动，目标是欧洲和美国的犹太社区以及居住着美国军人的英国皇家空军费尔福德军事基地。”

paras.en: “The threat presented by Iran and Iran-backed terrorist groups to America and our allies is not hypothetical — it is very real,” he added in the statement.
paras.zh: 他在声明中补充道：“伊朗和伊朗支持的恐怖组织对美国和我们的盟友构成的威胁不是假设的，而是非常真实的。”

paras.en: The new indictment offers fresh insight into an episode that has been shrouded in mystery for more than a month after five men were detained after midnight Sept. 27 on suspicion of explosives and terrorism offenses after three suspicious vans were spotted traveling toward the base in western England.
paras.zh: 新的起诉书为这一事件提供了新的视角。9月27日午夜后，三辆可疑货车被发现驶向英格兰西部基地，五名男子因涉嫌爆炸物和恐怖主义犯罪而被拘留，这个事件已经笼罩了一个多月的神秘面纱。

paras.en: The Justice Department indictment alleges that Al-Hassani paid associates to carry out surveillance of RAF Fairford in August and paid several people to move forward with the plot in September “by procuring vans and barrels of fuel, researching the purchase of chemical accelerants, including large quantities of potassium chloride, and purchasing metallic objects that could be used as explosive shrapnel.”
paras.zh: 司法部起诉书称，哈桑尼在 8 月份付钱给同事，让他们对英国皇家空军费尔福德进行监视，并在 9 月份付钱给几个人来推进阴谋，“通过采购货车和燃料桶，研究购买化学促进剂，包括大量氯化钾，以及购买可用作爆炸弹片的金属物体。”

paras.en: The group even made custom decals to give the vans the appearance that they were used by a fuel company and a swimming pool supply business, authorities say.
paras.zh: 当局称，该组织甚至定制了贴花，让这些货车看起来像是一家燃料公司和一家游泳池供应公司使用的。

paras.en: Al-Hassani is alleged to have then tasked the people to go to the base with the fuel when U.K. law enforcement took the men into custody.
paras.zh: 据称，当英国执法部门拘留这些人时，哈桑尼要求这些人携带燃料前往基地。

paras.en: Al-Saadi was helping direct the RAF Fairford plot while he was in a U.S. prison, according to the indictment. He made video and phone calls to his family members in Iraq, who are alleged to have passed coded messages to Al-Hassani and Mohajeri.
paras.zh: 起诉书称，萨阿迪在美国监狱期间帮助指挥了英国皇家空军费尔福德阴谋。他给在伊拉克的家人打电话和视频，据称他们向哈桑尼和莫哈杰里传递了密码信息。

paras.en: In a July call with his sister, Al-Saadi asked, “What are we doing about all our old work?” — a reference to terrorist activity — according to investigators.
paras.zh: 在 7 月份与妹妹的一次通话中，萨阿迪问道：“我们对所有旧工作做了什么？” ——据调查人员称，这是对恐怖活动的提及。

paras.en: His sister replied, “It isn’t cancelled,” investigators said.
paras.zh: 调查人员说，他的姐姐回答说：“它没有被取消。”

paras.en: In June, Al-Saadi pleaded not guilty to charges that he plotted at least 18 attacks in Europe in retaliation for the U.S. and Israel’s war with Iran.
paras.zh: 6 月，萨阿迪对他在欧洲策划至少 18 起袭击事件以报复美国和以色列与伊朗的战争的指控表示不认罪。

paras.en: But the indictment alleges that the three men conspired to use a network of contacts in the United Kingdom to commit terrorist attacks on behalf of an Iran-aligned terrorist network, which included Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps and Kata’ib Hizballah.
paras.zh: 但起诉书称，这三人密谋利用在英国的联系网络，代表与伊朗结盟的恐怖网络实施恐怖袭击，该网络包括伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队和真主党旅。

paras.en: The European attacks “were carried out in the name of a purportedly new terrorist group with the pseudonym Harakat Ashab al-Yamin al-Islamiya (“HAYI”), which is actually a front for Kata’ib Hizballah,” the release said.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，欧洲的袭击“是以一个据称是新恐怖组织的名义进行的，化名 Harakat Ashab al-Yamin al-Islamiya (“HAYI”)，实际上是真主党旅的幌子。”

paras.en: The U.S. government has designated Kata’ib Hizballah and the Revolutionary Guards as foreign terrorist organizations.
paras.zh: 美国政府已将真主党旅和革命卫队列为外国恐怖组织。

articles.title: Federal Court rules Lorella Springs Wilderness Park tourism permit invalid
articles.author: Roxanne Fitzgerald

paras.en: Following a long-running legal battle, the Federal Court has ruled Lorella Springs' tourism permit invalid.
paras.zh: 经过长期的法律斗争，联邦法院裁定 Lorella Springs 的旅游许可证无效。

paras.en: Native title holders are claiming a "hard fought win", despite the court rejecting a number of their key arguments.
paras.zh: 尽管法院驳回了原住民土地所有权持有者的一些关键论点，但他们仍声称这是一场“艰苦的胜利”。

paras.en: The permit has been set aside, with the Pastoral Land Board ordered to reassess the application "according to law".
paras.zh: 该许可证已被搁置，并责令牧区土地委员会“依法”重新评估该申请。

paras.en: Northern Territory native title holders are claiming a "hard fought win" after a Federal Court judge ruled a tourism permit for Lorella Springs Wilderness Park is invalid, and ordered the Pastoral Land Board to reassess the application.
paras.zh: 在联邦法院法官裁定洛雷拉泉荒野公园的旅游许可证无效，并命令田园土地委员会重新评估申请后，北领地原住民土地权持有者声称这是一场“来之不易的胜利”。

paras.en: For about two decades, the owners of Lorella Springs, a 400,000-hectare outback cattle station located about 1,000 kilometres from Darwin, ran a significant tourism business with accommodation, a bar, fishing, swimming and helicopter tours.
paras.zh: 洛雷拉泉 (Lorella Springs) 是一座占地 40 万公顷的内陆养牛场，距达尔文约 1,000 公里，其所有者在大约二十年的时间里经营着一项重要的旅游业务，包括住宿、酒吧、钓鱼、游泳和直升机旅游。

paras.en: The station, about 2.5 times the size of London, is also home to protected sacred, burial and ceremony sites.
paras.zh: 该车站的面积约为伦敦的 2.5 倍，也是受保护的圣地、墓地和仪式场所的所在地。

paras.en: But the station has been closed to most tourists since January 2023. Only a select number of guided tours have been allowed to visit, with the owners citing "bureaucracy" becoming "too much" to sustain operations.
paras.zh: 但自 2023 年 1 月以来，该车站已对大多数游客关闭。只有少数导游被允许参观，业主称“官僚主义”变得“太多”，无法维持运营。

paras.en: In 2022, owners Marie and Rhett Walker lodged an application for a "farm tourism operations" permit. Their application said Aboriginal sites would "be avoided from all tourism activity".
paras.zh: 2022 年，业主玛丽·沃克 (Marie Walker) 和瑞德·沃克 (Rhett Walker) 提出了“农场旅游经营”许可证的申请。他们的申请称，原住民遗址将“避免参与所有旅游活动”。

paras.en: The owners also applied to extract water from Rosie Creek.
paras.zh: 业主还申请从罗西溪取水。

paras.en: The Pastoral Land Board granted the permit and the water licence — but in 2025, the Northern Land Council (NLC), on behalf of Burdal Riley, Murrungun Wunubari and Mambali Walangara native title holders, challenged the NT government's decision to grant those.
paras.zh: 牧区土地委员会授予了许可证和取水许可证，但在 2025 年，北方土地委员会 (NLC) 代表 Burdal Riley、Murrungun Wunubari 和 Mambali Walangara 原住民地权持有者对北领地政府授予这些许可证的决定提出质疑。

paras.en: Concerned that sacred sites in the area had been interfered with in the past, the native title holders argued the tourism activities involved the "observation of Aboriginal cultural works and activities".
paras.zh: 由于担心该地区的圣地过去曾受到干扰，原住民权利持有者辩称，旅游活动涉及“观察原住民文化作品和活动”。

paras.en: They also argued the government had been "unreasonable and irrational" in its decision-making process and failed to consider the presence of threatened species and other environmental issues.
paras.zh: 他们还认为，政府在决策过程中“不合理且非理性”，未能考虑受威胁物种的存在和其他环境问题。

paras.en: In handing down her lengthy judgement on Friday, Justice Natalie Charlesworth considered the native title holders' 12 arguments.
paras.zh: 周五，法官 Natalie Charlesworth 做出了冗长的判决，考虑了原住民土地所有权持有者的 12 项论点。

paras.en: She found that when the Pastoral Land Board ultimately approved a permit covering about 60,000 hectares — an area far larger than what was applied for — it "exceeded its jurisdiction".
paras.zh: 她发现，当牧区土地委员会最终批准了一份占地约 60,000 公顷的许可证时——这个面积远远大于申请的面积——它“超出了其管辖范围”。

paras.en: "The circumstances in which that came about are not at all clear," she said.
paras.zh: “发生这种情况的情况根本不清楚，”她说。

paras.en: She also found there had been no comprehensive environmental impact assessment done of the entire area and that the board "failed to comply with its obligation to afford procedural fairness" to native title holders.
paras.zh: 她还发现，没有对整个地区进行全面的环境影响评估，而且该委员会“未能履行为原住民权利持有人提供程序公平的义务”。

paras.en: Justice Charlesworth declared the permit invalid largely on those points, and ordered the board to reassess the application "according to law", which means a new permit could be issued in future.
paras.zh: 查尔斯沃思法官宣布该许可证主要在这些方面无效，并命令委员会“依法”重新评估该申请，这意味着将来可能会颁发新的许可证。

paras.en: The native title holders also argued the permit did not qualify as "farm tourism" under section 24GB of the Native Title Act, as there was "no substantive connection to pastoral activities".
paras.zh: 原住民土地权持有者还辩称，根据《原住民土地权法》第 24GB 条，该许可证不符合“农场旅游”的资格，因为“与畜牧活动没有实质性联系”。

paras.en: Justice Charlesworth said she was informed the matter was the first time a court had been forced to consider the section — which allows certain activities like farm tourism or running cattle to go ahead on pastoral land without agreement from native title holders, but rules out other types of tourism involving observing Aboriginal activities or cultural works.
paras.zh: 查尔斯沃思法官表示，她获悉此事是法院第一次被迫考虑该条款，该条款允许农场旅游或放牛等某些活动在未经原住民土地权持有人同意的情况下在牧区进行，但排除涉及观察原住民活动或文化作品的其他类型的旅游。

paras.en: She noted there was "public interest in the resolution of the issue given the likelihood that it may arise again", with large swathes of the NT and South Australia covered by pastoral leases.
paras.zh: 她指出，“考虑到该问题可能再次出现，解决该问题符合公众利益”，北领地和南澳大利亚的大片地区都有田园租约。

paras.en: However, Justice Charlesworth rejected the argument, finding the activities on offer at Lorella Springs "all fall within the phrase 'farm tourism activities'."
paras.zh: 然而，查尔斯沃思法官驳回了这一论点，认为洛雷拉温泉提供的活动“都属于‘农场旅游活动’这一短语。”

paras.en: The native title holders also argued the permit was invalid because it permitted "tourism activities that involved observing the activities or cultural works of Aboriginal people".
paras.zh: 原住民权利持有者还辩称该许可证无效，因为它允许“涉及观察原住民活动或文化作品的旅游活动”。

paras.en: Justice Charlesworth "unreservedly" accepted evidence about the "hurt and distress" felt by native title holders over how tourism at Lorella Springs could impact sacred sites, but ultimately dismissed that argument as well.
paras.zh: 查尔斯沃思法官“毫无保留地”接受了有关原住民权利持有者因洛雷拉泉旅游业如何影响圣地而感到“伤害和痛苦”的证据，但最终也驳回了这一论点。

paras.en: "The focus of [section] 24GB is upon what has been authorised by the Board, not upon what may happen in the future by reason of feared unauthorised actions of the [owners] or tourists," she said.
paras.zh: “24GB [section] 24GB 的重点是委员会已授权的内容，而不是担心[业主]或游客未经授权的行为而导致未来可能发生的情况，”她说。

paras.en: Justice Charlesworth upheld the water licence, ruling she was not satisfied it would affect native title because there was no evidence the amount of water extracted would affect native title holders' ability to take water.
paras.zh: 查尔斯沃思法官维持了取水许可证的原判，裁定她不认为这会影响原住民所有权，因为没有证据表明提取的水量会影响原住民所有权持有人取水的能力。

paras.en: NLC chair Matthew Ryan called the judgement a "hard fought win" for native title holders.
paras.zh: NLC 主席马修·瑞安 (Matthew Ryan) 称这一判决对于本土头衔持有者来说是一场“艰苦的胜利”。

paras.en: "Protecting sacred sites is protecting culture. It is always necessary to work with the caretakers of precious country to keep these sacred areas safe," he said.
paras.zh: “保护圣地就是保护文化。始终有必要与珍贵国家的守护者合作，确保这些圣地的安全，”他说。

paras.en: A spokesperson for the NT government did not respond to questions about whether Lorella Springs would re-open in the future but said it "will take the time to carefully consider the Federal Court's decision."
paras.zh: 北领地政府发言人没有回答有关 Lorella Springs 未来是否会重新开放的问题，但表示“将花时间仔细考虑联邦法院的决定”。

articles.title: Man in custody after police helicopter search near Devonport

paras.en: A man allegedly linked to a series of incidents in Tasmania's north-west, including a service station robbery, is in police custody following a multi-hour search.
paras.zh: 一名据称与塔斯马尼亚西北部一系列事件有关的男子，包括加油站抢劫案，经过几个小时的搜查后被警方拘留。

paras.en: Police said they were first notified about the man shortly after 9am on Sunday, when they received reports he was "acting erratically" on Macfie Street in Devonport.
paras.zh: 警方表示，他们于周日上午 9 点后不久首次接到有关该男子的通知，当时他们收到报告称，该男子在德文波特的 Macfie 街“行为异常”。

paras.en: They said members of the public reported he was "knocking on doors and demanding keys to their vehicles" before he left the scene in a white Toyota.
paras.zh: 他们说，有公众报告说，他在开着一辆白色丰田车离开现场之前，“敲门并索要车辆钥匙”。

paras.en: Police said a service station in Railton, about 22 kilometres south of Devonport, was robbed just before 10am, with a quantity of cash taken from the premises.
paras.zh: 警方称，德文波特以南约 22 公里处的雷尔顿 (Railton) 的一个服务站于上午 10 点前遭到抢劫，并从该站内抢走大量现金。

paras.en: The man is then alleged to have stolen a silver Alfa Romeo from Kimberley, about 9 kilometres south-east of Railton.
paras.zh: 随后，该男子被指控从位于雷尔顿东南约 9 公里处的金伯利偷了一辆银色阿尔法罗密欧。

paras.en: Police resources, including a helicopter, were deployed to search for the man and the stolen vehicle.
paras.zh: 警方部署了包括一架直升机在内的资源来搜寻该男子和被盗车辆。

paras.en: The suspect was described as being about 5 feet 8 inches in height, with short hair, olive complexion and facial tattoos.
paras.zh: 据描述，嫌疑人身高约5英尺8英寸，短发，橄榄色肤色，面部有纹身。

paras.en: Police said the man was then detected in the Penguin area, about 30 kilometres west of Devonport, just before 5pm following information from the public.
paras.zh: 警方表示，根据公众提供的信息，下午 5 点左右，该男子在德文波特以西约 30 公里的企鹅地区被发现。

paras.en: They said he fled from the Alfa Romeo near Preservation Bay, and attempted to escape on foot before surrendering to police and being taken into custody.
paras.zh: 他们说，他从保护区湾附近的阿尔法罗密欧逃离，并试图徒步逃跑，然后向警方自首并被拘留。

paras.en: Investigations into the incidents are continuing.
paras.zh: 对事件的调查仍在继续。

articles.title: SpaceX Starship successfully re-docks at Texas launch pad after orbiting Earth
