paras.zh: 她曾在新加坡公司 Megaspeed 担任高级职位，该公司是 Nvidia 在东南亚最大的客户之一。 Megaspeed 因涉嫌违反美国出口管制，将美国制造的芯片走私到中国而受到美国刑事调查。

paras.en: A criminal investigation is ongoing in Singapore, where officials said Thursday Alice Huang had been barred from re-entering the country. The government also issued her with a stern warning after finding that she had knowingly provided police with inaccurate information to downplay her role in the company. It said that Huang was not investigated for espionage.
paras.zh: 新加坡正在进行一项刑事调查，官员周四表示，爱丽丝·黄已被禁止再次入境该国。在发现她故意向警方提供不准确信息以淡化她在公司中的角色后，政府还向她发出了严厉警告。据称，黄没有因间谍罪受到调查。

paras.en: The country’s Ministry of Home Affairs said in a statement that authorities had interviewed Huang and impounded her passport in 2025, but that its requests for cooperation from U.S. authorities had gone unanswered.
paras.zh: 该国内政部在一份声明中表示，当局已约谈了黄女士，并于 2025 年扣押了她的护照，但其向美国当局提出的合作请求却没有得到答复。

paras.en: “Despite these repeated requests, Singapore has to date received limited information or assistance in respect of the company,” it said.
paras.zh: “尽管一再提出要求，新加坡迄今为止收到的有关该公司的信息或援助有限，”它说。

paras.en: Investigators concluded in February that there was “insufficient evidence to establish that Huang had committed any offences,” the statement said, adding that investigations into Megaspeed and six other individuals were continuing, related to the shipment of servers via Singapore.
paras.zh: 声明称，调查人员在 2 月份得出结论，“没有足够的证据证明黄犯有任何罪行”，并补充说，对 Megaspeed 和其他六人的调查仍在继续，涉及通过新加坡运输服务器的问题。

paras.en: Megaspeed, meanwhile, said in the statement Thursday that it has “cooperated with inspections by the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) and stands ready to cooperate fully with any other relevant U.S. government authority.” The statement was signed by its chairman and CEO, Tan Yong Pong, who also goes by James Tan.
paras.zh: 与此同时，Megaspeed 在周四的声明中表示，它“已配合美国商务部工业与安全局 (BIS) 的检查，并准备与任何其他相关美国政府机构充分合作。”该声明由其董事长兼首席执行官陈永邦（又名詹姆斯·陈）签署。

paras.en: It said that “Megaspeed is committed to working constructively and transparently with the U.S. government.”
paras.zh: 声明称，“Megaspeed 致力于与美国政府进行建设性且透明的合作。”

paras.en: China has dismissed the spying allegations as “smears.” On Thursday, a Foreign Ministry spokesperson said that “the U.S. side should stop fabricating so-called espionage narratives as a pretext for implementing technological blockades.”
paras.zh: 中国驳斥了这些间谍指控，称其为“诽谤”。周四，外交部发言人表示，“美方应停止编造所谓间谍言论，以此作为实施技术封锁的借口。”

paras.en: Megaspeed did not address the allegations surrounding Alice Huang, but said that “to further reinforce our commitment to compliance, Megaspeed has retained a leading U.S. law firm to lead a comprehensive census of its graphics processing units (GPUs) and independently verify its export control compliance practices.”
paras.zh: Megaspeed 没有回应围绕 Alice Huang 的指控，但表示“为了进一步加强我们对合规的承诺，Megaspeed 聘请了一家领先的美国律师事务所来牵头对其图形处理单元 (GPU) 进行全面普查，并独立验证其出口管制合规做法。”

paras.en: The company added that it “welcomes appropriate government scrutiny and is committed to demonstrating through concrete actions that it operates responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable U.S. laws.”
paras.zh: 该公司补充说，它“欢迎政府适当的审查，并致力于通过具体行动证明其运营负责任、透明且符合适用的美国法律。”

paras.en: Nvidia’s stock price has plunged since its 63-year-old chief admitted over the weekend to being “unfaithful” to his wife.
paras.zh: 自从 Nvidia 63 岁的首席执行官周末承认对妻子“不忠”以来，该公司的股价已经暴跌。

paras.en: Huang quit on Thursday in the wake of reports that he had multiple extramarital relationships. In a statement, Nvidia named its executive vice president and chief financial officer Colette Kress as its interim CEO.
paras.zh: 在有报道称他有多次婚外情后，黄于周四辞职。英伟达在一份声明中任命其执行副总裁兼首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯(Colette Kress)为临时首席执行官。

paras.en: Nvidia’s board met Wednesday night to address Huang’s future at the company, a source familiar with the matter told NBC News, adding that the White House was aware of the meeting.
paras.zh: 一位知情人士告诉 NBC 新闻，英伟达董事会于周三晚间召开会议，讨论黄仁勋在公司的未来，并补充说白宫已知晓此次会议。

paras.en: The scandal has raised questions about how much U.S. government officials knew about Alice Huang and Megaspeed.
paras.zh: 该丑闻引发了人们对美国政府官员对 Alice Huang 和 Megaspeed 的了解程度的质疑。

paras.en: In the spring, Secretary of State Marco Rubio circulated a memo to officials in the Trump administration outlining how U.S. intelligence showed that the Nvidia CEO was in a romantic relationship with a business executive who was an asset of China’s spy service, according to a person familiar with Nvidia and a former national security official with knowledge of the matter. The New York Times and the Financial Times first reported on this memo.
paras.zh: 据一位熟悉英伟达的人士和一位知情的前国家安全官员透露，今年春天，国务卿马可·鲁比奥向特朗普政府官员分发了一份备忘录，概述了美国情报机构如何显示英伟达首席执行官与一名属于中国间谍机构的企业高管之间的恋爱关系。 《纽约时报》和《金融时报》首先报道了这份备忘录。

paras.en: Alice Huang’s precise role and relationship with China’s spy service remain unclear, however. It’s possible she was not a career spy for China’s spy agency, the Ministry of State Security, but was asked to cooperate and share information based on her access to Huang, a former national security official with knowledge of the matter told NBC News.
paras.zh: 然而，黄爱丽的确切角色以及与中国间谍部门的关系仍不清楚。一位知情的前国家安全官员告诉 NBC 新闻，她可能不是中国间谍机构国家安全部的职业间谍，但由于她与黄的接触，被要求合作并分享信息。

paras.en: Rep. Jim Himes, D-Conn., ranking Democrat on the House Intelligence Committee, told NPR that Alice Huang’s role still needed to be clarified.
paras.zh: 众议院情报委员会资深民主党人、康涅狄格州众议员吉姆·海姆斯 (Jim Himes) 告诉 NPR，爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 的角色仍需要澄清。

paras.en: Democrats will soon hold control of both the House and the Senate and, as a result, will have subpoena power.
paras.zh: 民主党很快将控制众议院和参议院，因此将拥有传票权。

paras.en: On Wednesday night, as the Nvidia board met, Sens. Elizabeth Warren, D-Mass., and Chris Coons, D-Del., announced they had written to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick with a request to preserve records on the subject.
paras.zh: 周三晚上，在英伟达董事会召开会议时，马萨诸塞州民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 和特拉华州民主党参议员克里斯·库恩斯 (Chris Coons) 宣布，他们已致函商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克 (Howard Lutnick)，请求保存有关该主题的记录。

articles.title: US floated NATO membership for Ukraine, Zelenskyy says

paras.en: The US has raised the possibility of a security framework for Europe to end Russia’s war in Ukraine, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says.
paras.zh: 总统泽伦斯基表示，美国提出了为欧洲建立安全框架以结束俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争的可能性。

paras.en: It's the first time the question of linking NATO membership to territorial concessions has been raised, the president said.
paras.zh: 总统说，这是第一次提出将北约成员身份与领土让步联系起来的问题。

paras.en: Mr Zelenskyy reiterated that Kyiv was not ready to concede territory.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基重申基辅不准备割让领土。

paras.en: US negotiators raised the idea of Ukraine's potential withdrawal from its eastern region of Donbas in exchange for joining NATO, according to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
paras.zh: 总统泽伦斯基表示，美国谈判代表提出了乌克兰可能从东部顿巴斯地区撤军以换取加入北约的想法。

paras.en: This is the first time the question of linking NATO membership to territorial concessions has been raised during the talks, the president said.
paras.zh: 总统说，这是会谈中首次提出将北约成员身份与领土让步挂钩的问题。

paras.en: "The Americans raised a question: 'What if Ukraine joins NATO? Would Ukraine withdraw from Donbas?"
paras.zh: “美国人提出了一个问题：‘如果乌克兰加入北约怎么办？乌克兰会从顿巴斯撤军吗？’”

paras.en: "That is why I believe NATO is back on the agenda. But you have also heard (Russian President Vladimir) Putin's signals, and this is an extremely difficult conversation."
paras.zh: “这就是为什么我相信北约重新回到议程上。但你也听到了（俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔）普京的信号，这是一次极其困难的对话。”

paras.en: Mr Putin has long said Ukrainian membership of NATO is a red line for Moscow, citing the issue as one reason for launching Russia's full-blown invasion in 2022.
paras.zh: 普京长期以来一直表示，乌克兰加入北约对莫斯科来说是一条红线，并称这一问题是俄罗斯在 2022 年发动全面入侵的原因之一。

paras.en: Mr Zelenskyy reiterated his position that Kyiv was not ready to concede territory.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基重申了基辅不准备割让领土的立场。

paras.en: But he also said that if it received a comprehensive package, including security guarantees, the right to a strong and well-funded Ukrainian army and funds to rebuild, he would put the question to a national referendum.
paras.zh: 但他也表示，如果获得全面的一揽子计划，包括安全保障、拥有一支强大且资金充足的乌克兰军队的权利以及重建资金，他将把这个问题提交全国公投。

paras.en: Echoing comments made by European leaders at a summit in Dublin on Friday, Mr Zelenskyy dismissed Russia's call for a broad agreement on European security architecture to be reached before the specifics are agreed on how to end the war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基回应了欧洲领导人周五在都柏林峰会上发表的言论，他驳回了俄罗斯关于在就如何结束乌克兰战争的具体细节达成一致之前就欧洲安全架构达成广泛协议的呼吁。

paras.en: "We cannot turn everything upside down and start by talking about changing the security framework in the world or across the continent overall, and only then talk about ending this war,"
paras.zh: “我们不能把一切颠倒过来，首先谈论改变世界或整个大陆的安全框架，然后才谈论结束这场战争，”

paras.en: Mr Zelenskyy also dismissed Mr Putin's suggestion for a local humanitarian ceasefire in Kostiantynivka, saying it reflected Moscow's inability to take the city by force.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基还驳回了普京关于在科斯蒂安蒂尼夫卡当地进行人道主义停火的建议，称这反映出莫斯科无力以武力夺取这座城市。

paras.en: Civilians there have already had the opportunity to evacuate, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，那里的平民已经有机会撤离。

paras.en: "Putin simply wants us to leave Kostiantynivka so that they can move in and occupy the entire city that way," he said.
paras.zh: “普京只是希望我们离开科斯蒂安蒂尼夫卡，这样他们就可以进入并占领整个城市，”他说。

paras.en: Ukraine has given a list of seven or eight other frontline settlements where civilians, including children, are trapped for a potential humanitarian truce but Russia prefers to use them as military targets, Mr Zelenskyy said.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，乌克兰已经列出了其他七八个前线定居点的名单，其中包括儿童在内的平民被困，以实现可能的人道主义休战，但俄罗斯更愿意将它们用作军事目标。

paras.en: Moscow denies deliberately targeting civilians in the war.
paras.zh: 莫斯科否认在战争中故意针对平民。

paras.en: The two days of US-brokered talks between Ukraine and Russia concluded on Wednesday in the Emirati capital without a major breakthrough.
paras.zh: 在美国的斡旋下，乌克兰和俄罗斯之间为期两天的会谈于周三在阿联酋首都结束，但没有取得重大突破。

paras.en: The sides agreed to a prisoner exchange that will involve more than 1,000 people, Mr Zelenskyy said.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，双方同意交换囚犯，涉及人数将超过 1000 人。

paras.en: The final numbers for the prisoner swap were still under discussion, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，囚犯交换的最终数字仍在讨论中。

paras.en: US peace envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner had pledged to raise an energy ceasefire with Mr Putin at a meeting in Moscow on Thursday, Zelenskyy said, but there was no news of any progress after their talks.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，美国和平特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳周四在莫斯科举行的一次会议上承诺与普京达成能源停火协议，但会谈后没有任何进展的消息。

paras.en: "Putin personally does not support a ceasefire,"
paras.zh: “普京个人并不支持停火”

paras.en: Mr Zelenskyy met Mr Witkoff and Mr Kushner on Thursday in Ireland after their talks in Moscow.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基先生在莫斯科会谈后于周四在爱尔兰会见了威特科夫先生和库什纳先生。

paras.en: He said the US negotiators had told him that all sides had agreed for Europe to have a seat at the negotiating table in forthcoming peace talks.
paras.zh: 他说，美国谈判代表告诉他，各方已同意欧洲在即将举行的和平谈判中在谈判桌上占有一席之地。

paras.en: In Abu Dhabi, delegates from Europe — which is now Ukraine's largest financial and military backer — had talks with US and Ukrainian officials but did not sit at the table with Russia.
paras.zh: 在阿布扎比，来自欧洲（目前是乌克兰最大的金融和军事支持者）的代表与美国和乌克兰官员进行了会谈，但没有与俄罗斯坐在一起。

paras.en: At the summit in Ireland, EU leaders agreed that Europe's team for any Ukraine peace talks would comprise five major military powers — non-EU member Britain plus France, Germany, Italy and Poland — as well as EU officials.
paras.zh: 在爱尔兰峰会上，欧盟领导人同意，乌克兰和平谈判的欧洲团队将由五个主要军事强国——非欧盟成员国英国加上法国、德国、意大利和波兰——以及欧盟官员组成。

articles.title: Can these true crime sleuths solve Australia's most infamous cold cases?
articles.author: Rhiannon Stevens

paras.en: At a seaside festival in regional South Australia, true crime obsession meets the grief of families whose loved ones are presumed murdered.
paras.zh: 在南澳大利亚地区的一个海滨节日上，真正的犯罪痴迷与亲人被推定被谋杀的家庭的悲伤交织在一起。

paras.en: Max Marten is speaking from a wheelchair beside a wooden stage in Victor Harbor's splendid art deco theatre. "We are dealing in a subject that affects every single person in this room," the podcast producer says. I look around me; the theatre is two-thirds full of mostly white, middle-aged women. "You have family and friends that may not be here anymore because of what happened," Max says.
paras.zh: 在维克多港华丽的装饰艺术剧院的木制舞台旁，马克斯·马丁坐在轮椅上发表讲话。 “我们正在讨论一个影响这个房间里每个人的主题，”播客制作人说。我环顾四周；剧院里三分之二的人大多是白人中年女性。 “由于发生的事情，你的家人和朋友可能不再在这里了，”马克斯说。

paras.en: What happened is usually murder, although many of the cases being discussed at "Crime Scene Victor Harbor" — billed as Australia's first true crime festival — have never been solved. Now, buffered from the wind in a seaside town an hour's drive from Adelaide, the audience is being asked to help. "Through conversation things get solved and people get listened to," Max says, before handing the microphone to Bryan Littlely, the brains behind the festival.
paras.zh: 发生的事情通常是谋杀，尽管在“维克多港犯罪现场”（号称澳大利亚第一个真正的犯罪节）上讨论的许多案件从未得到解决。现在，在距离阿德莱德一小时车程的海滨小镇，观众们被要求提供帮助，以躲避风浪。 “通过对话，问题得到解决，人们的意见得到倾听，”马克斯说道，然后将麦克风递给音乐节背后的大脑布莱恩·利特尔利 (Bryan Littlely)。

paras.en: Bryan, a cowboy boot-wearing former journalist, farmer and now true crime podcast host, once saw an episode of CSI: Crime Scene Investigation about a murder at a true crime convention. In the episode, called "Merchants of Menace", a murder takes place at a convention selling "murderabilia": items that were used in crimes, once belonged to killers, or artworks they produced in prison. There have been attempts to outlaw murderabilia in the US, where opponents say it trivialises or glorifies hideous crimes and further traumatises victims' families. It exists at the grisly fringe of true crime obsession.
paras.zh: 布莱恩曾是一名穿着牛仔靴的记者、农民，现在是真实犯罪播客主持人，他曾经看过《CSI：犯罪现场调查》的一集，讲述了真实犯罪大会上发生的一起谋杀案。在名为“威胁商人”的剧集中，一场谋杀案发生在一次出售“谋杀品”的集会上：用于犯罪、曾经属于杀手的物品，或者他们在监狱中制作的艺术品。美国曾试图将杀人行为定为非法，反对者称杀人行为轻视或美化了可怕的罪行，并进一步伤害了受害者家属。它存在于真正的犯罪痴迷的可怕边缘。

paras.en: For Bryan, the episode seeded the idea of a true crime convention that he revisited after he began presenting his true crime podcast "Sleepers" in front of live audiences. "Making yourself available to answer questions and have the statements and the evidence challenged by the public who are ever hungry for true crime [is popular]," he tells me. "It just so happens that people want to pay to see that." Why not host a true crime festival in his hometown, he thought, and bring together writers, podcasters and citizen sleuths to discuss the crimes they've wrestled into stories?
paras.zh: 对于布莱恩来说，这一集播下了真实犯罪大会的想法，在他开始在现场观众面前展示他的真实犯罪播客“Sleepers”后，他重新审视了这一想法。 “让自己能够回答问题，并让那些渴望了解真实犯罪的公众对陈述和证据提出质疑[很受欢迎]，”他告诉我。 “碰巧人们愿意付费观看。”他想，为什么不在他的家乡举办一个真正的犯罪节，让作家、播客和公民侦探聚集在一起，讨论他们编入故事的犯罪事件呢？

paras.en: As for why we're seeing a true crime renaissance, Bryan points to social media. "There's experts everywhere … anyone can be an investigator," including victims' families he told an Adelaide radio station ahead of the festival. "The families are speaking and there's less oversight by police, there's individual and independent investigations going on … not everyone wants to be spoken to by a police officer, and police are resource poor, they can't be looking at these cases." He promises the radio host that at Crime Scene Victor Harbor there'll be "revelations on some major cases".
paras.zh: 至于为什么我们会看到真正的犯罪复兴，布莱恩指出了社交媒体。 “到处都是专家……任何人都可以成为调查员，”包括受害者家属，他在节日前告诉阿德莱德一家广播电台。 “家属们正在发言，警方的监督较少，个别和独立的调查正在进行……并不是每个人都希望与警察交谈，而且警方资源匮乏，他们无法关注这些​​案件。”他向电台主持人承诺，维克多港犯罪现场将“揭露一些重大案件”。

paras.en: Before arriving at the festival, I checked into a desolate caravan park on the edge of town. Leaving my phone on the bed, I took a shower in the cramped bathroom of a prefab cabin. When I pulled the handle of the sliding door to leave the bathroom it wouldn't budge. I tried again, willing my fingers into the space between the door and the frame, but nothing happened. I wasn't panicking — yet — but I started to wonder how long it would be before someone realised I was stuck.
paras.zh: 到达节日之前，我入住了小镇边缘一个荒凉的房车公园。我把手机放在床上，在预制小屋狭窄的浴室里洗了个澡。当我拉动滑动门的把手离开浴室时，它纹丝不动。我又试了一次，将手指伸进门和门框之间的空间，但什么也没发生。我还没有惊慌，但我开始想知道要多久才会有人意识到我被困住了。

paras.en: I wedged open a small window. It wasn't big enough to climb out, but through a fist-sized opening I saw a single campervan and tent in an otherwise empty campground. Eventually, a woman wearing an over-sized t-shirt and pigtails tied with rainbow scrunchies appeared. I shouted, "hello, hello!", and she approached the window. She asked if the cabin door was locked. I wasn't sure. Then I could hear her inside the cabin. "There's frayed carpet under the door catching it," she said before pulling the carpet out and opening the door.
paras.zh: 我打开了一扇小窗户。它不够大，无法爬出去，但通过一个拳头大小的开口，我看到空荡荡的露营地里有一辆露营车和帐篷。最终，一名穿着超大T恤、扎着彩虹发圈的辫子的女人出现了。我喊道：“哈喽，哈喽！”，她就走到了窗边。她问舱门是否锁着。我不确定。然后我就可以听到她在机舱里的声音。 “门下面有磨损的地毯，把它粘住了，”她说，然后拉出地毯并打开了门。

paras.en: I was free. In a rush of relief, I walked out of the bathroom, smiling. Then I realised I was standing beside a bed wearing nothing but a towel face-to-face with a stranger. "Lucky it was me," the woman said before leaving. I took that to mean lucky I wasn't a man.
paras.zh: 我自由了。我松了口气，微笑着走出浴室。然后我意识到我正站在床边，与一个陌生人面对面，只穿了一条毛巾。 “幸运的是我，”女人在离开前说道。我认为这意味着幸运我不是一个男人。

paras.en: One theory that tries to account for true crime's popularity is that for women, the overwhelming consumers of the podcasts, TV shows and books that have proliferated over the past decade or so, it imparts useful life lessons. A sorry guide on how to escape killers and abusers and avoid becoming a victim.
paras.zh: 试图解释真实犯罪流行的一种理论是，对于女性来说，她们是过去十年左右播客、电视节目和书籍的绝大多数消费者，这些内容传授了有用的人生教训。这是一本关于如何逃离杀手和虐待者并避免成为受害者的遗憾指南。

paras.en: But this alone doesn't explain the rise of amateur sleuths or victims' families telling their own true crime stories. We live in an age of super sleuths like "mushroom murderer" Erin Patterson — who belonged to an online community researching the crimes of Keli Lane, convicted of murdering her newborn daughter in 2010 before her own case descended into true crime mania. I've come to Victor Harbor curious to figure out what's fuelling this phenomenon.
paras.zh: 但这本身并不能解释业余侦探或受害者家属讲述自己真实犯罪故事的兴起。我们生活在一个像“蘑菇杀人犯”艾琳·帕特森这样的超级侦探的时代，她属于一个研究科利·莱恩罪行的在线社区，2010 年，她因谋杀刚出生的女儿而被定罪，随后她自己的案件陷入了真正的犯罪狂潮。我来到维克多港，好奇地想弄清楚是什么助长了这种现象。

paras.en: On Friday night Victor Harbor's main street is deserted. A warm glow seeps from a sandstone pub opposite the theatre. Inside, Sharon Ferguson and Nanette Simpson are talking intently at the festival's "hub", their heads bowed together to combat the noise in the room. The two retirees have known each other for 50 years and have bumped into each other at the event.
paras.zh: 周五晚上，维克多港的主要街道空无一人。剧院对面的砂岩酒吧散发出温暖的光芒。在里面，莎朗·弗格森和纳内特·辛普森正在音乐节的“中心”聚精会神地交谈，她们低着头以对抗房间里的噪音。这两位退休人员相识已有 50 年，并在这次活动中相遇。

paras.en: When I ask why they're here, they place newspaper clippings and scribbled notes on the table. Sharon has an article about Hazel Pope and Joyce Eastwood who were last seen in 1970 outside the meatworks where they worked. According to Crime Stoppers SA, they unloaded two suitcases, were picked up by a male taxi driver and never heard from again. Sharon says she knew one of the women.
paras.zh: 当我问他们为什么来这里时，他们把剪报和潦草的笔记放在桌子上。 Sharon 有一篇关于 Hazel Pope 和 Joyce Eastwood 的文章，最后一次出现是在 1970 年他们工作的肉类加工厂外。据灭罪组织称，他们卸下了两个行李箱，被一名男性出租车司机接走，之后就再也没有音讯。莎伦说她认识其中一位女士。

paras.en: She also says she used to work with a man believed to have been involved in Adelaide's horrific "family" serial killings. Since Sharon realised her connection a few years back, she's been writing down names and memories as they arise — some day one might prove useful to someone.
paras.zh: 她还说，她曾经与一名据信参与阿德莱德可怕的“家庭”连环杀人案的男子一起工作。自从几年前莎伦意识到自己的联系以来，她一直在记下出现的名字和记忆——有一天，这些名字和记忆可能对某人有用。

paras.en: True crime has existed as a literary genre since the mid-1800s, but over the last 15 years it's become more participatory and immersive, as criminology professor Michael Arntfield writes: "Amateur sleuths, advocates, pundits and activists proliferate with each new feature. Podcasts beget further podcasts." Fanatics are dedicating their own time and resources trying to solve cold cases. Sometimes they make breakthroughs, sometimes fingers are pointed too hastily at innocent people. And like most things on the internet, true crime isn't immune to conspiracy theories.
paras.zh: 自 1800 年代中期以来，真实犯罪一直作为一种文学流派而存在，但在过去 15 年里，它变得更具参与性和沉浸感，正如犯罪学教授迈克尔·阿恩菲尔德 (Michael Arntfield) 所写的那样：“业余侦探、倡导者、专家和活动家随着每一个新功能的出现而激增。播客催生了更多的播客。”狂热分子正在投入自己的时间和资源试图解决悬案。有时他们会取得突破，有时会过于仓促地将矛头指向无辜者。与互联网上的大多数事物一样，真正的犯罪也不能免受阴谋论的影响。

paras.en: The next morning, I pass a group of older women dressed in Lycra discussing the fate of the Adelaide Crows' coach as they shuffle along the foreshore. It occurs to me that football, that great unifier, shares something with true crime obsession. Both tap into a desire for community and conversation through endlessly analysed strategy. And perhaps like football, true crime affords us a universe where the heroes and villains are easy to identify. As English writer Kate Summerscale argues, true crime "can relieve our anxiety by locating badness in a single person, rather than in our society or ourselves".
paras.zh: 第二天早上，我经过一群穿着莱卡的老年妇女，她们沿着前滩拖着脚步，讨论着阿德莱德乌鸦队教练的命运。我突然想到，足球这个伟大的统一者与真正的犯罪痴迷有着共同之处。两者都通过不断分析的策略来挖掘对社区和对话的渴望。也许就像足球一样，真正的犯罪为我们提供了一个英雄和恶棍很容易识别的宇宙。正如英国作家凯特·萨默斯凯尔（Kate Summerscale）所说，真正的犯罪“可以通过将坏处归咎于一个人而不是我们的社会或我们自己来缓解我们的焦虑”。

paras.en: At the first Crime Scene Victor Harbor event on the Saturday, Meni Caroutas is talking about the murder of Peter Falconio and the attempted kidnapping of Joanne Lees. Meni, host of the "hit podcast" The Missing Australia and an ex-TV reporter and police officer, tells the crowd that the evidence that saw Bradley John Murdoch convicted of murder is overwhelming. But, he says, there are people who believe Murdoch is innocent.
paras.zh: 在周六维克多港第一场犯罪现场活动中，梅尼·卡鲁塔斯谈论了彼得·法尔科尼奥被谋杀和乔安妮·李斯被企图绑架的事件。梅尼是“热门播客”《失踪的澳大利亚》的主持人，也是一名前电视记者和警察，他告诉人群，布拉德利·约翰·默多克被判谋杀罪的证据是压倒性的。但是，他说，有些人相信默多克是无辜的。

paras.en: The "Peter Falconio what really happened" Facebook page, dedicated to canvassing alternate theories on the case, has 18,000 members. As I write, the most recent post says: "Let's look at the people who were in Barrow Creek and what connection do they have with motorcycle gangs." Every time Meni mentions the conspiracy theories that surround the Falconio case, one woman in the crowd nods vigorously. There's research that suggests a link between morbid curiosity and conspiracy theories. A heightened interest in learning about threats, say through binging true crime, can lead people to conspiracy theories, the study's authors argue.
paras.zh: “Peter Falconio 到底发生了什么”Facebook 页面致力于探讨有关此案的不同理论，拥有 18,000 名会员。正如我所写，最近的帖子说：“让我们看看巴罗溪的人以及他们与摩托车团伙有什么联系。”每当梅尼提到围绕法尔科尼奥案件的阴谋论时，人群中就有一位女士用力点头。有研究表明病态好奇心与阴谋论之间存在联系。该研究的作者认为，人们对了解威胁的兴趣日益浓厚，比如通过了解真实的犯罪行为，可能会导致人们产生阴谋论。

paras.en: Beside me, a woman with a bright face wearing a white beanie is rapidly writing notes that seem unrelated to the talk. Then she texts someone: "This may be a good spot to look." I wonder if she trying to solve a crime in real time. Later, I'll speak with her and discover a community of trauma survivors who are organising searches, supporting families of the recently disappeared, and honing their investigative skills to help research crimes privately or for true crime productions.
paras.zh: 在我旁边，一位戴着白色无檐小便帽、面色明亮的女士正在快速写下似乎与演讲无关的笔记。然后她给某人发短信：“这可能是一个值得一看的好地方。”我想知道她是否试图实时解决犯罪问题。稍后，我将与她交谈，发现一个由创伤幸存者组成的社区，他们正在组织搜索，为最近失踪的家庭提供支持，并磨练他们的调查技能，以帮助私下研究犯罪或真正的犯罪制作。

paras.en: Debi Marshall is small but formidable. The long-time investigative crime journalist is speaking to a large audience about the "family" murders, which she calls Australia's Epstein case. She says numerous sexual assaults of boys snatched from Adelaide's streets led up to the murders of five young men between 1979 and 1983. She reads out more details about the suspected paedophile ring behind the abductions and killings — four of which remain unsolved. The woman next to me lets out a heavy sigh and crosses her arms.
paras.zh: 黛比·马歇尔身材虽小，但令人敬畏。这位长期从事犯罪调查的记者正在向大批听众讲述“家庭”谋杀案，她称之为澳大利亚的爱泼斯坦案。她说，1979 年至 1983 年间，阿德莱德街头发生的多起针对男孩的性侵犯事件，导致五名年轻男子被谋杀。她宣读了有关绑架和杀戮背后疑似恋童癖团伙的更多细节，其中四起案件仍未侦破。我旁边的女人重重地叹了一口气，交叉双臂。

paras.en: Some of the victims' family members are sitting in the front row watching Debi speak. Their faces are ragged and they're running out of time to see justice done. Along with Debi, they're currently campaigning for decades-old suppression orders on the names of people who were either police witnesses, informants or suspects to be lifted.
paras.zh: 一些受害者家属坐在前排观看黛比讲话。他们的脸都破烂不堪，他们已经没有时间看到正义得到伸张了。他们目前正在与黛比一起发起运动，要求解除已有数十年历史的对警方证人、线人或嫌疑人姓名的压制令。

paras.en: Debi says the "family" murders are the most depraved of the many cases she's worked on — and she wrote a book on which the Snowtown film is based. As Debi talks about the mutilation of these young men's bodies, I look out the window, a stand of Norfolk Island pines is motionless. Nothing is happening outside to distract, not even a breeze.
paras.zh: 黛比说，“家庭”谋杀案是她处理过的众多案件中最邪恶的一个——她还写了一本书，《雪城》电影就是根据这本书改编的。当黛比谈论这些年轻人的尸体被肢解时，我向窗外望去，诺福克岛的一棵松树一动不动。外面没有发生任何事情可以分散注意力，甚至连微风都没有。

paras.en: She tells the audience that investigating such crimes has taken a toll on her. Later she tells me she used to be too afraid to let her teenage daughter walk to school. And her work visited her in nightmares. "My specialty, for want of a different way of putting it, is serial killers," she says. "So, when you're chasing serial killers, you need to be careful they don't start chasing you. But they do start chasing you in your dreams. And sometimes they catch you, which is awful."
paras.zh: 她告诉观众，调查此类犯罪对她造成了损失。后来她告诉我，她曾经非常害怕让十几岁的女儿步行去学校。她的工作在噩梦中降临到她身上。 “我的专长是连环杀手，因为我不想用不同的方式来表达它，”她说。 “所以，当你追捕连环杀手时，你需要小心他们不要开始追你。但他们确实会在你的梦中开始追你。有时他们会抓住你，这很糟糕。”

paras.en: Debi raises this toll when people on social media accuse her of "doing this for the money". She has little time for those who she says peddle in true crime on social media for attention and revenue: "It's like the Salem witch hunts, this hysterical mob, each ramping the other up higher and higher into putting out this nonsense about what's happened in their opinion and then calling it fact … when the work involved in separating fact from rumour is so intense and time consuming."
paras.zh: 当社交媒体上的人们指责黛比“为了钱而这样做”时，她的损失增加了。她没有时间理会那些她所说的在社交媒体上兜售真实犯罪以获取关注和收入的人：“这就像塞勒姆的政治迫害，这群歇斯底里的暴徒，每一个人都在不断地煽动对方，把他们认为发生的事情胡说八道，然后称之为事实……而将事实与谣言分开的工作是如此紧张和耗时。”

paras.en: After Debi's presentation I get talking with the woman next to me. Deb Phali says she grew up in Western Sydney near where Anita Cobby was brutally killed in 1982. Deb remembers "driving past the area with my family and seeing all the cops everywhere" and she wonders if that sparked her interest in true crime. She says the fascination is really a desire to figure out human behaviour: "It's about trying to understand what makes people do this. You just hope that maybe you can listen to something and find some answers to help people. Not that I've got any."
paras.zh: 黛比的演讲结束后，我开始和我旁边的女士交谈。黛布·帕利 (Deb Phali) 说，她在西悉尼长大，1982 年安妮塔·科比 (Anita Cobby) 在那里被残酷杀害。黛布记得“和家人开车经过这个地区，看到到处都是警察”，她想知道这是否激发了她对真正犯罪的兴趣。她说，这种着迷实际上是一种弄清楚人类行为的渴望：“这是关于试图理解是什么促使人们这样做。你只是希望也许你可以倾听一些东西并找到一些答案来帮助人们。但我没有任何答案。”

paras.en: Deb's ex-husband also had a relative who went missing in 1982 and she says it's given her a particular interest in missing person's cases. Of 10-year-old Bradford's disappearance, she says it destroyed his family and that the case wasn't investigated properly by police. He was a Koori and had been in foster care, "so they didn't give a rats", she says.
paras.zh: Deb 的前夫也有一位亲戚在 1982 年失踪，她说这让她对失踪人员案件特别感兴趣。对于 10 岁男孩布拉德福德的失踪，她说这摧毁了他的家庭，而且警方没有适当调查此案。她说，他是库里人，一直被寄养，“所以他们没有养老鼠”。

paras.en: I wonder out loud how everyone in the crowd can stomach sitting through story after story of violence and tragedy. "Talking about it brings some support and some light to the darkness of it all," Deb says. "To know that people do care and are out there trying to do the right thing and you've got investigative people out there trying to help people, that's the positive I take out of it."
paras.zh: 我大声地想知道人群中的每个人如何能够忍受坐着听一个又一个暴力和悲剧的故事。 “谈论它会给这一切的黑暗带来一些支持和一些光明，”黛布说。 “知道人们确实关心并试图做正确的事情，并且有调查人员试图帮助人们，这就是我从中得到的积极影响。”

paras.en: When Sally Leydon is asked to say something about her mother Marion Barter on stage at the festival, she smacks her lips together creating a loud pop. Sally says her mother used to kiss her on her ears, so that a kiss would be something heard as well as felt. For a moment, Marion, who hasn't been heard from since 1997, comes into focus. In 2024, a NSW Coroner said Marion was dead, but that she could not make a finding about where or how she died.
paras.zh: 当莎莉·莱登被要求在音乐节的舞台上谈论她的母亲玛丽昂·巴特时，她咂着嘴唇发出响亮的声音。莎莉说，她的母亲过去常常亲吻她的耳朵，这样亲吻既可以被听到，也可以被感觉到。一时之间，自 1997 年以来就杳无音信的马里昂成为了焦点。 2024 年，新南威尔士州验尸官称马里昂已经死亡，但她无法确定她的死亡地点或死亡方式。

paras.en: The inquest into Marion's disappearance was announced the year after Sally launched The Lady Vanishes, a podcast which has captivated millions of listeners. Created with Seven News, Sally says it was unusual at the time for a family member to be involved in the production. "Me being involved and speaking on the podcast and working in real time with the journalists made the difference in how people connected with the podcast," Sally tells me later. "Journalists can't bring that lived experience." But it complicated her relationship with the police working on her mother's case. "If you speak your truth, police might not help you and not want to work with you, it's a fine line," she says.
paras.zh: 对马里昂失踪的调查是在莎莉推出播客《消失的女士》一年后宣布的，该播客吸引了数百万听众。莎莉表示，该剧由七台新闻制作，当时家庭成员参与制作是很不寻常的。 “我参与播客并在播客上发言，并与记者实时合作，这改变了人们与播客的联系方式，”莎莉后来告诉我。 “记者无法带来生活经历。”但这使她与处理她母亲案件的警察的关系变得复杂。 “如果你说出真相，警察可能不会帮助你，也不会愿意与你合作，这是一个很好的界限，”她说。

paras.en: Sally says her podcast isn't entertainment. But having millions of people download it is comforting, she says, and gives her hope. And it has helped. Armchair sleuths who listened to the podcast helped identify the man of interest in her mother's case. It's also given Sally a platform from which to advocate for the families of missing people, and she's started The Green Seat Project to raise awareness about missing persons cases and the trauma their families experience. "I can't change what's happened to me, or my mum or the impact it had on my brother [who died by suicide after their mother's disappearance], but I can certainly talk about it to make a change to make it better for the next family," Sally says.
paras.zh: 莎莉说她的播客不是娱乐。但她说，有数百万人下载它令人感到欣慰，并给了她希望。这确实有帮助。收听播客的纸上谈兵的侦探们帮助识别了与她母亲的案件有关的男子。它还为莎莉提供了一个为失踪人员家属发声的平台，她启动了“绿座项目”，以提高人们对失踪人员案件及其家人所经历的创伤的认识。 “我无法改变发生在我身上的事情，也无法改变发生在我妈妈身上的事，也无法改变它对我兄弟的影响（他在母亲失踪后自杀身亡），但我当然可以谈论它，以做出改变，让下一个家庭过得更好，”莎莉说。

paras.en: At the NSW Parliamentary Inquiry into Unsolved Murders and Long-Term Missing Persons Cases, Sally called for police to have greater sensitivity when they talk to and work with families of missing persons or murder victims. She also pushed for reforms around death in absentia and death certificate processes, the establishment of a voluntary disappearance register and improvements to how NSW Police process unidentified human remains.
paras.zh: 在新南威尔士州议会对未解决的谋杀案和长期失踪人员案件的调查中，莎莉呼吁警方在与失踪人员或谋杀受害者的家人交谈和合作时要更加敏感。她还推动围绕缺席死亡和死亡证明程序进行改革，建立自愿失踪登记册，并改进新南威尔士州警方处理身份不明的人体遗骸的方式。

paras.en: On stage Sally is relaxed and commanding. It's easy to see why she's drawn so many people to her mother's case. I'd count her as one of the growing number of women who as Caroline Fraser writes in the New York Review of Books is changing true crime from a "soiled brand" and "dismantling the age-old Master Detective myths—that women are responsible for what's done to them, that policing necessarily makes us safer, that cops are good at catching killers".
paras.zh: 在舞台上，莎莉显得轻松而威严。很容易理解为什么她会吸引这么多人关注她母亲的案件。我认为她是越来越多的女性之一，正如卡罗琳·弗雷泽（Caroline Fraser）在《纽约书评》中所写的那样，她们正在改变真正的犯罪行为，从“肮脏的品牌”和“瓦解古老的侦探大师神话——女性应对对她们所做的事情负责，警察必然让我们更安全，警察擅长抓捕凶手”。

paras.en: It's dark when the crowd leaves the theatre and steps onto Victor Harbor's main street. Festival organisers have drawn chalk outlines of bodies on the footpath to stage a fake crime scene. After hours spent discussing the missing and the murdered the gimmick feels off. As any true crime obsessive would tell you, police don't actually do this because it risks contaminating the crime scene. The imaginary body seems to speak to the uncomfortable intersection of crime, entertainment and narrative that true crime still can't resolve.
paras.zh: 当人群离开剧院并踏上维克多港的主要街道时，天已经黑了。节日组织者在人行道上用粉笔画出了尸体轮廓，以呈现一个假犯罪现场。经过几个小时的讨论失踪者和被谋杀者之后，这个噱头感觉不妙了。正如任何真正的犯罪迷都会告诉你的那样，警察实际上不会这样做，因为它有污染犯罪现场的风险。想象中的身体似乎讲述了犯罪、娱乐和叙事之间令人不安的交叉点，而真实的犯罪仍然无法解决这一问题。

paras.en: The presence at the festival speakers like Sally talking alongside traditional journalists is a reminder that legacy media is no longer the gatekeeper, says Adam Shand, a former newspaper reporter turned podcaster and author. And this has complicated things for police, he argues. "You had the odd journalist who would break ranks," he says. "But largely speaking, across Australia, crime journalists have been police journalists, and they've had to rely upon access to coppers … now people can access the audience, can access the subjects and they can do their own investigations, and they can become their own publishers most importantly."
paras.zh: 前报纸记者转为播客兼作家的亚当·山德 (Adam Shand) 表示，像莎莉这样的节日演讲者与传统记者一起讲话提醒人们，传统媒体不再是看门人。他认为，这让警方的事情变得复杂。 “你有一个奇怪的记者，他会打破常规，”他说。 “但总的来说，在澳大利亚各地，犯罪记者一直是警察记者，他们不得不依赖警察……现在人们可以接触观众，可以接触主题，他们可以自己进行调查，最重要的是，他们可以成为自己的出版商。”

paras.en: Adam says a cop once told him to "never get in front of the plough". But that's now common practice and has become the domain of legacy media podcasts too. "We saw this with The Teacher's Pet," Adam says. "Hedley Thomas and Damian Loone and others stepping in front of the plough constantly and showing people that the police had not done their job and therefore that drove the investigation and I think it led to the charging without the body."
paras.zh: 亚当说，一名警察曾经告诉他“永远不要走到犁前”。但这现在已成为常见做法，并且也已成为传统媒体播客的领域。 “我们在《老师的宠物》中看到了这一点，”亚当说。 “赫德利·托马斯（Hedley Thomas）、达米安·卢恩（Damian Loone）和其他人不断地走到犁前，向人们表明警察没有完成他们的工作，因此推动了调查，我认为这导致了没有尸体的指控。”

paras.en: Hedley's success in solving a crime might also be an outlier. Of the seemingly infinite number of true crime podcasts or TV shows, how many lead to convictions in unsolved cases? All of the weekend's presenters speak with certainty — or is it hubris? Two of them tell me confidently who is responsible for the disappearance of the Beaumont children from an Adelaide beach in 1966, and they offer up different names.
paras.zh: 赫德利在破案方面的成功也可能是一个异常值。在看似无数的真实犯罪播客或电视节目中，有多少会导致未侦破的案件被定罪？周末的所有主持人都言之有物——还是傲慢？他们中的两个人自信地告诉我谁对 1966 年阿德莱德海滩上的博蒙特孩子失踪负有责任，但他们提供了不同的名字。

paras.en: I leave Adam in the bar, as some women with armfuls of newly purchased books approach and ask to have their photo taken with him. I walk back to the caravan park along a dark footpath occasionally illuminated by the headlights of a passing car. I'm used to travelling alone. I'm not scared of the dark. But after the day's talks I feel jumpy.
paras.zh: 我把亚当留在酒吧里，一些妇女抱着新买的书走过来，要求与他合影。我沿着一条黑暗的小路走回房车公园，路过的汽车的车灯偶尔照亮。我习惯一个人旅行。我并不害怕黑暗。但经过一天的会谈后，我感到紧张。

paras.en: Psychologists often offer another theory, called "benign masochism", about why so many of us consume true crime. As Arntfield explains, although true crime involves consuming content that provokes fear or anxiety, audiences remain safe. "The theory proposes that intense emotional experiences trigger a secondary, opposing emotional response. Dread, tension and even revulsion can give way to relief; anxiety to reassurance," he writes. Repeated exposure can lead to more prolonged highs, and he argues this is likely why true crime is prevalent on platforms built for binging, like streaming services.
paras.zh: 心理学家经常提出另一种理论，称为“良性受虐狂”，解释为什么我们这么多人会消费真正的犯罪行为。正如阿恩菲尔德解释的那样，尽管真正的犯罪涉及消费引起恐惧或焦虑的内容，但观众仍然是安全的。 “该理论认为，强烈的情绪体验会引发次要的、相反的情绪反应。恐惧、紧张甚至厌恶可以让位于缓解；焦虑可以让位于安心，”他写道。反复接触可能会导致更长时间的高潮，他认为这可能就是为什么真正的犯罪在流媒体服务等为狂欢而建立的平台上盛行的原因。

paras.en: Back in the cabin I lie in bed worrying that my car — the only one in the carpark — is in a space with a number corresponding to the cabin. Anyone watching from the shadows will know mine is the only occupied cabin. The true crime weekend seems to be having the opposite effect on me.
paras.zh: 回到小屋后，我躺在床上，担心我的车——停车场里唯一的一辆——是在一个与小屋对应的号码的空间里。任何在阴影中观看的人都会知道我的小屋是唯一有人居住的小屋。真正的犯罪周末似乎对我产生了相反的影响。

paras.en: When 33-year-old Nadine Haag’s body was found in her Sydney apartment in 2009, police quickly concluded that she had died by suicide. But her family never believed Nadie had taken her own life. Four years later, after mounting their own investigation, they succeeded in having the finding overturned by a NSW coroner, who said, as The Sydney Morning Herald reported, that “the actions of Ms Haag's former partner ‘raised considerable suspicion’ that her death was the result of a homicide”.
paras.zh: 2009 年，当 33 岁的纳丁·哈格 (Nadine Haag) 的尸体在悉尼的公寓中被发现时，警方很快得出结论，她是自杀身亡。但她的家人从来不相信纳迪自杀了。四年后，在展开自己的调查后，他们成功地让新南威尔士州验尸官推翻了这一调查结果，据《悉尼先驱晨报》报道，验尸官表示，“哈格女士前伴侣的行为‘引起了相当大的怀疑’，认为她的死亡是他杀的结果”。

paras.en: After Nadine’s death, her sister Tasia wanted to learn as much as she could to understand Nadine’s case. She signed up for courses in crime scene staging, forensics and DNA, blood pattern analysis, crime scene photography – anything she thought might help. She also received a diploma in crime and justice. Seventeen years later, Tasia and her twin sister Chantal say they are still hoping to “see justice and the truth get out there”.
paras.zh: 纳丁去世后，她的妹妹塔西娅想尽可能多地了解纳丁的情况。她报名参加了犯罪现场分期、法医学和DNA、血型分析、犯罪现场摄影等课程——她认为任何可能有帮助的课程。她还获得了犯罪和司法文凭。十七年后，塔西亚和她的双胞胎妹妹尚塔尔表示，他们仍然希望“看到正义和真相大白于天下”。

paras.en: This search has led the sisters to the festival, and to supporting other families of missing or allegedly murdered people. Tasia belongs to an embryonic organisation called the Centre for Missing Persons, which is aiming to become the national voice for people in the missing persons space. The sisters also help families navigate police investigations, administrative and legal processes like obtaining death certificates, and they put their boots on to deliver flyers about missing people and help with bushland searches. They’re also calling for police to listen to victims’ families. “The family has so many answers, they have so much information, sometimes police take some of the information in … but quite often they don’t,” Chantal says.
paras.zh: 这次搜寻使姐妹们参加了这个节日，并支持了其他失踪或涉嫌被谋杀者的家庭。塔西亚属于一个名为“失踪人员中心”的新兴组织，该组织的目标是成为全国失踪人员领域的代言人。姐妹俩还帮助家人处理警方调查、行政和法律程序，例如获得死亡证明，并派出有关失踪人员的传单并帮助丛林搜寻。他们还呼吁警方倾听受害者家属的声音。 “家人有很多答案，他们有很多信息，有时警方会获取一些信息……但通常他们不会，”尚塔尔说。

paras.en: For Tasia and Chantal, the true crime festival is a chance to connect with people with similar experiences. It's "reassurance" that they're not alone, Chantal says. "That you’re not going crazy, that what’s happened is not just in your head.”
paras.zh: 对于塔西亚和尚塔尔来说，真正的犯罪节是一个与有相似经历的人建立联系的机会。尚塔尔说，这是“保证”他们并不孤单。 “你没有发疯，发生的事情不仅仅发生在你的脑海里。”

paras.en: Afterwards, I follow Tasia and her family into a dark room at a hilltop golf club for the final event of the weekend. Bryan Littlely, the festival founder, is presenting a slideshow of some of the cases he’s investigating in his “Sleepers” podcast. Bryan, who left the Adelaide Advertiser in 2015, tells me he started Sleepers because he “had information that had never made it to print”. He’s now firmly “in front of the plough” and his relationship with police is rocky.
paras.zh: 之后，我跟随塔西娅和她的家人进入山顶高尔夫俱乐部的一间暗室，参加周末的最后一场比赛。音乐节创始人布莱恩·利特利 (Bryan Littlely) 在他的“沉睡者”播客中展示了他正在调查的一些案件的幻灯片。布莱恩于 2015 年离开了《阿德莱德广告报》，他告诉我，他创办 Sleepers 是因为他“掌握了从未印刷出来的信息”。他现在坚定地“站在犁前”，而且他与警察的关系也不稳定。

paras.en: Earlier this year, Bryan told his followers he was sent a video showing what appeared to be human remains in regional south Australia. “The circumstances of this discovery place it firmly on my list to investigate in the hope of bringing answers to a family missing their loved one,” he wrote online. South Australian Police later told Seven News the skeletal remains were legally purchased medical teaching aids and warned against speculation as it “can unnecessarily distress and re-traumatise victims of crime, their families and loved ones, who may see inaccurate information circulated before the facts are established”.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，布莱恩告诉他的追随者，他收到了一段视频，显示南澳大利亚地区似乎有人类遗骸。他在网上写道：“这一发现的情况将其牢牢列入我的调查清单，希望为失踪亲人的家庭带来答案。”南澳大利亚警方后来告诉第七新闻台，这些骸骨是合法购买的医疗教具，并警告不要进行猜测，因为它“可能会给犯罪受害者、他们的家人和亲人带来不必要的痛苦和再次创伤，他们可能会在事实确定之前看到流传的不准确信息”。

paras.en: Bryan tells me he’s unperturbed: “I'll continue to do the work that I'm doing and unless I'm doing something that's illegal, which I don't do, then I'd expect that [police] let me go about my business.”
paras.zh: 布莱恩告诉我，他很平静：“我会继续做我正在做的工作，除非我做一些非法的事情，而我不做，那么我希望[警察]让我继续我的生意。”

paras.en: It’s not the first warning Bryan has received. In February, police warned against creating “false hope” in missing persons cases after they tested bone fragments found in a search Bryan organised and concluded the bones weren’t human. Bryan was looking for the remains of Joanne Ratcliffe and Kirste Gordon, who were abducted from Adelaide Oval during a football match in 1973.
paras.zh: 这并不是布莱恩第一次收到警告。今年二月，警方警告不要在失踪人员案件中抱有“虚假希望”，此前他们对布莱恩组织的搜索中发现的骨头碎片进行了检测，并得出结论，这些骨头不是人类的。布莱恩正在寻找乔安妮·拉特克利夫 (Joanne Ratcliffe) 和基尔斯特·戈登 (Kirste Gordon) 的遗体，她们于 1973 年在阿德莱德椭圆形体育场的一场足球比赛中被绑架。

paras.en: Bryan, who co-founded missing persons advocacy foundation Leave a Light On with Joanne’s sister Suzie Ratcliffe, talks about the case in his presentation. At one point, he points to a photo of an alleged paedophile he believes was involved. “Who is he?” Bryan asks. People in the audience shout out the man’s name. Then he begins to speak about the barrels that he believes could contain their remains.
paras.zh: 布莱恩与乔安妮的妹妹苏西·拉特克利夫共同创立了失踪人员倡导基金会“Leave a Light On”，他在演讲中谈到了此案。有一次，他指着一张他认为涉嫌恋童癖的照片。 “他是谁？”布莱恩问道。观众席上的人们大声喊出这个人的名字。然后他开始谈论他认为可以存放他们遗骸的桶。

paras.en: Sharing the weight of a case with a victim's family is a heavy responsibility. Sometimes Bryan becomes emotional when he talks about cold cases. But today he’s clear-headed as he explains how he’s had the barrels independently analysed, after police discounted them more than a decade ago. He tells the crowd they’ve found blood in the barrels. Suzie Ratcliffe is watching from the back of the room, expressionless.
paras.zh: 与受害者家属分担案件的重担是一项重大责任。有时布莱恩在谈论悬案时会变得情绪化。但今天，他头脑清醒，解释了在十多年前警方对这些木桶打折扣之后，他如何对这些木桶进行独立分析。他告诉人群他们在桶里发现了血迹。苏西·拉特克利夫面无表情地在房间后面看着。

paras.en: It’s the end of a long weekend and the details of cold cases are blurring into each other. I wonder how much longer we can collectively stare into the abyss. But this doesn’t feel like everything critics mount at true crime. Maybe that’s because it’s not occurring online. It feels like community coming together to help victims and their families.
paras.zh: 一个长周末结束了，悬案的细节彼此模糊。我想知道我们还能一起凝视深渊多久。但这并不像批评者对真正犯罪的批评。也许那是因为它不是在线发生的。感觉就像社区聚集在一起帮助受害者及其家人。

paras.en: A few weeks after the true crime festival, South Australian police will accept Bryan’s offer to take possession of the barrels for analysis. Police are yet to provide an update.
paras.zh: 真正的犯罪节结束几周后，南澳大利亚警方将接受布莱恩的提议，接管这些木桶进行分析。警方尚未提供最新消息。

articles.title: Cargo ships are being sunk here and some say it's all part of Russia's plan
articles.author: Kathryn Diss and Alex Parsons

paras.en: Just after 1am on October 13, Commander Ivan Ivanov and his crew received a mayday call.
paras.zh: 10 月 13 日凌晨 1 点刚过，指挥官伊万·伊万诺夫 (Ivan Ivanov) 和他的船员接到求救信号。

paras.en: A Malta-flagged ship, the Chelsea 3, was in distress and sinking in the Black Sea, 40 kilometres from the Bulgarian port of Varna.
paras.zh: 一艘悬挂马耳他国旗的船只“Chelsea 3”在距保加利亚瓦尔纳港 40 公里的黑海遇险并沉没。

paras.en: The vessel had been hit by a drone that had blown an enormous hole in its side, and it was taking on water.
paras.zh: 这艘船被一架无人机击中，在其侧面炸出了一个大洞，并且正在进水。

paras.en: Within minutes, Commander Ivanov's crew were heading out to sea to try and reach it.
paras.zh: 几分钟之内，伊万诺夫指挥官的船员们就出海试图到达那里。

paras.en: "The weather was extremely bad. The sea was stormy, with a very strong wind, and the visibility was very low," Commander Ivanov told the ABC.
paras.zh: 伊万诺夫指挥官告诉美国广播公司：“天气极其恶劣。海上风大浪急，风很大，能见度很低。”

paras.en: The Black Sea has become a deadly theatre of battle as merchant ships carrying things like grain, chemicals and oil are increasingly caught in the crossfire of Russia's war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 黑海已成为一个致命的战场，运载谷物、化学品和石油等物品的商船越来越多地陷入俄罗斯乌克兰战争的交火中。

paras.en: Both countries have ports on the Black Sea and have been hitting ships going to and from each other's docks since Moscow's full-scale invasion began.
paras.zh: 两国在黑海都有港口，自莫斯科全面入侵以来，两国一直在袭击往返对方码头的船只。

paras.en: But in the last few months, the attacks have taken on a whole new dimension, and sailors have become collateral damage.
paras.zh: 但在过去的几个月里，袭击已经达到了一个全新的程度，水手也受到了附带伤害。

paras.en: At least 38 have been killed since June, making the Black Sea the deadliest waterway in the world, even surpassing the Strait of Hormuz.
paras.zh: 自6月以来，已有至少38人死亡，使黑海成为世界上最致命的水道，甚至超过了霍尔木兹海峡。

paras.en: When the crew arrived, the Chelsea 3 was already listing to the left hard and the choppy seas made it too dangerous to deploy a lifeboat.
paras.zh: 当船员到达时，Chelsea 3 已经严重向左倾斜，波涛汹涌的海面使得部署救生艇非常危险。

paras.en: The sailors had to jump from their sinking ship to the border patrol vessel to save themselves.
paras.zh: 水手们不得不从正在下沉的船上跳到边境巡逻艇上以求自救。

paras.en: The ABC has gained rare access to embed with Bulgaria's border police, which act as the country's coast guard, undertaking search and rescue missions at sea.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚广播公司获得了难得的机会与保加利亚边防警察合作，后者充当该国的海岸警卫队，执行海上搜救任务。

paras.en: Commander Ivanov has worked on the sea for 20 years, but the Chelsea 3 was the first sinking cargo ship in distress he had dealt with.
paras.zh: 伊万诺夫指挥官在海上工作了 20 年，但“切尔西 3 号”是他处理过的第一艘沉没的遇险货船。

paras.en: Just as his crew returned to port having saved all on board, he received a second mayday call. Another cargo ship, the HS Dignity, was sinking after also being hit by multiple drones.
paras.zh: 就在他的船员救出船上所有人返回港口时，他接到了第二次求救信号。另一艘货船“HS Dignity”号也被多架无人机击中后正在沉没。

paras.en: But the worsening weather conditions would prove too dangerous. While five of the HS Dignity's crew were rescued after abandoning ship in a life boat, 11 remain missing.
paras.zh: 但事实证明，日益恶化的天气条件太危险了。虽然 HS Dignity 号的 5 名船员在弃船后乘坐救生艇获救，但仍有 11 人失踪。

paras.en: Commander Bozhidar Penev, who has spent more than a decade on the water with Bulgaria's border police, was also on call that night.
paras.zh: 指挥官博日达尔·佩内夫（Bozhidar Penev）在保加利亚边防警察的水上工作了十多年，当晚也值班。

paras.en: "Definitely, the last few weeks have been tough for us," he told the ABC.
paras.zh: “毫无疑问，过去几周对我们来说很艰难，”他告诉美国广播公司。

paras.en: "We have increased surveillance even further. We are always on high alert; we have multiple systems on board our ships to aid us in both daytime and night."
paras.zh: “我们进一步加强了监视。我们始终保持高度戒备；我们船上有多个系统，可以在白天和晚上为我们提供帮助。”

paras.en: He said drones had made his job more dangerous.
paras.zh: 他说无人机让他的工作变得更加危险。

paras.en: "I am afraid of this [drones]; the possibility is always there. But if I am afraid or not, this is my job and when there is a task, I have to do it," he said.
paras.zh: “我害怕这个[无人机]；这种可能性总是存在的。但无论我是否害怕，这都是我的工作，当有任务时，我就必须这样做，”他说。

paras.en: The HS Dignity, flagged Guinea-Bissau, had been travelling from Algeria to Romania. Among those missing is Mohammed Mreish's 20-year-old cousin, Amjad.
paras.zh: 悬挂几内亚比绍国旗的 HS Dignity 号原本从阿尔及利亚飞往罗马尼亚。失踪者中包括穆罕默德·姆雷什 (Mohammed Mreish) 20 岁的表弟阿姆贾德 (Amjad)。

paras.en: "I feel they are alive, that's my real feeling. I have a big hope," he told the ABC last month.
paras.zh: “我觉得他们还活着，这是我的真实感受。我有很大的希望，”他上个月告诉美国广播公司。

paras.en: He said Amjad's mother was distressed and would not have closure until her son was found.
paras.zh: 他说阿姆贾德的母亲很痛苦，在找到儿子之前不会关闭此事。

paras.en: Mohammed travelled from his home in Germany to Varna and spoke to some of the rescued sailors to find out more information about what happened.
paras.zh: 穆罕默德从德国的家前往瓦尔纳，与一些获救的水手进行了交谈，以了解有关所发生事件的更多信息。

paras.en: "They woke up at the middle of the night ... and found the ship full of water, so they decided to run to the deck again to launch the lifeboat," he told the ABC.
paras.zh: 他告诉澳大利亚广播公司：“他们在半夜醒来……发现船上充满了水，所以他们决定再次跑到甲板上释放救生艇。”

paras.en: He said they saw what they thought were two vessels coming towards them at speed and believed it was a rescue mission. They were actually sea drones.
paras.zh: 他说，他们看到两艘船只高速向他们驶来，并相信这是一次救援任务。它们实际上是海上无人机。

paras.en: Amjad was one of 14 Syrians among the crew. The country has been in turmoil and economically unstable as it rebuilds itself after former long-time dictator Bashar al-Assad was removed in 2024.
paras.zh: 阿姆贾德是船员中的 14 名叙利亚人之一。 2024 年前长期独裁者巴沙尔·阿萨德 (Bashar al-Assad) 下台后，该国在重建过程中一直处于动荡之中，经济不稳定。

paras.en: "They need money to live. They need money to survive. The situation in Syria is really not that good," Mohammed said.
paras.zh: “他们需要钱来生活。他们需要钱来生存。叙利亚的情况确实不太好，”穆罕默德说。

paras.en: "There's no work, no jobs, no money ... and the young people, they need to start their life. They need to work somewhere. And the only way is the sea."
paras.zh: “没有工作，没有工作，没有钱……而年轻人，他们需要开始自己的生活。他们需要在某个地方工作。唯一的出路就是大海。”

paras.en: Cargo ships traversing the Black Sea are forced to run the gauntlet of attacks by drones and missiles as Russia and Ukraine battle for control over the vital shipping corridor.
paras.zh: 随着俄罗斯和乌克兰争夺重要航运走廊的控制权，穿越黑海的货船被迫面临无人机和导弹的袭击。

paras.en: More than 500 ships have been hit within the waterway during the past year.
paras.zh: 去年，超过 500 艘船只在该航道内被击中。

paras.en: The number of sailors killed has risen fast because the nature of the strikes has changed from simply trying to disable ships to targeting their hulls and bridges in an attempt to sink them, a tactic known as "double tap".
paras.zh: 被杀的水手人数迅速增加，因为袭击的性质已经从简单地试图使船只瘫痪，转变为瞄准船只的船体和桥梁，试图击沉船只，这种战术被称为“双击”。

paras.en: The attacks are also now edging closer to Ukraine's neighbours and that means closer to territory falling under the North Atlantic Treaty Organisation (NATO).
paras.zh: 袭击现在也越来越接近乌克兰的邻国，这意味着更接近北大西洋公约组织（北约）管辖的领土。

paras.en: Tomas Alexa from global maritime security agency Ambrey said he expected the attacks to continue.
paras.zh: 全球海事安全机构安布雷的托马斯·亚历克萨（Tomas Alexa）表示，他预计袭击还会继续。

paras.en: "The Russians are testing the response, the unity of the Eastern flank," he said.
paras.zh: “俄罗斯人正在测试东部侧翼的反应和团结，”他说。

paras.en: "They are monitoring and looking very closely what is the reaction of NATO, but also of the European Union to these attacks.
paras.zh: “他们正在密切关注和密切关注北约以及欧盟对这些袭击的反应。

paras.en: "In a way, we assess that it is likely that third attacks will take place in Romanian-Bulgarian waters simply because the glass was broken."
paras.zh: “在某种程度上，我们评估认为，仅仅因为玻璃破碎，第三次袭击很可能会在罗马尼亚-保加利亚水域发生。”

paras.en: Romania and Bulgaria, which hug the western border of the Black Sea, are members of NATO alongside Turkey, which controls the access of ships through the Bosphorus Strait to the rest of the world.
paras.zh: 罗马尼亚和保加利亚紧邻黑海西部边界，与土耳其一样都是北约成员国，土耳其控制着船只通过博斯普鲁斯海峡通往世界其他地区的通道。

paras.en: During October, nine cargo ships were hit with drones within the exclusive economic zones of Bulgaria and Romania.
paras.zh: 十月份，有九艘货船在保加利亚和罗马尼亚的专属经济区内遭到无人机袭击。

paras.en: One was even inside the territorial waters of Romania.
paras.zh: 其中一艘甚至在罗马尼亚领海内。

paras.en: The reason ships are travelling closer to shore now is the simple fact that wartime insurance premiums have skyrocketed. Sailing close to the shore comes with fewer risks.
paras.zh: 现在船只靠近海岸的原因很简单，就是战时保险费飙升。靠近海岸航行的风险较小。

paras.en: The attacks are being seen as a major escalation and a test of NATO's collective security agreement, in which an attack on one member state is considered an attack on all.
paras.zh: 这些袭击被视为一次重大升级，也是对北约集体安全协议的一次考验，根据该协议，对一个成员国的攻击被视为对所有成员国的攻击。

paras.en: The alliance, which aims to deter conflict, was formed after World War II between the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and many European nations.
paras.zh: 该联盟旨在阻止冲突，由美国、加拿大、英国和许多欧洲国家在二战后组成。

paras.en: Bulgaria's former defence minister Todor Tagarev, who was in office when Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, said the Kremlin's primary goal is to crush Kyiv's economy by cutting off sea trade.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰时任职的保加利亚前国防部长托多尔·塔加列夫表示，克里姆林宫的主要目标是通过切断海上贸易来摧毁基辅的经济。

paras.en: However, it was also trying to test NATO's resolve, to see how far countries in the bloc will go to protect each other.
paras.zh: 然而，它也试图考验北约的决心，看看北约国家会在多大程度上相互保护。

paras.en: "One of the centres of gravity for Ukraine in this war is the European support to Ukraine," Mr Togarev said.
paras.zh: 托加列夫表示：“乌克兰在这场战争中的重心之一是欧洲对乌克兰的支持。”

paras.en: "When the Russians demonstrate how dangerous this is becoming for European countries, for European societies, then they hope that the support to the Ukrainian war effort will be diminished."
paras.zh: “当俄罗斯人证明这对欧洲国家、欧洲社会来说是多么危险时，他们希望减少对乌克兰战争努力的支持。”

paras.en: Despite being a member of NATO and the European Union, Bulgaria has historical ties with Russia that Mr Tagarev said was holding back a stronger response.
paras.zh: 尽管保加利亚是北约和欧盟的成员，但保加利亚与俄罗斯有着历史渊源，塔加列夫表示，这阻碍了保加利亚做出更强有力的反应。

paras.en: "They are really afraid to refer to Russia as an aggressor. And they do not want to have this as the basis for planning a response," Mr Tagarev said.
paras.zh: “他们真的害怕将俄罗斯称为侵略者。他们不想以此作为计划应对措施的基础，”塔加列夫表示。

paras.en: NATO's Article 5 (in which member states are obliged to come to each other's aid) has only been triggered once previously, after the September 11 attacks in New York.
paras.zh: 北约第 5 条（成员国有义务互相援助）此前仅在 9 月 11 日纽约袭击事件后触发过一次。

paras.en: Professor Kevin Rowlands from the Royal United Services Institute (RUSI) spent three decades in the British Navy and retired as a captain.
paras.zh: 英国皇家联合军种研究所 (RUSI) 的凯文·罗兰兹 (Kevin Rowlands) 教授在英国海军服役了三十年，并以上尉身份退休。

paras.en: He said it was easier from a political standpoint to go to war for America in 2001 than what it would be against Russia.
paras.zh: 他说，从政治角度来看，2001年为美国发动战争比对俄发动战争要容易得多。

paras.en: "Some of the NATO allies are more closely aligned to Russia than others. Some would be pushing for this kind of declaration, others would be holding back, so it becomes very political," he said.
paras.zh: “一些北约盟国比其他盟国与俄罗斯的关系更为密切。一些国家会推动这种声明，另一些国家则会犹豫不决，因此这变得非常政治化，”他说。

paras.en: Beyond calling out Russia's actions, Europe is grappling with how to deter the attacks and often resorts to labelling it "hybrid" or "shadow" warfare.
paras.zh: 除了谴责俄罗斯的行动外，欧洲还在努力解决如何阻止袭击的问题，并经常将其称为“混合”或“影子”战争。

paras.en: "An attack is an attack. If two countries are at war, let's call it for what it is, it's a war," Professor Rowlands said.
paras.zh: “攻击就是攻击。如果两个国家处于战争状态，我们就这么称呼它吧，这就是一场战争，”罗兰兹教授说。

paras.en: NATO has sent reinforcements to the Black Sea including more patrol planes, radar systems and intelligence officers.
paras.zh: 北约已向黑海派遣了增援部队，包括更多巡逻机、雷达系统和情报人员。

paras.en: But with the frontline in Ukraine practically at a standstill, analysts believe Moscow is likely to continue hitting ships that fuel Kyiv's economy.
paras.zh: 但由于乌克兰前线几乎处于停滞状态，分析人士认为，莫斯科可能会继续袭击为基辅经济提供动力的船只。

articles.title: Copper wire replacement caused air traffic control issue that grounded flights across U.S.: White House

paras.en: Copper wire replacement caused air traffic control issue that grounded flights across U.S.: White House
paras.zh: 白宫：更换铜线导致空中交通管制问题导致美国各地航班停飞

paras.en: - The White House on Saturday shared more detail on the issue that took down air traffic control equipment on Friday, grounding flights nationwide for hours.
paras.zh: - 周六，白宫分享了有关周五空中交通管制设备被毁、导致全国航班停飞数小时的问题的更多细节。

paras.en: - Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said a contractor was doing routine maintenance to upgrade copper wire to fibre optic cable when something went wrong, causing an air traffic control communications outage.
paras.zh: - 交通部长肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 表示，一名承包商正在进行例行维护，将铜线升级为光缆，但出现问题，导致空中交通管制通信中断。

paras.en: - He said the investigation will determine whether the fault was due to "incompetence" or "a faulty router."
paras.zh: - 他表示调查将确定故障是由于“无能”还是“路由器故障”造成的。

paras.en: - Countless passengers in the United States and beyond are facing travel delays on Saturday, and airlines are working to catch up on thousands of disrupted flights.
paras.zh: - 周六，美国及其他地区的无数乘客面临旅行延误，航空公司正在努力弥补数千个中断的航班。

paras.en: - November 14 No data on passenger medical issues during ground stop Sarah Petz Responding to one of the last questions of the news conference, Duffy said he didn't have any data or reports of passengers who had medical issues as a result of the ground stop. But he added that airport staff "rallied in those moments yesterday to accommodate passengers." "We don't want to leave passengers on airplanes," he said. Duffy ended his remarks with a final appeal for more money from Congress, referring to funding as a "great end-of-the-year Christmas present for the American people." He also said his team will continue to provide updates.
paras.zh: - 11 月 14 日 没有关于地面停留期间乘客医疗问题的数据 莎拉·佩茨 (Sarah Petz) 在回答新闻发布会的最后一个问题时，达菲表示，他没有任何关于因地面停留而出现医疗问题的乘客的数据或报告。但他补充说，机场工作人员“昨天在那些时刻集合起来为乘客提供服务”。 “我们不想让乘客留在飞机上，”他说。达菲最后呼吁国会提供更多资金，并称资金是“给美国人民的一份伟大的年终圣诞礼物”。他还表示，他的团队将继续提供最新消息。

paras.en: - There is more copper wire to swap out, secretary says Anya Zoledziowski When asked whether the FAA has to swap out copper wire elsewhere, Duffy said yes. About 75 per cent of the system has been transitioned to fibre so far, he said. "Is it disruptive? Yes," Duffy said. "People may not get to a wedding. They might not get to a birthday … [but] I want them to get home safely."
paras.zh: - 秘书表示，还有更多铜线可供更换 安雅·佐莱齐斯基 (Anya Zoledziowski) 当被问及 FAA 是否必须在其他地方更换铜线时，达菲说是的。他说，到目前为止，大约 75% 的系统已经过渡到光纤。 “这会造成破坏吗？是的，”达菲说。 “人们可能无法参加婚礼。他们可能无法参加生日......[但]我希望他们安全回家。”

paras.en: - Updating America's aerospace infrastructure will cost billions, Duffy says Sarah Petz Duffy says he's asked for $30 billion US ($42 billion Cdn) to make the upgrades necessary to modernize FAA infrastructure. But he added that the issue goes beyond telecommunications infrastructure, saying that he wants to look at upgrades to airport infrastructure like runways and air traffic control towers as well. "We have aging infrastructure throughout the airspace," he said. "It's not a cheap proposition." As mentioned earlier, Congress has been controlled by Republicans — Duffy's party — for the past two years.
paras.zh: - 达菲说，更新美国的航空航天基础设施将耗资数十亿美元 莎拉·佩茨 达菲说，他要求拨款 300 亿美元（420 亿加元）来进行必要的升级，以实现 FAA 基础设施的现代化。但他补充说，这个问题超出了电信基础设施的范围，他还想考虑升级机场基础设施，如跑道和空中交通管制塔。 “我们整个空域的基础设施都在老化，”他说。 “这不是一个便宜的提议。”如前所述，过去两年国会一直由共和党（达菲所在的政党）控制。

paras.en: - Stranded passengers will get support: FAA Anya Zoledziowski Bedford told reporters that all affected passengers in the U.S. will be supported — either by getting onto a new flight or by getting a full refund. He also said passengers should reach out to their air carriers directly. Canadian travellers are also urged to track their flight status, and airlines in Canada have rebooked flights and even offered a one-time option to change or cancel some flights without penalty. Looking ahead, though, Bedford essentially said it's too soon to tell what the FAA can do differently next time. For now, the agency needs to figure out the "root cause" of the glitch, he said, and then they can establish what needs to happen differently.
paras.zh: - 滞留乘客将获得支持：美国联邦航空管理局安雅·佐莱吉奥斯基·贝德福德 (Anya Zoledziowski Bedford) 告诉记者，美国所有受影响的乘客都将得到支持——要么乘坐新航班，要么获得全额退款。他还表示，乘客应该直接联系航空公司。还敦促加拿大旅客跟踪他们的航班状态，加拿大的航空公司已经重新预订了航班，甚至提供了一次性更改或取消某些航班的选项，而无需支付罚款。不过，展望未来，贝德福德本质上表示，现在判断美国联邦航空管理局下次可以采取哪些不同的做法还为时过早。他说，目前，该机构需要找出故障的“根本原因”，然后他们才能确定需要采取哪些不同的措施。

paras.en: - Passengers should feel safe to fly in the U.S., Bedford says Sarah Petz Officials were asked if they had any message for passengers who were nervous after yesterday's full ground stop, especially since it coincided with the Microsoft outage. "Bedford said passengers can rest assured that "we will keep planes on the ground unless we are 100 per cent confident that we've got the stability and resilience to operate safely." He also again stressed that officials are confident that this was not a cyber issue or cyberattack. But he also added that this incident highlights the need to upgrade their telecommunication infrastructure as soon as possible. "This is probably the worst kept secret in government, that this FTI system needs to be replaced," he said, referring to the FAA's telecommunications infrastructure. Duffy said several teams and departments, including Kash Patel with the FBI as well as the Department of War, were involved in yesterday's investigation.
paras.zh: - 贝德福德表示，乘客在美国飞行应该感到安全。莎拉·佩茨 (Sarah Petz) 被问及官员是否有任何信息要传达给那些在昨天完全地面停止后感到紧张的乘客，特别是因为这与微软停电同时发生。 “贝德福德表示，乘客们可以放心，“我们会让飞机留在地面上，除非我们百分百确信我们拥有安全运行的稳定性和弹性。”他还再次强调，官员们有信心这不是网络问题或网络攻击。但他还补充说，这一事件凸显了尽快升级其电信基础设施的必要性。“这可能是政府保守的最糟糕的秘密，这个 FTI 系统需要更换，”他说，指的是美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 的 FTI 系统。达菲表示，包括联邦调查局和战争部的卡什·帕特尔在内的多个团队和部门参与了昨天的调查。

paras.en: - 'Instability' on telecommunications routers was 1st sign something was wrong Sarah Petz Asked what gave the indication that something was going wrong, Bedford said they started to experience "instability" on their communication lines "that we couldn't explain." Because they couldn't identify a root cause for this, "we were unwilling to take any risk," he said. On Friday, Duffy said the FAA experienced telecommunications issues at 3:36 p.m. ET. The ground stop order was issued 17 minutes later, at 3:53 p.m. ET.
paras.zh: - 电信路由器“不稳定”是出现问题的第一个迹象 莎拉·佩茨 (Sarah Petz) 当被问及是什么表明出现问题时，贝德福德表示，他们的通信线路开始出现“不稳定”，“我们无法解释”。因为他们无法确定造成这种情况的根本原因，“我们不愿意冒任何风险，”他说。周五，达菲表示，美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 在下午 3:36 遇到了电信问题。等。 17 分钟后，下午 3 点 53 分，发布了地面停止命令。等。

paras.en: - Reporters question why maintenance behind glitch was scheduled Friday afternoon Anya Zoledziowski Duffy said that had the maintenance taken place at a big facility — like, say, Newark — it would have taken place at night. But the upgrade in question that led to the ground stop was in a remote location. "Safety is paramount. If we don't make these upgrades we can't have a safe system," Duffy said, noting that the FAA has to replace copper wire. "We're making transition not because we want to spend money, but because it is safer and it is more resilient." Fridays are typically one of the busiest days of the week for airports, according to CLEAR.
paras.zh: - 记者质疑为何故障维修安排在周五下午 安雅·佐莱吉奥斯基·达菲 (Anya Zoledziowski Duffy) 表示，如果维修是在大型设施（例如纽瓦克）进行，那么就会在晚上进行。但导致地面停止的相关升级位于偏远地区。 “安全至关重要。如果我们不进行这些升级，我们就无法拥有安全的系统，”达菲说，并指出美国联邦航空局必须更换铜线。 “我们进行转型不是因为我们想花钱，而是因为这样更安全、更有弹性。”据 CLEAR 称，周五通常是机场一周中最繁忙的日子之一。

paras.en: - FAA says more work to do, but 'worst is behind us' Anya Zoledziowski Bedford estimates that some 4,000 or 5,000 flights of 41,000 scheduled for today will be cancelled in the U.S. as airlines and airports continue to recover. Still, he struck an optimistic chord. "I do think the worst is behind us," he said.
paras.zh: - FAA 表示还有更多工作要做，但“最糟糕的情况已经过去了” Anya Zoledziowski Bedford 估计，随着航空公司和机场继续恢复，今天预定的 41,000 架航班中约有 4,000 或 5,000 架航班将在美国取消。尽管如此，他仍保持着乐观的态度。 “我确实认为最糟糕的时期已经过去了，”他说。

paras.en: - Full ground stop done 'for the right reasons,' FAA says Sarah Petz FAA administrator Bryan Bedford is up next. Bedford stressed that the mass grounding of flights was done out of an abundance of caution. "I'm sorry we put you through this, but we did it for the right reasons," he said, addressing passengers whose flights were disrupted yesterday. He added that the ground stop was necessary because they couldn't determine the root cause of the technical problems and needed to take pressure off their system. "I think that was the right call. We stand behind that." He also added that this was due to an equipment issue, and they don't believe it had anything to do with AI.
paras.zh: - 美国联邦航空局表示，莎拉·佩茨（Sarah Petz）“出于正确的原因”进行了全面地面停车，接下来是联邦航空局局长布莱恩·贝德福德（Bryan Bedford）。贝德福德强调，大规模停飞航班是出于高度谨慎的考虑。他对昨天航班受到干扰的乘客说：“我很抱歉让你们经历了这一切，但我们这样做是有正当理由的。”他补充说，地面停止是必要的，因为他们无法确定技术问题的根本原因，需要减轻系统的压力。 “我认为这是正确的决定。我们支持这一点。”他还补充说，这是由于设备问题造成的，他们不认为这与人工智能有任何关系。

paras.en: - Duffy again appealing for more funding Anya Zoledziowski Duffy is again making appeals for more funding, calling it a bipartisan issue — all while claiming that the U.S. has the safest airspace in the world. (Earlier, a Canadian aviation expert told CBC News that U.S. telecommunications and air traffic control systems could indeed use updates.) The transportation secretary is pushing Democrats and Republicans to work together to approve funding. Congress has been controlled by the Republican Party — Duffy's party — for the past two years. "This is a time when I think Congress can signal … we're willing to work together," Duffy said. "We can fight on a lot of things, but we're not gonna fight on this."
paras.zh: - 达菲再次呼吁更多资金 安雅·佐莱吉奥斯基·达菲（Anya Zoledziowski Duffy）再次呼吁更多资金，称这是两党问题，同时声称美国拥有世界上最安全的空域。 （早些时候，一位加拿大航空专家告诉 CBC 新闻，美国电信和空中交通管制系统确实可以使用更新。）交通部长正在推动民主党和共和党共同努力批准资金。过去两年来，国会一直由共和党（达菲所在的政党）控制。达菲说：“我认为国会可以在这个时候发出信号……我们愿意共同努力。” “我们可以在很多事情上争论，但我们不会在这个问题上争论。”

articles.title: Canadian judge decries U.S. sanctions of International Criminal Court as 'attack in favour of impunity'
articles.author: Aloysius Wong, Terence McKenna, Alex Shprintsen

paras.en: Canadian judge decries U.S. sanctions of International Criminal Court as 'attack in favour of impunity'
paras.zh: 加拿大法官谴责美国对国际刑事法院的制裁是“有罪不罚的攻击”

paras.en: Winnipeg-born Kimberly Prost and other ICC officials sanctioned last August
paras.zh: 温尼伯出生的金伯利·普罗斯特和其他国际刑事法院官员去年八月受到制裁

paras.en: Kimberly Prost began to feel the effects of the U.S. sanctions immediately.
paras.zh: 金伯利·普罗斯特立即开始感受到美国制裁的影响。

paras.en: "These economic sanctions are not symbolic in any way," said Prost, a Canadian judge at the International Criminal Court (ICC), who was sanctioned by the Trump administration last year.
paras.zh: 去年受到特朗普政府制裁的国际刑事法院（ICC）加拿大法官普罗斯特表示，“这些经济制裁无论如何都不具有象征意义。”

paras.en: Prost's credit cards were cancelled and her access to banking services hindered, she said, because of the U.S.'s wide-reaching impact on the global banking system.
paras.zh: 她说，由于美国对全球银行体系的广泛影响，普罗斯特的信用卡被取消，她获得银行服务的机会也受到阻碍。

paras.en: "Every time literally I go to make a bank transfer, I hold my breath because I don't know if it's going to work," Prost said in an interview with CBC News.
paras.zh: “每次我去银行转账时，我都会屏住呼吸，因为我不知道这是否有效，”普罗斯特在接受 CBC 新闻采访时说道。

paras.en: "To order an Uber, book a hotel, buy a theatre ticket — everything requires some form of credit card, and so you're sort of struggling to adjust."
paras.zh: “要叫 Uber、订酒店、买剧院门票——一切都需要某种形式的信用卡，所以你有点难以适应。”

paras.en: Based in The Hague, Netherlands, the ICC investigates and tries individuals charged with genocide, war crimes and crimes against humanity when courts in its 125 member states, including Canada, are unwilling or unable to do so.
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院总部位于荷兰海牙，负责调查和审判被控犯有种族灭绝罪、战争罪和反人类罪的个人，而包括加拿大在内的 125 个成员国的法院却不愿意或无法这样做。

paras.en: The sanctions on Prost are part of a larger U.S. campaign to discredit and dismantle the ICC, which began in earnest after a February 2025 executive order imposed sanctions for investigating American personnel and issuing arrest warrants against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his former defence minister Yoav Gallant.
paras.zh: 对普罗斯特的制裁是美国抹黑和解散国际刑事法院的更大规模行动的一部分，该行动是在 2025 年 2 月发布的一项行政命令对调查美国人员并对以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡及其前国防部长约夫·加兰特发出逮捕令实施制裁后正式开始的。

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump has since sustained his attack on the international court, calling on member states to immediately "resign from this rogue institution" in a September UN General Assembly speech. Just last month, Secretary of State Marco Rubio threatened to dismantle the ICC "brick by brick" if allies do not "rein in" the court.
paras.zh: 此后，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普继续对国际法院进行攻击，在9月份的联合国大会演讲中呼吁成员国立即“退出这个流氓机构”。就在上个月，国务卿马可·鲁比奥威胁称，如果盟友不“控制”国际刑事法院，他将“一砖一瓦”解散该法院。

paras.en: In a Sept. 22, 2026, speech at the United Nations General Assembly, U.S. President Donald Trump urged member nations of the International Criminal Court to 'officially resign from this rogue institution immediately.' (Yuki Iwamura/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 2026 年 9 月 22 日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在联合国大会上发表讲话，敦促国际刑事法院成员国“立即正式退出这个流氓机构”。 （岩村由纪/美联社）

paras.en: Prost says these actions are an attack against the international system of criminal justice and rule of law that has been built since the Second World War.
paras.zh: 普罗斯特表示，这些行为是对二战以来建立的国际刑事司法和法治体系的攻击。

paras.en: "It is an attack that foresees a world where victims of atrocity crimes are forgotten. And it is an attack in favour of impunity and ending accountability for these crimes. That's the only way it can be framed."
paras.zh: “这是一次攻击，预见到一个残暴罪行的受害者将被遗忘的世界。这是一次有利于有罪不罚和结束对这些罪行的责任的攻击。这是唯一可以陷害它的方式。”

paras.en: Prost was singled out for her role in judicially authorizing a March 2020 preliminary investigation into alleged war crimes in Afghanistan since 2003, including by U.S. service members.
paras.zh: 普罗斯特因其在司法授权于 2020 年 3 月对 2003 年以来阿富汗涉嫌战争罪（包括美国军人所犯的战争罪）进行初步调查中所发挥的作用而受到特别关注。

paras.en: Since 2021, however, the investigation has deprioritized the role of the U.S., focusing instead on the Afghan government and Taliban forces.
paras.zh: 然而，自 2021 年以来，调查不再优先考虑美国的作用，而是将重点放在阿富汗政府和塔利班部队上。

paras.en: "To my knowledge, there's no active investigation of the Americans in that case, but I'm sanctioned."
paras.zh: “据我所知，目前还没有针对这起案件对美国人进行积极调查，但我受到了制裁。”

paras.en: The United States has never been a member of the ICC, and has long expressed concerns that its citizens could be prosecuted.
paras.zh: 美国从未成为国际刑事法院成员，长期以来一直担心其公民可能受到起诉。

paras.en: "As the United States works to bring peace around the world, our diplomats or our soldiers could be drawn into this court," President George W. Bush said the day after the court was inaugurated in 2002. "It's very troubling to me."
paras.zh: “当美国致力于在世界各地实现和平时，我们的外交官或我们的士兵可能会被吸引到这个法庭，”2002 年该法庭落成后的第二天，乔治·W·布什总统说道。“这让我感到非常不安。”

paras.en: Twenty-four years later, Rubio echoed the same rhetoric about the "dangers" of the global court, warning that American border patrol agents, marines and prosecutors would "be at the mercy of foreign judges," risking imprisonment for defending their own country.
paras.zh: 二十四年后，卢比奥对全球法庭的“危险”做出了同样的言论，警告美国边境巡逻人员、海军陆战队员和检察官将“受到外国法官的摆布”，冒着因保卫自己的国家而被监禁的风险。

paras.en: However, Prost says Rubio's arguments are misleading, as the ICC would have "no jurisdiction" if the U.S. asserted its sovereignty and conducted its own genuine investigations or prosecutions when allegations arise.
paras.zh: 然而，普罗斯特表示，卢比奥的论点具有误导性，因为如果美国在指控出现时主张其主权并进行真正的调查或起诉，那么国际刑事法院将“没有管辖权”。

paras.en: Prost and two other ICC judges sued the Trump administration in June, opposing the sanctions that they say are "designed to exert extra-judicial pressure" and coerce them into "prioritizing their private interests over deciding cases on the basis of the law and facts."
paras.zh: 普罗斯特和另外两名国际刑事法院法官于六月起诉特朗普政府，反对制裁，他们称这些制裁“旨在施加法外压力”，并迫使他们“优先考虑私人利益，而不是根据法律和事实裁决案件”。

paras.en: "We decided that it was so significant and such an impediment to our work — and to the work of the court — to challenge it before the courts of the United States," said Prost.
paras.zh: 普罗斯特说：“我们认为，在美国法院提出质疑对我们的工作以及法院的工作来说是非常重要和巨大的障碍。”

paras.en: In July, four former U.S. ambassadors and prosecutors of international criminal tribunals submitted a brief in support of the ICC judges, arguing that the sanctions "penalize independent judicial decision-making."
paras.zh: 7月，四名前美国大使和国际刑事法庭检察官提交了一份支持国际刑事法庭法官的简报，认为制裁“惩罚了独立的司法决策”。

paras.en: Canadian officials have not intervened in Prost's lawsuit. But in a September interview with CBC News, Foreign Minister Anita Anand said Canada "remains committed to the ICC process."
paras.zh: 加拿大官员没有介入普罗斯特的诉讼。但在 9 月份接受 CBC 新闻采访时，外交部长安妮塔·阿南德表示，加拿大“仍然致力于国际刑事法院的程序”。

paras.en: "As a sovereign country, we determine our foreign policy, and that includes the principles on which our foreign policy is based," Anand said. "One of those fundamental principles is respect for international law."
paras.zh: 阿南德说：“作为一个主权国家，我们决定我们的外交政策，这包括我们外交政策所依据的原则。” “这些基本原则之一是尊重国际法。”

paras.en: Prost said the efforts to intimidate her and other judges are ultimately "futile."
paras.zh: 普罗斯特表示，恐吓她和其他法官的努力最终是“徒劳的”。

paras.en: "We continue to judge our cases on the facts and the law and the evidence before us objectively and independently, and that will never change," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“我们将继续客观、独立地根据事实、法律和证据来审理案件，这一点永远不会改变。”

paras.en: In October, the U.S. allowed the ICC to access certain information technology and banking services for six months. The State Department said that time would allow member states to demonstrate "meaningful progress" on U.S. concerns.
paras.zh: 十月份，美国允许国际刑事法院在六个月内使用某些信息技术和银行服务。美国国务院表示，成员国将有时间在美国的关切上展示“有意义的进展”。

paras.en: - EU awards human rights prize to International Criminal Court amid Trump attacks
paras.zh: - 在特朗普的攻击中，欧盟向国际刑事法院颁发人权奖

paras.en: - Trump administration hits International Criminal Court with sweeping sanctions
paras.zh: - 特朗普政府对国际刑事法院实施全面制裁

paras.en: Prost says losing access to those systems could have a "very crippling effect" on the court's operations.
paras.zh: 普罗斯特表示，失去对这些系统的访问可能会对法院的运作产生“非常严重的影响”。

paras.en: Though some member states have signaled support, she says the moment remains "critically important" to safeguard the ICC, which has taken steps to prepare in case sanctions come into full force.
paras.zh: 尽管一些成员国已表示支持，但她表示，现在对于保护国际刑事法院仍然“至关重要”，国际刑事法院已采取措施，为制裁全面生效做好准备。

paras.en: "It's their court. It's not the prosecutors' court, not the judges' court. It's the states' court, and they have to protect it."
paras.zh: “这是他们的法庭。这不是检察官法庭，也不是法官法庭。这是州法庭，他们必须保护它。”

paras.en: With files from Reuters and The Canadian Press
paras.zh: 来自路透社和加拿大媒体的文件

articles.title: Microsoft services fully restored after global outage

paras.en: Microsoft services fully restored after global outage
paras.zh: 全球停电后微软服务全面恢复

paras.en: Microsoft had said server issues were behind the problem and that it was not aware of any malicious activity
paras.zh: 微软表示，问题背后是服务器问题，并且不知道有任何恶意活动

paras.en: Microsoft said on Saturday that services had fully recovered across Teams, Outlook and its other products, ending a global outage that crippled online communications for businesses and governments for over 24 hours.
paras.zh: 微软周六表示，Teams、Outlook 及其其他产品的服务已完全恢复，结束了导致企业和政府在线通信瘫痪超过 24 小时的全球中断。

paras.en: "We have completed our efforts to address the underlying issue of the incident and restored service to the remaining impacted customers and regions," the company posted on X.
paras.zh: 该公司在 X 上发布消息称：“我们已经努力解决该事件的根本问题，并恢复了对其余受影响客户和地区的服务。”

paras.en: Microsoft had said server issues were behind the problem that also affected its Copilot AI assistant, and that it was not aware of any malicious activity, ruling out AI as the cause.
paras.zh: 微软曾表示，服务器问题是导致该问题的原因之一，该问题也影响了其 Copilot AI 助手，并且它不知道有任何恶意活动，因此排除了 AI 的原因。

paras.en: Outlook and Teams are two of the most widely used workplace applications, with hundreds of millions of users. The outage prevented people from performing essential functions such as sending emails, managing calendars and hosting virtual meetings.
paras.zh: Outlook 和 Teams 是使用最广泛的两种工作场所应用程序，拥有数亿用户。停电导致人们无法执行发送电子邮件、管理日历和主持虚拟会议等基本功能。

paras.en: It affected government agencies from Australia and Japan to the United States, caused delays at trading firms, hindered some companies from publishing earnings and prompted airlines to warn customers of communication lags, according to public statements.
paras.zh: 据公开声明称，它影响了从澳大利亚、日本到美国的政府机构，导致贸易公司延误，阻碍了一些公司发布收益，并促使航空公司警告客户通信滞后。

paras.en: Organizations that host Microsoft services on their own servers, rather than in the cloud, were somewhat spared.
paras.zh: 在自己的服务器上而不是在云中托管微软服务的组织在一定程度上幸免于难。

paras.en: The outage, reports of which started climbing Thursday, is one of the longest in Microsoft's history and the second disruption to its services this year.
paras.zh: 据周四报道称，这次中断是微软历史上最长的一次中断之一，也是今年其服务的第二次中断。

paras.en: Microsoft said the outage specifically hit features tied to Exchange Online — its cloud-based email and scheduling hub — leaving unconnected applications operational.
paras.zh: 微软表示，这次中断特别影响了与 Exchange Online（其基于云的电子邮件和调度中心）相关的功能，导致未连接的应用程序继续运行。

paras.en: The incident deepens questions about the global reliance on a handful of Big Tech companies that supply both the essential software and the cloud infrastructure that underpins it.
paras.zh: 这一事件加深了人们对全球对少数几家大型科技公司的依赖的质疑，这些公司既提供必要的软件，也提供支撑软件的云基础设施。

paras.en: It also highlighted the dependence on Microsoft's workplace software, with outage reports spiking as employees began their workdays across Asia and Europe, according to Downdetector's parent company, Ookla.
paras.zh: DownDetector 的母公司 Ookla 表示，这也突显了人们对微软工作场所软件的依赖，随着亚洲和欧洲的员工开始工作，中断报告激增。

paras.en: Downdetector logged more than 7.4 million reports worldwide, peaking at nearly 20,000 a minute, more than 1,500 times normal levels.
paras.zh: DownDetector 在全球范围内记录了超过 740 万份报告，峰值速度接近每分钟 20,000 份，是正常水平的 1,500 多倍。

paras.en: "It shows how much of the working day now runs through one provider's email and collaboration tools," said Luke Kehoe, lead industry analyst at Ookla.
paras.zh: Ookla 首席行业分析师 Luke Kehoe 表示：“它显示了现在工作日有多少时间通过一家提供商的电子邮件和协作工具进行。”

paras.en: Microsoft shares closed flat at $523.88 on Friday. The stock has gained roughly eight per cent so far this year.
paras.zh: 周五微软股价收盘持平于 523.88 美元。今年迄今为止，该股已上涨约百分之八。

paras.en: Disruptions and financial losses from the outage could result in numerous insurance claims, but the overall hit to insurers is expected to be limited, said Mario De Cicco, vice-president of European financial institutions at Morningstar DBRS.
paras.zh: 晨星 DBRS 欧洲金融机构副总裁马里奥·德西科 (Mario De Cicco) 表示，停电造成的中断和财务损失可能会导致大量保险索赔，但预计对保险公司的总体打击有限。

paras.en: De Cicco estimated global insured losses from the outage at between $300 million and $500 million, well below the $400 million to $1.5 billion financial toll from the 2024 CrowdStrike outage that crashed more than eight million Windows-based computers and caused widespread disruptions.
paras.zh: De Cicco 估计此次中断造成的全球保险损失在 3 亿至 5 亿美元之间，远低于 2024 年 CrowdStrike 中断造成的 4 亿至 15 亿美元的经济损失，那次中断导致超过 800 万台 Windows 计算机崩溃并造成大范围中断。

paras.en: Microsoft also faced an outage with its 365 services in January this year and in October last year. Last month, it reported an outage of its Azure cloud platform that impacted its suite of productivity software and a range of industries worldwide.
paras.zh: 微软的365服务也曾在今年1月和去年10月遭遇过宕机。上个月，该公司报告其 Azure 云平台出现故障，影响了其生产力软件套件和全球一系列行业。

paras.en: "The bigger worry is that this is not the first Microsoft 365 outage this year," said Josh Gilbert, a market analyst at trading platform eToro.
paras.zh: 交易平台 eToro 的市场分析师 Josh Gilbert 表示：“更令人担忧的是，这不是今年第一次 Microsoft 365 宕机。”

paras.en: "If reliability starts to look like a recurring problem, it hands every IT department a reason to think twice before putting even more of their business in one provider's hands."
paras.zh: “如果可靠性开始看起来像是一个反复出现的问题，那么每个 IT 部门就有理由在将更多业务交给一家提供商之前三思而后行。”

paras.en: Still, some analysts have questioned whether such incidents can push customers on to rivals due to the steep switching costs of replacing tools embedded so deeply in daily operations.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，一些分析师仍质疑此类事件是否会将客户推向竞争对手，因为更换深深嵌入日常运营中的工具的转换成本很高。

articles.title: New facilities in Laos and Cambodia: Is China expanding its military presence in Southeast Asia?

paras.en: It's often said that maintaining good relations with your neighbors is essential. So in early November, China's Foreign Minister Wang Yi invited his counterparts from Laos, Cambodia, Vietnam, Thailand and Myanmar to Beijing.
paras.zh: 人们常说，与邻居保持良好的关系至关重要。因此，11月初，中国外交部长王毅邀请老挝、柬埔寨、越南、泰国和缅甸外长访问北京。

paras.en: There the six countries agreed on closer economic and security cooperation.
paras.zh: 六国一致同意加强经济和安全合作。

paras.en: The visit is just one example of China's growing influence on Southeast Asia. It's not just about trade or infrastructure either, it's also increasingly about military cooperation.
paras.zh: 这次访问只是中国对东南亚影响力日益增强的一个例子。这不仅涉及贸易或基础设施，也越来越多地涉及军事合作。
