paras.en: For instance, at the end of September, China and Laos opened a joint military support and training center north of the Laotian capital, Vientiane. Initially Laotian air force pilots are to be trained at the Ban Keun airfield, China has said.
paras.zh: 例如，9月底，中国和老挝在老挝首都万象以北开设了联合军事保障和训练中心。中国表示，老挝空军飞行员最初将在班根机场接受训练。

paras.en: Earlier in 2025 China expanded its footprint at Cambodia's Ream naval base. China uses the facility on the Gulf of Thailand for logistics and training. And while Japanese and Vietnamese ships can visit the port, they're docked at a southern quay and it's unclear if other navies can use the same facilities under the same conditions as China.
paras.zh: 2025 年初，中国扩大了在柬埔寨云朗海军基地的足迹。中国利用泰国湾的该设施进行后勤和培训。虽然日本和越南船只可以访问该港口，但它们停靠在南部码头，目前尚不清楚其他海军是否可以在与中国相同的条件下使用相同的设施。

paras.en: "It remains to be seen how this [Ban Keun] will change China's military access to Southeast Asia," says Marco Bünte, a professor of Asian politics at the University Erlangen Nuremberg in Germany.
paras.zh: 德国埃尔兰根纽伦堡大学亚洲政治学教授马可·本特表示：“[班根]将如何改变中国对东南亚的军事准入还有待观察。”

paras.en: In recent years, China has significantly expanded its economic influence in the region.
paras.zh: 近年来，中国在该地区的经济影响力显着扩大。

paras.en: The China-Laos railway and other infrastructure projects connect Laos more closely with its northern neighbor. Laos is also heavily indebted to China.
paras.zh: 中老铁路等基础设施项目将老挝与北方邻国联系得更加紧密。老挝还欠中国大量债务。

paras.en: Bünte points out that Laos and Cambodia have been close military partners of China for some time and the new facility in Laos can be seen as another step towards deepening cooperation.
paras.zh: 文特指出，老挝和柬埔寨长期以来一直是中国密切的军事伙伴，老挝的新设施可以被视为深化合作的又一步。

paras.en: If that proves correct, "China would gain strategic depth in mainland Southeast Asia," Bünte explained. "It would also give China better military access to the South China Sea."
paras.zh: 如果事实证明这一点是正确的，“中国将在东南亚大陆获得战略纵深，”本特解释道。 “这也将使中国能够更好地进入南海军事通道。”

paras.en: Johann Fuhrmann, head of the Konrad Adenauer Foundation's Beijing office, points out that one should distinguish between training Laotian pilots and any potential use of the facilities by Chinese armed forces later.
paras.zh: 康拉德·阿登纳基金会北京办事处负责人约翰·福尔曼指出，应该区分训练老挝飞行员和中国武装部队以后可能使用这些设施的情况。

paras.en: "China gains influence when it co-designs the training and operation of such facilities over several years," Fuhrmann told DW.
paras.zh: 福尔曼告诉德国之声：“当中国在几年内共同设计此类设施的培训和运营时，它就会获得影响力。”

paras.en: But nobody should underestimate China's military positioning, Bünte continued. "China is expanding its military operational capabilities here although I wouldn't speak of military hegemony because China hasn't achieved that yet."
paras.zh: 但本特继续说道，任何人都不应低估中国的军事地位。 “中国正在这里扩大其军事行动能力，但我不会谈论军事霸权，因为中国尚未实现这一目标。”

paras.en: With regard to the Laotian airbase, China says that Laotian pilots will be trained there. But beside military transporters and helicopters, Laos actually only has three light combat aircraft by Russia's Yakovlev works.
paras.zh: 关于老挝空军基地，中方表示将在那里训练老挝飞行员。但除了军用运输机和直升机外，老挝实际上只有俄罗斯雅科夫列夫工厂生产的三架轻型战斗机。

paras.en: According to the aviation media outlet FlightGlobal, four more K-8s, Chinese two-seat intermediate jet trainer and light attack aircrafts, are in service there. Satellite images analyzed by the Reuters news agency in early October show eight K-8s at the base — even thought this doesn't necessarily mean they are stationed there permanently.
paras.zh: 据航空媒体 FlightGlobal 报道，还有四架中国两座中型喷气教练机和轻型攻击机 K-8 正在那里服役。路透社 10 月初分析的卫星图像显示，该基地有 8 架 K-8，尽管这并不一定意味着它们会永久驻扎在那里。

paras.en: Fuhrmann doesn't think anybody should jump to conclusions about this.
paras.zh: 福尔曼认为任何人都不应该对此草率下结论。

paras.en: "The idea of a Chinese air corridor is more of a future scenario than something that has already been proven," he says.
paras.zh: “中国空中走廊的想法更多的是未来的设想，而不是已经被证明的东西，”他说。

paras.en: For example, the runway at Ban Keun is only 2,000 meters (6,562 feet) long, which makes it too short for large Chinese bombers. These usually require 3,000 meters.
paras.zh: 例如，班根机场的跑道只有2,000米（6,562英尺）长，对于中国大型轰炸机来说太短了。这些通常需要 3,000 米。

paras.en: The crucial question is what rights China will be granted, Fuhrmann continues: "Will China have to obtain the approval of the respective government for every new use? Or are there longer-term commitments that both sides can invoke, even in times of crisis?"
paras.zh: 关键问题是中国将被授予哪些权利，福尔曼继续说道：“中国的每一项新用途都必须获得各自政府的批准吗？或者双方是否可以援引长期承诺，即使在危机时期也是如此？”

paras.en: Surrounding countries are reacting differently to what appears to be China's growing influence in Laos, Cambodia and Myanmar because these countries are already considered closer to China.
paras.zh: 周边国家对中国在老挝、柬埔寨和缅甸日益增长的影响力做出了不同的反应，因为这些国家已经被认为与中国关系更密切。

paras.en: Other Southeast Asian nations are hedging, trying to expand their relationship with China without severing ties with the US and also maintaining economic links with other Western nations. China's involvement offers them additional options and Beijing wants to explore those possibilities. That's just pragmatic though, Bünte says of the smaller Asian nations.
paras.zh: 其他东南亚国家正在两面下注，试图在不切断与美国关系的情况下扩大与中国的关系，同时保持与其他西方国家的经济联系。中国的参与为他们提供了更多选择，北京希望探索这些可能性。布恩特在谈到亚洲小国时表示，这只是务实的做法。

paras.en: "Overall, these states… try to keep as many options open as possible," he notes.
paras.zh: “总的来说，这些州……试图保留尽可能多的选择，”他指出。

paras.en: Vietnam and the Philippines are watching developments particularly closely. Both have territorial disputes with China in the South China Sea. But Vietnam also has close historical ties to Laos and trained its own military there.
paras.zh: 越南和菲律宾正在特别密切关注事态发展。两国都与中国在南海存在领土争端。但越南与老挝也有着密切的历史联系，并在那里训练了自己的军队。

paras.en: In early November, the Vietnamese government declared that any military cooperation must serve peace and stability and referred to the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia, commonly known as the ASEAN Treaty. China is not an ASEAN member but has also stated that its activities are not directed against any third parties.
paras.zh: 11月初，越南政府宣布任何军事合作都必须服务于和平与稳定，并提及《东南亚友好合作条约》（俗称《东盟条约》）。中国不是东盟成员国，但也声明其活动不针对任何第三方。

paras.en: "So far, these are individual steps," Bünte adds. "We would have to wait and see if this leads to a broader military alliance in the years to come."
paras.zh: “到目前为止，这些都是单独的步骤，”本特补充道。 “我们必须等待，看看这是否会在未来几年带来更广泛的军事联盟。”

paras.en: Fuhrmann says that Western nations should help strengthen the smaller countries in the region and take their interests seriously.
paras.zh: 福尔曼表示，西方国家应该帮助该地区小国增强实力，并认真对待它们的利益。

paras.en: "Ultimately, a counterweight can only be achieved through tangible contributions, not through warnings or lectures from Europe," he says.
paras.zh: “最终，平衡只能通过切实的贡献来实现，而不是通过欧洲的警告或说教，”他说。

paras.en: This story was originally published in German.
paras.zh: 这个故事最初以德语发表。

articles.title: Ukraine: Zelenskyy says security deal could go to referendum

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said US peace envoys asked whether Kyiv would withdraw from its eastern region of Donbas in exchange for joining NATO, according to remarks to the media published on Saturday.
paras.zh: 据周六向媒体发表的讲话，乌克兰总统泽伦斯基表示，美国和平特使询问基辅是否会从东部顿巴斯地区撤军，以换取加入北约。

paras.en: The suggestion was made following the latest round of peace talks in Abu Dhabi to bring Russia's nearly 5-year war in Ukraine to a close.
paras.zh: 这一建议是在阿布扎比举行最新一轮和平谈判后提出的，旨在结束俄罗斯在乌克兰近五年的战争。

paras.en: The Ukrainian leader told reporters: "The Americans raised a question: 'What if Ukraine joins NATO? Would Ukraine withdraw from Donbas?'"
paras.zh: 这位乌克兰领导人告诉记者：“美国人提出了一个问题：‘如果乌克兰加入北约怎么办？乌克兰会从顿巴斯撤军吗？’”

paras.en: Zelenskyy repeated Kyiv's position that it was not willing to cede territory to Russia. But he added that if the country reached a comprehensive deal, including security guarantees, a strong and well-funded Ukrainian army and funds to rebuild, he would put the question to the public in a referendum.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基重申了基辅的立场，即不愿意将领土割让给俄罗斯。但他补充说，如果该国达成一项全面协议，包括安全保障、一支强大且资金充足的乌克兰军队以及重建资金，他将在全民公投中向公众提出这个问题。

paras.en: "That is why I believe NATO is back on the agenda. But you have also heard [Russian President Vladimir] Putin's signals, and this is an extremely difficult conversation."
paras.zh: “这就是为什么我相信北约重新回到议程上。但你也听到了[俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔]普京的信号，这是一次极其困难的对话。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy said the prospect of NATO membership in exchange for withdrawing from Donbas has not been raised before.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，以前从未提出过以退出顿巴斯为交换条件加入北约的可能性。

paras.en: He also warned about Moscow's plan to change the continent's security architecture, saying it could lead to more conflict.
paras.zh: 他还对莫斯科改变非洲大陆安全架构的计划发出警告，称这可能会导致更多冲突。

paras.en: Putin has demanded that NATO pull back its troops from the Russian border, which European Union leaders have strongly criticized.
paras.zh: 普京要求北约从俄罗斯边境撤军，欧盟领导人对此表示强烈批评。

paras.en: "This is dangerous because, in my view, it is precisely things like this that lead to wars or escalations," Zelenskyy added.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基补充说：“这很危险，因为在我看来，正是这样的事情导致了战争或升级。”

paras.en: "Real security in Europe means the EU and NATO. That's it. There is no other security in Europe."
paras.zh: “欧洲真正的安全意味着欧盟和北约。仅此而已。欧洲没有其他安全。”

paras.en: Europe to play bigger role in peace talks
paras.zh: 欧洲将在和平谈判中发挥更大作用

paras.en: On Friday, the EU said several European diplomats would take part in future Ukraine peace talks, including Germany, France, the United Kingdom and Poland.
paras.zh: 周五，欧盟表示，包括德国、法国、英国和波兰在内的几位欧洲外交官将参加未来的乌克兰和平谈判。

paras.en: Moscow has long insisted that European states be excluded from the negotiations because they support Ukraine.
paras.zh: 莫斯科长期以来一直坚持将欧洲国家排除在谈判之外，因为它们支持乌克兰。

paras.en: The comments come as Russia’s Defence Ministry said its forces had captured the settlement of Tersianka in Ukraine’s southeastern Zaporizhzhia region, news agency Interfax reported.
paras.zh: 据国际文传电讯社报道，俄罗斯国防部表示，俄罗斯军队已占领乌克兰东南部扎波罗热地区的特尔西安卡定居点。

paras.en: Interfax cited the ministry as saying that Russian forces had struck Ukrainian energy and transport infrastructure used by the military, along with ammunition depots and drone production and storage sites.
paras.zh: 国际文传电讯社援引乌克兰国防部的话说，俄罗斯军队袭击了乌克兰军方使用的能源和运输基础设施，以及弹药库和无人机生产和储存场所。

paras.en: Russia has targeted power stations across Ukraine in waves of ballistic and cruise missile attacks, cutting power and heating to millions of people as temperatures plunge.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯对乌克兰各地的发电站发动了一波又一波的弹道导弹和巡航导弹袭击，随着气温骤降，数百万人的电力和供暖被切断。

paras.en: Zelenskyy warned that Putin was "betting everything" on this winter's war campaign, which Kyiv insists is aimed at hurting public morale.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基警告说，普京正在“把一切赌注”在今年冬天的战争上，基辅坚称此举旨在损害公众士气。

articles.title: COP31: Protesters, UN urge swift climate deal

paras.en: The United Nations' top climate official urged negotiators at the COP31 climate summit in Turkey to "avoid tactical delays" that would prevent a deal to stop global warming.
paras.zh: 联合国气候变化高级官员敦促在土耳其举行的第三十一届缔约方会议气候峰会上的谈判代表“避免战术上的拖延”，否则将阻止达成阻止全球变暖的协议。

paras.en: Delegates from more than 200 nations are gathered in the Mediterranean city of Antalya with the core goal of preventing the planet from warming by 2 degrees Celsius (3.6 degrees Fahrenheit).
paras.zh: 来自 200 多个国家的代表齐聚地中海城市安塔利亚，其核心目标是防止地球变暖 2 摄氏度（3.6 华氏度）。

paras.en: Downtown, thousands of civil society and environmental activists from around the world protested against the consequences of climate change.
paras.zh: 在市中心，来自世界各地的数千名民间社会和环保活动人士抗议气候变化的后果。

paras.en: Simon Stiell, executive secretary of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), said getting an agreement is "tough but vital work."
paras.zh: 联合国气候变化框架公约（UNFCCC）执行秘书西蒙·斯蒂尔表示，达成协议是“艰巨但至关重要的工作”。

paras.en: "There is no collective success without compromise from every party," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“没有各方的妥协，就不可能取得集体成功。”

paras.en: "As we head into the second week, I urge parties to move swiftly to the hardest issues and to avoid tactical delays."
paras.zh: “当我们进入第二周时，我敦促各方迅速采取行动解决最棘手的问题，避免战术上的拖延。”

paras.en: Climate protest draws activists from around the world
paras.zh: 气候抗议吸引了来自世界各地的活动人士

paras.en: Meanwhile, tens of thousands of protesters marched through Antalya on Saturday for climate protection and human rights, according to organizers.
paras.zh: 与此同时，据组织者称，周六，数万名抗议者在安塔利亚游行，呼吁保护气候和人权。

paras.en: Many were dismayed at the lack of progress and how the climate crisis is taking a back seat.
paras.zh: 许多人对缺乏进展以及气候危机如何退居二线感到沮丧。

paras.en: "The pursuit of profit at all costs continues to set the [global] agenda [and] govern the trajectory of our world, so there is a need to push back," environmental activist Zaki Mamdoo from South Africa told DW.
paras.zh: 来自南非的环保活动家扎基·马姆杜 (Zaki Mamdoo) 告诉德国之声：“不惜一切代价追求利润继续制定[全球]议程[并]控制我们世界的发展轨迹，因此有必要予以抵制。”

paras.en: Luisa Nebauer, the main organizer of Germany's Fridays for Future movement, lamented that German Chancellor Friedrich Merz was absent from the conference, along with several other European leaders.
paras.zh: 德国“星期五为未来”运动的主要组织者路易莎·内鲍尔对德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨以及其他几位欧洲领导人缺席会议表示遗憾。

paras.en: "We won't have a chance to solve any of the crises as long as our planet is destabilizing by the hour," Nebauer told DW. "We must show up!"
paras.zh: 内鲍尔告诉德国之声：“只要我们的星球每时每刻都在不稳定，我们就没有机会解决任何危机。” “我们必须出现！”

paras.en: Turkish authorities permitted the rally to go ahead, in a country that often bans large public gatherings.
paras.zh: 土耳其当局允许集会继续进行，因为该国经常禁止大型公众集会。

paras.en: Alongside the march, a parallel "People's Climate Summit" involving hundreds of domestic and international civil society groups takes place in Antalya this weekend.
paras.zh: 在游行的同时，本周末在安塔利亚举行了一场平行的“人民气候峰会”，数百个国内和国际民间社会团体参加。

paras.en: With inflation, wars, deindustrialization and debt being seen as bigger immediate threats, many governments are watering down their commitments to the clean energy transition, along with the billions required to help developing nations to adapt.
paras.zh: 由于通货膨胀、战争、去工业化和债务被视为更大的直接威胁，许多政府正在淡化其对清洁能源转型的承诺，以及帮助发展中国家适应所需的数十亿美元的承诺。

paras.en: The United States has snubbed the talks for the second year in a row under President Donald Trump, who has called climate change a hoax and promoted continued use of fossil fuels.
paras.zh: 在唐纳德·特朗普总统的领导下，美国连续第二年冷落此次谈判，特朗普称气候变化是一个骗局，并提倡继续使用化石燃料。

paras.en: Delegates also face pressure from large fossil-fuel-producing nations to avoid setting stricter targets for a faster phaseout of oil and gas.
paras.zh: 代表们还面临来自化石燃料生产大国的压力，要求他们避免为更快地逐步淘汰石油和天然气设定更严格的目标。

paras.en: Climate advocates in Antalya are growing increasingly frustrated by the lack of commitment and delaying tactics preventing an ambitious deal.
paras.zh: 安塔利亚的气候倡导者因缺乏承诺和拖延策略而越来越沮丧，阻碍了一项雄心勃勃的协议。

paras.en: COP31 is seeking to unlock finance and investment, reduce the use of so-called super-pollutants and methane and ensure food security.
paras.zh: COP31 正在寻求释放资金和投资，减少所谓超级污染物和甲烷的使用，并确保粮食安全。

paras.en: Host Turkey is, meanwhile, pushing a plan to expand global electrification. Yet, some environmental groups are disappointed the proposal doesn't push increased electricity use from renewable sources.
paras.zh: 与此同时，东道主土耳其正在推动一项扩大全球电气化的计划。然而，一些环保组织对该提案没有推动增加可再生能源的电力使用感到失望。

paras.en: A UN report last month warned that, within a few years, the world is set to exceed the 1.5 degrees Celsius (2.7 degrees Fahrenheit) of warming.
paras.zh: 联合国上个月的一份报告警告称，几年之内，全球变暖幅度将超过 1.5 摄氏度（2.7 华氏度）。

paras.en: The figure, set at COP21 in 2015, is the threshold beyond which most scientists believe the world will see increasingly extreme effects of climate change.
paras.zh: 这个数字是 2015 年 COP21 会议上设定的阈值，大多数科学家认为，超过这个阈值，世界将看到气候变化日益极端的影响。

paras.en: A first draft of a deal text is expected to emerge next week, according to Australia's COP31 President of Negotiations Chris Bowen.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚 COP31 谈判主席 Chris Bowen 表示，协议文本初稿预计将于下周公布。

articles.title: EU calls for immediate humanitarian access to Gaza

paras.en: The European Union has urged Israel to reopen all Gaza border crossings and grant “immediate, unimpeded access” for aid groups to provide humanitarian relief in the territory following devastating flooding in Gaza this week.
paras.zh: 欧盟敦促以色列重新开放所有加沙过境点，并允许援助团体“立即、不受阻碍地进入”，以在本周加沙发生毁灭性洪水后在该地区提供人道主义救援。

paras.en: Civilian infrastructure and medical facilities in Gaza “must be protected,” said an EU statement released on Saturday by the office of Kaja Kallas, the EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs and the Vice-President of the European Commission.
paras.zh: 欧盟外交事务高级代表兼欧盟委员会副主席卡贾卡拉斯办公室周六发表的一份欧盟声明表示，加沙的民用基础设施和医疗设施“必须受到保护”。

paras.en: The EU call came as an Israeli drone attack killed two more Palestinians in Gaza on Saturday.
paras.zh: 欧盟发出这一呼吁之际，以色列无人机周六在加沙发动袭击，造成两名巴勒斯坦人死亡。

paras.en: The drone struck them as they walked down a street in Jabaliya on the northern edge of Gaza City, according to Mohamed Abu Selmiya, director of Shifa Hospital in Gaza City, where the casualties were taken. The American field hospital said several other people were wounded but did not provide a number.
paras.zh: 加沙市希法医院院长穆罕默德·阿布·塞尔米亚 (Mohamed Abu Selmiya) 表示，当他们走在加沙城北部边缘贾巴利亚的一条街道上时，无人机袭击了他们。伤员就在该医院。美国野战医院称还有多人受伤，但没有提供具体数字。

paras.en: The Israeli military said it struck two Hamas “militants” in the area.
paras.zh: 以色列军方表示，袭击了该地区的两名哈马斯“武装分子”。

paras.en: An Israeli air attack on Thursday at the Nasser Medical Complex in southern Gaza killed at least six Palestinians, including a surgeon, and left dozens wounded.
paras.zh: 周四，以色列对加沙南部纳赛尔医疗中心发动空袭，造成至少六名巴勒斯坦人死亡，其中包括一名外科医生，数十人受伤。

paras.en: “The EU underlines the need to respect international law, including international humanitarian law, at all times,” the 27-nation bloc said on Saturday. “This includes the protection of civilians and civilian infrastructure, as well as medical personnel and facilities. The recent airstrike on the Nasser Hospital is deeply alarming,” it added.
paras.zh: “欧盟强调必须始终尊重国际法，包括国际人道主义法，”这个由 27 个国家组成的集团周六表示。 “这包括保护平民和民用基础设施，以及医务人员和设施。最近对纳赛尔医院的空袭令人深感震惊，”它补充道。

paras.en: Damage from Israeli attacks on Gaza’s infrastructure has worsened floods caused by heavy rain, which have submerged large areas of the enclave, local officials and the UN said this week. Gaza’s media office reported that more than 700km of Gaza’s sewage network has been destroyed.
paras.zh: 当地官员和联合国本周表示，以色列对加沙基础设施的袭击造成的破坏加剧了暴雨引发的洪水，淹没了飞地的大片地区。加沙媒体办公室报道称，加沙700多公里的污水管网已被摧毁。

paras.en: Heavy rain has directly affected at least 106,000 people in Gaza in recent days, according to the UN children’s agency, UNICEF, with thousands of tents for displaced Palestinians submerged and latrines overflowing into camps.
paras.zh: 据联合国儿童基金会称，最近几天，大雨直接影响了加沙至少 106,000 人，数以千计为流离失所的巴勒斯坦人搭建的帐篷被淹没，厕所挤满了难民营。

paras.en: In response, the EU said that “Israel must enable the work of the UN and its agencies, and humanitarian organisations including NGOs, and comply with all its obligations under international law, including international humanitarian law and international human rights law.”
paras.zh: 欧盟对此回应称，“以色列必须支持联合国及其机构以及包括非政府组织在内的人道主义组织的工作，并遵守国际法（包括国际人道主义法和国际人权法）规定的所有义务。”

paras.en: The EU reaffirmed “its commitment to the two-state solution” and called for “the full withdrawal of Israeli forces from Gaza” as it called for “sustained distribution of humanitarian assistance and early recovery support at scale” to ease the worsening humanitarian crisis in Gaza.
paras.zh: 欧盟重申“对两国解决方案的承诺”，并呼吁“以色列军队从加沙全面撤军”，并呼吁“大规模持续分发人道主义援助和早期恢复支持”，以缓解加沙日益恶化的人道主义危机。

articles.title: Italy fines Meta $880m over photo privacy

paras.en: Italian regulators have fined Meta 805 million euros ($887m) for accessing users’ photos without their consent.
paras.zh: 意大利监管机构因 Meta 未经用户同意访问用户照片而对其处以 8.05 亿欧元（8.87 亿美元）的罚款。

paras.en: The Facebook app on Android devices “accessed photos, videos and associated metadata stored on Italian users’ smartphones without specific consent and without informing them”, Garante, the Italian data privacy authority, said Saturday.
paras.zh: 意大利数据隐私机构 Garante 周六表示，Android 设备上的 Facebook 应用程序“在未经明确同意且未通知他们的情况下访问了存储在意大利用户智能手机上的照片、视频和相关元数据”。

paras.en: The issue relates specifically to the “Get suggestions from gallery when browsing Facebook” feature, which suggests photos and videos from the phone’s gallery for posting while browsing.
paras.zh: 该问题特别与“浏览 Facebook 时从图库获取建议”功能有关，该功能会建议用户在浏览时发布手机图库中的照片和视频。

paras.en: This feature violates the Italian law implementing the EU’s ePrivacy directive, the authority said.
paras.zh: 该机构表示，这一功能违反了执行欧盟电子隐私指令的意大利法律。

paras.en: Garante said the app’s process for collecting consent is too generic and does not allow users to fully understand the specific permissions they are allowing by accepting. The suggestions option was also enabled by default.
paras.zh: 加兰特表示，该应用程序收集同意的流程过于笼统，不允许用户完全理解他们通过接受所允许的特定权限。默认情况下，建议选项也是启用的。

paras.en: The figure of 805 million euros is by far the largest fine ever imposed by the Italian regulator.
paras.zh: 8.05亿欧元的罚款是迄今为止意大利监管机构开出的最大一笔罚款。

paras.en: Garante said Meta must fix the unclear consent notification and disable it being set by default, suggesting that roughly 20 million Italian Android users could have been affected by it.
paras.zh: Garante 表示，Meta 必须修复不明确的同意通知，并禁用默认设置，这表明大约 2000 万意大利 Android 用户可能受到了影响。

paras.en: The regulator also highlighted a “lack of cooperation” by Meta and said an earlier violation, which resulted in a 2019 fine, was a contributing factor in their decision.
paras.zh: 监管机构还强调了 Meta “缺乏合作”，并表示早先的违规行为导致了 2019 年的罚款，这是他们做出决定的一个因素。

paras.en: The amount is roughly 0.47 percent of Meta’s global turnover.
paras.zh: 该金额约占 Meta 全球营业额的 0.47%。

paras.en: The proceedings did not address the possible use of content to train artificial intelligence, which Meta denies.
paras.zh: 诉讼程序并未涉及可能使用内容来训练人工智能的问题，Meta 对此予以否认。

paras.en: Meta has not yet publicly commented on the matter, and it has the right to appeal the regulator’s decision.
paras.zh: Meta尚未对此事公开发表评论，并有权对监管机构的决定提出上诉。

articles.title: US suggested Ukraine cede parts of Donbas to Russia to become part of NATO

paras.en: US negotiators have floated the idea that Ukraine should cede parts of eastern Donbas in exchange for NATO membership, Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said, after the latest rounds of Russia-Ukraine peace talks in Abu Dhabi and Ireland.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基在阿布扎比和爱尔兰举行最新一轮俄罗斯-乌克兰和平谈判后表示，美国谈判代表提出了乌克兰应放弃东顿巴斯部分地区以换取北约成员资格的想法。

paras.en: This is the first time the question of linking NATO membership to territorial concessions has been raised, Zelenskyy told reporters in remarks released by his office on Saturday.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基在其办公室周六发表的讲话中对记者表示，这是第一次提出将北约成员身份与领土让步联系起来的问题。

paras.en: “The Americans raised a question: ‘What if Ukraine joins NATO? Would Ukraine withdraw from Donbas?” he said. “That is why I believe NATO is back on the agenda.”
paras.zh: “美国人提出了一个问题：‘如果乌克兰加入北约怎么办？乌克兰会从顿巴斯撤军吗？’”他说。 “这就是为什么我相信北约重新回到议程上。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy said the parts of the Donbas region in eastern Ukraine the US asked about were areas Russia does not control. The Ukrainian president said he refused to cede territory.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，美国询问的乌克兰东部顿巴斯地区部分地区不受俄罗斯控制。乌克兰总统表示他拒绝割让领土。

paras.en: “[Russian President Vladimir] Putin’s desire to change borders in Europe is a fact. I am sure this is part of his concept of revising security guarantees in Europe,” he said. “This is dangerous because, in my view, it is precisely things like this that lead to wars or escalations.”
paras.zh: “[俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔]普京希望改变欧洲边界是事实。我确信这是他修改欧洲安全保障概念的一部分，”他说。 “这很危险，因为在我看来，正是这样的事情导致了战争或升级。”

paras.en: Putin has long said that Ukrainian membership of NATO is a red line for Moscow, citing the issue as one reason for launching Russia’s full-blown invasion in 2022.
paras.zh: 普京长期以来一直表示，乌克兰加入北约对莫斯科来说是一条红线，并称这一问题是俄罗斯在 2022 年发动全面入侵的原因之一。

paras.en: Zelenskyy did say that if Ukraine received a comprehensive package, including security guarantees, military and reconstruction funds, and a recovery plan from the US and other partners, he would put the question about ceding parts of Donbas to a national referendum.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基确实表示，如果乌克兰收到美国和其他合作伙伴提供的全面一揽子计划，包括安全保障、军事和重建资金以及复苏计划，他将把有关割让顿巴斯部分地区的问题提交全民公投。

paras.en: “If the American side confirms precisely this to us, together with other NATO partners, then I will ask our Ukrainian society what it thinks: do we accept it or not?” Zelenskyy said.
paras.zh: “如果美国方面和其他北约伙伴向我们证实了这一点，那么我将问问我们乌克兰社会的想法：我们接受还是不接受？”泽连斯基说道。

paras.en: He stressed that any arrangement would not involve recognising occupied territories as Russian. Zelenskyy also rejected the possibility of Ukraine committing to neutrality, saying that would require changing the country’s constitution.
paras.zh: 他强调，任何安排都不会涉及承认被占领土为俄罗斯领土。泽伦斯基还拒绝了乌克兰承诺中立的可能性，称这需要修改该国宪法。

paras.en: “If Putin expects Ukraine’s neutrality to be enshrined, that’s not going to happen,” he said. “We’re not in NATO right now anyway.”
paras.zh: “如果普京希望乌克兰保持中立，那这就不会发生，”他说。 “无论如何，我们现在不在北约。”

paras.en: Despite the diplomatic push to end the conflict, Russia and Ukraine reported numerous overnight attacks. Russian officials reported on Friday that about 1,200 Ukrainian drones were fired at the country, with oil infrastructure among the targets, while Ukraine reported attacks on a hospital and the port of Odesa.
paras.zh: 尽管通过外交努力结束冲突，俄罗斯和乌克兰仍报告了多起夜间袭击事件。俄罗斯官员周五报告称，约 1,200 架乌克兰无人机向该国发射，目标包括石油基础设施，而乌克兰则报告称，一家医院和敖德萨港遭到袭击。

paras.en: At the summit in Ireland over recent days, EU leaders agreed that Europe’s team for any Ukraine peace talks would comprise five major military powers – non-EU member Britain plus France, Germany, Italy and Poland – as well as EU officials. They would hold talks with US and Ukrainian officials, but not with Russia.
paras.zh: 在最近几天于爱尔兰举行的峰会上，欧盟领导人同意，乌克兰和平谈判的欧洲团队将由五个主要军事强国——非欧盟成员国英国加上法国、德国、意大利和波兰——以及欧盟官员组成。他们将与美国和乌克兰官员举行会谈，但不会与俄罗斯举行会谈。

articles.title: Indonesia's VP resigns as his eligibility and academic credentials are questioned
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Indonesia's VP resigns as his eligibility and academic credentials are questioned
paras.zh: 印度尼西亚副总统因资格和学历受到质疑而辞职

paras.en: JAKARTA, Indonesia — Indonesia's vice president resigned on Thursday as questions grew over his eligibility for the office after recent court rulings disputed his educational credentials.
paras.zh: 印度尼西亚雅加达——印度尼西亚副总统周四辞职，因为最近法院的裁决对他的教育资格提出了质疑，他担任该职位的资格受到越来越多的质疑。

paras.en: Gibran Rakabuming Raka, the 39-year-old son of former President Joko Widodo, submitted his resignation to the leadership of the People's Consultative Assembly, the country's highest legislative body, at the parliament building in the capital, Jakarta.
paras.zh: 前总统佐科·维多多39岁的儿子吉布兰·拉卡布明·拉卡在首都雅加达议会大厦向该国最高立法机构人民协商会议领导层提交了辞呈。

paras.en: Raka didn't comment as he left the meeting.
paras.zh: 拉卡离开会议时没有发表评论。

paras.en: "There will always be political dynamics in public office, that's normal," his father, Widodo, told reporters from his hometown in Solo, adding that he had reminded his son that political positions are temporary.
paras.zh: 他的父亲维多多在家乡梭罗对记者说：“公职中总会有政治动态，这很正常。”他补充说，他曾提醒儿子，政治职位是暂时的。

paras.en: "We will continue to support President Prabowo's government, especially programs that serve the interests of the broader public," he said, referring to Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们将继续支持普拉博沃总统的政府，特别是为更广泛公众利益服务的计划。”他指的是印度尼西亚总统普拉博沃·苏比安托。

paras.en: The academic credentials investigation was apparently not related to investigations into allegations that top police officials had been involved in wiretapping targeting the president.
paras.zh: 学历调查显然与对高级警察官员参与针对总统的窃听的指控的调查无关。

paras.en: Raka had offered to resign Tuesday during a meeting with Prabowo, saying he wanted to avoid a prolonged political controversy. He personally delivered his resignation letter to the president on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 拉卡周二在与普拉博沃会面时提出辞职，称他想避免长期的政治争议。周三，他亲自向总统递交了辞职信。

paras.en: Prabowo addressed the nation Thursday afternoon after holding a meeting with Raka and the parliamentary leadership at the presidential palace.
paras.zh: 普拉博沃周四下午在总统府与拉卡和议会领导层举行会议后向全国发表讲话。

paras.en: Flanked by Raka and top leaders of parliament, a grim-looking Prabowo said that he accepted Raka's resignation "with a heavy heart" and praised the vice president for showing "courage, responsibility and statesmanship" by stepping down.
paras.zh: 在拉卡和议会最高领导人的簇拥下，面色严峻的普拉博沃表示，他“心情沉重”地接受了拉卡的辞职，并称赞副总统下台表现出了“勇气、责任感和政治家风度”。

paras.en: "He chose to resign for the greater interest of the nation, the state and the Indonesian people," Prabowo said in a televised statement. "He has been a great help to me, from our election campaign through the past two years of government. Many of our achievements would not have been possible without his contribution."
paras.zh: 普拉博沃在电视声明中表示：“他选择辞职是为了国家、国家和印度尼西亚人民的更大利益。” “从我们的竞选活动到过去两年的执政，他给了我很大的帮助。如果没有他的贡献，我们的许多成就是不可能实现的。”

paras.en: Prabowo praised Raka's dedication and hard work, highlighting Raka's visits to 35 provinces and 149 regencies and cities to inspect 303 government projects during the past two years as examples of his commitment to public service.
paras.zh: 普拉博沃赞扬拉卡的奉献精神和辛勤工作，并强调拉卡在过去两年里访问了35个省份和149个县市，检查了303个政府项目，以此作为致力于公共服务的例证。

paras.en: "I will continue to support him, and I pray that he and his family are given strength during what is undoubtedly a difficult time," Prabowo said.
paras.zh: 普拉博沃说：“我将继续支持他，我祈祷他和他的家人在这无疑是困难的时期得到力量。”

paras.en: Under the Indonesian Constitution, a vice presidential vacancy doesn't trigger a new election. The office remains vacant until the People's Consultative Assembly elects a replacement from two candidates nominated by the president within 60 days.
paras.zh: 根据印度尼西亚宪法，副总统空缺不会引发新的选举。该职位将一直空缺，直至人民协商会议在 60 天内从总统提名的两名候选人中选出替代者。

paras.en: Long-running allegations over candidacy lead to court disputes
paras.zh: 关于候选人资格的长期指控导致法庭纠纷

paras.en: The Constitutional Court and the Supreme Court ruled last month that the documents that Raka submitted regarding his overseas education didn't meet election requirements.
paras.zh: 宪法法院和最高法院上个月裁定，拉卡提交的有关海外教育的文件不符合选举要求。

paras.en: A subsequent petition, submitted Wednesday to the House leadership by 120 lawmakers from eight political parties, began a parliamentary process that could have led to his impeachment.
paras.zh: 随后，来自 8 个政党的 120 名议员周三向众议院领导层提交了一份请愿书，启动了可能导致他被弹劾的议会程序。

paras.en: The push for his impeachment was driven largely by long-running allegations that Raka's candidacy was enabled by a Constitutional Court ruling that critics see as a conflict of interest and evidence of weak political accountability and dynastic privilege.
paras.zh: 推动弹劾他的主要原因是长期存在的指控，即拉卡的候选资格是由宪法法院的裁决促成的，批评者认为这是利益冲突，也是政治责任和王朝特权薄弱的证据。

paras.en: Before Prabowo chose him as his running mate for the 2024 election, Raka didn't meet the age requirement of 40 for vice presidential candidates. But the court's contentious ruling in October 2023 carved an exception allowing those who served or had been elected as regional leaders to run at a younger age.
paras.zh: 在普拉博沃选择他作为2024年选举的竞选搭档之前，拉卡没有达到副总统候选人40岁的年龄要求。但法院在 2023 年 10 月做出的​​颇具争议的裁决规定了一个例外，允许那些曾担任或曾当选地区领导人的人在更年轻的年龄参选。

paras.en: Under Indonesian election law, a presidential or vice-presidential candidate must have completed senior high school or an equivalent level of education. Because Raka completed his secondary education overseas, he was required to provide documents showing that his qualifications were equivalent to an Indonesian high school diploma.
paras.zh: 根据印度尼西亚选举法，总统或副总统候选人必须完成高中或同等程度的教育。由于拉卡在海外完成了中学教育，因此他需要提供文件证明其学历相当于印尼高中文凭。

paras.en: Raka was the first vice president of the country to resign before the end of a term since the fall of dictator Suharto and the start of Indonesia's democratic reforms in 1998.
paras.zh: 拉卡是自1998年独裁者苏哈托倒台和印度尼西亚开始民主改革以来第一位在任期结束前辞职的副总统。

paras.en: Parliamentary leaders were due to convene immediately to begin the process of selecting a replacement, Speaker Ahmad Muzani said.
paras.zh: 议长艾哈迈德·穆扎尼表示，议会领导人将立即召开会议，开始选择继任者的程序。

paras.en: "We ask for the prayers and support of all Indonesians so that this democratic process can proceed smoothly and serve as a constructive new precedent in our constitutional system," Muzani told reporters.
paras.zh: 穆扎尼对记者说：“我们请求所有印度尼西亚人的祈祷和支持，以便这一民主进程能够顺利进行，并成为我们宪法制度的建设性新先例。”

articles.title: U.S. envoys meet with Putin in Moscow on Ukraine talks, then see Zelenskyy in Dublin
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: U.S. envoys meet with Putin in Moscow on Ukraine talks, then see Zelenskyy in Dublin
paras.zh: 美国特使在莫斯科会见普京讨论乌克兰问题，然后在都柏林会见泽连斯基

paras.en: DUBLIN — U.S. envoys met Thursday with Russian President Vladimir Putin in the Kremlin before heading to Ireland for talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy as Washington sought new momentum for its peace efforts.
paras.zh: 都柏林——美国特使周四在克里姆林宫会见了俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京，然后前往爱尔兰与乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基举行会谈，华盛顿正在为其和平努力寻求新动力。

paras.en: Envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, who is also President Donald Trump's son-in-law, brokered talks this week between delegations from Moscow and Kyiv. The session in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, brought the first direct discussions between Ukrainian and Russian representatives in nine months as the push for a settlement stalled.
paras.zh: 特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和唐纳德·特朗普总统的女婿贾里德·库什纳本周促成了莫斯科和基辅代表团之间的会谈。在阿拉伯联合酋长国阿布扎比举行的会议上，乌克兰和俄罗斯代表在推动解决方案陷入停滞之际进行了九个月以来的首次直接讨论。

paras.en: The talks produced no major breakthrough, aside from an agreement to swap a large number of prisoners, with the exact figure still to be announced. Plans for another round of talks were announced as well, with Witkoff and Zelenskyy saying Europe will join, though they gave no details about which countries or how many.
paras.zh: 除了交换大量囚犯的协议外，会谈没有取得重大突破，具体数字仍有待公布。还宣布了另一轮谈判的计划，威特科夫和泽连斯基表示欧洲将加入，但他们没有透露具体是哪些国家或有多少国家。

paras.en: Kushner and Witkoff met with Putin for about two hours before going to Dublin, where they met with Zelenskyy for more than an hour as the conflict stretches toward the five-year mark.
paras.zh: 库什纳和维特科夫在前往都柏林之前与普京会面了大约两个小时，在冲突接近五年之际，他们在那里与泽连斯基会面了一个多小时。

paras.en: Europe seeks a place at the negotiating table
paras.zh: 欧洲寻求在谈判桌上占有一席之地

paras.en: Kushner said one goal of the meeting with Putin was to get the Russian leader's blessing for European representatives to be part of the talks, which are looking at the continent's broader security arrangements.
paras.zh: 库什纳表示，与普京会面的目标之一是获得俄罗斯领导人的批准，让欧洲代表参加会谈，会谈正在研究欧洲大陆更广泛的安全安排。

paras.en: In Abu Dhabi, several European security advisers were involved on the sidelines but not in the main three-way talk.
paras.zh: 在阿布扎比，几位欧洲安全顾问在场外参与，但没有参与主要的三方会谈。

paras.en: Speaking to reporters before boarding a plane to leave Moscow, Witkoff said the next round of talks has been agreed upon. Russian state TV showed Witkoff saying that "the Europeans will join at the next meeting," but he did not elaborate.
paras.zh: 威特科夫在登上离开莫斯科的飞机前对记者表示，下一轮会谈已经商定。俄罗斯国家电视台播放维特科夫表示“欧洲人将参加下次会议”，但他没有详细说明。

paras.en: Zelenskyy in Dublin indicated the Europeans would not be on the sidelines. "Next meeting, Europe will be during negotiations, will be a negotiation team – not some way, not separately. They will have a voice," he said.
paras.zh: 都柏林的泽连斯基表示欧洲人不会袖手旁观。 “下一次会议，欧洲将参加谈判，将成为一个谈判小组——不是以某种方式，也不是单独进行。他们将有发言权，”他说。

paras.en: The U.S. and Zelenskyy want Europe to appoint a single person to negotiate with Moscow.
paras.zh: 美国和泽伦斯基希望欧洲任命一个人与莫斯科进行谈判。

paras.en: Russia, meanwhile, doesn't want European countries involved in the direct negotiations, complaining they are financing and supplying Ukraine's military effort. The Europeans are concerned about Russia's conduct and broader intentions on the continent.
paras.zh: 与此同时，俄罗斯不希望欧洲国家参与直接谈判，抱怨他们正在为乌克兰的军事行动提供资金和供应。欧洲人对俄罗斯在欧洲大陆的行为和更广泛的意图感到担忧。

paras.en: But Washington and European capitals have sometimes seemed at odds in their diplomatic efforts. Trump has repeatedly sided with Putin, last month waiving sanctions and striking a deal to import Russian diesel, in moves that dismayed Ukraine and European leaders.
paras.zh: 但华盛顿和欧洲各国首都的外交努力有时似乎存在分歧。特朗普一再站在普京一边，上个月放弃制裁并达成进口俄罗斯柴油的协议，此举令乌克兰和欧洲领导人感到沮丧。

paras.en: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov argued that for Europe to join peace talks, it first must name a representative.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫表示，欧洲要加入和谈，首先必须任命一名代表。

paras.en: "The Europeans squabble like spiders in a jar. If someone takes the initiative to establish contact with the Russian side, such people are facing ostracism."
paras.zh: “欧洲人就像罐子里的蜘蛛一样争吵。如果有人主动与俄罗斯方面建立联系，这样的人就会面临排斥。”

paras.en: Many in Europe also see the inclusion of Moscow in discussions about postwar European security as an unwelcome concession to Putin, who has described NATO's eastward expansion as a main security threat and has demanded the alliance's troops be pulled back from Russia's borders.
paras.zh: 许多欧洲人还认为，让莫斯科参与有关战后欧洲安全的讨论是对普京的不受欢迎的让步，普京将北约东扩描述为主要的安全威胁，并要求从俄罗斯边境撤军。

paras.en: Putin's aide calls the talks 'constructive'
paras.zh: 普京助手称会谈“具有建设性”

paras.en: Some analysts say negotiators may be looking to grant Russia concessions on NATO's strategy in return for peace in Ukraine — a possibility that alarms European leaders.
paras.zh: 一些分析人士表示，谈判代表可能寻求让俄罗斯在北约战略上做出让步，以换取乌克兰的和平——这种可能性令欧洲领导人感到震惊。

paras.en: Thursday's talks were "substantive, constructive, frank and useful," Putin's aide Yuri Ushakov said.
paras.zh: 普京的助手尤里·乌沙科夫表示，周四的会谈“具有实质性、建设性、坦率且有益”。

paras.en: He added that the Kremlin leader reminded Witkoff and Kushner about Moscow's proposals from 2021 -- before it sent troops into Ukraine -- demanding that NATO roll back the alliance's military deployments in Central and Eastern Europe. Russia will update those with "fresh considerations," Ushakov said.
paras.zh: 他补充说，克里姆林宫领导人提醒维特科夫和库什纳注意莫斯科从 2021 年起的提议——在向乌克兰派遣军队之前——要求北约撤回该联盟在中欧和东欧的军事部署。乌沙科夫表示，俄罗斯将用“新的考虑”来更新这些内容。

paras.en: Putin reaffirmed to the U.S. envoys that any European troops sent to Ukraine after a ceasefire — an idea long floated by Europe to prevent a new attack by Moscow — would be "absolutely unacceptable" and Russia would regard the deployment as a security threat and legitimate target. "In other words, the war would resume immediately," the Russian president said.
paras.zh: 普京向美国特使重申，在停火后向乌克兰派遣任何欧洲军队——这是欧洲长期以来为防止莫斯科发动新的袭击而提出的想法——将是“绝对不可接受的”，俄罗斯将把这一部署视为安全威胁和合法目标。 “换句话说，战争将立即恢复，”俄罗斯总统说。

paras.en: He also said Russia regards its border with Ukraine to be sealed by a prospective peace deal as now extending to cover the four Ukrainian regions that Moscow annexed in 2022 but never fully controlled.
paras.zh: 他还表示，俄罗斯认为，未来的和平协议将封锁与乌克兰的边界，目前边界已扩大到莫斯科于 2022 年吞并但从未完全控制的四个乌克兰地区。

paras.en: Fighting continues as another bitter winter approaches
paras.zh: 又一个严冬临近，战斗仍在继续

paras.en: Zelenskyy is in Dublin for a meeting of more than 40 European countries that also includes NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基正在都柏林参加 40 多个欧洲国家参加的会议，其中包括北约秘书长马克·吕特。

paras.en: Rutte said the U.S., Europe and Ukraine are "very much aligned" on what security guarantees should look like, following a meeting in Paris in January. "But now of course we need the peace deal, or at least a ceasefire," Rutte said.
paras.zh: 吕特表示，一月份在巴黎举行会议后，美国、欧洲和乌克兰就安全保障的内容“非常一致”。 “但现在我们当然需要和平协议，或者至少是停火，”吕特说。

paras.en: Amid the negotiations, fighting continues along the 1,200-kilometer (about 750-mile) front line.
paras.zh: 在谈判期间，战斗沿着 1,200 公里（约 750 英里）的前线仍在继续。

paras.en: Russia's bigger army has been held back by dogged Ukrainian resistance while Moscow's drone and missile strikes on Ukraine's energy facilities disrupted heat, electricity and water supplies to Ukrainian cities, sapping public morale in what Kyiv calls a "weaponization of winter."
paras.zh: 俄罗斯规模更大的军队一直受到乌克兰顽强抵抗的阻碍，而莫斯科对乌克兰能源设施的无人机和导弹袭击扰乱了乌克兰城市的供热、电力和供水，削弱了公众士气，基辅称之为“冬季武器化”。

paras.en: Russia's Defense Ministry said its air defenses downed 71 Ukrainian drones overnight. Its forces struck a drone-manufacturing plant in Kyiv and three other facilities producing missile fuel and drone components in the area around the Ukrainian capital, the ministry said.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部表示，其防空系统一夜之间击落了 71 架乌克兰无人机。乌克兰国防部表示，其部队袭击了基辅的一家无人机制造厂以及乌克兰首都周边地区的另外三座生产导弹燃料和无人机零部件的设施。

paras.en: Russia launched missiles and 123 drones, 73 of them jet-powered drones, at Ukraine overnight, the Ukrainian air force said. Hits were recorded at 17 locations, it said.
paras.zh: 乌克兰空军表示，俄罗斯连夜向乌克兰发射了导弹和 123 架无人机，其中 73 架是喷气式无人机。据称，有 17 个地点被击中。

paras.en: U.S. Starlink problems return, Zelenskyy says
paras.zh: 泽连斯基称美国星链问题再次出现

paras.en: Ukraine is experiencing another slowdown in the U.S. Starshield system — SpaceX's military-grade version of the Starlink satellite internet service — that the country needs to defend itself against Russian attacks, Zelenskyy said Thursday on social media.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基周四在社交媒体上表示，乌克兰正在经历美国星盾系统（SpaceX 的星链卫星互联网服务的军用级版本）的又一次放缓，该国需要该系统来防御俄罗斯的攻击。

paras.en: Military units have recorded "significant disruptions," including speed restrictions limiting Ukrainian drones to 161 kph (100 mph), Zelenskyy said, adding that a military investigation established that the restrictions weren't random errors.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，军事单位记录了“严重干扰”，包括将乌克兰无人机的速度限制为 161 公里/小时（100 英里/小时），并补充说，军事调查证实这些限制并非随机错误。

paras.en: Ukraine uses Starlink and Starshield for intercepting Russian drones and launching its own strikes.
paras.zh: 乌克兰使用“星链”和“星盾”拦截俄罗斯无人机并发动自己的袭击。

paras.en: Last month, limits on Ukrainian drone speeds severely disrupted operations and alarmed Kyiv officials who fear U.S. support could drop off.
paras.zh: 上个月，对乌克兰无人机速度的限制严重扰乱了行动，并令基辅官员感到震惊，他们担心美国的支持可能会下降。

paras.en: Elon Musk acknowledged that his company SpaceX had throttled the Starlink internet service in Ukraine for about a week, saying the system couldn't be used for offensive strikes against Russia.
paras.zh: 埃隆·马斯克承认，他的公司 SpaceX 已对乌克兰的 Starlink 互联网服务进行了大约一周的限制，并表示该系统不能用于对俄罗斯进行进攻。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said the speed limits cover operations in Russian-occupied parts of Ukraine and that Kyiv is trying to find out from U.S. officials what is going on.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，速度限制涵盖了俄罗斯占领的乌克兰地区的行动，基辅正在试图从美国官员那里了解发生了什么。

paras.en: Russian colonel reportedly killed by a car bomb
paras.zh: 俄罗斯上校据称被汽车炸弹炸死

paras.en: A Russian serviceman was killed in St. Petersburg early Thursday when his vehicle exploded, according to the Investigative Committee, the country's main criminal investigation agency. It didn't identify the victim or say who was behind the bombing.
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯主要刑事调查机构调查委员会称，周四早些时候，一名俄罗斯军人在圣彼得堡的车辆爆炸中身亡。它没有透露受害者的身份，也没有透露谁是爆炸案的幕后黑手。

paras.en: The Fontanka news outlet said the victim was a colonel and that a bomb in his car exploded as he drove off.
paras.zh: 丰坦卡新闻媒体称，受害者是一名上校，他开车离开时，他车里的一枚炸弹爆炸了。

paras.en: Several senior Russian military officers have died in bombings and other attacks that Moscow blames on Ukraine. Kyiv has claimed responsibility for some attacks on Russian soil.
paras.zh: 几名俄罗斯高级军官在爆炸和其他袭击中丧生，莫斯科将其归咎于乌克兰。基辅声称对俄罗斯领土上的一些袭击事件负责。

articles.title: Fuel crisis and protests pressure Chile's far-right president
articles.author: John Bartlett

paras.en: Fuel crisis and protests pressure Chile's far-right president
paras.zh: 燃料危机和抗议给智利极右翼总统带来压力

paras.en: SANTIAGO, Chile — Chile's ultraconservative president finds himself on the back foot after just eight months in power.
paras.zh: 智利圣地亚哥——智利极端保守的总统在上任仅八个月后就发现自己陷入了困境。

paras.en: José Antonio Kast, a politician who spent a career railing against progressive issues, reproductive rights and welfare policies from the extreme fringes of right-wing politics, now finds himself with just 24% approval in the polls.
paras.zh: 何塞·安东尼奥·卡斯特 (José Antonio Kast) 是一位政治家，他的职业生涯一直在反对右翼政治极端边缘的进步问题、生殖权利和福利政策，现在他发现自己在民意调查中的支持率仅为 24%。

paras.en: It is less than a year since Kast stormed to the presidency in December 2025 by avoiding all mention of his hardline stances on social matters, focusing instead on two hot-button issues whipped up in the national media: illegal immigration and public security.
paras.zh: 距离卡斯特于 2025 年 12 月上任总统不到一年，他避免提及自己在社会问题上的强硬立场，而是将注意力集中在国家媒体上掀起的两个热点问题：非法移民和公共安全。

paras.en: But rather than pressing ahead with those at the top of his agenda, he has floundered. And as elsewhere around the Americas and worldwide, rising costs of living have come to hit him hard.
paras.zh: 但他并没有继续推进他最重要的议程，而是陷入了困境。与美洲和世界其他地方一样，生活成本的上涨对他造成了沉重打击。

paras.en: "Our salaries are maybe 20% of a European income, but with a similar cost of living – it's terrible," said Simón Echavarría, a 30-year-old architect, at a march in Santiago on Friday evening.
paras.zh: 周五晚上，30 岁的建筑师西蒙·埃查瓦里亚 (Simón Echavarría) 在圣地亚哥的一次游行中表示：“我们的工资可能是欧洲人收入的 20%，但生活成本却相似，这太糟糕了。”

paras.en: "We want to protest against the measures that have set us back on environmental issues, on human rights, even reducing the sentences of pedophiles – they are implementing things that nobody asked for," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们想要抗议那些在环境问题、人权问题上让我们倒退的措施，甚至减少恋童癖者的刑期——他们正在实施没有人要求的事情。”

paras.en: Behind him, heavily armed police blocked the streets and fired water cannons at protesters chanting and waving flags in the square.
paras.zh: 在他身后，全副武装的警察封锁了街道，并向广场上高呼口号、挥舞旗帜的抗议者发射高压水枪。

paras.en: Much of the recent ire stems from the revelation last month that Kast's government had signed decrees to cut the sentences of 56 prisoners whose crimes range from the rape of children to dictatorship-era human rights violations.
paras.zh: 最近的愤怒很大程度上源于上个月卡斯特政府签署法令对 56 名囚犯减刑的消息，这些囚犯的罪行包括强奸儿童和独裁时代侵犯人权等。

paras.en: Kast has since admitted that this was an "error", but came out in support of the undersecretary who signed the decrees nonetheless.
paras.zh: 卡斯特此后承认这是一个“错误”，但仍然站出来支持签署这些法令的副部长。

paras.en: But beneath the more egregious moves Kast has made in his first year in power is simmering discontent over affordability.
paras.zh: 但在卡斯特执政第一年采取的更令人震惊的举措背后，隐藏着对负担能力的不满。

paras.en: In July, Kast's government chose not to apply an anti-inflation tool available to the Chilean state to ease the rise in fuel prices brought about by the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran.
paras.zh: 7月，卡斯特政府选择不采用智利政府可用的反通胀工具，以缓解美以与伊朗战争带来的燃油价格上涨。

paras.en: Protests exploded as prices shot up overnight and motorists joined long queues at gas stations to fill their tanks before the rise came into effect.
paras.zh: 随着价格一夜之间飙升，驾车者在涨价生效之前在加油站排起长队加油，引发了抗议活动。

paras.en: This week, Chile's formidable truckers' unions blockaded two major highways in an effort to exert pressure on the government and address high fuel prices.
paras.zh: 本周，智利强大的卡车司机工会封锁了两条主要高速公路，试图向政府施加压力并解决高油价问题。

paras.en: On Friday, the strike was broken after the government backed down, sending a bill to Chile's congress which will reverse planned fuel price rises.
paras.zh: 周五，在政府作出让步后，罢工被打破，并向智利国会提交了一项法案，该法案将扭转计划中的燃油价格上涨。

paras.en: It is expected to be approved this month, but public anger continues to grow over the cost of living.
paras.zh: 预计该法案将于本月获得批准，但公众对生活成本的愤怒持续增长。

paras.en: Politicians across the Americas who have enthusiastically aligned themselves with President Donald Trump are facing challenges similar to those confronting the U.S. administration, as rising fuel prices and the cost of everyday goods fuel public discontent.
paras.zh: 美洲各地热情支持唐纳德·特朗普总统的政治家面临着与美国政府类似的挑战，因为不断上涨的燃油价格和日常用品成本加剧了公众的不满。

paras.en: In Argentina, far-right libertarian Javier Milei faces reelection in less than a year, with 60% of the country disapproving of his leadership amid spiraling inflation. In Peru, President Keiko Fujimori is also facing growing discontent, with 53% disapproving of her government, according to a recent Ipsos poll.
paras.zh: 在阿根廷，极右翼自由主义者哈维尔·米莱 (Javier Milei) 在不到一年的时间内面临连任，在通货膨胀不断上升的情况下，该国 60% 的人不赞成他的领导。在秘鲁，总统藤森庆子也面临着日益增长的不满情绪，根据益普索 (Ipsos) 最近的一项民意调查，53% 的人不赞成她的政府。

paras.en: At the march in Santiago on Friday, 30-year-old veterinarian Patricia Pereira said that she was concerned about cuts to science funding, but that her discontent ran deeper.
paras.zh: 在周五圣地亚哥的游行中，30 岁的兽医帕特里夏·佩雷拉 (Patricia Pereira) 表示，她对科学经费的削减感到担忧，但她的不满情绪更深了。

paras.en: "Here in Chile, it was a hard-won victory for children to have free education, achieved through protests, and now even that's also being called into question," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“在智利，孩子们通过抗议获得了免费教育，这是来之不易的胜利，但现在连这一点也受到了质疑。”

paras.en: Protests are likely to grow in Santiago if the government fails to address the rising cost of living. President Kast has shown little sign of doing so.
paras.zh: 如果政府不能解决生活成本上升的问题，圣地亚哥的抗议活动可能会加剧。卡斯特总统几乎没有表现出这样做的迹象。

paras.en: To the contrary, his budget proposal is making its way through Congress, with the government seeking cuts to education, culture, science and a host of social programs.
paras.zh: 相反，他的预算提案正在国会获得通过，政府寻求削减教育、文化、科学和一系列社会项目。
