articles.title: New prostate cancer guidelines urge men to start screening at specific age

paras.en: The American Cancer Society is recommending regular prostate cancer screening starting at age 50 for men at average risk under updated guidelines released Nov. 12.
paras.zh: 根据 11 月 12 日发布的更新指南，美国癌症协会建议平均风险男性从 50 岁开始定期进行前列腺癌筛查。

paras.en: The update shifts from emphasizing individual decisions about screening to explicitly recommending regular testing for eligible men.
paras.zh: 此次更新从强调筛查的个人决定转变为明确建议对符合条件的男性进行定期检测。

paras.en: The new guidelines call for PSA testing every two years for average-risk men ages 50 through 69. Black men should begin annual screening at 45, regardless of family history. Other men with a father, brother or son diagnosed with prostate cancer should also begin at 45, with the frequency depending on their family history.
paras.zh: 新指南要求对 50 至 69 岁的平均风险男性每两年进行一次 PSA 检测。黑人男性应从 45 岁开始每年进行一次筛查，无论家族史如何。其他父亲、兄弟或儿子被诊断患有前列腺癌的男性也应该从 45 岁开始，频率取决于他们的家族史。

paras.en: Men ages 70 to 74 should discuss whether to continue screening with their doctors; routine screening is not recommended at 75 and older.
paras.zh: 70至74岁的男性应与医生讨论是否继续筛查；不建议 75 岁及以上人士进行常规筛查。

paras.en: Prostate cancer is the second-leading cause of cancer death among U.S. men. For disease that has not spread beyond the prostate or nearby areas, the five-year relative survival rate is nearly 100%, according to the American Cancer Society.
paras.zh: 前列腺癌是美国男性癌症死亡的第二大原因。根据美国癌症协会的数据，对于尚未扩散到前列腺或附近区域以外的疾病，五年相对生存率接近 100%。

paras.en: "Men think it is going to happen to someone else," Dr. Ash Tewari, chair of the Milton and Carroll Petrie Department of Urology at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai Medical Center in New York City, told Fox News.
paras.zh: 纽约市西奈山医疗中心伊坎医学院米尔顿和卡罗尔·皮特里泌尿外科主任阿什·特瓦里博士告诉福克斯新闻，“人们认为这种情况会发生在别人身上。”

paras.en: The doctor, who has performed more than 10,000 prostate cancer operations, said the success rate of treating patients is exceedingly high, but that many men still need to be nudged to get screened.
paras.zh: 这位做过一万多例前列腺癌手术的医生表示，治疗患者的成功率非常高，但许多男性仍然需要接受筛查。

paras.en: A prostate cancer screening involves a simple blood test for PSA, which measures the level of prostate-specific antigen, the protein produced by normal and cancerous cells in the prostate gland.
paras.zh: 前列腺癌筛查包括对 PSA 进行简单的血液检测，测量前列腺特异性抗原（前列腺中正常细胞和癌细胞产生的蛋白质）的水平。

paras.en: Under the updated guidelines, a PSA level of 3 ng/mL or higher in men younger than 70 warrants a repeat test to confirm the result. There are other explanations for higher PSA levels beyond the existence of prostate cancer, such as an enlarged prostate, inflammation or an infection.
paras.zh: 根据更新后的指南，70 岁以下男性的 PSA 水平达到 3 ng/mL 或更高时，需要重复测试以确认结果。除了前列腺癌的存在之外，对于 PSA 水平升高还有其他解释，例如前列腺肥大、炎症或感染。

paras.en: Screening can also identify slow-growing cancers that may never cause harm. The society recommends discussing screening’s benefits and possible harms with a healthcare provider and offering close monitoring as an initial approach for low-risk cancers.
paras.zh: 筛查还可以识别生长缓慢但可能永远不会造成伤害的癌症。该协会建议与医疗保健提供者讨论筛查的好处和可能的危害，并提供密切监测作为低风险癌症的初步方法。

paras.en: "We know how to cure 95% of them," said Tewari, referring to prostate cancer patients. "I can operate, we have developed medications … to get to them in time, my approach is very simple: Go right where they are."
paras.zh: “我们知道如何治愈其中 95% 的患者，”特瓦里说，他指的是前列腺癌患者。 “我可以操作，我们已经开发出药物……为了及时找到它们，我的方法非常简单：就在它们所在的地方。”

paras.en: To reach more men, Tewari and Mount Sinai have created mobile prostate cancer screening vehicles that are deployed in neighborhoods so men can be examined where they live.
paras.zh: 为了惠及更多男性，特瓦里和西奈山创建了移动前列腺癌筛查车，部署在社区中，以便男性可以在他们居住的地方接受检查。

paras.en: The first bus, the Mount Sinai Robert F. Smith Mobile Prostate Cancer Screening Unit, was sent out in New York City in 2022. Last month, another bus was deployed to the Atlanta Falcons-Chicago Bears game at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta. The Winship Cancer Institute at Emory University offered free screenings in partnership with the Atlanta Falcons during the game.
paras.zh: 第一辆巴士是西奈山罗伯特·F·史密斯移动前列腺癌筛查中心，于 2022 年在纽约市派出。上个月，另一辆巴士被部署到亚特兰大梅赛德斯奔驰体育场举行的亚特兰大猎鹰队与芝加哥熊队的比赛中。埃默里大学温希普癌症研究所与亚特兰大猎鹰队在比赛期间合作提供免费筛查。

paras.en: Tewari and Mount Sinai are engaged in other ways to get the word out to men.
paras.zh: 特瓦里和西奈山正在通过其他方式向人们宣传这一信息。

paras.en: The ACS estimates that more than 333,000 men in the U.S. will be diagnosed in 2026, and about 36,000 will die from the disease.
paras.zh: ACS 估计，到 2026 年，美国将有超过 333,000 名男性被诊断出患有这种疾病，约 36,000 人将死于这种疾病。

paras.en: Last month, actress Brooke Shields joined Tewari and directed a public service announcement advocating screening and early detection. The goal is to screen more than one million men for prostate cancer under Tewari's Million Strong Men Initiative.
paras.zh: 上个月，女演员波姬·小丝 (Brooke Shields) 加入 Tewari 并执导了一项倡导筛查和早期发现的公共服务公告。 Tewari 的“百万强人计划”的目标是对超过 100 万男性进行前列腺癌筛查。

paras.en: "We need to be able to talk about ...down there," a son says to his father in the PSA video.
paras.zh: “我们需要能够谈论......在那里，”一个儿子在公益广告视频中对他的父亲说。

paras.en: "I never got to have the talk with my dad early enough," says Shields in the video. Her father, Frank, died of prostate cancer in 2003 at 61 years old.
paras.zh: “我从来没有足够早地和我父亲交谈，”希尔兹在视频中说道。她的父亲 Frank 于 2003 年因前列腺癌去世，享年 61 岁。

paras.en: "Prostate cancer is treatable when detected early," she adds.
paras.zh: “如果早期发现，前列腺癌是可以治疗的，”她补充道。

paras.en: "Prostate cancer is often a disease that families don't talk about until there is a reason to," said Tewari. "We want to change that. Starting the conversation early can give men an opportunity to learn about their risk, talk with their doctors about screening and act when appropriate."
paras.zh: “前列腺癌通常是一种家人不会谈论的疾病，除非有理由，”特瓦里说。 “我们希望改变这一点。尽早开始对话可以让男性有机会了解自己的风险，与医生讨论筛查并在适当的时候采取行动。”

paras.en: Prostate cancer is one of the most common cancers in men. The ACS estimates that more than 333,000 men in the U.S. will be diagnosed in 2026, and about 36,000 will die from the disease.
paras.zh: 前列腺癌是男性最常见的癌症之一。 ACS 估计，到 2026 年，美国将有超过 333,000 名男性被诊断出患有这种疾病，约 36,000 人将死于这种疾病。

articles.title: Eisenkot condemns Netanyahu’s ‘racist’ campaign against Israel’s Arab citizens
articles.author: William Christou

paras.en: Israeli prime ministerial hopeful Gadi Eisenkot condemned a “racist and aggressive campaign of delegitimisation” against the country’s Arab citizens, after the caretaker prime minister, Benjamin Netanyahu, accused Arab parties of electoral fraud without evidence.
paras.zh: 以色列总理候选人加迪·艾森科特谴责针对该国阿拉伯公民的“种族主义和侵略性非法化运动”，此前看守总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡在没有证据的情况下指责阿拉伯政党选举舞弊。

paras.en: Netanyahu has repeatedly targeted Arab parties and Palestinian citizens of Israel after his party received a disappointing electoral showing, accusing them of manipulating the election and being linked to Hamas. Israeli electoral authorities have rejected these claims as not being backed by evidence.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在其政党选举结果令人失望后，多次针对阿拉伯政党和以色列巴勒斯坦公民，指责他们操纵选举并与哈马斯有联系。以色列选举当局拒绝了这些说法，因为这些说法没有证据支持。

paras.en: Arab citizens of Israel, the vast majority of them of Palestinian descent, comprise more than 20% of the country’s population.
paras.zh: 以色列的阿拉伯公民占该国人口的 20% 以上，其中绝大多数具有巴勒斯坦血统。

paras.en: Shin Bet, Israel’s internal security branch, sought to question four Arab lawmakers, including the Arab-majority Ra’am party head, Mansour Abbas, leading to accusations that the security agency had become politicised.
paras.zh: 以色列内部安全部门辛贝特试图质询四名阿拉伯议员，其中包括阿拉伯占多数的拉姆党领袖曼苏尔阿巴斯，导致该安全机构被指责为政治化。

paras.en: “Arab citizens of Israel are an integral part of the Israeli story. The attempt to marginalise them and vilify them collectively is a profound violation of the principles of statesmanship,” Eisenkot said in a statement on Friday.
paras.zh: 艾森科特在周五的一份声明中表示：“以色列的阿拉伯公民是以色列故事不可或缺的一部分。试图将他们边缘化并集体诽谤他们的行为严重违反了政治家原则。”

paras.en: Eisenkot’s statement was a rare instance of a prominent Jewish political leader taking a strong stand in defence of Arab Israelis.
paras.zh: 艾森科特的声明是杰出犹太政治领袖为捍卫阿拉伯以色列人采取强硬立场的罕见例子。

paras.en: The statement also reflected political realities in Israel, as Arab parties found themselves kingmakers after the latest election. The two Arab-majority parties, Ra’am and the Joint List, secured 19 seats in the October election.
paras.zh: 该声明还反映了以色列的政治现实，因为阿拉伯政党在最近一次选举后发现自己成为了国王的缔造者。两个阿拉伯占多数的政党，Ra’am 和 Joint List，在 10 月份的选举中获得了 19 个席位。

paras.en: They have the potential to help Eisenkot form a governing coalition and become Israel’s next prime minister. If Eisenkot cannot form a coalition within 28 days, with a possible 14-day extension, the mandate to form a government would pass to another lawmaker, potentially Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 他们有潜力帮助艾森科特组建执政联盟并成为以色列下一任总理。如果艾森科特无法在 28 天内组建联合政府（可能会延长 14 天），那么组建政府的授权将移交给另一位议员，可能是内塔尼亚胡。

paras.en: Eisenkot has to balance the competing interests of several parties if he hopes to form a coalition. Rightwing elements of the opposition have pledged to drop their support of the prospective PM if he cooperates with Arab parties.
paras.zh: 艾森科特如果希望组建联合政府，就必须平衡多党的利益竞争。反对派的右翼分子承诺，如果未来的总理与阿拉伯政党合作，他们将放弃对他的支持。

paras.en: His statement on Friday portrayed a more statesman-like approach to ruling than his more rightwing, demagogic opponents who have used Arab parties and citizens as political scapegoats over the last three years.
paras.zh: 他周五的声明描绘了一种更像政治家的执政方式，而不是他的右翼、煽动性的对手，后者在过去三年中利用阿拉伯政党和公民作为政治替罪羊。

paras.en: “[Arab citizens] have been subjected to a racist and aggressive campaign of delegitimisation, fuelled by the outgoing prime minister and those around him for political purposes,” Eisenkot said in his statement.
paras.zh: 艾森科特在声明中表示：“在即将离任的总理及其周围人士出于政治目的的推动下，[阿拉伯公民]遭受了种族主义和侵略性的非法化运动。”

paras.en: “The prime minister of Israel is the prime minister of all Israeli citizens, including those who did not vote for him,” he added.
paras.zh: “以色列总理是所有以色列公民的总理，包括那些没有投票给他的人，”他补充道。

paras.en: Netanyahu and his allies have repeatedly criticised leaders of Arab parties for refusing to describe Hamas as a “terror group” after its unprecedented 7 October 2023 attack on Israel.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡及其盟友多次批评阿拉伯政党领导人在哈马斯于 2023 年 10 月 7 日对以色列发动前所未有的袭击后拒绝将其描述为“恐怖组织”。

paras.en: All leaders of Arab parties have condemned the attack, in which Arab Israelis – descendants of Palestinians who remained in what became Israel in 1948 – were also among those killed.
paras.zh: 所有阿拉伯政党领导人都谴责了这次袭击，遇害者中也包括阿拉伯以色列人——1948 年留在以色列境内的巴勒斯坦人的后裔。

paras.en: In a speech, Netanyahu falsely claimed that the two Arab lists sought to establish either an “Islamic state” or a “nationalist Palestinian state”.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在一次演讲中错误地声称，这两个阿拉伯国家名单旨在建立“伊斯兰国”或“民族主义巴勒斯坦国”。

paras.en: During the same ceremony, the national security minister, Itamar Ben Gvir, heckled Joint List’s leader, Yousef Jabareen, during his oath of allegiance, accusing him of having “pledged allegiance to Hamas”.
paras.zh: 在同一仪式上，国家安全部长伊塔马尔·本·格维尔 (Itamar Ben Gvir) 在联合名单领导人优素福·贾巴林 (Yousef Jabareen) 宣誓效忠时质问他，指责他“宣誓效忠哈马斯”。

paras.en: “It is entirely legitimate to disagree with representatives of the Arab parties, even to strongly disapprove of some of them. But it is neither legitimate nor acceptable to malign an entire community, and I will not allow it,” Eisenkot said.
paras.zh: “不同意阿拉伯政党代表的观点，甚至强烈反对其中一些代表，是完全合法的。但诽谤整个社区既不合法，也不可接受，我不会允许这样做，”艾森科特说。

paras.en: President Isaac Herzog tasked Eisenkot with forming a new government on Sunday after consultations in which a majority of political parties, including the two Arab lists, recommended him for the role.
paras.zh: 艾萨克·赫尔佐格总统周日责成艾森科特组建新政府。在磋商中，包括两个阿拉伯名单在内的大多数政党都推荐他担任这一职务。

paras.en: Israeli media has reported that Eisenkot has also been reaching out to the country’s ultra-Orthodox parties for a potential alliance. The issue of the ultra-Orthodox not serving in the Israeli military was one of the hot button issues during the October election, with Eisenkot previously saying they should also be included in the country’s mandatory draft.
paras.zh: 以色列媒体报道称，艾森科特还一直在与该国的极端正统政党接触，寻求潜在的联盟。极端正统派不在以色列军队服役的问题是十月选举期间的热点问题之一，艾森科特此前表示，他们也应该被纳入该国的强制征兵中。

articles.title: Choking fires, deadly heat and devastating floods: 2026 in extreme weather
articles.author: Jonathan Watts; graphics by Sara Fiorillo

paras.en: After the world’s hottest summer since records began in 1850, the death toll from extreme weather in 2026 is already in the high tens of thousands. That is a conservative estimate and is certain to rise much higher.
paras.zh: 在经历了自 1850 年有记录以来世界上最热的夏季之后，2026 年极端天气造成的死亡人数已高达数万人。这是一个保守的估计，并且肯定会上涨得更高。

paras.en: As Cop31 continues and scientists warn that climate breakdown may be accelerating, the Guardian looks back at a year of droughts, fires and floods as a reminder that, unless the world takes urgent action to cut emissions, this disastrous year will be one of the best of the rest of our lives.
paras.zh: 随着第三十一届缔约方会议的继续进行，科学家警告气候崩溃可能正在加速，《卫报》回顾了干旱、火灾和洪水的一年，提醒人们，除非世界采取紧急行动减少排放，否则这一灾难性的一年将是我们余生中最美好的一年。

paras.en: Extreme heat fuels wildfires in Australia
paras.zh: 极端高温助长澳大利亚野火

paras.en: As temperatures jump nearly 20C (68F) above average, Victoria and other southern states register new heat records, including 50C in Port Augusta and the tiny opal mining town of Andamooka. Melbourne hospitals report a 25% increase in heat-related illnesses, while authorities in many areas struggle with wildfires. Scientists say the supercharged climate has made the heatwave five times more likely. Heatwaves already cause more deaths in Australia than all other natural hazards combined.
paras.zh: 随着气温比平均水平高出近 20 摄氏度（68 华氏度），维多利亚州和其他南部各州创下了新的高温记录，其中包括奥古斯塔港和蛋白石采矿小镇安达穆卡的 50 摄氏度。墨尔本医院报告称，与高温相关的疾病增加了 25%，而许多地区的当局正在努力应对野火。科学家表示，过度的气候使热浪发生的可能性增加了五倍。热浪在澳大利亚造成的死亡人数已经超过了所有其他自然灾害的总和。

paras.en: Mudslides kill 72 in Brazil after record rain
paras.zh: 巴西创纪录降雨后泥石流造成72人死亡

paras.en: The city of Juiz de Fora in Minas Gerais records its wettest ever month, triggering landslides that sweep away hundreds of homes in poor communities on unstable hillsides. Floods also disrupt Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo. More than 10,000 people are displaced.
paras.zh: 米纳斯吉拉斯州的茹伊斯德福拉市迎来了有史以来最潮湿的一个月，引发山体滑坡，摧毁了不稳定山坡上贫困社区的数百所房屋。洪水还扰乱了里约热内卢和圣保罗。超过10,000人流离失所。

paras.en: Devastating floods across much of the world
paras.zh: 世界大部分地区发生毁灭性洪水

paras.en: In Ethiopia, at least 131 people are killed in floods and mudslides that bury entire villages. Eighty die in Kenya and 18 in Tanzania. The Arabian peninsula is battered by fierce winds and heavy downpours that flood the streets of the desert kingdom. Hailstones the size of tennis balls fall in Oman and lightning storms leave cities in the UAE inundated with water. Many areas report record rainfall. At least 30 die in Afghanistan as heavy rains trigger landslides. Hong Kong is soaked in twice the usual monthly precipitation. Flood waters in southern Russia submerge homes and leave more than 300,000 without electricity. Huge tracts of farmland are left underwater in Argentina and Chile.
paras.zh: 在埃塞俄比亚，洪水和泥石流掩埋了整个村庄，造成至少 131 人死亡。肯尼亚有 80 人死亡，坦桑尼亚有 18 人死亡。阿拉伯半岛遭受狂风和倾盆大雨的袭击，淹没了这个沙漠王国的街道。网球大小的冰雹落在阿曼，雷暴使阿联酋的城市被水淹没。许多地区报告降雨量创历史新高。阿富汗暴雨引发山体滑坡，造成至少 30 人死亡。香港每月的降水量是平常的两倍。俄罗斯南部的洪水淹没了房屋，导致超过 30 万居民断电。阿根廷和智利的大片农田被淹没在水下。

paras.en: World’s energy imbalance accelerates rapidly
paras.zh: 世界能源失衡加速加剧

paras.en: The World Meteorological Organization reveals an alarming buildup of energy in Earth’s system. More than 90% is stored in the oceans, where warming has more than doubled over the past two decades compared with the average over the previous 45 years. This makes weather more extreme and threatens health and food supplies. António Guterres, the UN secretary general, says: “The global climate is in a state of emergency. Planet Earth is being pushed beyond its limits. Every key climate indicator is flashing red.” Guterres urges the world to cut fossil fuel emissions as rapidly as possible to minimise future risks. However, CO2 in the atmosphere continues to rise.
paras.zh: 世界气象组织揭示了地球系统中能量的惊人积累。超过 90% 储存在海洋中，过去 20 年来海洋变暖程度是过去 45 年平均水平的两倍多。这使得天气变得更加极端，并威胁健康和粮食供应。联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯表示：“全球气候正处于紧急状态。地球正在超出其极限。每一个关键的气候指标都在闪烁红色。”古特雷斯敦促世界尽快减少化石燃料排放，以尽量减少未来的风险。然而，大气中的二氧化碳仍在持续上升。

paras.en: Super typhoon tears through Micronesia, Guam and Saipan
paras.zh: 超强台风席卷密克罗尼西亚、关岛和塞班岛

paras.en: At peak intensity on 12 April, Sinlaku registers a wind speed of 295km/h (183mph) – roughly the same as a Shinkansen bullet train and the joint highest recorded by a storm in the western Pacific basin so early in the year. It is also the deadliest in decades, killing 12, leaving 43,000 without power, forcing mass evacuation and causing $1.5bn (£1.1bn) in damages. This will remain one of the most powerful storms of 2026, superseded only by Super Typhoon Champi that will strike Taiwan and Japan in October.
paras.zh: 4 月 12 日，辛拉库的峰值强度达到 295 公里/小时（183 英里/小时），与新干线子弹头列车的风速大致相同，也是今年早些时候西太平洋盆地风暴记录的最高风速。这也是几十年来最严重的一次，造成 12 人死亡，43,000 人断电，迫使大规模疏散，并造成 15 亿美元（11 亿英镑）的损失。这仍将是 2026 年最强大的风暴之一，仅次于 10 月份袭击台湾和日本的超级台风“占比”。

paras.en: Hundreds of millions endure deadly heat in south Asia
paras.zh: 南亚数亿人忍受致命高温

paras.en: At least 47 heat-related deaths are reported in southern Asia as temperatures soar above 45C in several Indian and Bangladeshi cities, and hit a peak of 52C in Pakistan’s southern province of Sindh. Scientists warn that the climate crisis is exposing hundreds of millions of people in south Asia to longer, deadlier pre-monsoon heat.
paras.zh: 据报道，南亚地区至少有 47 人因高温死亡，印度和孟加拉国几个城市的气温飙升至 45 摄氏度以上，巴基斯坦南部信德省的最高气温达到 52 摄氏度。科学家警告说，气候危机使南亚数亿人面临季风前更长时间、更致命的高温。

paras.en: Sea surface temperature graphs begin to jag upwards and away from all previous highs on 21 June, starting a trend that will worsen over the rest of the year. This alarms scientists because oceans absorb more than 90% of the excess energy in Earth’s system. If the seas start to release that heat then the land and air will get warmer more quickly. This coincides with the emergence of the latest El Niño, which is confirmed on 2 June.
paras.zh: 6 月 21 日，海面温度图表开始急剧上升，远离之前的所有高点，开始出现一种在今年剩余时间里恶化的趋势。这让科学家们感到震惊，因为海洋吸收了地球系统 90% 以上的多余能量。如果海洋开始释放热量，那么陆地和空气就会更快变暖。这恰逢最近一次厄尔尼诺现象的出现，并于 6 月 2 日得到证实。

paras.en: Arctic and Antarctic swelter in unprecedented warmth
paras.zh: 北极和南极地区前所未有的酷热

paras.en: Instead of the usual winter snow and ice, scientists at the Esperanza base on the Trinity peninsula of Antarctica are astonished to see rain and dirt outside their windows after an eight-day heatwave that peaked with a record temperature of 15C on 6 June. At the other end of the planet, the Arctic experiences its warmest ever June. Beliy Island, Siberia, registers 28.3C on 25 June, the highest temperature ever recorded that far north in the Eurasian Arctic.
paras.zh: 南极洲三一半岛埃斯佩兰萨基地的科学家们惊讶地发现，在经历了为期八天的热浪之后，他们的窗外不再是平常的冬季冰雪，6月6日的最高气温达到创纪录的15摄氏度。在地球的另一端，北极正经历有史以来最温暖的六月。 6 月 25 日，西伯利亚贝利岛的气温达到 28.3 摄氏度，这是欧亚北极地区有记录以来的最高气温。

paras.en: Relentless rains claim almost 100 lives in west Africa from May to June. Record downpours of up to 140mm (5.5in) in a single day are made five times more likely and 23% more intense by the human-caused climate crisis. Floods and mudslides kill 59 in Côte d’Ivoire, 35 in Ghana and five in Togo.
paras.zh: 从 5 月到 6 月，西非的持续降雨夺去了近 100 人的生命。由于人为造成的气候危机，单日降雨量达到创纪录的 140 毫米（5.5 英寸）的倾盆大雨的可能性增加了五倍，强度增加了 23%。洪水和泥石流导致科特迪瓦 59 人死亡、加纳 35 人死亡、多哥 5 人死亡。

paras.en: Almost 1,000 wildfires sweep across Canada, charring 3m hectares (7.4m acres) and sending a haze of smoke as far as New York. On 15 July Toronto registers the world’s worst air quality as a result of the haze. Smoke kills 4,000 people in Canada each year, almost four times as many as at the start of the century. Meanwhile, in Europe, prolonged droughts create tinderbox conditions for wildfires in Greece, Portugal, Italy, Norway, Germany, Spain and France. They burn 686,000 hectares in Europe, twice the average of the past 20 years.
paras.zh: 近 1,000 场野火席卷了加拿大各地，烧焦了 300 万公顷（740 万英亩）土地，浓烟甚至蔓延至纽约。 7 月 15 日，多伦多因雾霾而出现世界上最糟糕的空气质量。加拿大每年有 4,000 人因烟雾死亡，几乎是本世纪初的四倍。与此同时，在欧洲，长期干旱为希腊、葡萄牙、意大利、挪威、德国、西班牙和法国的野火创造了易燃易爆的条件。欧洲烧毁面积达 686,000 公顷，是过去 20 年平均面积的两倍。

paras.en: Extreme weather disrupts US 250th birthday festivities and the World Cup
paras.zh: 极端天气扰乱了美国250岁生日庆祝活动和世界杯

paras.en: Half of the US population is under a heat alert before 4 July independence celebrations, disrupting Donald Trump’s Great American State Fair on the National Mall in Washington and other events. Dozens of heat-related deaths are reported and thousands experience power cuts.
paras.zh: 在 7 月 4 日独立庆祝活动之前，一半的美国人口处于高温警报状态，扰乱了唐纳德·特朗普在华盛顿国家广场举办的伟大美国州博览会和其他活动。据报道，已有数十人因高温死亡，数千人遭遇断电。

paras.en: At least nine World Cup games are played in potentially dangerous heat and humidity, while fierce storms delay three matches by more than an hour, including Mexico v England.
paras.zh: 至少有九场世界杯比赛是在潜在危险的高温和潮湿环境下进行的，而猛烈的暴风雨使三场比赛推迟了一个多小时，其中包括墨西哥对阵英格兰的比赛。

paras.en: Nepal glacier collapse kills at least 1,300
paras.zh: 尼泊尔冰川崩塌造成至少1300人死亡

paras.en: Lhende Khola river valley communities are swept away after a 2 sq km (0.8 sq miles) slab of rock and glacier ice falls 1,400 metres (4,600ft) in the Himalayas, triggering a flood of water and debris. More than 5,000 people are missing and 8,600 need medical attention. Scientists say unusually warm temperatures and long-term permafrost degradation owing to the climate crisis were among the likely causes of the catastrophe.
paras.zh: 喜马拉雅山 2 平方公里（0.8 平方英里）的岩石和冰川从 1,400 米（4,600 英尺）处落下，引发洪水和碎片，Lhende Khola 河谷社区被冲走。超过 5,000 人失踪，8,600 人需要医疗救助。科学家表示，气候危机导致的异常温暖的气温和长期的永久冻土退化是这场灾难的可能原因之一。

paras.en: Europe’s murderous heat forces reactor shutdown
paras.zh: 欧洲酷热迫使反应堆关闭

paras.en: The UK and France are among a host of nations that swelter through the warmest summer (June to August) in European history. The heat kills an estimated 50,000 people in cities across the continent. Two-thirds of those excess deaths are attributable to the climate crisis. Many more are likely to have died in rural areas. As droughts spread, Romania is forced to shut down its only nuclear power station because the cooling system could not be replenished by low water levels in the Danube River.
paras.zh: 英国和法国等国家都经历了欧洲历史上最温暖的夏季（六月至八月）。据估计，非洲大陆各城市有 50,000 人死于高温。其中三分之二的超额死亡可归因于气候危机。更多的人可能死于农村地区。随着干旱蔓延，罗马尼亚被迫关闭其唯一的核电站，因为多瑙河的低水位无法补充冷却系统。

paras.en: Hundreds are killed and millions evacuated as the world’s most populous continent experiences its hottest September and severe storms. Typhoon Dujuan kills at least 10 people in Japan, with violent winds of 144km/h and 832mm of rain in only 48 hours on the island of Izu Oshima. Three die in a mudslide in eastern China during Typhoon Saudel. At least 102 are killed in India and Nepal amid rain that is nine times the norm in some places. Eight die and half a million are affected by flooding in Bangkok, Thailand.
paras.zh: 世界上人口最多的大陆经历了最热的九月和严重的风暴，数百人丧生，数百万人撤离。台风杜娟在日本造成至少10人死亡，伊豆大岛仅48小时内就遭遇时速144公里的狂风和832毫米的降雨。台风“萨德尔”期间，中国东部发生泥石流，造成三人死亡。印度和尼泊尔的降雨量是正常水平的九倍，造成至少 102 人死亡。泰国曼谷洪水泛滥，造成 8 人死亡、50 万人受灾。

paras.en: Governments warned to brace for peak El Niño
paras.zh: 各国政府警告要为厄尔尼诺现象高峰做好准备

paras.en: The UN disaster relief agency urges countries to prepare for an unprecedented “wrecking ball” El Niño that is forecast to peak around the end of the year. UK authorities advise households to stockpile a few days of basic supplies. Climate scientists project more than 450,000 people globally will die by February as a result of the additional heat brought by the super El Niño.
paras.zh: 联合国救灾机构敦促各国做好准备，应对史无前例的“破坏球”厄尔尼诺现象，预计该现象将在今年年底左右达到顶峰。英国当局建议家庭储备几天的基本用品。气候科学家预计，到 2 月份，全球将有超过 45 万人因超级厄尔尼诺现象带来的额外热量而死亡。

paras.en: Protests in Indonesia after deadly fires
paras.zh: 印度尼西亚发生致命火灾后举行抗议活动

paras.en: Demonstrators in Jakarta protest against Indonesia’s worst fire season in a decade, which has scorched almost 2m hectares of forest – more than twice as big an area as last year. The choking haze is estimated to have killed 3,560 people in one month alone.
paras.zh: 雅加达的示威者抗议印度尼西亚十年来最严重的火灾季节，这场火灾已经烧毁了近 200 万公顷的森林，面积是去年的两倍多。据估计，仅一个月内，令人窒息的雾霾就已造成 3,560 人死亡。

paras.en: After the heaviest October rainfall in 76 years, the Chilean government declares the Santiago district of Las Condes a “disaster zone”, with more than 1,000 people evacuated from their homes, some by helicopter.
paras.zh: 在经历了 76 年来最严重的 10 月份降雨之后，智利政府宣布圣地亚哥拉斯孔德斯地区为“灾区”，1000 多人从家中撤离，其中一些人乘坐直升机撤离。

paras.en: Drought and fire in the Amazon rainforest
paras.zh: 亚马逊雨林的干旱和火灾

paras.en: Months of drought leave some of the world’s mightiest rivers, including the Rio Negro, Madeira and Tapajós, close to record low levels, curtailing the water transport of essential goods. This coincides with a sharp rise in fire activity in the central and eastern Amazon region, releasing so much smoke that the city of Manaus registers the second-worst air quality in the world on 12 October.
paras.zh: 数月的干旱导致内格罗河、马德拉河和塔帕若斯河等世界上一些最强大的河流水位接近历史最低水平，从而限制了必需品的水路运输。与此同时，亚马逊中部和东部地区的火灾活动急剧增加，释放出大量烟雾，导致马瑙斯市在 10 月 12 日出现世界第二差的空气质量。

paras.en: 2026 is forecast to be one of the hottest years in history
paras.zh: 预计 2026 年将是历史上最热的年份之一

paras.en: Global temperatures tie an all-time record of 2.04C above preindustrial levels, which was set in 2023. This year is forecast to be one of the four warmest years in history, along with 2023, 2024 and 2025. Sea surface temperatures are so high that the climate scientist Eliot Jacobson calculates the odds of being this far above the norm at 33tn to one. Meanwhile, the amount of CO2 in the atmosphere reaches a peak not seen in 2m years. On the plus side, global fossil fuel emissions are likely to fall this year thanks to a shift away from oil and gas owing to high prices after the US-Israeli attack on Iran, and ever cheaper renewable alternatives.
paras.zh: 全球气温与 2023 年创下的比工业化前水平高 2.04 摄氏度的历史纪录持平。预计今年将是历史上最热的四个年份之一，另外两个年份是 2023 年、2024 年和 2025 年。海洋表面温度如此之高，以至于气候科学家艾略特·雅各布森 (Eliot Jacobson) 计算出远高于正常水平的几率为 33 比 1。与此同时，大气中的二氧化碳含量达到了200万年以来的最高点。从好的方面来说，由于美以袭击伊朗后价格高企，人们不再使用石油和天然气，而且可再生能源替代品变得越来越便宜，今年全球化石燃料排放量可能会下降。

articles.title: How a US extradition bid over Hamas allegations put a wealthy activist before a Spanish court
articles.author: Timothy Pratt

paras.en: A two-hour hearing in Spain’s high court Friday on the US extradition request of wealthy leftwing activist and philanthropist James “Fergie” Chambers turned out to be a study in contrasts.
paras.zh: 周五，西班牙高等法院就美国引渡富有的左翼活动家和慈善家詹姆斯·“菲姬”·钱伯斯的请求举行了两个小时的听证会，结果证明这是一项对比研究。

paras.en: Chambers’s defense took most of the session to query the US citizen and detail irregularities in the Trump administration’s extradition request – several of which the Guardian has reported on – as well as the figures of Spanish law that would lead the three-judge panel to deny the request; while the prosecutor sped through his case, head down, asking Chambers no questions at all.
paras.zh: 钱伯斯的辩护律师在会议的大部分时间里询问了这位美国公民，并详细说明了特朗普政府引渡请求中的违规行为（《卫报》已经报道了其中几起事件），以及导致三名法官组成的小组拒绝引渡请求的西班牙法律数据；而检察官则低着头，快速审理他的案件，根本没有向钱伯斯提出任何问题。

paras.en: Notably, neither the judges or the prosecutor asked Chambers to address the insinuation in the extradition request that the wealthy activist had supported Hamas. Chambers’s case is the first known instance of the US seeking to extradite a citizen over alleged support for Hamas, an accusation apparently tied to an international money laundering charge and donations to organizations helping Palestinians in Gaza.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，法官和检察官都没有要求钱伯斯回应引渡请求中暗示这位富有的活动人士支持哈马斯的问题。钱伯斯的案件是美国因涉嫌支持哈马斯而寻求引渡公民的第一起已知案件，这一指控显然与国际洗钱指控和向帮助加沙巴勒斯坦人的组织捐款有关。

paras.en: But the defense’s queries did allow him to speak for the first time since his 10 July arrest in Ibiza about events at the center of the case: 2023 protests against Israeli weapons manufacturer Elbit in Massachusets and New Hampshire and 2024 transfers of $7.2m to Tunisia, where he lived at the time. The latter was buttressed with testimony from a financial expert.
paras.zh: 但辩方的询问确实让他自 7 月 10 日在伊维萨岛被捕以来首次谈论了案件的核心事件：2023 年马萨诸塞州和新罕布什尔州针对以色列武器制造商埃尔比特的抗议活动，以及 2024 年向他当时居住的突尼斯转移的 720 万美元。后者得到了一位金融专家的证词的支持。

paras.en: On the whole, Chambers painted a picture different from the depiction contained in the extradition request, that of a violent backer of Hamas on the run from the US. At one point, he noted that his family’s next door neighbor in Tunis was the US ambassador.
paras.zh: 总体而言，钱伯斯描绘了一幅与引渡请求中所描述的不同的画面，即一名哈马斯的暴力支持者正在逃离美国。有一次，他指出他家在突尼斯的隔壁邻居是美国大使。

paras.en: The court will decide next week on extraditing Chambers. If the decision is affirmative, Spain’s council of ministers can reverse the court’s decision. This means Chambers’s extradition may be among the last decisions made under Pedro Sánchez, the socialist prime minister, before national elections on 29 November.
paras.zh: 法院将于下周就引渡钱伯斯做出决定。如果裁决是肯定的，西班牙部长会议可以推翻法院的裁决。这意味着引渡钱伯斯可能是社会党总理佩德罗·桑切斯 (Pedro Sánchez) 在 11 月 29 日全国选举之前做出的最后决定之一。

paras.en: Friday’s hearing began with Chambers’s defense asking about his wealth. A self-described communist and anti-imperialist, Chambers sold stock back to his family’s business, Atlanta-based Cox Enterprises, worth about $250m in mid-2023.
paras.zh: 周五的听证会开始时，钱伯斯的辩护律师询问了他的财富情况。钱伯斯自称是共产主义者和反帝国主义者，他在 2023 年中期将股票卖回给其家族企业、总部位于亚特兰大的考克斯企业 (Cox Enterprises)，价值约 2.5 亿美元。

paras.en: Then he started a foundation, he told the court. He and the foundation’s three-member board decide on funding and ensure that no projects seeking support are under US sanctions, Chambers said. The foundation has funded an estimated 100 progressive and humanitarian projects in 20 countries, according to his partner, activist and actor Stella Schnabel – including, Chambers said Friday, organizations in Gaza working on issues such as “medical treatment for children, transportation out of dangerous areas and clean water and food”.
paras.zh: 他告诉法庭，然后他成立了一个基金会。钱伯斯说，他和该基金会的三人董事会决定资金，并确保寻求支持的项目不会受到美国制裁。据他的合作伙伴、活动家兼演员斯特拉·施纳贝尔称，该基金会已资助了 20 个国家的大约 100 个进步和人道主义项目，钱伯斯周五表示，其中包括加沙的一些组织，致力于“儿童医疗、危险地区运输以及清洁水和食品”等问题。

paras.en: Two of the request’s three charges – riot and conspiracy to riot – are related to the late-2023 protests against Elbit.
paras.zh: 该请求的三项指控中的两项——骚乱和阴谋骚乱——与 2023 年末针对埃尔比特的抗议活动有关。

paras.en: Chambers detailed his participation in the protests: locking himself to a door, marching in the street and – in New Hampshire – standing in the road, speaking to the media and paying bail for four protesters who were eventually found guilty of misdemeanor charges and served 30 days in jail.
paras.zh: 钱伯斯详细描述了他参与抗议活动的情况：将自己锁在门上，在街上游行，以及在新罕布什尔州站在路上向媒体发表讲话，并为四名抗议者支付保释金，这四名抗议者最终被判犯有轻罪，并入狱 30 天。

paras.en: As for the $7.2m, the defense and a financial expert serving as a witness laid out how ten bank transfers from the US to Tunisia mostly went to sponsor the football club Club Africain – described by Chambers as “one of the largest football clubs in Africa” – and a sporting business Chambers launched while living in Tunisia.
paras.zh: 至于这 720 万美元，辩方和作为证人的金融专家列出了从美国到突尼斯的 10 笔银行转账，大部分用于赞助足球俱乐部非洲俱乐部（钱伯斯形容为“非洲最大的足球俱乐部之一”）以及钱伯斯在突尼斯生活期间创办的体育企业。

paras.en: “Is there any indication that the money went to support terrorist activities?” asked defense attorney Aitor Martínez. “None,” said financial expert Albert Deulofeu Schilt.
paras.zh: “有任何迹象表明这些钱用于支持恐怖活动吗？”辩护律师艾托·马丁内斯问道。 “没有，”金融专家阿尔伯特·德乌洛费乌·希尔特 (Albert Deulofeu Schilt) 说。

paras.en: Then, in about 15 minutes of rapid-fire monotone, prosecutor Juan Hernández Villalba laid out a wholly different picture of Chambers as backing “an organized structure … aimed at repeatedly committing illegal acts … together with funds destined for terrorist organizations”.
paras.zh: 然后，在大约 15 分钟的连珠炮般的单调中，检察官胡安·埃尔南德斯·比利亚尔巴 (Juan Hernández Villalba) 描绘了一幅完全不同的钱伯斯画面：支持“一个有组织的结构……旨在反复实施非法行为……以及用于恐怖组织的资金”。

paras.en: He accused the defense of laying out the facts of the case “in a fragmented way … when what’s most relevant is an evaluation of the whole picture”.
paras.zh: 他指责辩方“以支离破碎的方式陈述案件事实……而最相关的是对整个情况的评估”。

paras.en: “The extradition petition isn’t based on ideology or political statements, but on actions [Chambers] organized, financed and carried out, causing material damage,” Hernández Villalba asserted.
paras.zh: “引渡请愿不是基于意识形态或政治声明，而是基于[钱伯斯]组织、资助和实施的行动，造成了物质损失，”埃尔南德斯·比利亚尔巴断言。

paras.en: The actions against Elbit “were presented as a simple protest”, he said. “Nevertheless, the actions described by the US were planned for days … with objectively violent content.”
paras.zh: 他说，针对埃尔比特的行动“只是一次简单的抗议”。 “尽管如此，美国描述的行动是计划了数天的……客观上包含暴力内容。”

paras.en: Given all this, the prosecutor said, “there are more than enough indications to consider … that [Chambers’s] funding was aimed at terrorism”.
paras.zh: 检察官表示，鉴于这一切，“有足够多的迹象可以考虑……[钱伯斯]的资金是针对恐怖主义的”。

paras.en: Among the 100-plus people in varying time zones following Friday’s hearing on the court’s YouTube channel was Irish film-maker and journalist Sinéad O’Shea, whose documentary on Chambers called All About the Money makes its New York premiere this weekend. It covers the time period cited by the FBI affidavit underpinning the US request. O’Shea said that extradition case “builds a false narrative which begins with the protest in New Hampshire – a piece of vandalism at worst and for which people ended up serving 30 days. I saw myself the football club in which he invested in Tunisia and his donations to Palestinian and other charities are a matter of public record. It is impossible not to see this as a politically motivated case.”
paras.zh: 周五在法庭 YouTube 频道上举行听证会后，来自不同时区的 100 多人中包括爱尔兰电影制片人和记者 Sinéad O’Shea，她的关于钱伯斯的纪录片《All About the Money》将于本周末在纽约首映。它涵盖了支持美国请求的联邦调查局宣誓书所引用的时间段。奥谢表示，引渡案“建立了一个虚假的叙述，从新罕布什尔州的抗议活动开始，最严重的是一场破坏行为，人们最终被判入狱 30 天。我看到了他在突尼斯投资的足球俱乐部，他对巴勒斯坦和其他慈善机构的捐款是公开记录的问题。不可能不将此视为出于政治动机的案件。”

paras.en: Chambers’s views have been extensively profiled in US media. A week after the 7 October 2023 Hamas attacks on Israel, he posted on X about Israel’s response: “Stop calling it ‘collective punishment’/There’s nothing to be ‘punished’ for/No faction of the Palestinian resistance, Hamas or other, has done *anything* wrong/It’s simply genocide/Like it has been.”
paras.zh: 钱伯斯的观点已被美国媒体广泛报道。 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯袭击以色列一周后，他在 X 上发布了以色列的回应：“别再称其为‘集体惩罚’/没有什么可‘惩罚’的/巴勒斯坦抵抗运动的任何派别，哈马斯或其他人，都没有做错*任何事情/这只是种族灭绝/就像过去一样。”

paras.en: Dressed in dark jeans, a grey-blue shirt, a black jacket, with a close-cropped haircut and mustache, Chambers got the last word during the hearing.
paras.zh: 钱伯斯身穿深色牛仔裤、灰蓝色衬衫、黑色夹克，留着短发，留着小胡子，在听证会上作了最后发言。

paras.en: “To this day I cannot understand why I have been in prison since July for what amounts to speaking emotionally and committing minor offenses of public disturbance,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“直到今天，我仍无法理解为什么我自 7 月以来就因为情绪激动的言论和轻微的扰乱公共秩序罪而被关进监狱。”

paras.en: “I’ve never had any contact with any terrorist organization. I’ve certainly never financed any terrorist organization … and for this my family has been torn apart. I missed my grandmother’s funeral last week. My five-year-old son asks where I am every day. And my wife will give birth, God willing, in March – and I don’t know if I will be by her side.”
paras.zh: “我从未与任何恐怖组织有过任何接触。我当然从未资助过任何恐怖组织……为此，我的家庭已经支离破碎。我上周错过了祖母的葬礼。我五岁的儿子每天都问我在哪里。上帝保佑，我的妻子将在三月生下孩子——我不知道我是否会在她身边。”

paras.en: “[All] because I have spoken my mind, and I had a lot more money than others who have spoken their mind, in my country. And that’s all it amounts to.”
paras.zh: “[全部]因为我已经说出了自己的想法，而且在我的国家，我比其他说出自己想法的人有更多的钱。仅此而已。”

articles.title: Copper wire upgrade caused nationwide flight suspension, US transport secretary says

paras.en: A nationwide US ground stop that caused thousands of flight cancellations was caused by an issue following a copper wire upgrade, Transport Secretary Sean Duffy said.
paras.zh: 运输部长肖恩·达菲表示，美国全国范围内的一次地面停靠导致数千架航班取消，原因是铜线升级后出现问题。

paras.en: Duffy told a news conference that the government was trying to find out whether the problem was caused by "incompetence" on the part of the company doing the upgrades, or faulty equipment.
paras.zh: 达菲在新闻发布会上表示，政府正在试图查明问题是否是由于进行升级的公司“无能”或设备故障造成的。

paras.en: The US government does not believe it was as a result of a cyber-attack, although an investigation is still under way, Duffy said.
paras.zh: 达菲表示，美国政府不认为这是网络攻击造成的，但调查仍在进行中。

paras.en: Friday's suspension was the longest such incident since the 11 September 2001 attacks on the US and the disruption is expected to last for days.
paras.zh: 周五的中断是自 2001 年 9 月 11 日美国遭受袭击以来最长的此类事件，预计中断将持续数天。

paras.en: Maintenance was being carried out to switch from copper wire to fibre by a contractor called L3Harris, a technology provider company, Duffy said.
paras.zh: Duffy 表示，一家名为 L3Harris 的技术提供商公司承包商正在进行维护工作，以从铜线切换到光纤。

paras.en: The US has "an incredibly old telecommunications system", he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，美国拥有“极其古老的电信系统”。

paras.en: "It was such an old wire that it was being discontinued," he said.
paras.zh: “这是一种非常旧的电线，以至于已经停产了，”他说。

paras.en: The transport secretary explained that a router that was being worked on had started flooding other air traffic control systems and created communication issues with planes which led the government to shut down the airspace for safety reasons.
paras.zh: 交通部长解释说，正在开发的路由器已经开始淹没其他空中交通管制系统，并造成与飞机的通信问题，导致政府出于安全原因关闭了空域。

paras.en: Bryan Bedford, who heads the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), told the same news conference: "We see zero evidence of anything nefarious, and zero evidence of anything AI related."
paras.zh: 美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 负责人布莱恩·贝德福德 (Bryan Bedford) 在同一场新闻发布会上表示：“我们看到任何邪恶行为的证据为零，任何与人工智能相关的证据也为零。”

paras.en: No flights were allowed to take off from the continental US for more than four hours from 15:54 EST (19:54 GMT) on Friday.
paras.zh: 自周五美国东部时间 15:54（格林尼治标准时间 19:54）起超过四个小时，不允许任何航班从美国大陆起飞。

paras.en: More than 3,500 flights were cancelled and more than 2,000 delayed in the US on Saturday, according to tracking website Flight Aware, as knock-on disruption continues.
paras.zh: 根据跟踪网站 Flight Aware 的数据，周六，美国有 3,500 多个航班被取消，2,000 多个航班延误，连锁干扰仍在继续。

paras.en: In some cases, passengers were left stuck inside planes on the tarmac, unable to take off or to return to the gates. Some international flights were allowed to depart US airports, in an apparent effort to clear space.
paras.zh: 在某些情况下，乘客被困在停机坪上的飞机内，无法起飞或返回登机口。一些国际航班被允许从美国机场起飞，显然是为了腾出空间。

paras.en: Duffy warned that a similar issue could arise again unless the US Congress approved upgrades to air traffic control infrastructure.
paras.zh: 达菲警告说，除非美国国会批准升级空中交通管制基础设施，否则类似的问题可能会再次出现。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump has requested $30.1bn for the upgrades. Both chambers of Congress are currently controlled by the Republican Party.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普已要求拨款 301 亿美元用于升级。目前国会参众两院均由共和党控制。

paras.en: Former TSA Administrator John Pistole told the BBC that "the fact that they were able to get it restarted in four-and-a-half hours is good news - it shows a resilience in the system - but what's to say it's not going to happen tomorrow?"
paras.zh: 运输安全管理局前局长约翰·皮斯托尔 (John Pistole) 告诉 BBC，“他们能够在四个半小时内重新启动系统，这是个好消息 - 它显示了系统的弹性 - 但怎么能说明天就不会发生呢？”

paras.en: A nationwide ground stop has only been ordered one other time since all flights were banned from take-off for several days following the 11 September 2001 attacks.
paras.zh: 自 2001 年 9 月 11 日袭击事件发生后数天所有航班均禁止起飞以来，仅曾下令在全国范围内进行一次地面停飞。

articles.title: Sotheby's auction of $180m Van Gogh challenged over claims it was 'sold under duress'

paras.en: Auction house Sotheby's says it is working to resolve a dispute over the intended sale of a painting by Vincent van Gogh.
paras.zh: 拍卖行苏富比表示，正在努力解决有关文森特·梵高画作拟出售的争议。

paras.en: ChÃ¢taigniers en Fleurs, which carries an estimate of $180m (Â£136m), is due to go under the hammer in New York on Wednesday.
paras.zh: Châtaigniers en Fleurs 的估价为 1.8 亿美元（1.36 亿英镑），定于周三在纽约进行拍卖。

paras.en: But representatives acting for heirs of the Fischer family - earlier German owners of the work - say it may have been sold under duress during the rise of the Nazis.
paras.zh: 但代表费舍尔家族继承人（该作品的早期德国所有者）的代表表示，该作品可能是在纳粹崛起期间被迫出售的。

paras.en: Sotheby's say its own "extensive research" has not established this, but say they will work with the family to try and reach a solution.
paras.zh: 苏富比表示，其自己的“广泛研究”尚未证实这一点，但表示他们将与家人合作，尝试达成解决方案。

paras.en: "Sotheby's takes provenance and restitution matters extremely seriously and has undertaken extensive research into the ownership history of ChÃ¢taigniers en fleurs," Sotheby's told the BBC in a statement.
paras.zh: 苏富比在一份声明中告诉英国广播公司：“苏富比非常重视出处和归还问题，并对 Châtaigniers en fleurs 的所有权历史进行了广泛的研究。”

paras.en: "We are aware of the concerns recently raised by representatives of the Fischer heirs and have been in dialogue with them regarding the painting's history.
paras.zh: “我们意识到费舍尔继承人代表最近提出的担忧，并一直在与他们就这幅画的历史进行对话。

paras.en: "While our research to date has not established that the painting was sold under duress, we recognize the importance of engaging thoughtfully and constructively with the family and are committed to working toward a mutually satisfactory resolution."
paras.zh: “虽然我们迄今为止的研究尚未证实这幅画是在胁迫下出售的，但我们认识到与家人进行深思熟虑和建设性接触的重要性，并致力于达成双方都满意的解决方案。”

paras.en: The painting - whose name translates as Blossoming Chestnut Trees - is being sold as part of a set called the Blaquier-Arrieta Collection.
paras.zh: 这幅画的名字翻译为《开花的栗子树》，作为 Blaquier-Arrieta 系列的一部分出售。

paras.en: Sotheby's website details the provenance of the oil painting and how it has researched the artwork changing hands since 1890.
paras.zh: 苏富比网站详细介绍了这幅油画的出处，以及它如何研究自 1890 年以来这幅艺术品易手的情况。

paras.en: It says Samuel Fischer - a famous German publisher - acquired it 1909 before it was passed down in his family after his death in 1934.
paras.zh: 据称，德国著名出版商塞缪尔·费舍尔 (Samuel Fischer) 于 1909 年获得了这本书，并于 1934 年去世后在他的家族中传承下来。

paras.en: The painting was deposited with Paul Cassirer in Amsterdam in 1932 or 1933 before it went to Henriette and Marcel Kapferer in Paris in 1936, Sotherby's says.
paras.zh: 苏瑟比拍卖行称，这幅画于 1932 年或 1933 年存放在阿姆斯特丹的保罗·卡西尔 (Paul Cassirer) 手中，随后于 1936 年被巴黎的亨利埃特·卡普费雷尔 (Henriette Kapferer) 和马塞尔·卡普费雷尔 (Marcel Kapferer) 收藏。

paras.en: Four other owners have had it since before it was put up for auction this year.
paras.zh: 在今年它被拍卖之前，其他四位所有者就已经拥有它。

paras.en: Fischer family heirs have instructed a lawyer who, according to the New York Times, external, has written to Sotherby's.
paras.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，费舍尔家族的继承人已委托一名外部律师致函苏瑟比拍卖行。

paras.en: He is said to have told the auction house the painting was sold in Amsterdam before World War Two because of financial losses the Fischer family's publishing company suffered under the Nazis.
paras.zh: 据说他告诉拍卖行，这幅画是在第二次世界大战前在阿姆斯特丹出售的，因为费舍尔家族的出版公司在纳粹统治下遭受了经济损失。

paras.en: The BBC has contacted the lawyer for comment.
paras.zh: BBC 已联系该律师征求意见。

articles.title: Philippines wins first Eurovision Song Contest Asia

paras.en: The Philippines have won the very first Eurovision Song Contest Asia, hosted in Bangkok and with 11 countries vying for the title.
paras.zh: 菲律宾赢得了在曼谷举办的首届亚洲欧洲歌唱大赛冠军，共有 11 个国家参与争夺冠军头衔。

paras.en: Nineteen-year-old singer Carmelle was always a front runner with her women's empowerment anthem Sobra-Sobra, complete with its catchy rap section.
paras.zh: 十九岁的歌手卡梅尔（Carmelle）凭借她的女性赋权歌曲《Sobra-Sobra》以及朗朗上口的说唱部分一直是领跑者。

paras.en: She earned 211 points in total - 93 from the jury and 118 from the public vote - ahead of Thailand's MANG x DAOU in second place with 170 points.
paras.zh: 她总共获得了 211 分，其中评审团得分为 93 分，公众投票得分为 118 分，领先于泰国选手 MANG x DAOU 的 170 分。

paras.en: There was a joyous atmosphere at the One Bangkok Arena as the crowd cheered the contestants and celebrated the popular winner.
paras.zh: 曼谷一号体育馆内洋溢着欢乐的气氛，人群为参赛者欢呼，庆祝这位受欢迎的获胜者。

paras.en: Carmelle, the youngest contestant in the competition, was an obvious favourite with the juries and the public despite strong showings from several nations.
paras.zh: 卡梅尔是本次比赛中最年轻的参赛者，尽管来自多个国家的选手都表现出色，但她显然受到了评审团和公众的青睐。

paras.en: Other notable acts included MANG x DAOU, whose emotive duet Aroma elicited huge cheers from the home crowd.
paras.zh: 其他值得注意的表演包括 MANG x DAOU，他们情感丰富的二重唱《Aroma》引起了主场观众的热烈欢呼。

paras.en: Bangladeshi beatboxers Beatmosphere eschewed the traditional backing track, instead using their voices to replicate the sounds of drums and basslines.
paras.zh: 孟加拉国 Beatbox 歌手 Beatmosphere 避开了传统的背景音乐，而是用他们的声音来复制鼓和贝斯线的声音。

paras.en: And Laos's Thinla performed her crowd-pleasing song Bae in a traditional Lao hilltribe outfit.
paras.zh: 老挝的 Thinla 身着传统的老挝山地部落服装，表演了她广受观众喜爱的歌曲《Bae》。

paras.en: However, the Laotian song had a unintentional second outing after the music video was played over an apparent technical issue during the broadcast - meaning it was the last song the audience heard before the vote.
paras.zh: 然而，由于广播期间明显的技术问题，在播放音乐视频后，这首老挝歌曲无意中第二次出现——这意味着这是观众在投票前听到的最后一首歌曲。

paras.en: The voting system worked much the same as the European Eurovison, with the public vote accounting for 50% of the result and the other 50% coming from the 11 national juries - with additional points awarded from a rest of the world vote.
paras.zh: 投票系统与欧洲欧洲电视网的运作方式大致相同，公众投票占结果的 50%，另外 50% 来自 11 个国家评审团，另外还有来自世界其他地区投票的额外分数。

paras.en: Also performing during the broadcast was 2026 Eurovision Song Contest winner Dara from Bulgaria, who performed her winning song Bangaranga and new song Bad Idea.
paras.zh: 直播期间还有来自保加利亚的 2026 年欧洲歌唱大赛冠军达拉 (Dara) 表演，她演唱了获奖歌曲《Bangaranga》和新歌《Bad Idea》。

paras.en: Thai superstar Jeff Satur also made an appearance, hitting the high notes in his performance of Black Tie.
paras.zh: 泰国巨星杰夫·萨图尔 (Jeff Satur) 也悉数登场，在《Black Tie》中演绎高调。

paras.en: Eurovision in Asia was an idea that has been talked about for decades, but one that never seemed to materialise - despite many false starts - until now.
paras.zh: 亚洲欧洲歌唱大赛这个想法已经被讨论了几十年，但直到现在，尽管有许多错误的开始，这个想法似乎从未实现。

paras.en: There is a huge enthusiasm here for Eurovision Asia, but a large number of the audience were established fans of the original contest from other countries and regions of the world.
paras.zh: 这里对亚洲欧洲电视网有着巨大的热情，但大量观众是来自世界其他国家和地区的原版比赛的忠实粉丝。

paras.en: Speaking after the show, fan Zelie Pereira - who travelled from Scotland to Thailand to attend - said she was "very happy" with Carmelle's win.
paras.zh: 从苏格兰前往泰国参加演出的粉丝泽莉·佩雷拉 (Zelie Pereira) 在演出结束后表示，她对卡梅尔的胜利“非常高兴”。

paras.en: Korea, Vietnam and Laos also received praise from Pereira and her friends Michael Peters and Scarlett Massie, both from England.
paras.zh: 韩国、越南和老挝也得到了佩雷拉和她来自英国的朋友迈克尔·彼得斯和斯嘉丽·马西的赞扬。

paras.en: "It was amazing, a very high standard," said Massie.
paras.zh: “这太棒了，一个非常高的标准，”马西说。

paras.en: "The dance was amazing. The sets were amazing. The costumes were amazing. The singing was amazing. Incredible", Peters added.
paras.zh: “舞蹈太棒了。布景太棒了。服装太棒了。歌声太棒了。难以置信”，彼得斯补充道。

paras.en: They confidently declared that "Asia Vision" should be the name for next year's show.
paras.zh: 他们自信地宣称“亚洲视野”应该是明年展会的名称。

paras.en: For some, it seems the excitement for another edition is already building.
paras.zh: 对于一些人来说，似乎已经开始对另一版感到兴奋。

paras.en: However the crowd at the One Bangkok Arena thinned out not long after the Philippines singer Carmelle lifted the trophy.
paras.zh: 然而，在菲律宾歌手卡梅尔举起奖杯后不久，曼谷一号体育场的人群就稀疏了。

paras.en: The arena was crowded, but not full, and it's still not clear how much commitment there is among regional broadcasters to keep the contest going and expand it to more than 11 countries.
paras.zh: 竞技场很拥挤，但并没有满员，目前还不清楚地区广播公司有多少承诺来维持比赛并将其扩大到超过 11 个国家。

articles.title: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

paras.en: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery
paras.zh: 纸基摩擦材料如何为现代机械提供动力

paras.en: Have you ever wondered what enables everything from roaring construction machinery to agricultural machinery plowing the fields to industrial equipment shuttling through factories—the precise starting, smooth operation, and reliable braking they achieve?
paras.zh: 您有没有想过，从轰鸣的工程机械到耕地的农业机械，再到穿梭于工厂的工业设备，是什么让它们能够实现精确的启动、平稳的运行和可靠的制动？

paras.en: The answer lies in a seemingly insignificant yet crucial core component: friction material. It acts as the "safety guard" and "power link" of machinery, ensuring every brake is safe and effective, and every power transmission is smooth and flawless.
paras.zh: 答案就在于一个看似微不足道却至关重要的核心部件：摩擦材料。它充当机械的“安全卫士”和“动力纽带”，保证每一次制动都安全有效，每一次动力传递平稳无瑕。

paras.en: Among the vast family of friction materials, wet friction materials are becoming the new favorite in modern machinery due to their exceptional reliability, safety, and exceptionally long lifespan. Among wet materials, paper-based friction materials stand out as a leading force thanks to their excellent overall performance, cost-effectiveness, and broad application prospects.
paras.zh: 在众多的摩擦材料家族中，湿式摩擦材料因其卓越的可靠性、安全性和超长的使用寿命而成为现代机械的新宠。在湿式材料中，纸基摩擦材料以其优异的综合性能、成本效益和广阔的应用前景脱颖而出，成为主导力量。

paras.en: Today, let's delve deeper into the fascinating world of this "unsung hero"—paper-based friction materials.
paras.zh: 今天，让我们深入探究这个“无名英雄”——纸基摩擦材料的迷人世界。

paras.en: What is Paper-Based Friction Material? — A Sponge-Like Power Core
paras.zh: 什么是纸基摩擦材料？ — 海绵状动力核心

paras.en: Imagine a "sponge" with countless tiny pores—that's the most intuitive image of paper-based friction material.
paras.zh: 想象一下有无数微小孔隙的“海绵”——这就是纸基摩擦材料最直观的形象。

paras.en: It is a material with a reticular porous structure composed of three core components: reinforcing fibers, functional fillers, and a binder resin. This unique structure gives it extraordinary capabilities:
paras.zh: 它是一种具有网状多孔结构的材料，由增强纤维、功能填料和粘结剂树脂三种核心成分组成。这种独特的结构赋予了它非凡的功能：

paras.en: - Oil Storage Capacity: The porous structure acts like a miniature "oil depot," capable of storing large quantities of lubricant.
paras.zh: - 储油能力：多孔结构就像一个微型“油库”，能够储存大量润滑剂。

paras.en: - Dynamic Lubrication: When the friction plate and mating plate engage and are subjected to pressure, the lubricant within the material is instantly squeezed onto the friction surface, forming a tough lubricant film, enabling smooth, gentle "wet" friction.
paras.zh: - 动态润滑：当摩擦片和配合片接合并受到压力时，材料内的润滑剂立即被挤压到摩擦表面上，形成坚韧的润滑膜，从而实现平滑、温和的“湿”摩擦。

paras.en: - Self-Recovery: When the friction plates separate, the material rebounds like memory foam, "absorbing" the lubricant back into the pores, ready for the next operation.
paras.zh: - 自我恢复：当摩擦片分离时，材料会像记忆海绵一样反弹，将润滑剂“吸收”回毛孔中，为下一次操作做好准备。

paras.en: It is this dynamic cycle of "oil storage-oil squeezing-oil return" that allows paper-based friction materials to perform well in an oil bath environment, achieving a perfect combination of high durability and stable friction performance.
paras.zh: 正是这种“储油-挤油-回油”的动态循环，让纸基摩擦材料在油浴环境下表现良好，实现了高耐用性和稳定摩擦性能的完美结合。

paras.en: Exploring Core Performance: How Do Three Key Factors Affect It?
paras.zh: 探索核心绩效：三个关键因素如何影响它？

paras.en: The performance of paper-based friction materials is not static. Like a top athlete, its performance is influenced by the "field," "equipment," and "condition." Let's examine how these three key factors shape its performance.
paras.zh: 纸基摩擦材料的性能并不是静态的。就像顶级运动员一样，其表现受到“场地”、“装备”和“条件”的影响。让我们来看看这三个关键因素如何影响其性能。

paras.en: Factor 1: The "Stage Effect" of Lubricants
paras.zh: 因素一：润滑油的“阶段效应”

paras.en: Paper-based friction materials are highly sensitive to lubricants, and different lubricants create distinct "stages" for their performance. Even the same friction material can exhibit significantly different friction characteristics (especially the kinetic friction coefficient) when exposed to different lubricants.
paras.zh: 纸基摩擦材料对润滑剂高度敏感，不同的润滑剂为其性能创造了不同的“阶段”。即使是相同的摩擦材料，当接触不同的润滑剂时也会表现出明显不同的摩擦特性（尤其是动摩擦系数）。

paras.en: Figure 1: Kinetic friction coefficient curve for a paper-based friction material in gear oil
paras.zh: 图 1：纸基摩擦材料在齿轮油中的动摩擦系数曲线

paras.en: Figure 2: Dynamic friction coefficient curve of the same material in hydraulic oil
paras.zh: 图2：同材质在液压油中的动摩擦系数曲线

paras.en: Interpretation: The above chart clearly shows that the same material behaves very differently in gear oil and hydraulic fluid. Furthermore, various additives added to lubricating oils (such as dispersants and anti-wear agents) can interact complexly with the material surface, further affecting its friction properties. Therefore, choosing the right oil for paper-based friction materials is the first step in achieving optimal performance.
paras.zh: 解读：上图清楚地表明，相同的材料在齿轮油和液压油中的表现截然不同。此外，润滑油中添加的各种添加剂（如分散剂和抗磨剂）会与材料表面发生复杂的相互作用，进一步影响其摩擦性能。因此，为纸基摩擦材料选择合适的油是实现最佳性能的第一步。

paras.en: Density is a trump card for paper-based friction materials. It is directly related to the material's porosity, leading to a delicate balancing act in terms of performance.
paras.zh: 密度是纸基摩擦材料的王牌。它与材料的孔隙率直接相关，从而导致性能方面的微妙平衡。

paras.en: High density (low porosity) means a denser material, resulting in better strength and thermal conductivity, lower wear rate, and longer life. However, the downside is reduced oil storage capacity, which can lead to a lower coefficient of friction and compromise power transmission.
paras.zh: 高密度（低孔隙率）意味着材料更致密，从而具有更好的强度和导热性、更低的磨损率和更长的使用寿命。然而，其缺点是储油能力降低，这可能导致摩擦系数降低并损害动力传输。

paras.en: Low density (high porosity) means the material is more porous, resulting in greater oil storage capacity and a higher coefficient of friction, which can provide greater braking force or transmit torque. However, the downside is reduced mechanical strength and wear resistance, shortening service life.
paras.zh: 低密度（高孔隙率）意味着材料孔隙较多，从而产生更大的储油能力和更高的摩擦系数，从而可以提供更大的制动力或传递扭矩。但其缺点是机械强度和耐磨性降低，使用寿命缩短。

paras.en: Figure 3: Comparison of the dynamic coefficient of friction for materials of varying densities (Type 2 to Type 6, increasing density)
paras.zh: 图 3：不同密度材料的动摩擦系数比较（类型 2 至类型 6，密度增加）

paras.en: Figure 4: Comparison of wear rates of materials with different densities
paras.zh: 图4：不同密度材料的磨损率比较

paras.en: Interpretation: Figures 3 and 4 vividly illustrate this balancing act. There's no such thing as absolute good or bad, only suitability. When selecting a paper-based friction material, the optimal trade-off between friction coefficient and durability must be determined based on specific application requirements (e.g., high torque versus long life).
paras.zh: 解读：图3和图4生动地说明了这种平衡行为。没有绝对的好或坏，只有合适。选择纸基摩擦材料时，必须根据具体应用要求（例如高扭矩与长寿命）确定摩擦系数和耐用性之间的最佳权衡。

paras.en: Factor 3: Extreme Challenges of Operating Conditions
paras.zh: 因素三：运行条件的极端挑战

paras.en: In addition to oil type and density, actual operating conditions, such as surface pressure, sliding speed, and oil temperature, pose extreme challenges to paper-based friction materials. These factors directly affect the temperature of the friction interface, the thickness and stability of the oil film, and thus dynamically alter the coefficient of friction.
paras.zh: 除了油的类型和密度之外，实际操作条件，例如表面压力、滑动速度和油温，对纸基摩擦材料提出了极大的挑战。这些因素直接影响摩擦界面的温度、油膜的厚度和稳定性，从而动态地改变摩擦系数。

paras.en: Therefore, please remember: the coefficient of friction of a particular paper-based friction material is not a fixed value, but rather a performance range determined through extensive and repeated testing under specific operating conditions.
paras.zh: 因此，请记住：特定纸基摩擦材料的摩擦系数不是一个固定值，而是在特定操作条件下通过广泛和反复测试确定的性能范围。

paras.en: Broad Applications: Injecting a Powerful "Heart" into Machinery
paras.zh: 广泛应用：为机械注入强大的“心脏”

paras.en: Thanks to its excellent overall performance and customizability, Carlisle Brake & Friction's paper-based friction materials have been successfully applied to the core components of various heavy-duty machinery, becoming their powerful and reliable "heart."
paras.zh: 凭借其优异的综合性能和可定制性，卡莱制动摩擦材料纸基摩擦材料已成功应用于各类重型机械的核心部件，成为其强大而可靠的“心脏”。

paras.en: We understand that different machines and applications require significantly different friction materials. For example:
paras.zh: 我们了解不同的机器和应用需要截然不同的摩擦材料。例如：

paras.en: - Service brakes for construction machinery (such as excavators and loaders) require materials that provide a stable, powerful braking force under high loads to ensure safety.
paras.zh: - 工程机械（如挖掘机和装载机）的行车制动器需要能够在高负载下提供稳定、强大制动力的材料，以确保安全。

paras.en: - Powershift transmissions for agricultural machinery (such as tractors) require materials that provide smooth engagement and excellent heat resistance to handle frequent shifting.
paras.zh: - 农业机械（如拖拉机）的动力换档变速箱需要能够提供平稳接合和出色耐热性的材料，以应对频繁换档。

paras.en: - Clutches for industrial machinery require materials that respond quickly and have a long lifespan to ensure continuous and efficient operation of production lines.
paras.zh: - 工业机械离合器需要响应快且使用寿命长的材料，以确保生产线连续高效运行。

paras.en: To this end, Carlisle Brake & Friction has developed a series of special paper-based friction materials for different application scenarios, providing each customer with the most suitable and reliable solution.
paras.zh: 为此，卡莱制动摩擦开发了一系列针对不同应用场景的特种纸基摩擦材料，为每位客户提供最合适、最可靠的解决方案。

paras.en: Continuous Innovation, Driving the Future
paras.zh: 持续创新，驱动未来

paras.en: Technological advancement is endless. To meet increasingly demanding application requirements and broaden market prospects, Carlisle Brake & Friction remains at the forefront of innovation.
paras.zh: 技术进步永无止境。为了满足日益苛刻的应用要求并拓宽市场前景，Carlisle Brake & Friction 始终走在创新的前沿。

paras.en: We are not only continuously optimizing the formulation and processing of paper-based friction materials to push their performance limits, but are also actively exploring next-generation wet friction materials with even higher performance. These R&D efforts have made significant progress, aiming to provide global customers with more diverse and advanced options, driving the infinite possibilities of future machinery.
paras.zh: 我们不仅不断优化纸基摩擦材料的配方和加工工艺以突破其性能极限，而且还积极探索具有更高性能的下一代湿式摩擦材料。这些研发工作取得了重大进展，旨在为全球客户提供更多样化、更先进的选择，驱动未来机械的无限可能。

articles.title: Celebrating 100-Years with Medina Mayor and Employees

paras.en: Celebrating 100-Years with Medina Mayor and Employees
paras.zh: 与麦地那市长和员工一起庆祝 100 周年

paras.en: MEDINA, OHIO — September 24, 2025 — Carlisle Brake & Friction (CBF), a global leader in the development and manufacture of high-performance brake and friction solutions, today welcomed Medina Mayor Dennis Hanwell, Economic Development Director Kimberly Marshall, and Executive Director of the Medina Chamber of Commerce Jaclyn Ringstmeier, for a special photo op at the company’s headquarters, located at 920 Lake Road. The event was a commemorative celebration of CarlisleCBF’s 100-year anniversary and its enduring presence in the Medina community.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州梅迪纳 — 2025 年 9 月 24 日 — 高性能制动和摩擦解决方案开发和制造领域的全球领导者 Carlisle Brake & Friction (CBF) 今天欢迎梅迪纳市长 Dennis Hanwell、经济发展总监 Kimberly Marshall 和梅迪纳商会执行董事 Jaclyn Ringstmeier 在位于湖路 920 号的公司总部进行了特别合影。该活动是为了纪念 CarlisleCBF 成立 100 周年及其在麦地那社区的持久存在。

paras.en: The photo op featured Mayor Hanwell alongside Carlisle’s Operations Leader, David Smith, and a number of employees who have been with the company for decades. The occasion honored CarlisleCBF’s century of innovation and its deep roots in the Medina area, where it has been a significant employer and community partner.
paras.zh: 这张照片的主角是汉威尔市长、卡莱尔的运营负责人大卫·史密斯以及一些在公司工作了几十年的员工。此次活动旨在表彰 CarlisleCBF 的百年创新历程及其在麦地那地区的深厚根基，该公司一直是该地区重要的雇主和社区合作伙伴。

paras.en: "We are incredibly proud of our history and our strong connection to the city of Medina," said David Smith. "This milestone is a testament to the hard work and dedication of our employees, many of whom have been with us for decades. We are grateful for the continued support of Mayor Hanwell and the entire Medina community."
paras.zh: “我们对我们的历史以及我们与麦地那市的紧密联系感到无比自豪，”大卫·史密斯说。 “这一里程碑证明了我们员工的辛勤工作和奉献精神，其中许多人已经在我们身边工作了数十年。我们感谢汉威尔市长和整个麦地那社区的持续支持。”

paras.en: The photo op followed a recent employee and family event at the Medina plant that celebrated the 100-year milestone. The celebration was filled with games, face painting, food, and fun for all ages, reinforcing the company's commitment to its employees and their families.
paras.zh: 这张照片是在麦地那工厂最近举行的庆祝 100 周年里程碑的员工和家庭活动之后​​拍摄的。庆祝活动充满了适合各个年龄段的游戏、面部彩绘、美食和乐趣，强化了公司对员工及其家人的承诺。

paras.en: Mayor Hanwell expressed his gratitude for CarlisleCBF’s presence in the city. “Carlisle has been a part of the Medina community for nearly 65 years, providing good jobs and a strong economic foundation,” said Mayor Hanwell. "We are proud to celebrate their 100-year anniversary and recognize the significant role they have played in our city’s growth and prosperity."
paras.zh: 汉威尔市长对 CarlisleCBF 来到该市表示感谢。 “近 65 年来，卡莱尔一直是麦地那社区的一部分，提供了良好的就业机会和强大的经济基础，”汉威尔市长说。 “我们很自豪能够庆祝他们的 100 周年纪念日，并认识到他们在我们城市的发展和繁荣中发挥的重要作用。”

paras.en: CarlisleCBF, a brand of CentroMotion, was founded in 1925 and has grown to become a global leader in its field, serving a wide range of markets including agriculture, construction, and mining.
paras.zh: CarlisleCBF 是 CentroMotion 旗下品牌，成立于 1925 年，现已发展成为该领域的全球领导者，服务于农业、建筑和采矿等广泛市场。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a leading global provider of highly engineered and integrated brake and friction solutions for a wide range of industrial applications. With over 100 years of experience, the company is dedicated to delivering innovative, reliable, and high-performance products to its customers worldwide.
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是 CentroMotion 旗下品牌，是一家为各种工业应用提供精心设计的集成制动和摩擦解决方案的全球领先供应商。该公司拥有 100 多年的经验，致力于为全球客户提供创新、可靠和高性能的产品。

articles.title: CentroMotion @Agritechnica 2025

paras.en: Agritechnica 2025 was an incredible opportunity to connect with industry leaders, customers, and partners from around the world. We want to extend a sincere thank you to everyone who visited the CarlisleCBF and CentroMotion team at the show.
paras.zh: Agritechnica 2025 是一个与来自世界各地的行业领导者、客户和合作伙伴建立联系的绝佳机会。我们要向在展会上参观 CarlisleCBF 和 CentroMotion 团队的所有人致以诚挚的谢意。

From advanced friction technologies to solutions designed for the future of farming, this video gives you a front-row look at what makes Carlisle Brake & Friction a trusted partner in the Ag market.
paras.zh: 我们很高兴分享 CentroMotion Agritechnica 2025 视频，该视频捕捉了我们展台的活力并突出了我们展示的创新农业设备产品。从先进的摩擦技术到为未来农业设计的解决方案，该视频让您直观地了解是什么让 Carlisle Brake & Friction 成为农业市场值得信赖的合作伙伴。

paras.en: 👉 Watch the video here: [Agritechnica 2025 Video]
paras.zh: 👉在这里观看视频：[Agritechnica 2025 视频]

paras.en: Thank you again for making Agritechnica 2025 a success. We look forward to continuing the conversation and driving innovation together!
paras.zh: 再次感谢您使 Agritechnica 2025 取得成功。我们期待继续对话并共同推动创新！

articles.title: ASE Education Foundation Launches $25M Federal Apprenticeship Grant
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The award comes through the Department’s Pay-for-Performance Incentive Payments Program, and the idea behind it is simple: reward registered apprenticeship sponsors for hiring apprentices and coaching them through the make-or-break first year on the job. Program sponsors — dealer groups, shop associations, franchise operators and similar organizations — can receive $3,500 for every apprentice they bring on and keep, paid in two parts as the new technician reaches 90 and 270 days on the job.
paras.zh: 该奖项来自该部门的绩效工资奖励计划，其背后的想法很简单：奖励注册学徒赞助商雇用学徒并指导他们度过工作成败的第一年。项目赞助商——经销商团体、商店协会、特许经营经营者和类似组织——每招收和留用一名学徒即可获得 3,500 美元，当新技术人员工作满 90 天和 270 天时分两部分支付。

paras.en: “This launch of this program lets us do something the industry has needed for a long time: open a clear, paid path into the trade, and give employers a proven way to invest in and grow the people who keep this country moving,” said Mike Coley, President, ASE Education Foundation. “We’re not just filling jobs. We’re building careers that can support a family for a lifetime, strengthening the shops and dealers that serve their communities, and protecting the motoring public who trusts all of us every time they start their car.”
paras.zh: ASE 教育基金会主席迈克·科利 (Mike Coley) 表示：“该计划的推出让我们能够做行业长期以来一直需要的事情：开辟一条清晰的、有偿的进入行业的道路，并为雇主提供一种行之有效的方法来投资和培养推动国家前进的人才。” “我们不仅仅是在填补工作岗位。我们正在建立能够养活一个家庭一生的职业，加强为社区服务的商店和经销商，并保护每次启动汽车时都信任我们的汽车公众。”

paras.en: The Foundation is actively recruiting partners in all 50 states, the five territories and the District of Columbia, and apprenticeships will be created all across the industry; in franchised dealerships, retail chains, fleets, body shops, truck and diesel repair shops, and independent auto repair shops. Current RA Program sponsors who are ready to step up, put apprentices to work, and start receiving incentive payments can apply today at ASEeducationFoundation.org/apprenticeship/sponsor-application.
paras.zh: 基金会正在全美 50 个州、五个地区和哥伦比亚特区积极招募合作伙伴，并将在整个行业内设立学徒岗位；特许经销商、零售连锁店、车队、车身维修店、卡车和柴油维修店以及独立汽车维修店。目前的 RA 计划赞助商如果准备好站出来，让学徒工作并开始接收奖励金，可以立即在 ASEeducationFoundation.org/apprenticeship/sponsor-application 进行申请。
